import { getExerciseImage, getUserExercisePhoto } from '@/lib/exerciseImages';
import { Dumbbell, Camera, Loader2, ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';

// Shows a demonstration photo for an exercise, inline (no links).
// `compact` renders a small thumbnail (for dense lists like program rows).
// `userPhoto` overrides the default image with a user-uploaded photo.
// `slug` auto-loads a user-uploaded photo from localStorage if userPhoto isn't passed.
// `onUpload` enables an upload button overlay.
// When no photo is available, shows a placeholder with an upload prompt.
export default function ExerciseVideo({ name, videoUrl, instructions, compact, muscleGroup, userPhoto, slug, onUpload, uploading }) {
  const resolvedUserPhoto = userPhoto || (slug ? getUserExercisePhoto(slug) : null);
  const url = resolvedUserPhoto || videoUrl || getExerciseImage(name, muscleGroup);

  if (compact) {
    return (
      <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-lg overflow-hidden shrink-0 border border-border/50 bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center">
        {url ? (
          <Image src={url} alt={`${name} form demonstration`} className="block w-full h-full" fittingType="fill" />
        ) : (
          <Dumbbell size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mb-3">
      <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-border/50 bg-background/40">
        <div className="relative aspect-video w-full">
          {url ? (
            <Image src={url} alt={`${name} form demonstration`} className="block w-full h-full" fittingType="fill" />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-muted/20">
              <ImageIcon size={32} className="text-muted-foreground/50" />
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70">No demonstration photo</p>
            </div>
          )}
          {onUpload && (
            <button
              onClick={onUpload}
              disabled={uploading}
              className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 glass-strong rounded-full p-2.5 tap-min flex items-center justify-center text-luxury-blue disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Upload your own demonstration photo"
            >
              {uploading ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <Camera size={16} />}
            </button>
          )}
          {resolvedUserPhoto && (
            <span className="absolute top-2 left-2 text-[9px] font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full glass-strong text-luxury-blue">
              Your photo
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          <Dumbbell size={11} className="text-luxury-blue" /> How to do {name}
        </div>
        {instructions && (
          <div className="px-3 pb-3 pt-1">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1">How to perform</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-foreground/80 leading-relaxed">{instructions}</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/exercises/anatomyMuscles.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { FRONT_PATHS, BACK_PATHS } from '@/components/exercises/anatomyPaths';

const RULES = [
  [/full body|cardio|conditioning/, 'all'], [/upper chest|clavicular/, 'upper_chest'],
  [/lower chest/, 'lower_chest'], [/chest|pectoral/, 'chest'],
  [/rear delt|posterior delt/, 'rear_delts'], [/shoulder|delt/, 'deltoids'],
  [/bicep/, 'biceps'], [/brachialis/, 'brachialis'], [/tricep/, 'triceps'],
  [/forearm|brachioradialis/, 'forearms'], [/grip/, 'grip'], [/oblique/, 'obliques'],
  [/core/, 'core'], [/\babs\b|abdominis|abdominal/, 'abs'], [/quad|rectus femoris|vastus/, 'quads'],
  [/tibialis/, 'tibialis'], [/hip flexor|iliopsoas/, 'hip_flexors'],
  [/inner thigh|adductor/, 'inner_thighs'], [/neck/, 'neck'], [/rotator|infraspinatus|teres minor/, 'rotator_cuff'],
  [/lower trap/, 'lower_traps'], [/upper back|rhomboid/, 'upper_back'],
  [/lower back|erector/, 'lower_back'], [/trap/, 'traps'], [/latissimus|\blats?\b/, 'lats'],
  [/back/, 'back'], [/glute(?:us)? medius|glute medius/, 'glute_medius'],
  [/glute/, 'glutes'], [/hamstring|biceps femoris|semitendinosus/, 'hamstrings'],
  [/soleus/, 'soleus'], [/calf|calves|gastrocnemius/, 'calves'], [/arm/, 'arms'],
];
const POSTERIOR = new Set(['rear_delts', 'triceps', 'rotator_cuff', 'lats', 'upper_back', 'lower_back', 'lower_traps', 'traps', 'back', 'glutes', 'glute_medius', 'hamstrings', 'calves', 'soleus']);
const GROUPS = { core: ['abs', 'obliques'], back: ['lats', 'upper_back', 'lower_back'], arms: ['biceps', 'triceps'], all: ['chest', 'deltoids', 'biceps', 'forearms', 'abs', 'obliques', 'quads', 'calves'] };
const keyFor = (name) => RULES.find(([pattern]) => pattern.test(String(name || '').toLowerCase()))?.[1];
const expand = (key) => GROUPS[key] || (key ? [key] : []);

export default function getAnatomyMuscles(primaryMuscle, secondaryMuscles = []) {
  const primary = keyFor(primaryMuscle);
  const view = POSTERIOR.has(primary) ? 'back' : 'front';
  const paths = view === 'back' ? BACK_PATHS : FRONT_PATHS;
  const active = new Map();
  (Array.isArray(secondaryMuscles) ? secondaryMuscles : []).forEach((name) => {
    expand(keyFor(name)).forEach((key) => active.set(key, 'secondary'));
  });
  expand(primary).forEach((key) => active.set(key, 'primary'));
  const highlights = [...active].flatMap(([key, role]) => (paths[key] || []).map((d) => ({ key, role, d })));
  return { view, highlights };
}

FILE: src/components/habits/HabitLogHistory.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import RecordEditor from '@/components/records/RecordEditor';
import { recordsChanged } from '@/lib/recordEditing';
const FIELDS = [{ key: 'date', label: 'Completion date', type: 'date', required: true }];

export default function HabitLogHistory({ habit, onClose, onChanged }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const data = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['habit-history', habit.id], initialPageParam: undefined, queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => base44.entities.HabitLog.filter({ habit_id: habit.id }, { sort: '-date', limit: 50, cursor: pageParam }), getNextPageParam: page => page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined });
  const remove = async record => {
    setBusy(true); setError('');
    try { await base44.entities.HabitLog.delete(record.id); setConfirm(null); recordsChanged('HabitLog'); await onChanged(); }
    catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Could not delete this completion.'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  if (editing) return <RecordEditor entity="HabitLog" record={editing} fields={FIELDS} title="Edit completion date" onClose={() => setEditing(null)} onSaved={onChanged} />;
  return <Dialog open onOpenChange={open => { if (!open && !busy) onClose(); }}><DialogContent className="record-dialog">
    <DialogTitle>{habit.name} history</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Edit a previous completion date or delete an incorrect entry.</DialogDescription>
    {data.isLoading && <p role="status">Loading completions…</p>}
    {(error || data.error) && <p role="alert" className="text-destructive text-sm">{error || 'Could not load completions.'}</p>}
    <div className="divide-y divide-border">{data.data?.pages.flatMap(page => page.items).map(record => <div key={record.id} className="py-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><span className="text-sm">{record.date}</span><div className="flex gap-1">
      {confirm === record.id ? <><Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirm(null)}>Cancel</Button><Button size="sm" variant="destructive" disabled={busy} onClick={() => remove(record)}>{busy ? 'Deleting…' : 'Confirm delete'}</Button></> : <><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEditing(record)}>Edit</Button><Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-destructive" onClick={() => setConfirm(record.id)}>Delete</Button></>}
    </div></div>)}</div>
    {data.isSuccess && !data.data.pages[0].items.length && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No completions saved yet.</p>}
    {data.hasNextPage && <Button variant="outline" disabled={data.isFetchingNextPage} onClick={() => data.fetchNextPage()}>{data.isFetchingNextPage ? 'Loading…' : 'Load older completions'}</Button>}
  </DialogContent></Dialog>;
}

import React from 'react';
import { ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';

export default function DashboardWidgetOption({ item, definition, onChange, onMove, first, last }) {
  return <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 space-y-2">
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-sm font-medium">{definition.label}</p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{definition.category}{item.added ? item.enabled ? ' · Enabled' : ' · Disabled' : ''}</p></div>
      {item.added ? <Switch aria-label={`Enable ${definition.label}`} checked={item.enabled} onCheckedChange={enabled => onChange({ enabled })} /> : <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onChange({ added: true, enabled: true })}><Plus size={16} /> Add</Button>}
    </div>
    {item.added && <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label={`Move ${definition.label} up`} disabled={first} onClick={() => onMove(-1)}><ChevronUp size={16} /></Button>
      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label={`Move ${definition.label} down`} disabled={last} onClick={() => onMove(1)}><ChevronDown size={16} /></Button>
      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onChange({ size: item.size === 'compact' ? 'standard' : 'compact' })}>{item.size === 'compact' ? 'Compact view' : 'Standard view'}</Button>
      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" aria-label={`Remove ${definition.label}`} onClick={() => onChange({ added: false })}><Trash2 size={16} /></Button>
    </div>}
  </div>;
}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, Search, ScanLine, Plus, Star, Minus, Check, ChevronRight, Layers, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { FOODS, foodFactor, parseQty, isPer100g, defaultQty } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';
import FullScreenPage from '@/components/nutrition/FullScreenPage';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const MEALS = ['Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Snack', 'Pre-Workout', 'Post-Workout'];

export default function AddFoodPage({
  onClose, selectedMeal, setSelectedMeal,
  customFoods, favorites, toggleFavorite, addFood,
  recentFoods, savedMeals, onLogSavedMeal,
  onScan, onQuickAdd, onBuildMeal, onCopyDay, onCreateFood
}) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('search');
  const [detailFood, setDetailFood] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  const allFoods = useMemo(() => [...(customFoods || []), ...FOODS], [customFoods]);
  const favNames = useMemo(() => new Set((favorites || []).map((f) => f.ref_id)), [favorites]);

  const searchResults = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!q) return [];
    return allFoods.filter((f) => f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 50);
  }, [search, allFoods]);

  const quickAdd = (food) => {
    addFood(food, defaultQty(food));
    setToast(`Added ${food.name}`);
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 1500);
  };

  if (detailFood) {
    return (
      <FoodDetailPage
        food={detailFood}
        onBack={() => setDetailFood(null)}
        onClose={onClose}
        selectedMeal={selectedMeal}
        setSelectedMeal={setSelectedMeal}
        addFood={addFood}
        isFavorite={favNames.has(detailFood.name)}
        onToggleFavorite={() => toggleFavorite(detailFood)}
      />
    );
  }

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'search', label: 'Search' },
    { id: 'recent', label: 'Recent' },
    { id: 'myfoods', label: 'My Foods' },
    { id: 'meals', label: 'Meals' },
  ];

  return (
    <FullScreenPage>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center px-2 pt-2 safe-pt shrink-0">
        <button onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center">
          <ChevronLeft size={24} />
        </button>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold flex-1 truncate">Add to {selectedMeal}</h2>
        <button onClick={onScan} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center">
          <ScanLine size={20} />
        </button>
        <button onClick={onQuickAdd} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center">
          <Plus size={22} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Search bar */}
      <div className="px-4 py-2 shrink-0">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
          <Input
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); if (tab !== 'search') setTab('search'); }}
            placeholder="Search foods..."
            className="pl-9 h-11 w-full"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-border px-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar shrink-0">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
            className={cn(
              'px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap min-h-[44px] flex items-center transition-colors',
              tab === t.id ? 'text-luxury-blue border-b-2 border-luxury-blue' : 'text-muted-foreground'
            )}
          >
            {t.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 min-h-0">
        {tab === 'search' && (
          <FoodList
            foods={searchResults}
            onPick={setDetailFood}
            onQuickAdd={quickAdd}
            favNames={favNames}
            emptyMessage={search ? 'No foods found. Try a different search.' : 'Start typing to search the food database.'}
          />
        )}
        {tab === 'recent' && (
          <FoodList
            foods={recentFoods}
            onPick={setDetailFood}
            onQuickAdd={quickAdd}
            favNames={favNames}
            emptyMessage="No recent foods yet. Foods you log will appear here for quick access."
          />
        )}
        {tab === 'myfoods' && (
          <>
            <FoodList
              foods={customFoods}
              onPick={setDetailFood}
              onQuickAdd={quickAdd}
              favNames={favNames}
              emptyMessage="No custom foods yet."
            />
            <button onClick={onCreateFood} className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-3 mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-luxury-blue min-h-[48px]">
              <Plus size={16} /> Create Food
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {tab === 'meals' && (
          <>
            <SavedMealsList meals={savedMeals} onLog={(m) => { onLogSavedMeal(m); onClose(); }} />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-3 mb-4">
              <button onClick={onBuildMeal} className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-xl glass text-sm font-medium min-h-[48px]">
                <Layers size={16} /> Build Meal
              </button>
              <button onClick={onCopyDay} className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-xl glass text-sm font-medium min-h-[48px]">
                <Copy size={16} /> Copy Day
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 glass-strong px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-medium animate-fade-up z-10 whitespace-nowrap">
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}
    </FullScreenPage>
  );
}

function FoodList({ foods, onPick, onQuickAdd, favNames, emptyMessage }) {
  if (!foods || foods.length === 0) {
    return <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-10 px-4">{emptyMessage}</p>;
  }
  return (
    <div>
      {foods.map((f) => (
        <div key={f.name} className="flex items-center gap-2 py-3 border-b border-border/40">
          <button onClick={() => onPick(f)} className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" dir="auto">{f.name}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              {isPer100g(f) ? `${f.calories} kcal / 100g` : `${f.calories} kcal / ${f.quantity}${f.unit}`}
            </p>
          </button>
          {favNames.has(f.name) && <Star size={14} className="text-luxury-gold fill-current shrink-0" />}
          <button
            onClick={() => onQuickAdd(f)}
            className="w-11 h-11 rounded-lg bg-luxury-blue/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 active:bg-luxury-blue/25 transition-colors"
            aria-label={`Quick add ${f.name}`}
          >
            <Plus size={18} className="text-luxury-blue" />
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function SavedMealsList({ meals, onLog }) {
  if (!meals || meals.length === 0) {
    return <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-10 px-4">No saved meals yet.</p>;
  }
  return (
    <div>
      {meals.map((m) => (
        <button
          key={m.id}
          onClick={() => onLog(m)}
          className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 py-3 border-b border-border/40 text-left"
        >
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" dir="auto">{m.name}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              {Math.round(m.total_calories || 0)} kcal · {(m.items || []).length} foods
            </p>
          </div>
          <ChevronRight size={18} className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function FoodDetailPage({ food, onBack, onClose, selectedMeal, setSelectedMeal, addFood, isFavorite, onToggleFavorite }) {
  const [qty, setQty] = useState('');
  const per100 = isPer100g(food);
  const dq = defaultQty(food);
  const q = qty !== '' ? parseQty(qty) : dq;
  const factor = foodFactor(food, q);
  const grams = per100 ? +(q * 100).toFixed(1) : null;

  const inc = () => setQty(String(+(q + 1).toFixed(2)));
  const dec = () => setQty(String(+Math.max(0.5, q - 1).toFixed(2)));

  const handleAdd = () => {
    addFood(food, qty !== '' ? qty : dq);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <FullScreenPage>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center px-2 pt-2 safe-pt shrink-0">
        <button onClick={onBack} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center">
          <ChevronLeft size={24} />
        </button>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold flex-1 truncate" dir="auto">{food.name}</h2>
        <button onClick={onToggleFavorite} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center">
          <Star size={20} className={isFavorite ? 'text-luxury-gold fill-current' : 'text-muted-foreground'} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 min-h-0">
        {/* Amount */}
        <div className="mb-6">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2">Amount</p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={dec} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl glass flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 active:bg-muted/40 transition-colors">
              <Minus size={20} />
            </button>
            <Input
              type="text"
              inputMode="decimal"
              value={qty}
              onChange={(e) => setQty(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={String(dq)}
              className="flex-1 h-14 text-center text-2xl tabular-nums font-bold min-w-0"
              autoFocus
            />
            <button onClick={inc} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl glass flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 active:bg-muted/40 transition-colors">
              <Plus size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2 text-center">
            {per100 ? `${q} × 100g = ${grams}g` : `${q} ${food.unit || ''}`}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Nutrition preview */}
        <div className="glass rounded-xl p-4 mb-6">
          <div className="text-center mb-4">
            <p className="text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums text-luxury-red">
              {Math.round((food.calories || 0) * factor)}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">kcal</p>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
            <div>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-luxury-blue">{+((food.protein_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1)}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Protein g</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{+((food.carbs_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1)}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Carbs g</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{+((food.fat_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1)}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Fat g</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Meal selector */}
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2">Meal</p>
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
            {MEALS.map((m) => (
              <button
                key={m}
                onClick={() => setSelectedMeal(m)}
                className={cn(
                  'text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap min-h-[40px] flex items-center transition-colors',
                  selectedMeal === m ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground'
                )}
              >
                {m}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sticky bottom action */}
      <div className="px-4 pt-3 pb-4 safe-pb border-t border-border/40 shrink-0">
        <Button
          className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[52px] text-base font-semibold"
          onClick={handleAdd}
        >
          <Check size={18} /> Add to {selectedMeal}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </FullScreenPage>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/BarcodeScanner.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Camera, X, Check, AlertCircle, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { foodItemToFood } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';

// Barcode scanner using the native BarcodeDetector API where available, with
// manual barcode entry fallback. Looks up the barcode in the user's custom
// FoodItem records first; if not found, lets the user enter nutrition manually.
// Deterministic — no AI, no credits.
export default function BarcodeScanner({ selectedMeal, onLogged, onClose }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('idle'); // idle | scanning | found | notfound
  const [barcode, setBarcode] = useState('');
  const [food, setFood] = useState(null);
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [manual, setManual] = useState({ name: '', calories: '', protein_g: '', carbs_g: '', fat_g: '', serving_size: 100, serving_unit: 'g' });
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const streamRef = useRef(null);
  const rafRef = useRef(null);

  const hasBarcodeDetector = typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BarcodeDetector' in window;

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (rafRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    rafRef.current = null;
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => () => stopCamera(), [stopCamera]);

  const startCamera = async () => {
    if (!hasBarcodeDetector) return;
    setMode('scanning');
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment' } });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      const video = videoRef.current;
      if (!video) return;
      video.srcObject = stream;
      await video.play();
      const detector = new window.BarcodeDetector({ formats: ['ean_13', 'ean_8', 'upc_a', 'upc_e', 'code_128'] });
      const tick = async () => {
        try {
          const codes = await detector.detect(video);
          if (codes && codes.length) {
            setBarcode(codes[0].rawValue);
            stopCamera();
            lookupBarcode(codes[0].rawValue);
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) { /* frame not ready */ }
        rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      tick();
    } catch (e) {
      setMode('idle');
      console.error('Camera error', e);
    }
  };

  const lookupBarcode = async (code) => {
    try {
      const items = await base44.entities.FoodItem.filter({ barcode: code });
      if (items && items.length) {
        setFood(foodItemToFood(items[0]));
        setMode('found');
      } else {
        setMode('notfound');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setMode('notfound');
    }
  };

  const manualLookup = () => {
    if (!barcode.trim()) return;
    lookupBarcode(barcode.trim());
  };

  const logFood = async (f) => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const factor = Number(qty) || 1;
      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      await base44.entities.NutritionLog.create({
        date: today, meal: selectedMeal, food_name: f.name,
        quantity: factor * (f.quantity || 1), unit: f.unit || 'serving',
        calories: Math.round((f.calories || 0) * factor),
        protein_g: +((f.protein_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        carbs_g: +((f.carbs_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        fat_g: +((f.fat_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        fiber_g: +((f.fiber_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        sugar_g: +((f.sugar_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        sodium_mg: Math.round((f.sodium_mg || 0) * factor),
        source: 'Barcode', is_ai_estimated: false, logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      onLogged();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const saveManual = async () => {
    if (!manual.name.trim() || !manual.calories) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const f = {
        name: manual.name,
        calories: Number(manual.calories) || 0,
        protein_g: Number(manual.protein_g) || 0,
        carbs_g: Number(manual.carbs_g) || 0,
        fat_g: Number(manual.fat_g) || 0,
        unit: manual.serving_unit,
        quantity: 1,
      };
      // Save as custom food with barcode for future scans
      await base44.entities.FoodItem.create({
        name: manual.name, barcode: barcode.trim(),
        serving_size: Number(manual.serving_size) || 100, serving_unit: manual.serving_unit,
        calories_per_serving: f.calories, protein_g: f.protein_g, carbs_g: f.carbs_g, fat_g: f.fat_g,
        category: 'Custom', is_custom: true,
      }).catch(() => {});
      await logFood(f);
    } catch (e) { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose} onBackdropClick={() => { stopCamera(); onClose(); }}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Barcode Scanner</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => { stopCamera(); onClose(); }}><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>

        {mode === 'idle' && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {hasBarcodeDetector ? (
              <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]" onClick={startCamera}><Camera size={18} /> Start Camera Scan</Button>
            ) : (
              <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-2 border border-luxury-gold/30">
                <AlertCircle size={16} className="text-luxury-gold shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Camera barcode scanning isn't supported on this browser. Enter the barcode manually below.</p>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Input value={barcode} onChange={(e) => setBarcode(e.target.value)} placeholder="Enter barcode…" className="glass h-11 tabular-nums" inputMode="numeric" />
              <Button variant="outline" className="glass" onClick={manualLookup} disabled={!barcode.trim()}><Search size={16} /> Look Up</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {mode === 'scanning' && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-black aspect-[4/3]">
              <video ref={videoRef} className="w-full h-full object-cover" playsInline muted />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                <div className="w-4/5 h-16 border-2 border-luxury-blue rounded-lg" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-center text-muted-foreground">Point the camera at a product barcode…</p>
            <Button variant="outline" className="w-full glass" onClick={() => { stopCamera(); setMode('idle'); }}>Cancel</Button>
          </div>
        )}

        {mode === 'found' && food && (
          <div className="space-y-3 animate-fade-up">
            <div className="rounded-xl glass p-3">
              <p className="font-semibold text-sm">{food.name}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">Barcode: {barcode}</p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center">
                <Macro label="kcal" value={Math.round(food.calories || 0)} accent="red" />
                <Macro label="P" value={Math.round(food.protein_g || 0)} accent="blue" />
                <Macro label="C" value={Math.round(food.carbs_g || 0)} />
                <Macro label="F" value={Math.round(food.fat_g || 0)} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Servings</span>
              <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={qty} onChange={(e) => setQty(e.target.value)} className="glass h-9 w-20 text-center tabular-nums" />
            </div>
            <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-red glow-red min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => logFood(food)} disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Log It</>}</Button>
          </div>
        )}

        {mode === 'notfound' && (
          <div className="space-y-3 animate-fade-up">
            <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-2 border border-luxury-gold/30">
              <AlertCircle size={16} className="text-luxury-gold shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No food found for barcode <span className="tabular-nums">{barcode}</span>. Enter the nutrition from the label and it'll be saved for future scans.</p>
            </div>
            <Input value={manual.name} onChange={(e) => setManual({ ...manual, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Food name" className="glass h-10" />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
              <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={manual.calories} onChange={(e) => setManual({ ...manual, calories: e.target.value })} placeholder="kcal" className="glass h-10 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" />
              <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={manual.protein_g} onChange={(e) => setManual({ ...manual, protein_g: e.target.value })} placeholder="P g" className="glass h-10 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" />
              <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={manual.carbs_g} onChange={(e) => setManual({ ...manual, carbs_g: e.target.value })} placeholder="C g" className="glass h-10 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" />
              <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={manual.fat_g} onChange={(e) => setManual({ ...manual, fat_g: e.target.value })} placeholder="F g" className="glass h-10 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" />
            </div>
            <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={saveManual} disabled={saving || !manual.name.trim() || !manual.calories}>{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Save & Log</>}</Button>
          </div>
        )}
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}

function Macro({ label, value, accent }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col">
      <span className={cn('text-base font-bold tabular-nums', accent === 'red' ? 'text-luxury-red' : accent === 'blue' ? 'text-luxury-blue' : 'text-foreground')}>{value}</span>
      <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/CopyMealSheet.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { X, Copy, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';

const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

// Copy meals/foods from a previous day to today. Deterministic — no AI.
export default function CopyMealSheet({ onClose, onCopied }) {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  const load = async () => {
    try {
      // Load last 14 days of logs
      const since = new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const all = await base44.entities.NutritionLog.filter({ date: { $gte: since } }, '-date', 200);
      setLogs((all || []).filter((l) => (l.date || '') < TODAY));
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const byDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    for (const l of logs) {
      if (!l.date || l.food_name === 'Water') continue;
      if (!map[l.date]) map[l.date] = { date: l.date, calories: 0, items: [] };
      map[l.date].calories += l.calories || 0;
      map[l.date].items.push(l);
    }
    return map;
  }, [logs]);

  const dates = Object.keys(byDate).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));

  const copyDay = async () => {
    if (!selectedDate) return;
    const entries = (byDate[selectedDate].items || []).map((l) => ({
      date: TODAY, meal: l.meal || 'Snack', food_name: l.food_name,
      quantity: l.quantity, unit: l.unit, calories: l.calories,
      protein_g: l.protein_g, carbs_g: l.carbs_g, fat_g: l.fat_g,
      fiber_g: l.fiber_g, sugar_g: l.sugar_g, sodium_mg: l.sodium_mg,
      source: l.source || 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }));
    try {
      if (entries.length) await base44.entities.NutritionLog.bulkCreate(entries);
      onCopied();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Copy from Previous Day</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose}><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-8"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>
        ) : dates.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-8">No previous days with logged food found.</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
              {dates.map((d) => {
                const day = byDate[d];
                const date = new Date(d + 'T00:00:00');
                return (
                  <button key={d} onClick={() => setSelectedDate(d)} className={cn('w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl transition-all', selectedDate === d ? 'glass border border-luxury-blue/50 glow-blue' : 'glass')}>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{date.toLocaleDateString('default', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{day.items.length} foods · {Math.round(day.calories)} kcal</p>
                      </div>
                      <Calendar size={16} className={cn(selectedDate === d ? 'text-luxury-blue' : 'text-muted-foreground')} />
                    </div>
                    {selectedDate === d && (
                      <div className="mt-2 space-y-1 border-t border-border/30 pt-2">
                        {day.items.slice(0, 6).map((it, i) => (
                          <p key={i} className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{it.food_name} · {it.meal}</p>
                        ))}
                        {day.items.length > 6 && <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">+{day.items.length - 6} more</p>}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={copyDay} disabled={!selectedDate}><Copy size={16} /> Copy to Today</Button>
          </>
        )}
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/FoodScanner.jsx

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Search, X, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { FOODS, FOOD_CATEGORIES } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';

// Deterministic food picker — searches the built-in local database. No AI, no credits.
export default function FoodScanner({ selectedMeal, onLogged, onClose }) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('All');
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(null);
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const results = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
    return FOODS.filter((f) => {
      if (category !== 'All' && f.category !== category) return false;
      if (q && !f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    }).slice(0, 40);
  }, [search, category]);

  const confirm = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const factor = Number(qty) || 1;
      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      await base44.entities.NutritionLog.create({
        date: today, meal: selectedMeal, food_name: picked.name,
        quantity: factor * (picked.quantity || 1), unit: picked.unit || 'serving',
        calories: Math.round((picked.calories || 0) * factor),
        protein_g: +((picked.protein_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        carbs_g: +((picked.carbs_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        fat_g: +((picked.fat_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        fiber_g: +((picked.fiber_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
        sodium_mg: Math.round((picked.sodium_mg || 0) * factor),
        source: 'Database', is_ai_estimated: false, logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      onLogged();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Quick Add Food</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>

        {!picked && (
          <>
            <div className="relative mb-3">
              <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search the food database…" className="pl-9 glass" autoFocus />
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar mb-3">
              {FOOD_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                <button key={c} onClick={() => setCategory(c)} className={cn('text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap min-h-[36px]', category === c ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue' : 'border-border glass text-muted-foreground')}>{c}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {results.map((f, i) => (
                <button key={i} onClick={() => setPicked(f)} className="w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl glass hover:bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{f.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{f.category} · {f.quantity}{f.unit}</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-luxury-red shrink-0">{f.calories}<span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground"> kcal</span></span>
                </button>
              ))}
              {!results.length && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-8">No foods found. Try a different search or category.</p>}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {picked && (
          <div className="space-y-3 animate-fade-up">
            <div className="rounded-xl glass p-3">
              <p className="font-semibold text-sm">{picked.name}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">{picked.category} · per {picked.quantity}{picked.unit}</p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center">
                <Macro label="kcal" value={Math.round(picked.calories || 0)} accent="red" />
                <Macro label="P" value={Math.round(picked.protein_g || 0)} accent="blue" />
                <Macro label="C" value={Math.round(picked.carbs_g || 0)} />
                <Macro label="F" value={Math.round(picked.fat_g || 0)} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Servings</span>
              <Input type="number" value={qty} onChange={(e) => setQty(e.target.value)} className="glass h-9 w-20 text-center tabular-nums" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Values from the built-in food database (USDA-equivalent averages). Estimates for tracking, not clinical values.</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1 glass" onClick={() => setPicked(null)}>Back</Button>
              <Button className="flex-1 bg-luxury-red glow-red" onClick={confirm} disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Log It</>}</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}

function Macro({ label, value, accent }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col">
      <span className={cn('text-base font-bold tabular-nums', accent === 'red' ? 'text-luxury-red' : accent === 'blue' ? 'text-luxury-blue' : 'text-foreground')}>{value}</span>
      <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/MealBuilder.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, Pill } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Plus, X, Search, Trash2, Save, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { FOODS, FOOD_CATEGORIES, foodFactor, parseQty, isPer100g, defaultQty } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';

const MEALS = ['Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Snack', 'Pre-Workout', 'Post-Workout'];
const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

export default function MealBuilder({ onClose, selectedMeal, setSelectedMeal, onLogged, customFoods }) {
  const [tray, setTray] = useState([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('All');
  const [mealName, setMealName] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [logging, setLogging] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  const allFoods = useMemo(() => [...(customFoods || []), ...FOODS], [customFoods]);
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = category === 'All' ? allFoods : allFoods.filter((f) => f.category === category);
    if (search) list = list.filter((f) => f.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
    return list.slice(0, 40);
  }, [search, category, allFoods]);

  const totals = useMemo(() => tray.reduce((a, t) => ({
    calories: a.calories + t.calories, protein: a.protein + t.protein_g,
    carbs: a.carbs + t.carbs_g, fat: a.fat + t.fat_g, fiber: a.fiber + t.fiber_g,
    sugar: a.sugar + t.sugar_g, sodium: a.sodium + t.sodium_mg,
  }), { calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0, fiber: 0, sugar: 0, sodium: 0 }), [tray]);

  const addToTray = (food) => {
    const dq = defaultQty(food);
    setTray((t) => [...t, { ...food, _id: Date.now() + Math.random(), qty: dq, calories: food.calories, protein_g: food.protein_g, carbs_g: food.carbs_g, fat_g: food.fat_g, fiber_g: food.fiber_g, sugar_g: food.sugar_g, sodium_mg: food.sodium_mg }]);
  };

  const updateQty = (id, qtyRaw) => {
    const qty = parseQty(qtyRaw);
    setTray((t) => t.map((item) => {
      if (item._id !== id) return item;
      const base = allFoods.find((f) => f.name === item.name);
      if (!base || !qty) return { ...item, qty: qtyRaw, calories: 0, protein_g: 0, carbs_g: 0, fat_g: 0, fiber_g: 0, sugar_g: 0, sodium_mg: 0 };
      const factor = foodFactor(base, qty);
      return { ...item, qty: qtyRaw, calories: Math.round((base.calories || 0) * factor), protein_g: +((base.protein_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1), carbs_g: +((base.carbs_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1), fat_g: +((base.fat_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1), fiber_g: +((base.fiber_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1), sugar_g: +((base.sugar_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1), sodium_mg: Math.round((base.sodium_mg || 0) * factor) };
    }));
  };

  const removeItem = (id) => setTray((t) => t.filter((i) => i._id !== id));

  const buildEntries = () => tray.map((item) => {
    const base = allFoods.find((f) => f.name === item.name) || item;
    const qty = parseQty(item.qty);
    const factor = foodFactor(base, qty);
    const storedQty = isPer100g(base) ? +(qty * 100).toFixed(1) : qty;
    return {
      date: TODAY, meal: selectedMeal, food_name: base.name, quantity: storedQty, unit: base.unit,
      calories: Math.round((base.calories || 0) * factor), protein_g: +((base.protein_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      carbs_g: +((base.carbs_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1), fat_g: +((base.fat_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      fiber_g: +((base.fiber_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1), sugar_g: +((base.sugar_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      sodium_mg: Math.round((base.sodium_mg || 0) * factor), source: base._custom ? 'User Entered' : 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  });

  const logToToday = async () => {
    if (!tray.length) return;
    setLogging(true);
    try {
      await base44.entities.NutritionLog.bulkCreate(buildEntries());
      setDone(true);
      setTimeout(() => { onLogged(); onClose(); }, 700);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); setLogging(false); }
  };

  const saveMeal = async () => {
    if (!tray.length || !mealName.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const items = buildEntries().map(({ date, meal, source, logged_at, ...rest }) => rest);
      await base44.entities.SavedMeal.create({
        name: mealName.trim(), meal_type: selectedMeal, items,
        total_calories: Math.round(totals.calories), total_protein_g: +totals.protein.toFixed(1),
      });
      setDone(true);
      setTimeout(() => { onLogged(); onClose(); }, 700);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Build a Meal</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose}><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar mb-3">
          {MEALS.map((m) => <Pill key={m} active={selectedMeal === m} onClick={() => setSelectedMeal(m)}>{m}</Pill>)}
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar mb-3">
          {FOOD_CATEGORIES.map((c) => <Pill key={c} active={category === c} onClick={() => setCategory(c)}>{c}</Pill>)}
        </div>

        <div className="relative mb-3">
          <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input autoFocus value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search foods…" className="pl-9" />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1.5 mb-4">
          {filtered.map((f, i) => (
            <button key={i} onClick={() => addToTray(f)} className="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl glass hover:bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{f.name}{f._custom && <span className="text-[9px] text-luxury-blue ml-1">★</span>}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{isPer100g(f) ? 'Per 100g' : `${f.quantity}${f.unit}`} · {f.calories} kcal · P{f.protein_g} C{f.carbs_g} F{f.fat_g}</p>
              </div>
              <Plus size={16} className="text-luxury-blue shrink-0 ml-2" />
            </button>
          ))}
          {!filtered.length && <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4">No matches.</p>}
        </div>

        {tray.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Meal Tray ({tray.length})</p>
            <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
              {tray.map((item) => (
                <Card key={item._id} className="p-2.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{item.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{Math.round(item.calories)} kcal · P{item.protein_g}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={item.qty} onChange={(e) => updateQty(item._id, e.target.value)} className="h-10 w-16 glass text-center text-xs tabular-nums min-w-0" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground w-8">{item.unit}</span>
                  <button onClick={() => removeItem(item._id)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>

            <Card className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center">
              <TrayStat label="Cal" value={Math.round(totals.calories)} />
              <TrayStat label="Protein" value={Math.round(totals.protein)} unit="g" />
              <TrayStat label="Carbs" value={Math.round(totals.carbs)} unit="g" />
              <TrayStat label="Fat" value={Math.round(totals.fat)} unit="g" />
            </Card>

            <Input value={mealName} onChange={(e) => setMealName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Meal name (to save as reusable)" className="glass h-10 mb-3" />

            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button className="flex-1 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={logToToday} disabled={logging || done}>
                {done ? <><Check size={16} /> Logged</> : logging ? 'Logging…' : 'Log to Today'}
              </Button>
              <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={saveMeal} disabled={saving || done || !mealName.trim()}>
                {done ? <Check size={16} /> : <><Save size={15} /> Save</>}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        {tray.length === 0 && <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-6">Add foods to start building your meal.</p>}
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}

function TrayStat({ label, value, unit }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <span className="text-base font-bold tabular-nums">{value}{unit && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">{unit}</span>}</span>
      <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';

/**
 * Mobile-only Fuel summary card with a visual calorie ring,
 * inline macro bars, and remaining/over indicator.
 * Deterministic — uses only passed-in totals/goal, no AI.
 */
export default function MobileFuelSummary({ totals, goal, onShowDetails }) {
  const calPct = goal?.calorie_target ? Math.min(100, (totals.calories / goal.calorie_target) * 100) : 0;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, (goal?.calorie_target || 0) - totals.calories);
  const over = totals.calories > (goal?.calorie_target || 0);
  const target = goal?.calorie_target || 0;

  const macros = [
    { label: 'P', value: totals.protein, target: goal?.protein_target_g, bar: 'bg-luxury-red' },
    { label: 'C', value: totals.carbs, target: goal?.carb_target_g, bar: 'bg-luxury-blue' },
    { label: 'F', value: totals.fat, target: goal?.fat_target_g, bar: 'bg-luxury-gold' },
  ];

  const size = 88;
  const stroke = 7;
  const radius = (size - stroke) / 2;
  const circ = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const offset = circ - (calPct / 100) * circ;

  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-4 mb-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        {/* Calorie ring */}
        <div className="relative shrink-0" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
          <svg width={size} height={size} className="-rotate-90">
            <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={stroke} className="text-muted/30" />
            <circle
              cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={stroke}
              strokeDasharray={circ} strokeDashoffset={offset} strokeLinecap="round"
              className={cn(over ? 'text-luxury-red' : 'text-luxury-blue', 'transition-all duration-700')}
            />
          </svg>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums leading-none">{Math.round(totals.calories)}</span>
            <span className="text-[8px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">/ {target || '—'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Remaining + macros */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="mb-2">
            <p className={cn('text-base font-bold tabular-nums leading-none', over ? 'text-luxury-red' : 'text-luxury-blue')}>
              {over ? '+' : ''}{Math.round(over ? totals.calories - target : remaining)}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{over ? 'kcal over target' : 'kcal remaining'}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            {macros.map((m) => {
              const pct = m.target ? Math.min(100, (m.value / m.target) * 100) : 0;
              return (
                <div key={m.label} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground w-3">{m.label}</span>
                  <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted/30 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className={cn('h-full rounded-full transition-all', m.bar)} style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] tabular-nums text-muted-foreground w-14 text-right">
                    {Math.round(m.value)}{m.target ? `/${Math.round(m.target)}` : ''}g
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button
        onClick={onShowDetails}
        className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-border/30 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors min-h-[36px]"
      >
        Nutrition Details <ChevronDown size={13} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

/**
 * Clean mobile bottom sheet for Fuel modules.
 *
 * Structural rules:
 * - Uses standard `fixed inset-0` — the global CSS in index.css automatically
 *   reserves 80px + safe-area at the bottom for the fixed Home/Menu nav on
 *   mobile, and reduces that to 0 when the keyboard opens. No double padding.
 * - Panel: one scroll area (overflow-y-auto), no nested scroll containers.
 * - z-50: above page content, below bottom nav (z-60) so nav stays visible.
 * - p-4 only for visual breathing room — the global CSS handles nav clearance.
 * - Desktop: md:max-h-[85vh] keeps the original desktop sheet behavior.
 */
export default function MobileSheet({ onClose, onBackdropClick, children, className }) {
  const handleBackdrop = onBackdropClick || onClose;
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={handleBackdrop} />
      <div className={cn(
        'relative w-full max-w-md mx-auto glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-4',
        'max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto animate-fade-up',
        'md:max-h-[85vh]',
        className
      )}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/MyFoodsSheet.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Plus, X, Pencil, Trash2, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { parseQty } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';

const NUTRIENT_FIELDS = [
  { key: 'calories_per_serving', label: 'Cal', ph: 'kcal' },
  { key: 'protein_g', label: 'Protein', ph: 'P g' },
  { key: 'carbs_g', label: 'Carbs', ph: 'C g' },
  { key: 'fat_g', label: 'Fat', ph: 'F g' },
  { key: 'fiber_g', label: 'Fiber', ph: 'F g' },
  { key: 'sugar_g', label: 'Sugar', ph: 'S g' },
  { key: 'sodium_mg', label: 'Sodium', ph: 'Na mg' },
];

function emptyForm() {
  return { name: '', calories_per_serving: '', protein_g: '', carbs_g: '', fat_g: '', fiber_g: '', sugar_g: '', sodium_mg: '' };
}

export default function MyFoodsSheet({ onClose, onChanged }) {
  const [foods, setFoods] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null); // null | 'new' | existing record
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm());
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const items = await base44.entities.FoodItem.filter({ is_custom: true }, '-created_date', 200);
      setFoods(items || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const startNew = () => { setForm(emptyForm()); setEditing('new'); };
  const startEdit = (f) => {
    setForm({
      name: f.name || '', calories_per_serving: f.calories_per_serving ?? '',
      protein_g: f.protein_g ?? '', carbs_g: f.carbs_g ?? '', fat_g: f.fat_g ?? '',
      fiber_g: f.fiber_g ?? '', sugar_g: f.sugar_g ?? '', sodium_mg: f.sodium_mg ?? '',
    });
    setEditing(f);
  };

  const save = async () => {
    if (!form.name.trim() || form.calories_per_serving === '') return;
    setSaving(true);
    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      serving_size: 100, serving_unit: 'g',
      calories_per_serving: parseQty(form.calories_per_serving),
      protein_g: parseQty(form.protein_g),
      carbs_g: parseQty(form.carbs_g),
      fat_g: parseQty(form.fat_g),
      fiber_g: parseQty(form.fiber_g),
      sugar_g: parseQty(form.sugar_g),
      sodium_mg: parseQty(form.sodium_mg),
      category: 'Custom',
      is_custom: true,
    };
    try {
      if (editing === 'new') {
        await base44.entities.FoodItem.create(payload);
      } else {
        await base44.entities.FoodItem.update(editing.id, payload);
      }
      setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm()); load(); onChanged && onChanged();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const remove = async (id) => {
    try { await base44.entities.FoodItem.delete(id); load(); onChanged && onChanged(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">My Foods</h3>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Custom foods saved per 100g — appear in your search automatically.</p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose}><X size={18} /></Button>
      </div>

      {!editing && (
        <Button className="w-full mb-3 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={startNew}><Plus size={15} /> Create Custom Food</Button>
      )}

      {editing && (
        <Card className="mb-3 p-3 animate-scale-in">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1">{editing === 'new' ? 'New Custom Food' : 'Edit Custom Food'}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">All nutrition values are per 100g. Use '.' or ',' for decimals.</p>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Food name" className="glass h-10" />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
              {NUTRIENT_FIELDS.map((n) => (
                <div key={n.key}>
                  <Label className="text-[9px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">{n.label}</Label>
                  <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={form[n.key]} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, [n.key]: e.target.value })} placeholder={n.ph} className="glass h-10 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button size="sm" className="flex-1 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={save} disabled={saving || !form.name.trim() || form.calories_per_serving === ''}><Save size={14} /> {saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save'}</Button>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => { setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm()); }}>Cancel</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-2">
        {loading && <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4">Loading…</p>}
        {!loading && foods.length === 0 && !editing && <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4">No custom foods yet. Create one to add it to your search.</p>}
        {foods.map((f) => (
          <Card key={f.id} className="p-2.5 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" dir="auto">{f.name}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">Per 100g · {Math.round(f.calories_per_serving || 0)} kcal · P{f.protein_g || 0} C{f.carbs_g || 0} F{f.fat_g || 0}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0 ml-2">
              <button onClick={() => startEdit(f)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue p-1.5 tap-min"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
              <button onClick={() => remove(f.id)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1.5 tap-min"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
            </div>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/NutritionCalendar.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const DOW = ['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S'];

function dayStatus(entry, target) {
  if (!entry) return 'none';
  const calTarget = target?.calorie_target || 0;
  const proTarget = target?.protein_target_g || 0;
  const calRatio = calTarget ? entry.calories / calTarget : 0;
  const proRatio = proTarget ? entry.protein / proTarget : 0;
  if (calRatio >= 0.85 && calRatio <= 1.15 && proRatio >= 0.85) return 'good';
  if (calRatio >= 0.6) return 'close';
  return 'far';
}

const STATUS_CLASS = {
  good: 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30',
  close: 'bg-luxury-gold/15 text-luxury-gold border-luxury-gold/30',
  far: 'bg-luxury-red/15 text-luxury-red border-luxury-red/30',
  none: 'bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground border-border/40',
};

export default function NutritionCalendar({ byDate, target, selectedDate, onSelect }) {
  const [view, setView] = useState(() => {
    const d = selectedDate ? new Date(selectedDate) : new Date();
    return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), 1);
  });
  const year = view.getFullYear();
  const month = view.getMonth();
  const firstDow = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const cells = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < firstDow; i++) cells.push(null);
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) cells.push(d);

  const dateStr = (d) => new Date(year, month, d).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const monthName = view.toLocaleString('default', { month: 'long' });

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <button onClick={() => setView(new Date(year, month - 1, 1))} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg glass min-h-[40px] min-w-[40px] flex items-center justify-center"><ChevronLeft size={16} /></button>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{monthName} {year}</p>
        <button onClick={() => setView(new Date(year, month + 1, 1))} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg glass min-h-[40px] min-w-[40px] flex items-center justify-center"><ChevronRight size={16} /></button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 mb-1.5">
        {DOW.map((d, i) => <div key={i} className="text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">{d}</div>)}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5">
        {cells.map((d, i) => {
          if (!d) return <div key={i} />;
          const ds = dateStr(d);
          const status = dayStatus(byDate[ds], target);
          const selected = ds === selectedDate;
          return (
            <button key={i} onClick={() => onSelect(ds)}
              className={cn('aspect-square rounded-lg border text-xs font-medium flex items-center justify-center min-h-[40px] transition-all',
                STATUS_CLASS[status], selected && 'ring-2 ring-luxury-blue')}>
              {d}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 mt-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
        <Legend color="bg-emerald-400" label="On target" />
        <Legend color="bg-luxury-gold" label="Close" />
        <Legend color="bg-luxury-red" label="Far" />
        <Legend color="bg-muted-foreground/40" label="No data" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Legend({ color, label }) {
  return <div className="flex items-center gap-1"><span className={cn('w-2 h-2 rounded-full', color)} /> {label}</div>;
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { parseQty } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';

const MEALS = ['Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Snack', 'Pre-Workout', 'Post-Workout'];

export default function QuickAdd({ onClose, selectedMeal, setSelectedMeal, addFood }) {
  const [calories, setCalories] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [protein, setProtein] = useState('');
  const [carbs, setCarbs] = useState('');
  const [fat, setFat] = useState('');

  const handleAdd = () => {
    const cal = parseQty(calories);
    if (!cal) return;
    addFood({
      name: name.trim() || 'Quick Add',
      calories: cal,
      protein_g: parseQty(protein) || 0,
      carbs_g: parseQty(carbs) || 0,
      fat_g: parseQty(fat) || 0,
      fiber_g: 0, sugar_g: 0, sodium_mg: 0,
      unit: 'serving', quantity: 1,
    }, 1);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Quick Add</h3>
        <button onClick={onClose} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground p-2 min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"><X size={18} /></button>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1.5">Calories *</p>
          <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={calories} onChange={(e) => setCalories(e.target.value)} placeholder="0" className="glass h-14 text-2xl text-center tabular-nums font-bold" autoFocus />
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1.5">Food name (optional)</p>
          <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Snack" className="glass h-11" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1.5">Meal</p>
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
            {MEALS.map((m) => (
              <button key={m} onClick={() => setSelectedMeal(m)} className={cn('text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap min-h-[36px] flex items-center', selectedMeal === m ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue' : 'border-border glass text-muted-foreground')}>{m}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1.5">Macros (optional)</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={protein} onChange={(e) => setProtein(e.target.value)} placeholder="P g" className="glass h-11 text-center tabular-nums" />
            <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={carbs} onChange={(e) => setCarbs(e.target.value)} placeholder="C g" className="glass h-11 text-center tabular-nums" />
            <Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={fat} onChange={(e) => setFat(e.target.value)} placeholder="F g" className="glass h-11 text-center tabular-nums" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[52px] text-base font-semibold" onClick={handleAdd} disabled={!parseQty(calories)}><Check size={18} /> Add</Button>
      </div>
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/SavedMealEditor.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import RecordField from '@/components/records/RecordField';
import { nutritionFields } from '@/lib/recordFields';
import { recordsChanged } from '@/lib/recordEditing';
const ITEM_FIELDS = nutritionFields.filter(field => !['date', 'meal'].includes(field.key));
const MEALS = ['Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Snack', 'Pre-Workout', 'Post-Workout'];

export default function SavedMealEditor({ meal, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(meal.name || '');
  const [type, setType] = useState(meal.meal_type || 'Snack');
  const [items, setItems] = useState(() => (meal.items || []).map(item => ({ ...item })));
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const save = async event => {
    event.preventDefault(); setBusy(true); setError('');
    try {
      const values = items.map(item => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(item).map(([key, value]) => [key, ITEM_FIELDS.some(field => field.key === key && field.type === 'number') ? Number(value) || 0 : value])));
      await base44.entities.SavedMeal.update(meal.id, { name: name.trim(), meal_type: type, items: values, total_calories: Math.round(values.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.calories || 0), 0)), total_protein_g: +values.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.protein_g || 0), 0).toFixed(1) });
      recordsChanged('SavedMeal'); await onSaved(); onClose();
    } catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Your meal could not be saved.'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return <Dialog open onOpenChange={open => { if (!open && !busy) onClose(); }}><DialogContent className="record-dialog"><DialogTitle>Edit saved meal</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Correct your saved recipe. Previously logged meals stay unchanged.</DialogDescription>
    <form onSubmit={save} className="space-y-5"><fieldset disabled={busy} className="space-y-4">
      <RecordField field={{ key: 'name', label: 'Meal name', required: true }} value={name} onChange={setName} />
      <RecordField field={{ key: 'meal_type', label: 'Meal', options: MEALS }} value={type} onChange={setType} />
      {items.map((item, index) => <fieldset key={index} className="rounded-2xl border border-border p-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><legend className="px-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Food {index + 1}</legend>{ITEM_FIELDS.map(field => <RecordField key={field.key} field={field} value={item[field.key] ?? ''} onChange={value => setItems(prev => prev.map((row, i) => i === index ? { ...row, [field.key]: value } : row))} />)}</fieldset>)}
    </fieldset>{error && <p role="alert" className="text-destructive text-sm">{error}</p>}<div className="sticky bottom-0 flex gap-3 py-3 bg-background"><Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose} className="flex-1">Cancel</Button><Button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="flex-1">{busy ? 'Saving…' : 'Save changes'}</Button></div></form>
  </DialogContent></Dialog>;
}

FILE: src/components/nutrition/SavedMealsSheet.jsx
