import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { X, Trash2, Repeat } from 'lucide-react';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';

const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

export default function SavedMealsSheet({ onClose, onLogged }) {
  const [meals, setMeals] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  const load = async () => {
    try { setMeals(await base44.entities.SavedMeal.list('-updated_date', 50) || []); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const logMeal = async (meal) => {
    const entries = (meal.items || []).map((item) => ({
      date: TODAY, meal: meal.meal_type || 'Snack', food_name: item.food_name,
      quantity: item.quantity, unit: item.unit, calories: item.calories,
      protein_g: item.protein_g, carbs_g: item.carbs_g, fat_g: item.fat_g,
      fiber_g: item.fiber_g, sugar_g: item.sugar_g, sodium_mg: item.sodium_mg,
      source: 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }));
    try { await base44.entities.NutritionLog.bulkCreate(entries); onLogged(); onClose(); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const deleteMeal = async (id) => {
    setMeals((m) => m.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
    try { await base44.entities.SavedMeal.delete(id); } catch (e) { load(); console.error(e); }
  };

  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Saved Meals</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose}><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-8"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>
        ) : meals.length ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {meals.map((m) => (
              <Card key={m.id} className="p-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate" dir="auto">{m.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">{m.meal_type} · {(m.items || []).length} foods · {Math.round(m.total_calories || 0)} kcal · P{Math.round(m.total_protein_g || 0)}</p>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={() => deleteMeal(m.id)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1 shrink-0"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
                </div>
                <Button size="sm" className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue" onClick={() => logMeal(m)}><Repeat size={14} /> Log to Today</Button>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-8">No saved meals yet. Build a meal and tap Save to reuse it later.</p>
        )}
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme, THEMES, ACCENTS, FONTS } from '@/lib/ThemeContext';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Palette, Check } from 'lucide-react';

export default function AppearanceSettings() {
  const { theme, accent, oled, font, setTheme, setAccent, setOled, setFont } = useTheme();

  return (
    <Card className="mb-4">
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2"><Palette size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Appearance</p>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Premium themes adapt every screen, chart, and sheet instantly.</p>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 mb-4">
        {THEMES.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.id}
            onClick={() => setTheme(t.id)}
            className={cn(
              'relative rounded-xl p-2.5 text-left border transition-all min-h-[64px]',
              theme === t.id ? 'border-luxury-blue ring-1 ring-luxury-blue/40' : 'border-border glass'
            )}
          >
            <ThemePreview themeId={t.id} />

        ))}
      </div>

      {theme === 'custom' && <CustomThemeBuilder />}

          <button

            onClick={() => setAccent(a.id)}
            className={cn(
              'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs border transition-all min-h-[36px]',
              accent === a.id ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/10 text-foreground' : 'border-border glass text-muted-foreground'
            )}
          >
            <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full" style={{ background: ACCENT_SWATCH[a.id] }} />
            {a.name}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2">Font</p>
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap mb-4">
        {FONTS.map((f) => (
          <button key={f.id} onClick={() => setFont(f.id)} style={{ fontFamily: FONT_SAMPLE[f.id] }}
            className={cn('px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs border transition-all min-h-[36px]', font === f.id ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/10 text-foreground' : 'border-border glass text-muted-foreground')}>{f.name}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs font-medium">OLED / True Black</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Pure black background for OLED screens (dark themes).</p>
        </div>
        <Switch checked={oled} onCheckedChange={setOled} disabled={theme === 'porcelain'} />
      </div>
    </Card>
  );

const FONT_SAMPLE = {
  inter: 'Inter, sans-serif',
  system: 'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif',
  serif: "'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif",
  rounded: 'Quicksand, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif',
  mono: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace',
};

const ACCENT_SWATCH = {
  blue: 'hsl(220 88% 55%)',
  ice: 'hsl(198 90% 55%)',
  platinum: 'hsl(220 10% 60%)',
  emerald: 'hsl(158 60% 44%)',
  violet: 'hsl(265 68% 64%)',
};

function ThemePreview({ themeId }) {
  const palettes = {
    obsidian: { bg: '#0a0a12', card: '#16161f', accent: '#3b82f6' },
    midnight: { bg: '#070a14', card: '#0f1726', accent: '#4f93f5' },
    graphite: { bg: '#121212', card: '#1c1c1c', accent: '#6b8db5' },
    slate: { bg: '#0e1622', card: '#16202e', accent: '#5b91d6' },
    carbon: { bg: '#14110d', card: '#1f1a14', accent: '#d97706' },
    frost: { bg: '#0a1218', card: '#10202b', accent: '#22a7c9' },
    rose: { bg: '#1a0d12', card: '#241319', accent: '#e85a8c' },
    onyx: { bg: '#0c0c0f', card: '#18181d', accent: '#b8b8c0' },
    porcelain: { bg: '#f4f1ea', card: '#ffffff', accent: '#2563eb' },
    custom: { bg: '#0a0a12', card: '#16161f', accent: '#3b82f6' },
    system: { bg: '#0a0a12', card: '#16161f', accent: '#3b82f6' },
  };
  const p = palettes[themeId] || palettes.obsidian;
  return (
    <div className="w-full h-8 rounded-lg overflow-hidden flex" style={{ background: p.bg }}>
      <div className="flex-1" style={{ background: p.card }} />
      <div className="w-2.5" style={{ background: p.accent }} />
      <div className="w-4" style={{ background: p.card }} />
    </div>
  );
}

function CustomThemeBuilder() {
  const { setCustomTheme } = useTheme();
  const defaults = { bg: '#0a0a12', card: '#16161f', accent: '#3b82f6', text: '#f4f6fb' };
  const [c, setC] = useState(() => {
    try { return { ...defaults, ...(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lraz_custom') || '{}')) }; }
    catch (e) { return defaults; }
  });
  const update = (k, v) => { const next = { ...c, [k]: v }; setC(next); setCustomTheme(next); };
  return (
    <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/40">
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1">Build Your Theme</p>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Pick your own colors. Text color controls every font across the app.</p>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <ColorField label="Background" value={c.bg} onChange={(v) => update('bg', v)} />
        <ColorField label="Surface" value={c.card} onChange={(v) => update('card', v)} />
        <ColorField label="Accent" value={c.accent} onChange={(v) => update('accent', v)} />
        <ColorField label="Text Color" value={c.text} onChange={(v) => update('text', v)} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ColorField({ label, value, onChange }) {
  return (
    <label className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 glass rounded-xl p-2 min-h-[44px]">
        <input type="color" value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent p-0" />
        <span className="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">{value}</span>
      </div>
    </label>
  );
}

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Download, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { downloadPersonalData } from '@/lib/personalDataDownload';

export default function DownloadDataCard() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const busy = useRef(false);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const download = async (format) => {
    if (busy.current) return;
    busy.current = true; setExporting(true); setError('');
    try { await downloadPersonalData(user, format, setStatus); setStatus('Your download is ready. Keep this file somewhere private.'); }
    catch (failure) { setError(failure.message || 'The download could not be prepared. Please try again.'); setStatus(''); }
    finally { busy.current = false; setExporting(false); }
  };
  return (
    <Card className="mb-4" id="download-data">
      <h2 className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"><Download size={16} className="text-primary" /> Download your data</h2>
      <p className="mb-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">Download your profile and personal fitness records, including all history, habits, saved meals, and favorites. Photo details are included; private photo files are not.</p>
      <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Button disabled={exporting || !user} onClick={() => download('json')}>
          {exporting ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <Download size={16} />} {exporting ? 'Preparing…' : 'Download data (JSON)'}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="outline" disabled={exporting || !user} onClick={() => download('csv')}><Download size={16} /> Download data (CSV)</Button>
      </div>
      {status && <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{status}</p>}
      {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-xs text-destructive">{error}</p>}
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/profile/GoalEditor.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { ActionSelect } from '@/components/ui/action-select';
import { Target, RefreshCw, Check, Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import { recalcGoalTargets } from '@/lib/profileSync';

const GOAL_OPTIONS = ['Fat Loss', 'Muscle Gain', 'Body Recomposition', 'Strength Gain', 'Athletic Performance', 'Endurance', 'General Fitness', 'Maintenance'];
const RATE_OPTIONS = ['Conservative', 'Moderate', 'Faster'];

const EMPTY = {
  primary_goal: 'Body Recomposition', rate_preference: 'Moderate',
  target_weight_kg: '', target_body_fat_percent: '',
  calorie_target: '', protein_target_g: '', carb_target_g: '', fat_target_g: '', fiber_target_g: '', water_target_ml: '',
};

const toForm = (g) => ({
  primary_goal: g.primary_goal || 'Body Recomposition',
  rate_preference: g.rate_preference || 'Moderate',
  target_weight_kg: g.target_weight_kg ?? '',
  target_body_fat_percent: g.target_body_fat_percent ?? '',
  calorie_target: g.calorie_target ?? '',
  protein_target_g: g.protein_target_g ?? '',
  carb_target_g: g.carb_target_g ?? '',
  fat_target_g: g.fat_target_g ?? '',
  fiber_target_g: g.fiber_target_g ?? '',
  water_target_ml: g.water_target_ml ?? '',
});

export default function GoalEditor({ user }) {
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY);

  useEffect(() => { loadGoal(); }, []);

  const loadGoal = async () => {
    try {
      const goals = await base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1);
      setGoal(goals[0] || null);
      if (goals[0]) setForm(toForm(goals[0]));
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const set = (k, v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  const recalculate = () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const updated = recalcGoalTargets(user, { ...(goal || {}), ...form });
    if (updated) setForm((f) => ({ ...f, ...updated }));
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const data = { ...form };
      ['target_weight_kg', 'target_body_fat_percent', 'calorie_target', 'protein_target_g', 'carb_target_g', 'fat_target_g', 'fiber_target_g', 'water_target_ml'].forEach((k) => (data[k] = data[k] === '' ? undefined : Number(data[k])));
      if (goal) {
        await base44.entities.Goal.update(goal.id, data);
        setGoal({ ...goal, ...data });
      } else {
        const created = await base44.entities.Goal.create({ ...data, status: 'active', created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
        setGoal(created);
      }
      setEditing(false);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="mb-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2"><Target size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Goals & Targets</p>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
          {editing && <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={recalculate} className="text-muted-foreground min-h-[36px]"><RefreshCw size={14} /> Auto</Button>}
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => (editing ? save() : setEditing(true))} disabled={saving} className="text-luxury-blue min-h-[36px]">
            {editing ? (saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={14} /> Save</>) : <><Pencil size={14} /> Edit</>}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Primary Goal</Label>
          {editing ? <ActionSelect value={form.primary_goal} options={GOAL_OPTIONS} onChange={(v) => set('primary_goal', v)} />
            : <p className="text-sm font-medium min-h-[44px] flex items-center">{form.primary_goal || '—'}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Rate</Label>
          {editing ? <ActionSelect value={form.rate_preference} options={RATE_OPTIONS} onChange={(v) => set('rate_preference', v)} />
            : <p className="text-sm font-medium min-h-[44px] flex items-center">{form.rate_preference || '—'}</p>}
        </div>
        <NumField label="Calories" value={form.calorie_target} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('calorie_target', v)} />
        <NumField label="Protein (g)" value={form.protein_target_g} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('protein_target_g', v)} />
        <NumField label="Carbs (g)" value={form.carb_target_g} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('carb_target_g', v)} />
        <NumField label="Fat (g)" value={form.fat_target_g} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('fat_target_g', v)} />
        <NumField label="Fiber (g)" value={form.fiber_target_g} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('fiber_target_g', v)} />
        <NumField label="Water (ml)" value={form.water_target_ml} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('water_target_ml', v)} />
        <NumField label="Target Wt (kg)" value={form.target_weight_kg} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('target_weight_kg', v)} />
        <NumField label="Target BF %" value={form.target_body_fat_percent} editing={editing} onChange={(v) => set('target_body_fat_percent', v)} />
      </div>

      {editing && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-3">Tap <span className="text-luxury-blue font-medium">Auto</span> to recalculate from your current weight, height, age, and goal — then tweak any value manually and Save.</p>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

function NumField({ label, value, editing, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>
      {editing ? <Input type="number" value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className="glass h-9 tabular-nums" />
        : <p className="text-sm font-medium min-h-[36px] flex items-center tabular-nums">{value || '—'}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Activity, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { ACTIVITIES } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';
import { ActionSelect } from '@/components/ui/action-select';

// Editor for planned cardio blocks attached to a training day. Reuses the same
// activity catalog as the standalone Cardio Session feature.
export default function DayCardioEditor({ day, onChange }) {
  const cardio = day.cardio || [];

  const addCardio = () => {
    const a = ACTIVITIES[0];
    onChange({ ...day, cardio: [...cardio, { activity: a.id, activity_label: a.label, target_duration_minutes: 10, target_distance_km: '', target_calories: '', intensity: '', notes: '' }] });
  };
  const updateCardio = (i, field, value) => onChange({ ...day, cardio: cardio.map((c, j) => (j === i ? { ...c, [field]: value } : c)) });
  const removeCardio = (i) => onChange({ ...day, cardio: cardio.filter((_, j) => j !== i) });
  const pickActivity = (i, label) => {
    const a = ACTIVITIES.find((x) => x.label === label) || ACTIVITIES[0];
    updateCardio(i, 'activity', a.id);
    updateCardio(i, 'activity_label', a.label);
  };

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"><Activity size={12} className="text-luxury-red" /> Cardio</p>
        <button onClick={addCardio} className="text-[11px] text-luxury-blue flex items-center gap-1 min-h-[36px]"><Plus size={13} /> Add</button>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {cardio.map((c, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="rounded-xl glass p-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <Activity size={13} className="text-luxury-red shrink-0" />
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <ActionSelect value={c.activity_label} options={ACTIVITIES.map((a) => a.label)} onChange={(v) => pickActivity(i, v)} />
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => removeCardio(i)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Target min</span>
                <Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={c.target_duration_minutes ?? ''} onChange={(e) => updateCardio(i, 'target_duration_minutes', Number(e.target.value) || 0)} className="glass h-10 text-xs text-center tabular-nums" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Target km</span>
                <Input type="number" inputMode="decimal" value={c.target_distance_km ?? ''} onChange={(e) => updateCardio(i, 'target_distance_km', e.target.value)} className="glass h-10 text-xs text-center tabular-nums" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Calories</span>
                <Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={c.target_calories ?? ''} onChange={(e) => updateCardio(i, 'target_calories', e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : '')} placeholder="kcal" className="glass h-10 text-xs text-center tabular-nums" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <Input value={c.intensity || ''} onChange={(e) => updateCardio(i, 'intensity', e.target.value)} placeholder="Intensity / HR zone (optional)" className="glass h-8 text-xs mt-2 mb-1" />
            <Input value={c.notes || ''} onChange={(e) => updateCardio(i, 'notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="Notes (tempo, cues…)" className="glass h-8 text-xs" />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/programs/DayEditor.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dumbbell, Plus, Trash2, Search, X, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Copy, Flame } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import ExercisePicker from '@/components/programs/ExercisePicker';
import DayCardioEditor from '@/components/programs/DayCardioEditor';

export default function DayEditor({ day, onChange, onRemove, index }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

  const addExercise = (ex) => {
    onChange({ ...day, exercises: [...(day.exercises || []), { exercise_name: ex.name, sets: 3, reps_low: 8, reps_high: 12, rir_target: 2, rest_seconds: 120, notes: '', set_type: 'working', optional: false }] });
  };

  const updateExercise = (i, field, value) => {
    const isNumeric = !['exercise_name', 'notes', 'set_type', 'optional'].includes(field);
    onChange({ ...day, exercises: day.exercises.map((ex, j) => j === i ? { ...ex, [field]: isNumeric ? (Number(value) || 0) : value } : ex) });
  };
  const removeExercise = (i) => onChange({ ...day, exercises: day.exercises.filter((_, j) => j !== i) });
  const moveExercise = (i, dir) => {
    const arr = [...day.exercises]; const j = i + dir;
    if (j < 0 || j >= arr.length) return;
    [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
    onChange({ ...day, exercises: arr });
  };
  const duplicateExercise = (i) => {
    const arr = [...day.exercises];
    arr.splice(i + 1, 0, { ...arr[i] });
    onChange({ ...day, exercises: arr });
  };

  return (
    <Card className="p-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2"><button type="button" aria-label="Toggle training day" onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)} className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center">
          <ChevronDown size={16} className={cn('transition-transform', expanded && 'rotate-180')} />
          </button>
          <Input value={day.day_name} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...day, day_name: e.target.value })} className="glass h-10 text-sm font-semibold" />
        </div>
        {onRemove && <button onClick={onRemove} className="ml-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>}
      </div>
      {expanded && (
        <>
          <Input value={day.focus || ''} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...day, focus: e.target.value })} placeholder="Focus (e.g. Chest/Triceps)" className="glass h-9 text-xs mb-3" />
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {(day.exercises || []).map((ex, i) => (
              <div key={i} className={cn('rounded-xl glass p-2.5', ex.optional && 'opacity-60')}>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-[repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))] sm:flex items-center gap-1 mb-2 [&>input]:col-span-4 [&>svg]:hidden sm:[&>svg]:block">
                  <Dumbbell size={13} className="text-luxury-blue shrink-0" />
                  <Input value={ex.exercise_name} onChange={(e) => updateExercise(i, 'exercise_name', e.target.value)} placeholder="Exercise name" className="glass h-10 text-sm flex-1 min-w-0" />
                  <button onClick={() => moveExercise(i, -1)} disabled={i === 0} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30 min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><ChevronUp size={14} /></button>
                  <button onClick={() => moveExercise(i, 1)} disabled={i === (day.exercises.length - 1)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30 min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><ChevronDown size={14} /></button>
                  <button onClick={() => duplicateExercise(i)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Copy size={13} /></button>
                  <button onClick={() => removeExercise(i)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                  <NumField label="Sets" value={ex.sets} onChange={(v) => updateExercise(i, 'sets', v)} />
                  <NumField label="Reps lo" value={ex.reps_low} onChange={(v) => updateExercise(i, 'reps_low', v)} />
                  <NumField label="Reps hi" value={ex.reps_high} onChange={(v) => updateExercise(i, 'reps_high', v)} />
                  <NumField label="RIR" value={ex.rir_target} onChange={(v) => updateExercise(i, 'rir_target', v)} />
                  <NumField label="Rest s" value={ex.rest_seconds} onChange={(v) => updateExercise(i, 'rest_seconds', v)} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
                  <button onClick={() => updateExercise(i, 'set_type', ex.set_type === 'warmup' ? 'working' : 'warmup')} className={cn('text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-full border min-h-[28px]', ex.set_type === 'warmup' ? 'border-luxury-gold bg-luxury-gold/15 text-luxury-gold' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground')}>{ex.set_type === 'warmup' ? 'Warm-up' : 'Working'}</button>
                  <button onClick={() => updateExercise(i, 'optional', !ex.optional)} className={cn('text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-full border min-h-[28px]', ex.optional ? 'border-luxury-red/40 bg-luxury-red/10 text-luxury-red' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground')}>{ex.optional ? 'Optional' : 'Required'}</button>
                </div>
                <Input value={ex.notes || ''} onChange={(e) => updateExercise(i, 'notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="Notes (tempo, cues…)" className="glass h-8 text-xs mt-2" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <ExercisePicker onPick={addExercise} />
          <DayCardioEditor day={day} onChange={onChange} />
        </>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

function NumField({ label, value, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
      <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={value ?? ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className="glass h-10 text-xs text-center tabular-nums min-w-0" />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/programs/ExercisePicker.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Plus, Search, Dumbbell, Pencil, X, Star, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getAllExercises, MUSCLE_GROUPS, EQUIPMENT_OPTIONS } from '@/lib/exerciseDatabase';

// Pick an exercise from the shared 500+ library OR enter a custom name manually.
// Uses the SAME exercise source as Search, WorkoutLogger, SubstitutionSheet, etc.
export default function ExercisePicker({ onPick }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [exercises, setExercises] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [customName, setCustomName] = useState('');
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('library');
  const [muscleFilter, setMuscleFilter] = useState('All');
  const [equipFilter, setEquipFilter] = useState('All');
  const [favs, setFavs] = useState({});

  // Load shared library + favorites when the picker opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true);
    getAllExercises().then((all) => { if (active) { setExercises(all); setLoading(false); } });
    base44.entities.Favorite.list('-created_date', 500).then((f) => {
      if (!active) return;
      const m = {};
      (f || []).forEach((x) => { if (x.type === 'exercise') m[x.ref_id] = x; });
      setFavs(m);
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [open]);

  // Hide the floating coach button while the picker is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      document.body.classList.add('exercise-picker-open');
      return () => document.body.classList.remove('exercise-picker-open');
    }
  }, [open]);

  const toggleFav = async (ex) => {
    const key = ex.slug || ex.id;
    if (favs[key]) {
      try { await base44.entities.Favorite.delete(favs[key].id); setFavs((p) => { const n = { ...p }; delete n[key]; return n; }); } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      try {
        const created = await base44.entities.Favorite.create({ type: 'exercise', ref_id: key, name: ex.name, subtitle: ex.primary_muscle, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
        setFavs((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: created }));
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  };

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let list = exercises;
    if (muscleFilter !== 'All') list = list.filter((e) => e.muscle_group === muscleFilter || e.primary_muscle === muscleFilter);
    if (equipFilter !== 'All') list = list.filter((e) => (e.equipment || []).includes(equipFilter));
    if (query) {
      const q = query.toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter((e) => `${e.name} ${e.primary_muscle} ${e.muscle_group} ${(e.equipment || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    }
    return list.slice(0, 200);
  }, [exercises, query, muscleFilter, equipFilter]);

  const favList = useMemo(() => exercises.filter((e) => favs[e.slug || e.id]).slice(0, 100), [exercises, favs]);

  const pickLibrary = (ex) => {
    onPick({ name: ex.name });
    setOpen(false); setQuery(''); setMuscleFilter('All'); setEquipFilter('All');
  };

  const pickCustom = () => {
    if (!customName.trim()) return;
    onPick({ name: customName.trim() });
    setCustomName(''); setOpen(false);
  };

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full mt-2 text-xs glass" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        <Plus size={13} /> Add Exercise
      </Button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="exercise-picker-screen fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-background flex flex-col h-[100dvh] !pb-0 md:z-50 md:h-auto md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-center md:bg-black/60 md:backdrop-blur-sm"
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setOpen(false); }}
    >
      <div className="relative flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col h-full md:h-auto md:max-h-[85dvh] md:max-w-xl md:w-full md:glass-strong md:rounded-t-3xl">
        {/* Header + tabs */}
        <div className="shrink-0 p-4 pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mb-3">
            <button onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="text-muted-foreground min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center -ml-2 md:hidden">
              <ArrowLeft size={22} />
            </button>
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg flex-1 md:flex-none">Add Exercise</h3>
            <button onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="text-muted-foreground min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center hidden md:flex">
              <X size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button onClick={() => setMode('library')} className={cn('flex-1 text-xs py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1 min-h-[40px]', mode === 'library' ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>
              <Search size={13} /> Library
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => setMode('favorites')} className={cn('flex-1 text-xs py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1 min-h-[40px]', mode === 'favorites' ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>
              <Star size={13} /> Favorites
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => setMode('custom')} className={cn('flex-1 text-xs py-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-1 min-h-[40px]', mode === 'custom' ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>
              <Pencil size={13} /> Custom
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Library filters — stay visible while list scrolls */}
        {mode === 'library' && (
          <div className="shrink-0 px-4 pb-2">
            <div className="relative mb-2">
              <Search size={14} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input autoFocus value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search 500+ exercises…" className="pl-8 h-10 glass" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar mb-2 -mx-1 px-1">
              {MUSCLE_GROUPS.map((m) => (
                <button key={m} onClick={() => setMuscleFilter(m)} className={cn('px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap min-h-[32px]', muscleFilter === m ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>{m}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar mb-1 -mx-1 px-1">
              {EQUIPMENT_OPTIONS.map((eq) => (
                <button key={eq} onClick={() => setEquipFilter(eq)} className={cn('px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap min-h-[32px]', equipFilter === eq ? 'bg-luxury-red text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>{eq}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-1 px-1">{loading ? 'Loading library…' : `${filtered.length} exercise${filtered.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Scrollable exercise list — independent vertical scrolling */}
        {mode === 'library' && (
          <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 pb-[calc(1.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              {filtered.map((ex) => (
                <ExerciseRow key={ex.slug || ex.id} ex={ex} fav={!!favs[ex.slug || ex.id]} onPick={pickLibrary} onToggleFav={toggleFav} />
              ))}
              {!loading && !filtered.length && <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground py-6">No matches. Try different filters or use the Custom tab.</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {mode === 'favorites' && (
          <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 pb-[calc(1.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              {favList.map((ex) => (
                <ExerciseRow key={ex.slug || ex.id} ex={ex} fav onPick={pickLibrary} onToggleFav={toggleFav} />
              ))}
              {!favList.length && <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground py-6">No favorite exercises yet. Tap the star next to any exercise in the Library tab.</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {mode === 'custom' && (
          <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 pb-[calc(1.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <Input autoFocus value={customName} onChange={(e) => setCustomName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Type any exercise name…" className="glass h-10" onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && pickCustom()} />
              <Button size="sm" className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue" onClick={pickCustom} disabled={!customName.trim()}><Plus size={14} /> Add Custom Exercise</Button>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground text-center">Manual exercises are saved by name and work in the workout logger.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ExerciseRow({ ex, fav, onPick, onToggleFav }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted/40 transition-all">
      <button onClick={() => onPick(ex)} className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
        <Dumbbell size={14} className="text-luxury-blue shrink-0" />
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-xs font-medium truncate">{ex.name}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{ex.primary_muscle} · {(ex.equipment || []).join(', ') || '—'}</p>
          {ex.instructions && <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 truncate">{ex.instructions}</p>}
        </div>
      </button>
      <button onClick={() => onToggleFav(ex)} className="shrink-0 min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center">
        <Star size={15} className={cn(fav ? 'fill-luxury-gold text-luxury-gold' : 'text-muted-foreground')} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Plus, Trash2, Layers } from 'lucide-react';

const PHASES = ['Foundation', 'Hypertrophy', 'Strength', 'Power', 'Cutting', 'Lean Gaining', 'Recomposition', 'Maintenance', 'Deload', 'Competition Prep', 'Post-Event Recovery', 'Transition'];

// Mesocycle block editor: divides a program into phased blocks.
export default function MesocycleEditor({ blocks, onChange }) {
  const list = blocks || [];
  const update = (i, patch) => onChange(list.map((b, j) => (j === i ? { ...b, ...patch } : b)));
  const add = () => onChange([...list, { name: `Block ${list.length + 1}`, weeks: 4, phase: 'Hypertrophy', target_rpe: 7 }]);
  const remove = (i) => onChange(list.filter((_, j) => j !== i));
  return (
    <Card>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2"><Layers size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Mesocycle Blocks</p>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Divide your program into phased blocks (e.g. Accumulation → Intensification → Deload). Leave empty for a single-phase program.</p>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {list.map((b, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="glass rounded-xl p-2.5 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Input value={b.name} onChange={(e) => update(i, { name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Block name" className="glass h-9 text-sm flex-1" />
              <button onClick={() => remove(i)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                <Label className="text-[10px] uppercase">Weeks</Label>
                <Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={b.weeks} onChange={(e) => update(i, { weeks: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} className="glass h-9 text-center" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                <Label className="text-[10px] uppercase">Phase</Label>
                <select value={b.phase} onChange={(e) => update(i, { phase: e.target.value })} className="glass h-9 w-full rounded-md text-xs px-1 bg-transparent border border-input">
                  {PHASES.map((p) => <option key={p} value={p} className="bg-background">{p}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                <Label className="text-[10px] uppercase">RPE</Label>
                <Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={b.target_rpe} onChange={(e) => update(i, { target_rpe: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })} className="glass h-9 text-center" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <Button variant="outline" className="w-full glass border-dashed mt-2 min-h-[40px]" onClick={add}><Plus size={14} /> Add Block</Button>
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/programs/ProgramProgress.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { CheckCircle2, Calendar, TrendingUp, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const WEEK = 7 * 86400000;

export default function ProgramProgress({ program }) {
  const [workouts, setWorkouts] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!program?.id) return;
    base44.entities.WorkoutSession.filter({ program_id: program.id }, '-date', 500)
      .then(setWorkouts).catch(() => {});
  }, [program?.id]);

  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const days = program.days || [];
    const durationWeeks = program.duration_weeks || 8;
    const freq = program.days_per_week || days.length || 3;
    const start = program.start_date ? new Date(program.start_date) : (program.created_date ? new Date(program.created_date) : new Date());
    const weeksElapsed = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - start.getTime()) / WEEK);
    const currentWeek = Math.min(durationWeeks, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(weeksElapsed)));
    const completed = workouts.filter((w) => w.status === 'completed').length;
    const totalPlanned = freq * durationWeeks;
    const adherence = totalPlanned > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((completed / totalPlanned) * 100)) : 0;
    const nextIndex = days.length ? completed % days.length : 0;
    const next = days[nextIndex];
    // Mesocycle block tracking
    let currentBlock = null, blockWeek = null;
    const blocks = program.blocks || [];
    if (blocks.length) {
      let acc = 0;
      for (const b of blocks) {
        if (weeksElapsed < acc + b.weeks) { currentBlock = b; blockWeek = Math.floor(weeksElapsed - acc) + 1; break; }
        acc += b.weeks;
      }
      if (!currentBlock) { currentBlock = blocks[blocks.length - 1]; blockWeek = currentBlock.weeks; }
    }
    const isComplete = weeksElapsed >= durationWeeks;
    const completedSessions = workouts.filter((w) => w.status === 'completed');
    const totalVolume = completedSessions.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.total_volume_kg || 0), 0);
    const avgVolume = completedSessions.length ? Math.round(totalVolume / completedSessions.length) : 0;
    return { currentWeek, durationWeeks, completed, totalPlanned, adherence, next, weeksElapsed, currentBlock, blockWeek, isComplete, totalVolume, avgVolume };
  }, [program, workouts]);

  return (
    <>
    <Card className="mb-4">
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><TrendingUp size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Program Progress</p>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Calendar size={14} className="text-muted-foreground" /><div><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Week</p><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{data.currentWeek} / {data.durationWeeks}</p></div></div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><CheckCircle2 size={14} className="text-muted-foreground" /><div><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Workouts</p><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{data.completed} / {data.totalPlanned}</p></div></div>
      </div>
      <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/30 overflow-hidden mb-3">
        <div className="h-full bg-luxury-blue transition-all" style={{ width: `${data.adherence}%` }} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Adherence</span>
        <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{data.adherence}%</span>
      </div>
      {data.next && (
        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Target size={14} className="text-luxury-red" />
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Next:</span>
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">{data.next.day_name}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {data.currentBlock && (
        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50">
          <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Current Block</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{data.currentBlock.name} <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">· {data.currentBlock.phase}</span></p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Week {data.blockWeek} of {data.currentBlock.weeks}{data.currentBlock.target_rpe ? ` · target RPE ${data.currentBlock.target_rpe}` : ''}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">Started {program.start_date || program.created_date ? new Date(program.start_date || program.created_date).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) : '—'}. Editing this program updates future workouts only — completed sessions keep their original values.</p>
    </Card>
    {data.isComplete && (
      <Card className="mb-4 border-luxury-blue/30">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><CheckCircle2 size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Program Complete</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
          <div><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{data.completed}</p><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Workouts</p></div>
          <div><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{data.adherence}%</p><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Adherence</p></div>
          <div><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(data.totalVolume).toLocaleString()}</p><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Total Volume kg</p></div>
          <div><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{data.avgVolume.toLocaleString()}</p><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Avg / Session kg</p></div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Set a new active program or extend this block to keep progressing.</p>
      </Card>
    )}
    </>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Ruler, Trash2, Pencil, X, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function MeasurementHistory({ measurements, onRefresh }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);

  if (!measurements.length) return <EmptyState icon={Ruler} title="No measurements yet" description="Log your first measurement to start your history." />;

  return (
    <div>
      <Card>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Ruler size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Measurement History</p>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          {measurements.map((m) => (
            <div key={m.id} className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-t border-border/40 first:border-t-0">
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium tabular-nums">{m.weight_kg ?? '—'} kg{m.body_fat_percent != null ? ` · ${m.body_fat_percent}% BF` : ''}{m.waist_cm != null ? ` · ${m.waist_cm}cm waist` : ''}</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{new Date(m.date).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}{m.body_fat_method ? ` · ${m.body_fat_method}` : ''}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-1">
                <button onClick={() => setEditing(m)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue min-h-[36px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                <button onClick={async () => { try { await base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.delete(m.id); onRefresh?.(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } }} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[36px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {editing && <EditSheet measurement={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} onSaved={() => { setEditing(null); onRefresh?.(); }} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function EditSheet({ measurement, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    weight_kg: measurement.weight_kg ?? '',
    body_fat_percent: measurement.body_fat_percent ?? '',
    waist_cm: measurement.waist_cm ?? '',
    hip_cm: measurement.hip_cm ?? '',
    neck_cm: measurement.neck_cm ?? '',
    notes: measurement.notes ?? '',
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const set = (k, v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const data = { ...form };
      ['weight_kg', 'body_fat_percent', 'waist_cm', 'hip_cm', 'neck_cm'].forEach((k) => (data[k] = data[k] === '' ? undefined : Number(data[k])));
      await base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.update(measurement.id, data);
      onSaved();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto animate-fade-up">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Edit Measurement</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <Field label="Weight (kg)"><Input type="number" value={form.weight_kg} onChange={(e) => set('weight_kg', e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="Body Fat (%)"><Input type="number" value={form.body_fat_percent} onChange={(e) => set('body_fat_percent', e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="Waist (cm)"><Input type="number" value={form.waist_cm} onChange={(e) => set('waist_cm', e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="Neck (cm)"><Input type="number" value={form.neck_cm} onChange={(e) => set('neck_cm', e.target.value)} /></Field>
          <Field label="Hip (cm)"><Input type="number" value={form.hip_cm} onChange={(e) => set('hip_cm', e.target.value)} /></Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Notes"><Input value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} /></Field>
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="w-full mt-4 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]">{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Save Changes</>}</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({ label, children }) {
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>{children}</div>;
}

FILE: src/components/progress/PRTimeline.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Trophy, Dumbbell } from 'lucide-react';
import { estimate1RM } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';

// PR timeline from sets flagged is_pr (plus sessions with pr_count), grouped by date desc.
export default function PRTimeline({ sessions, sets }) {
  const timeline = useMemo(() => {
    const dates = {};
    sessions.forEach((s) => { if (s.id && s.date) dates[s.id] = new Date(s.date).getTime(); });
    const prSets = (sets || []).filter((s) => s.is_pr && dates[s.session_id]).map((s) => ({
      date: dates[s.session_id],
      exercise: s.exercise_name,
      weight: s.weight_kg,
      reps: s.reps,
      e1rm: estimate1RM(s.weight_kg, s.reps),
    }));
    // Also include sessions with pr_count > 0 but no flagged sets (fallback)
    const byDate = {};
    prSets.forEach((p) => {
      const d = new Date(p.date).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
      if (!byDate[d]) byDate[d] = { date: d, ts: p.date, items: [] };
      byDate[d].items.push(p);
    });
    return Object.values(byDate).sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts);
  }, [sessions, sets]);

  if (!timeline.length) return <EmptyState icon={Trophy} title="No PRs recorded yet" description="When you log a set that beats your previous best, it appears here on your strength timeline." />;

  return (
    <Card>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Trophy size={15} className="text-luxury-gold" /> PR Timeline</p>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {timeline.map((day, i) => (
          <div key={i}>
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1.5">{day.date}</p>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {day.items.map((p, j) => (
                <div key={j} className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-luxury-gold/15 text-luxury-gold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Dumbbell size={13} /></div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium flex-1 truncate">{p.exercise}</span>
                  <span className="text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{p.weight}kg × {p.reps}</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-gradient-blue w-14 text-right">{Math.round(p.e1rm)}kg</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-3">Estimated 1RM uses the Epley formula. PRs are detected automatically when a logged set exceeds your previous best for that exercise.</p>
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/progress/ProgressPhotos.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState, Pill } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Image } from '@/components/ui/image';
import { Camera, Trash2, X, Upload, Lock, ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const VIEWS = ['All', 'Front', 'Side', 'Back'];
const POSES = ['All', 'Relaxed', 'Flexed'];

export default function ProgressPhotos() {
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [view, setView] = useState('All');
  const [pose, setPose] = useState('All');
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [viewer, setViewer] = useState(null);
  const fileRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  const load = async () => {
    try { const p = await base44.entities.ProgressPhoto.list('-date', 200); setPhotos(p || []); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const onPick = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const { file_url } = await base44.integrations.Core.UploadFile({ file });
      await base44.entities.ProgressPhoto.create({
        date: new Date().toISOString(),
        view: view === 'All' ? 'Front' : view,
        pose: pose === 'All' ? 'Relaxed' : pose,
        photo_url: file_url,
        is_private: true,
      });
      await load();
    } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
    finally { setUploading(false); if (fileRef.current) fileRef.current.value = ''; }
  };

  const remove = async (id) => {
    try { await base44.entities.ProgressPhoto.delete(id); setPhotos((p) => p.filter((x) => x.id !== id)); setViewer(null); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const filtered = photos.filter((p) => (view === 'All' || p.view === view) && (pose === 'All' || p.pose === pose));

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-10"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card className="border-luxury-blue/30 bg-luxury-blue/5">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <Lock size={15} className="text-luxury-blue shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">Progress photos are private by default and only visible to you. They're stored to track visual changes over time — never shared without your action.</p>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
        {VIEWS.map((v) => <Pill key={v} active={view === v} onClick={() => setView(v)}>{v}</Pill>)}
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar -mt-2">
        {POSES.map((p) => <Pill key={p} active={pose === p} onClick={() => setPose(p)}>{p}</Pill>)}
      </div>

      <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="image/*" capture="user" onChange={onPick} className="hidden" />
      <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()} disabled={uploading}>
        {uploading ? <><div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" /> Uploading…</> : <><Camera size={18} /> Add Progress Photo</>}
      </Button>

      {!filtered.length ? (
        <EmptyState icon={ImageIcon} title="No photos yet" description="Add a front, side or back photo to visually track your progress over time." />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {filtered.map((p) => (
            <button key={p.id} onClick={() => setViewer(p)} className="relative aspect-square rounded-xl overflow-hidden glass border border-border/60">
              <Image src={p.photo_url} alt="progress" fittingType="fill" className="w-full h-full" />
              <span className="absolute bottom-1 left-1 text-[8px] font-medium px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/60 text-white">{p.view} · {p.pose}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {viewer && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 flex flex-col" onClick={() => setViewer(null)}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 safe-pt" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <button onClick={() => setViewer(null)} className="text-white min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"><X size={22} /></button>
            <span className="text-xs text-white/70">{new Date(viewer.date).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })} · {viewer.view} · {viewer.pose}</span>
            <button onClick={() => remove(viewer.id)} className="text-luxury-red min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"><Trash2 size={20} /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center px-4" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <img src={viewer.photo_url} alt="progress" className="max-w-full max-h-full rounded-xl object-contain" />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/records/RecordActions.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Pencil, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import RecordEditor from '@/components/records/RecordEditor';
import { recordsChanged, syncLatestMeasurement } from '@/lib/recordEditing';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';

export default function RecordActions({ entity, record, fields, title, onChanged, onDelete, onEdit }) {
  const { user, checkUserAuth } = useAuth();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const remove = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setError('');
    try { if (onDelete) await onDelete(record); else await base44.entities[entity].delete(record.id); recordsChanged(entity); if (entity === 'BodyMeasurement' && await syncLatestMeasurement(user)) await checkUserAuth(); await onChanged?.(); setMode(null); }
    catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Could not delete this record.'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center shrink-0" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label={`Edit ${title}`} onClick={() => onEdit ? onEdit(record) : setMode('edit')}><Pencil size={16} /></Button>
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label={`Delete ${title}`} onClick={() => setMode('delete')}><Trash2 size={16} className="text-destructive" /></Button>
      {mode === 'edit' && <RecordEditor entity={entity} record={record} fields={fields} title={`Edit ${title}`} onClose={() => setMode(null)} onSaved={onChanged} />}
      {mode === 'delete' && <Dialog open onOpenChange={open => { if (!open && !busy) setMode(null); }}>
        <DialogContent className="record-dialog"><DialogTitle>Delete {title}?</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>This permanently removes only this saved record. This cannot be undone.</DialogDescription>
          {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
          <div className="flex gap-3"><Button variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setMode(null)} className="flex-1">Cancel</Button><Button variant="destructive" disabled={busy} onClick={remove} className="flex-1">{busy ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete'}</Button></div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/records/RecordEditor.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import RecordField from '@/components/records/RecordField';
import { fieldValue, recordPatch, updateRecord, syncLatestMeasurement } from '@/lib/recordEditing';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';

export default function RecordEditor({ entity, record, fields, title, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const { user, checkUserAuth } = useAuth();
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => Object.fromEntries(fields.map(field => [field.key, fieldValue(record, field)])));
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const submit = async event => {
    event.preventDefault(); setSaving(true); setError('');
    try { await updateRecord(entity, record, recordPatch(record, fields, form)); if (entity === 'BodyMeasurement' && await syncLatestMeasurement(user)) await checkUserAuth(); await onSaved?.(); onClose(); }
    catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Your changes could not be saved. Please try again.'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };
  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={open => { if (!open && !saving) onClose(); }}>
      <DialogContent className="record-dialog" onInteractOutside={e => { if (saving) e.preventDefault(); }}>
        <DialogTitle className="font-heading text-xl pr-8">{title}</DialogTitle>
        <DialogDescription>Update your saved information. Other details stay unchanged.</DialogDescription>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
          <fieldset disabled={saving} className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {fields.map(field => <RecordField key={field.key} field={field} value={form[field.key]} onChange={value => setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field.key]: value }))} />)}
          </fieldset>
          {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
          <div className="sticky bottom-0 flex gap-3 bg-background py-3">
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving} className="flex-1">Cancel</Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="flex-1">{saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save changes'}</Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import React, { useId } from 'react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function RecordField({ field, value, onChange, disabled }) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className={cn('space-y-2 min-w-0', (field.options || field.type === 'textarea') && 'col-span-full')}>
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground capitalize">{field.label}{field.required ? ' *' : ''}</Label>
      {field.options ? <div id={id} role="group" aria-label={field.label} className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {field.options.map(option => { const val = typeof option === 'object' ? option.value : option; const label = typeof option === 'object' ? option.label : option; return <button type="button" key={val} disabled={disabled} aria-pressed={value === val} onClick={() => onChange(val)} className={cn('min-h-11 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs font-medium', value === val ? 'border-primary bg-primary/15 text-primary' : 'border-border bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground')}>{label}</button>; })}
      </div> : field.type === 'textarea' ? <Textarea id={id} value={value} disabled={disabled} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)} rows={3} /> :
        <Input id={id} type={field.type || 'text'} inputMode={field.type === 'number' ? 'decimal' : undefined} min={field.min} max={field.max} step={field.step} required={field.required} disabled={disabled} value={value} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { MUSCLE_GROUPS } from '@/lib/performanceAnalytics';

const STATUS = {
  ready: { dot: 'bg-emerald-400', label: 'Ready', text: 'text-emerald-400' },
  partial: { dot: 'bg-luxury-gold', label: 'Partial', text: 'text-luxury-gold' },
  needs: { dot: 'bg-luxury-red', label: 'Recovering', text: 'text-luxury-red' },
  unknown: { dot: 'bg-muted-foreground/40', label: 'No data', text: 'text-muted-foreground' },
};

function fmtHours(h) {
  if (h == null) return 'no data';
  if (h < 24) return `${h}h ago`;
  return `${Math.round(h / 24)}d ago`;
}

// Visual, color-coded muscle recovery map. All statuses are estimates.
export default function MuscleRecoveryMap({ recovery }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
      {MUSCLE_GROUPS.map((m) => {
        const r = recovery[m] || { status: 'unknown' };
        const s = STATUS[r.status] || STATUS.unknown;
        return (
          <div key={m} className="rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-background/30 p-2.5 flex items-center gap-2.5 min-h-[44px]">
            <span className={cn('w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full shrink-0', s.dot)} />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold truncate">{m}</p>
              <p className={cn('text-[10px]', s.text)}>{s.label} · {fmtHours(r.hoursSince)}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/recovery/ReadinessCheckIn.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { X, Check, Moon, Activity, Zap, Brain, Smile, Heart } from 'lucide-react';
import { computeReadinessFromInputs } from '@/lib/performanceAnalytics';
import { Ring } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

export default function ReadinessCheckIn({ onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [sleepHours, setSleepHours] = useState(7);
  const [sleepQuality, setSleepQuality] = useState(7);
  const [soreness, setSoreness] = useState(3);
  const [stress, setStress] = useState(3);
  const [energy, setEnergy] = useState(7);
  const [mood, setMood] = useState(7);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const readiness = computeReadinessFromInputs({ sleep_hours: sleepHours, sleep_quality: sleepQuality, soreness_level: soreness, stress_level: stress, energy, mood });

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await base44.entities.RecoveryRecord.create({
        date: TODAY,
        sleep_hours: sleepHours,
        sleep_quality: sleepQuality,
        soreness_level: soreness,
        stress_level: stress,
        energy,
        mood,
        readiness_score: readiness,
        recovery_score: readiness,
        source: 'Manual',
      });
      onSaved?.();
      onClose();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto animate-fade-up">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Daily Check-In</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-center mb-5">
          <Ring value={readiness} label="Readiness" size={120} color={readiness >= 70 ? 'blue' : readiness >= 40 ? 'gold' : 'red'} />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <Label icon={Moon} text="Sleep hours" />
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <input type="range" min="0" max="12" step="0.5" value={sleepHours} onChange={(e) => setSleepHours(Number(e.target.value))} className="flex-1 accent-luxury-blue" />
              <span className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums w-12 text-right">{sleepHours}h</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Stepper icon={Moon} label="Sleep quality" value={sleepQuality} onChange={setSleepQuality} />
          <Stepper icon={Activity} label="Soreness" value={soreness} onChange={setSoreness} invert />
          <Stepper icon={Brain} label="Stress" value={stress} onChange={setStress} invert />
          <Stepper icon={Zap} label="Energy" value={energy} onChange={setEnergy} />
          <Stepper icon={Smile} label="Mood" value={mood} onChange={setMood} />
        </div>

        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-4 flex items-start gap-1"><Heart size={11} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> Readiness is an estimate from your inputs — not a medical measurement. Higher sleep, energy and mood raise it; higher soreness and stress lower it.</p>

        <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="w-full mt-4 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]">{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={18} /> Save Check-In</>}</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Label({ icon: Icon, text }) {
  return <p className="text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2 text-muted-foreground"><Icon size={13} /> {text}</p>;
}

function Stepper({ icon: Icon, label, value, onChange, invert }) {
  const tone = invert ? (value >= 7 ? 'text-luxury-red' : value <= 3 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-foreground') : (value >= 7 ? 'text-emerald-400' : value <= 3 ? 'text-luxury-red' : 'text-foreground');
  return (
    <div>
      <Label icon={Icon} text={label} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button onClick={() => onChange(Math.max(1, value - 1))} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl glass flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] text-lg font-bold">−</button>
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
          {Array.from({ length: 10 }).map((_, i) => (
            <button key={i} onClick={() => onChange(i + 1)} className={cn('h-2.5 rounded-full transition-all', i < value ? (invert ? 'bg-luxury-red' : 'bg-luxury-blue') : 'bg-muted/40')} style={{ flex: 1 }} />
          ))}
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => onChange(Math.min(10, value + 1))} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl glass flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] text-lg font-bold">+</button>
        <span className={cn('text-lg font-bold tabular-nums w-8 text-right', tone)}>{value}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
