FILE: src/components/recovery/WeeklyReview.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { X, Dumbbell, Activity, Apple, TrendingUp, Trophy, Scale, Flame, Clock, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { computeVolumeByMuscle, computeBestLifts, computeNutritionTrends, detectPlateaus, detectDeload } from '@/lib/performanceAnalytics';
import { formatDuration, formatDistance } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const DAY = 86400000;
const WEEK_AGO = Date.now() - 7 * DAY;

export default function WeeklyReview({ onClose }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [sessions, sets, cardio, nutrition, recovery, measurements, goal] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 60),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 500),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 60),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.RecoveryRecord.list('-date', 14),
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 30),
        base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
      ]);
      setData({ sessions: sessions || [], sets: sets || [], cardio: cardio || [], nutrition: nutrition || [], recovery: recovery || [], measurements: measurements || [], goal: goal?.[0] || null });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const r = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data) return null;
    const wkSessions = data.sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && new Date(s.date).getTime() >= WEEK_AGO);
    const wkSets = data.sets.filter((s) => new Date(s.created_date).getTime() >= WEEK_AGO);
    const wkCardio = data.cardio.filter((c) => new Date(c.date).getTime() >= WEEK_AGO);
    const wkNutrition = data.nutrition.filter((n) => new Date(n.date).getTime() >= WEEK_AGO);
    const wkRecovery = data.recovery.filter((rec) => new Date(rec.date).getTime() >= WEEK_AGO);
    const volumeByMuscle = computeVolumeByMuscle(data.sessions, data.sets, 7);
    const totalVolume = wkSessions.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.total_volume_kg || 0), 0);
    const prs = wkSets.filter((s) => s.is_pr).length + wkSessions.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.pr_count || 0), 0);
    const bestLifts = computeBestLifts(wkSets);
    const plateaus = detectPlateaus(data.sessions, data.sets);
    const nut = computeNutritionTrends(data.nutrition, data.goal, 7);
    const cardioSeconds = wkCardio.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.duration_seconds || 0), 0);
    const cardioCalories = wkCardio.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.calories || 0), 0);
    const cardioDistance = wkCardio.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.distance_km || 0), 0);
    const avgReadiness = wkRecovery.length ? Math.round(wkRecovery.reduce((a, rec) => a + (rec.readiness_score || 0), 0) / wkRecovery.length) : null;
    const weights = data.measurements.filter((m) => m.weight_kg && new Date(m.date).getTime() >= WEEK_AGO).sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
    const weightChange = weights.length >= 2 ? +(weights[weights.length - 1].weight_kg - weights[0].weight_kg).toFixed(1) : null;
    const topMuscles = Object.entries(volumeByMuscle).filter(([, v]) => v.sets > 0).sort((a, b) => b[1].sets - a[1].sets).slice(0, 4);
    const weekStart = (d) => { const x = new Date(d); x.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); x.setDate(x.getDate() - ((x.getDay() + 6) % 7)); return x.getTime(); };
    const wkMap = {};
    data.sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date).forEach((s) => { const ws = weekStart(s.date); wkMap[ws] = (wkMap[ws] || 0) + (s.total_volume_kg || 0); });
    const weeklyVolumes = Object.keys(wkMap).sort().map((k) => ({ weekStart: Number(k), volume: wkMap[k] }));
    const deload = detectDeload({ weeklyVolumes, recovery: data.recovery?.[0] });
    return { wkSessions, wkSets, wkCardio, wkNutrition, totalVolume, prs, bestLifts, plateaus, nut, cardioSeconds, cardioCalories, cardioDistance, avgReadiness, weightChange, topMuscles, checkIns: wkRecovery.length, deload };
  }, [data]);

  if (loading) return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center"><div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60" onClick={onClose} /><div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-6 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[40vh]"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div></div>;
  if (!r) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto animate-fade-up">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Weekly Review</h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Last 7 days · {new Date(WEEK_AGO).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })} – today</p>
          </div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">
          <Stat icon={Dumbbell} label="Workouts" value={`${r.wkSessions.length}`} />
          <Stat icon={Activity} label="Cardio" value={`${r.wkCardio.length}`} sub={formatDuration(r.cardioSeconds)} />
          <Stat icon={Flame} label="Cardio kcal" value={`${Math.round(r.cardioCalories)}`} accent />
          <Stat icon={TrendingUp} label="Volume" value={`${Math.round(r.totalVolume).toLocaleString()}`} unit="kg" />
          <Stat icon={Trophy} label="PRs" value={`${r.prs}`} accent="blue" />
          <Stat icon={Scale} label="Weight Δ" value={r.weightChange != null ? `${r.weightChange > 0 ? '+' : ''}${r.weightChange}` : '—'} unit="kg" accent={r.weightChange != null ? (r.weightChange < 0 ? 'red' : 'blue') : null} />
        </div>

        <Section icon={Apple} title="Nutrition">
          <Row k="Avg calories" v={r.nut.avgCalories ? `${r.nut.avgCalories} kcal` : '—'} />
          <Row k="Avg protein" v={r.nut.avgProtein ? `${r.nut.avgProtein} g` : '—'} />
          <Row k="Days logged" v={`${r.nut.daysLogged} / 7`} />
          <Row k="Protein goal days" v={`${r.nut.proteinDaysHit} / 7`} />
        </Section>

        <Section icon={CheckCircle2} title="Recovery">
          <Row k="Check-ins" v={`${r.checkIns} / 7`} />
          <Row k="Avg readiness" v={r.avgReadiness != null ? `${r.avgReadiness}` : '—'} />
        </Section>

        {r.topMuscles.length > 0 && (
          <Section icon={Dumbbell} title="Top Trained Muscles">
            {r.topMuscles.map(([m, v]) => <Row key={m} k={m} v={`${v.sets} sets · ${Math.round(v.volume).toLocaleString()} kg`} />)}
          </Section>
        )}

        {r.bestLifts.length > 0 && (
          <Section icon={Trophy} title="Top Lifts This Week">
            {r.bestLifts.slice(0, 3).map((b) => <Row key={b.exercise} k={b.exercise} v={`${Math.round(b.bestE1RM)} kg est 1RM`} />)}
          </Section>
        )}

        {r.deload?.recommended && (
          <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 mb-3 border-luxury-gold/30">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1.5"><AlertTriangle size={14} className="text-luxury-gold" /> Deload {r.deload.severity}</p>
            <ul className="space-y-1">
              {r.deload.reasons.map((reason, i) => <li key={i} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-start gap-1.5"><span className="text-luxury-gold mt-0.5">•</span> {reason}</li>)}
            </ul>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">A deload week typically uses ~60% volume and intensity. This is a training suggestion, not medical advice.</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {r.plateaus.length > 0 && (
          <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 mb-3 flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle size={15} className="text-luxury-gold mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground"><span className="text-foreground font-medium">{r.plateaus[0].exercise}</span> estimated 1RM has been flat for ~{r.plateaus[0].weeks} weeks. Consider a deload or rep-range change.</p>
          </div>
        )}

        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2 leading-relaxed">This is a deterministic summary of your last 7 days. No medical claims — your consistency is what you can control.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Stat({ icon: Icon, label, value, unit, sub, accent }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1"><Icon size={13} className="text-muted-foreground" /><span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span></div>
      <p className={cn('text-xl font-bold tabular-nums', accent === 'red' ? 'text-luxury-red' : accent === 'blue' ? 'text-luxury-blue' : 'text-foreground')}>{value}{unit && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">{unit}</span>}</p>
      {sub && <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{sub}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Section({ icon: Icon, title, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 mb-3">
      <p className="text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2"><Icon size={13} className="text-luxury-blue" /> {title}</p>
      <div className="space-y-1">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ k, v }) {
  return <div className="flex justify-between text-xs"><span className="text-muted-foreground">{k}</span><span className="font-medium tabular-nums">{v}</span></div>;
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Dumbbell, Apple, Activity, Image as ImageIcon, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const TABS = [
  { id: 'program', label: 'Programs', icon: Dumbbell },
  { id: 'meal', label: 'Meals', icon: Apple },
  { id: 'exercise', label: 'Exercises', icon: Dumbbell },
  { id: 'workout', label: 'Workouts', icon: Activity },
  { id: 'photo', label: 'Photos', icon: ImageIcon },
];

export default function ShareContentSheet({ open, onClose, onShare }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('program');
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setLoading(true);
    (async () => {
      let list = [];
      try {
        if (tab === 'program') list = await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.list('-created_date', 50);
        else if (tab === 'meal') list = await base44.entities.SavedMeal.list('-created_date', 50);
        else if (tab === 'exercise') list = await base44.entities.Exercise.list('name', 50);
        else if (tab === 'workout') list = await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 50);
        else if (tab === 'photo') list = await base44.entities.ProgressPhoto.list('-date', 30);
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      setItems(list || []);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  }, [open, tab]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const pick = (item) => {
    let att;
    if (tab === 'program') att = { type: 'program', id: item.id, name: item.name, subtitle: [item.goal, item.split].filter(Boolean).join(' · '), snapshot: { goal: item.goal, split: item.split, days_per_week: item.days_per_week, duration_weeks: item.duration_weeks, days: (item.days || []).map((d) => ({ day_name: d.day_name, focus: d.focus, exercises: (d.exercises || []).length })) } };
    else if (tab === 'meal') att = { type: 'meal', id: item.id, name: item.name, subtitle: `${item.total_calories || 0} kcal`, snapshot: { total_calories: item.total_calories, total_protein_g: item.total_protein_g, items: (item.items || []).map((i) => ({ food_name: i.food_name, quantity: i.quantity, unit: i.unit, calories: i.calories, protein_g: i.protein_g })) } };
    else if (tab === 'exercise') att = { type: 'exercise', id: item.id, name: item.name, subtitle: item.primary_muscle || item.category || '', snapshot: { primary_muscle: item.primary_muscle, category: item.category, equipment: item.equipment, instructions: item.instructions, coaching_cues: item.coaching_cues } };
    else if (tab === 'workout') att = { type: 'workout', id: item.id, name: item.name, subtitle: new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString(), snapshot: { date: item.date, focus: item.focus, total_volume_kg: item.total_volume_kg, duration_minutes: item.duration_minutes, status: item.status } };
    else if (tab === 'photo') att = { type: 'photo', id: item.id, name: `${item.view || 'Front'} ${item.pose || ''}`.trim(), subtitle: new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString(), image_url: item.photo_url, snapshot: { view: item.view, pose: item.pose, photo_url: item.photo_url, date: item.date } };
    onShare(att);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-end justify-center" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl border-t border-border max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-4 pb-2 shrink-0">
          <p className="font-semibold">Share content</p>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground"><X size={20} /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 px-4 pb-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar shrink-0">
          {TABS.map((t) => {
            const Icon = t.icon;
            return (
              <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setTab(t.id)} className={cn('px-3 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap min-h-[40px] flex items-center gap-1', tab === t.id ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>
                <Icon size={13} /> {t.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 pb-6 space-y-2">
          {loading ? (
            <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8 text-sm">Loading…</p>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8 text-sm">Nothing to share here yet.</p>
          ) : items.map((item) => (
            <button key={item.id} onClick={() => pick(item)} className="w-full glass rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center gap-3 text-left active:scale-[0.99]">
              {item.photo_url ? (
                <img src={item.photo_url} alt="" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Dumbbell size={16} /></div>
              )}
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{item.name || (tab === 'photo' ? `${item.view || 'Front'} ${item.pose || ''}`.trim() : 'Untitled')}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate">
                  {tab === 'meal' ? `${item.total_calories || 0} kcal` : tab === 'workout' ? new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString() : tab === 'photo' ? new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString() : [item.goal, item.split, item.primary_muscle].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
                </p>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle } from '@/components/ui/sheet';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dumbbell, Apple, Activity, Image as ImageIcon, AlertTriangle, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';

// Views a shared content attachment. Tries to load the original by id/type
// (respecting RLS — only loads if the receiver has access); if the original is
// missing, deleted, or private, falls back to the snapshot stored in the
// message so the receiver always sees what was shared. Offers copy-to-account
// actions where the receiver can't open the sender's original directly.
export default function SharedContentSheet({ attachment, open, onClose }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [live, setLive] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !attachment) return;
    setLive(null); setCopied(false); setLoading(true);
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { type, id } = attachment;
        let r = null;
        if (type === 'program') r = await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.get(id);
        else if (type === 'meal') r = await base44.entities.SavedMeal.get(id);
        else if (type === 'exercise') r = await base44.entities.Exercise.get(id);
        else if (type === 'workout') r = await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.get(id);
        else if (type === 'photo') r = await base44.entities.ProgressPhoto.get(id);
        setLive(r);
      } catch (e) { setLive(null); }
      finally { setLoading(false); }
    })();
  }, [open, attachment]);

  if (!attachment) return null;
  const s = attachment.snapshot || {};
  const Icon = { program: Dumbbell, meal: Apple, exercise: Dumbbell, workout: Activity, photo: ImageIcon }[attachment.type] || Dumbbell;
  const typeLabel = { program: 'Training Program', meal: 'Saved Meal', exercise: 'Exercise', workout: 'Workout', photo: 'Progress Photo' }[attachment.type] || 'Content';

  const copyProgram = async () => {
    if (!live) return;
    try {
      const { id, created_date, updated_date, created_by_id, archived, draft, active, ...rest } = live;
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.create({ ...rest, name: `${live.name} (Copy)`, active: false, draft: false });
      setCopied(true);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };
  const copyMeal = async () => {
    if (!live) return;
    try {
      const { id, created_date, updated_date, created_by_id, ...rest } = live;
      await base44.entities.SavedMeal.create({ ...rest, name: `${live.name} (Copy)` });
      setCopied(true);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };
  const copyExercise = async () => {
    if (!live) return;
    try {
      const { id, created_date, updated_date, created_by_id, ...rest } = live;
      await base44.entities.Exercise.create({ ...rest, name: `${live.name} (Copy)`, is_custom: true });
      setCopied(true);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <SheetContent side="bottom" className="rounded-t-3xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle className="flex items-center gap-2"><Icon size={16} /> Shared {typeLabel}</SheetTitle>
        </SheetHeader>
        <div className="px-4 pb-6 space-y-3">
          <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3">
            <p className="font-semibold">{attachment.name}</p>
            {attachment.subtitle && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{attachment.subtitle}</p>}
          </div>

          {loading ? (
            <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Loading…</p>
          ) : !live ? (
            <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle size={16} className="text-luxury-gold shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">Original no longer available</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">This content may have been deleted or is private. Showing the shared snapshot instead.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {attachment.type === 'program' && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
                <Stat label="Goal" value={s.goal || live?.goal || '—'} />
                <Stat label="Split" value={s.split || live?.split || '—'} />
                <Stat label="Days/wk" value={s.days_per_week ?? live?.days_per_week ?? '—'} />
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mt-2">Days</p>
              {(s.days || live?.days || []).map((d, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="glass rounded-xl p-3">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium">{d.day_name || `Day ${i + 1}`}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{d.focus || ''} · {d.exercises ?? (d.exercises || []).length ?? 0} exercises</p>
                </div>
              ))}
              {live ? (
                <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => { onClose(); navigate(`/program/${live.id}`); }}>Open Program</Button>
              ) : (
                <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={copyProgram} disabled={copied}>
                  {copied ? <><Check size={16} /> Copied to my programs</> : <><Copy size={16} /> Copy to my programs</>}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {attachment.type === 'meal' && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-center">
                <Stat label="Calories" value={`${s.total_calories ?? live?.total_calories ?? 0}`} />
                <Stat label="Protein" value={`${s.total_protein_g ?? live?.total_protein_g ?? 0}g`} />
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mt-2">Items</p>
              {(s.items || live?.items || []).map((it, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="glass rounded-xl p-3 flex justify-between">
                  <div><p className="text-sm font-medium">{it.food_name}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{it.quantity} {it.unit || ''}</p></div>
                  <p className="text-sm tabular-nums">{it.calories || 0} kcal</p>
                </div>
              ))}
              {live && (
                <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={copyMeal} disabled={copied}>
                  {copied ? <><Check size={16} /> Copied</> : <><Copy size={16} /> Copy to my meals</>}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {attachment.type === 'exercise' && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-center">
                <Stat label="Muscle" value={s.primary_muscle || live?.primary_muscle || '—'} />
                <Stat label="Category" value={s.category || live?.category || '—'} />
              </div>
              {(s.instructions || live?.instructions) && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{s.instructions || live.instructions}</p>}
              {(s.coaching_cues || live?.coaching_cues)?.length ? (
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1">Cues</p>
                  <ul className="text-sm space-y-1">{(s.coaching_cues || live.coaching_cues).map((c, i) => <li key={i}>• {c}</li>)}</ul>
                </div>
              ) : null}
              {live && (
                <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={copyExercise} disabled={copied}>
                  {copied ? <><Check size={16} /> Copied</> : <><Copy size={16} /> Add to my exercises</>}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {attachment.type === 'workout' && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
                <Stat label="Date" value={live ? new Date(live.date).toLocaleDateString() : new Date(s.date).toLocaleDateString()} />
                <Stat label="Volume" value={`${Math.round(s.total_volume_kg ?? live?.total_volume_kg ?? 0)}kg`} />
                <Stat label="Duration" value={`${s.duration_minutes ?? live?.duration_minutes ?? 0}m`} />
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Workouts are view-only summaries of a completed session.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {attachment.type === 'photo' && (
            (s.photo_url || live?.photo_url) ? (
              <img src={s.photo_url || live.photo_url} alt="" className="w-full rounded-xl object-cover max-h-[50vh]" />
            ) : <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Photo unavailable.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-xl py-2">
      <p className="text-sm font-bold truncate">{value}</p>
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Play, Plus, Activity, Clock, TrendingUp, Dumbbell } from 'lucide-react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';

export default function LiveTraining() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [active, setActive] = useState(null);
  const [recent, setRecent] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('lraz_active_workout');
      if (raw) setActive(JSON.parse(raw));
    } catch (e) {}
    base44.entities.WorkoutSession.filter({ status: 'completed' }, { sort: '-date', limit: 3 }).then((page) => setRecent(page.items)).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="grid min-w-0 grid-cols-1 items-start gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
      {active ? (
        <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/40 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate('/workout/new')}>

              <Play size={22} className="text-luxury-blue" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="font-semibold">Resume Workout</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-white/60 truncate">{active.session?.name || active.name || 'Active session'} · {active.blocks?.length || 0} exercises</p>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue shrink-0 min-h-[40px]">Resume</Button>

          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <Button className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/workout/new')}><Plus size={16} /> Quick Log</Button>
            <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/train')}><Activity size={16} /> Programs</Button>

FILE: src/components/train/TodayView.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Play, Dumbbell, Clock, Layers, Plus, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function TodayView({ programs }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [scheduled, setScheduled] = useState(null);
  const [completedCount, setCompletedCount] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const activeProgram = useMemo(() => programs.find((p) => p.active && !p.archived && !p.draft) || programs.find((p) => !p.archived && !p.draft) || null, [programs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      const today = localDateStr();
      try {
        const [sched, completed] = await Promise.all([
          base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.filter({ date: today, completed: false }, { limit: 1 }),
          activeProgram ? base44.entities.WorkoutSession.count({ program_id: activeProgram.id, status: 'completed' }) : Promise.resolve(0),
        ]);
        if (!active) return;
        setScheduled(sched.items[0] || null);
        setCompletedCount(completed);
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      finally { if (active) setLoading(false); }
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [activeProgram?.id]);

  const todayDay = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeProgram?.days?.length) return null;
    const days = activeProgram.days;
    if (activeProgram.schedule_type === 'fixed' && activeProgram.weekday_map) {
      const jsDow = new Date().getDay();
      const mondayIndex = (jsDow + 6) % 7;
      const dayIndex = activeProgram.weekday_map[String(mondayIndex)];
      if (dayIndex != null && days[dayIndex]) return { ...days[dayIndex], _index: dayIndex };
    }
    const nextIndex = days.length ? completedCount % days.length : 0;
    return { ...days[nextIndex], _index: nextIndex };
  }, [activeProgram, completedCount]);

  const startWorkout = () => {
    if (scheduled?.program_id && scheduled.day_index != null) {
      navigate(`/workout/new?programId=${scheduled.program_id}&dayIndex=${scheduled.day_index}`);
    } else if (activeProgram && todayDay?._index != null) {
      navigate(`/workout/new?programId=${activeProgram.id}&dayIndex=${todayDay._index}`);
    } else {
      navigate('/workout/new');
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="py-16 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading today's training…</div>;

  if (!activeProgram) {
    return (
      <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-primary/30 text-center py-10">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl glass flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4"><Layers size={26} className="text-primary" /></div>
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg mb-1">No active program</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-5 max-w-xs mx-auto">Create or activate a program to get a structured plan, or jump into a quick log.</p>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-xs mx-auto">
          <Button className="btn-gold min-h-[48px]" onClick={() => navigate('/program/new?mode=templates')}><Plus size={16} /> New Program</Button>
          <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[48px]" onClick={() => navigate('/workout/new')}><Play size={16} /> Quick Log</Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const exerciseCount = todayDay?.exercises?.length || 0;
  const estimatedMinutes = activeProgram.session_duration_minutes || 45;
  const weekNum = Math.min(activeProgram.duration_weeks || 8, Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Date.now() - new Date(activeProgram.start_date || activeProgram.created_date).getTime()) / (7 * 86400000))));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-primary/30">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
          <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Today's Workout</p>
          <button onClick={() => navigate(`/program/${activeProgram.id}`)} className="text-[11px] text-primary flex items-center gap-0.5">Program <ChevronRight size={12} /></button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">{todayDay?.day_name || (scheduled?.title || 'Workout')}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-1.5">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"><Dumbbell size={12} /> {exerciseCount} exercises</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1"><Clock size={12} /> ~{estimatedMinutes} min</p>
          {todayDay?.focus && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{todayDay.focus}</p>}
        </div>

        {todayDay?.exercises?.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-1.5 mt-4">
            {todayDay.exercises.map((ex, i) => (
              <button key={i} onClick={() => navigate(`/exercise/${ex.exercise_id || ex.exercise_name?.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`)} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl glass hover:bg-muted/30 transition-all text-left min-h-[44px]">
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-xs font-bold">{i + 1}</div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{ex.exercise_name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{ex.sets || 1} sets · {ex.reps_low || ''}{ex.reps_high ? `-${ex.reps_high}` : ''} reps{ex.rir_target != null ? ` @${ex.rir_target}RIR` : ''}</p>
                </div>
                <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <Button onClick={startWorkout} className="w-full btn-gold min-h-[52px] text-base font-semibold mt-4"><Play size={18} /> Start Workout</Button>
      </Card>

      {/* Program progress strip */}
      <button onClick={() => navigate(`/program/${activeProgram.id}`)} className="w-full glass rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between hover:border-primary/30 transition-all min-h-[64px]">
        <div className="flex-1 text-left min-w-0">
          <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Active Program</p>
          <p className="font-semibold truncate">{activeProgram.name}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{activeProgram.goal} · Week {weekNum} of {activeProgram.duration_weeks || 8}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end shrink-0 ml-3">
          <span className="text-lg font-bold text-primary tabular-nums">{Math.round((weekNum / (activeProgram.duration_weeks || 8)) * 100)}%</span>
          <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/train/TrainAnalysis.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Card, Stat, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { BarChart, Bar, LineChart, Line, AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid, Legend } from 'recharts';
import { Activity, TrendingUp, Dumbbell, Trophy, Clock, Flame, Calendar, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { loadWorkoutData, groupSetsBySession, muscleGroupVolume, weeklyVolumeTrend, topExercisesByVolume, workoutFrequency, trainingConsistency, prProgression, durationTrend, cardioVsTraining } from '@/lib/workoutData';
import { getAllExercises } from '@/lib/exerciseDatabase';

const tooltipStyle = { background: 'hsl(var(--card))', border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 11 };

export default function TrainAnalysis() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [exMap, setExMap] = useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [d, exercises] = await Promise.all([loadWorkoutData(), getAllExercises()]);
        if (!alive) return;
        setData(d);
        const map = {};
        exercises.forEach((e) => { map[e.name] = e; });
        setExMap(map);
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      finally { if (alive) setLoading(false); }
    })();
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, []);

  const setsBySession = useMemo(() => (data ? groupSetsBySession(data.sets) : {}), [data]);

  const analytics = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data) return null;
    const allCompletedSets = data.sets.filter((s) => s.completed);
    const totalVolume = allCompletedSets.reduce((a, s) => a + (Number(s.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(s.reps) || 0), 0);
    const totalSets = allCompletedSets.length;
    const totalReps = allCompletedSets.reduce((a, s) => a + (Number(s.reps) || 0), 0);
    const consistency = trainingConsistency(data.sessions);
    const frequency = workoutFrequency(data.sessions);
    const weekly = weeklyVolumeTrend(data.sessions, setsBySession);
    const muscleVol = muscleGroupVolume(allCompletedSets, exMap);
    const topEx = topExercisesByVolume(allCompletedSets);
    const prs = prProgression(data.sets, setsBySession);
    const durations = durationTrend(data.sessions);
    const cardioTrain = cardioVsTraining(data.sessions, data.cardio);
    const totalDuration = data.sessions.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.duration_minutes || 0), 0);
    const avgDuration = data.sessions.length ? Math.round(totalDuration / data.sessions.length) : 0;
    return { totalVolume: Math.round(totalVolume), totalSets, totalReps, consistency, frequency, weekly, muscleVol, topEx, prs, durations, cardioTrain, totalDuration, avgDuration, sessionCount: data.sessions.length, prCount: prs.length };
  }, [data, setsBySession, exMap]);

  if (loading) return <div className="py-20 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">Loading analysis…</div>;
  if (!analytics || analytics.sessionCount === 0) {
    return <EmptyState icon={Activity} title="No data to analyze yet" description="Complete a few workouts and your training analysis will appear here with volume, frequency, PRs, and trends." />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Summary stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card><Stat label="Total Volume" value={analytics.totalVolume} unit="kg" accent="blue" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Workouts" value={analytics.sessionCount} /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Total Sets" value={analytics.totalSets} /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Total Reps" value={analytics.totalReps} /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="PRs" value={analytics.prCount} accent="gold" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Current Streak" value={analytics.consistency.streak} unit="days" accent="red" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Avg Duration" value={analytics.avgDuration} unit="min" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Days Trained" value={analytics.consistency.totalDays} /></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Weekly volume trend */}
      {analytics.weekly.some((w) => w.volume > 0) && (
        <Card>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><TrendingUp size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Weekly Volume (12 weeks)</p>
          <div className="h-44">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <AreaChart data={analytics.weekly}>
                <defs><linearGradient id="volGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" stopOpacity={0.4} /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" stopOpacity={0} /></linearGradient></defs>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} interval={1} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={tooltipStyle} />
                <Area isAnimationActive={false} type="monotone" dataKey="volume" stroke="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" strokeWidth={2} fill="url(#volGrad)" />
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Workout frequency */}
      {analytics.frequency.some((w) => w.sessions > 0) && (
        <Card>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Calendar size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Workout Frequency (8 weeks)</p>
          <div className="h-40">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={analytics.frequency}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} allowDecimals={false} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={tooltipStyle} />
                <Bar isAnimationActive={false} dataKey="sessions" fill="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Muscle group volume */}
      {analytics.muscleVol.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Dumbbell size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Muscle Group Volume</p>
          <div className="h-56">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={analytics.muscleVol} layout="vertical">
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis type="number" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                <YAxis type="category" dataKey="group" tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} width={70} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={tooltipStyle} />
                <Bar isAnimationActive={false} dataKey="volume" fill="hsl(var(--luxury-red))" radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Top exercises */}
      {analytics.topEx.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Zap size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Top Exercises by Volume</p>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {analytics.topEx.map((e, i) => {
              const max = analytics.topEx[0].volume || 1;
              return (
                <div key={e.name}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                    <span className="truncate">{i + 1}. {e.name}</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums shrink-0 ml-2">{e.volume}kg · {e.sets} sets</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/30 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="h-full bg-luxury-blue rounded-full" style={{ width: `${(e.volume / max) * 100}%` }} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* PR progression */}
      {analytics.prs.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Trophy size={15} className="text-luxury-gold" /> PR History ({analytics.prs.length})</p>
          <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
            {analytics.prs.slice().reverse().slice(0, 20).map((pr, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-1.5 border-b border-border/30 last:border-0">
                <Trophy size={12} className="text-luxury-gold shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-medium truncate flex-1" dir="auto">{pr.exercise}</span>
                <span className="tabular-nums">{pr.weight}kg × {pr.reps}</span>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums shrink-0">{pr.date}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Duration trend */}
      {analytics.durations.length > 1 && (
        <Card>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Clock size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Workout Duration Trend</p>
          <div className="h-36">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <LineChart data={analytics.durations}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={tooltipStyle} />
                <Line isAnimationActive={false} type="monotone" dataKey="duration" stroke="hsl(var(--luxury-gold))" strokeWidth={2} dot={{ r: 2 }} />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Cardio vs Training */}
      {analytics.cardioTrain.some((w) => w.training > 0 || w.cardio > 0) && (
        <Card>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Flame size={15} className="text-luxury-red" /> Cardio vs Training (min/week)</p>
          <div className="h-44">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={analytics.cardioTrain}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={tooltipStyle} />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <Bar isAnimationActive={false} dataKey="training" fill="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
                <Bar isAnimationActive={false} dataKey="cardio" fill="hsl(var(--luxury-red))" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/train/TrainCalendar.jsx

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Dumbbell, Flame, Check, Calendar as CalIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn, localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';
import useTrainingCalendar from '@/hooks/useTrainingCalendar';
import WorkoutHistoryViewer from '@/components/train/WorkoutHistoryViewer';

const WD = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];

export default function TrainCalendar() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState(() => { const d = new Date(); return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), 1); });
  const calendar = useTrainingCalendar(cursor);
  const data = calendar.data;
  const loading = calendar.isLoading;
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);



  // Map: dateStr -> { sessions: [], cardio: [], scheduled: [] }
  const dayMap = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data) return {};
    const map = {};
    data.sessions.forEach((s) => {
      const d = localDateStr(s.date);
      if (!map[d]) map[d] = { sessions: [], cardio: [], scheduled: [] };
      map[d].sessions.push(s);
    });
    data.cardio.forEach((c) => {
      const d = localDateStr(c.date);
      if (!map[d]) map[d] = { sessions: [], cardio: [], scheduled: [] };
      map[d].cardio.push(c);
    });
    data.scheduled.forEach((s) => {
      const d = localDateStr(s.date);
      if (!map[d]) map[d] = { sessions: [], cardio: [], scheduled: [] };
      map[d].scheduled.push(s);
    });
    return map;
  }, [data]);

  const grid = useMemo(() => {
    const year = cursor.getFullYear();
    const month = cursor.getMonth();
    const first = new Date(year, month, 1);
    const startOffset = (first.getDay() + 6) % 7; // Monday=0
    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const cells = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < startOffset; i++) cells.push(null);
    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
      const date = new Date(year, month, d);
      const str = localDateStr(date);
      cells.push({ day: d, date: str, info: dayMap[str] });
    }
    return cells;
  }, [cursor, dayMap]);

  const monthLabel = cursor.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  const todayStr = localDateStr();

  if (loading) return <div className="py-20 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">Loading calendar…</div>;

  const hasAny = data && (data.sessions.length > 0 || data.scheduled.length > 0 || data.cardio.length > 0);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setCursor(new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth() - 1, 1))} className="min-h-[40px]"><ChevronLeft size={18} /></Button>
        <p className="font-semibold">{monthLabel}</p>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setCursor(new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth() + 1, 1))} className="min-h-[40px]"><ChevronRight size={18} /></Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 mb-1">
        {WD.map((w) => <div key={w} className="text-center text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground py-1">{w}</div>)}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
        {grid.map((cell, i) => {
          if (!cell) return <div key={i} />;
          const info = cell.info;
          const hasWorkout = info?.sessions?.length > 0;
          const hasCardio = info?.cardio?.length > 0;
          const hasScheduled = info?.scheduled?.length > 0;
          const isToday = cell.date === todayStr;
          return (
            <button
              key={i}
              onClick={() => {
                if (hasWorkout) {
                  const s = info.sessions[0];
                  setSelected({ session: s });
                } else if (hasScheduled) {
                  const sch = info.scheduled[0];
                  if (sch.program_id) navigate(`/program/${sch.program_id}`);
                }
              }}
              className={cn(
                'aspect-square rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative transition-all min-h-[40px]',
                hasWorkout ? 'bg-luxury-blue/20 border border-luxury-blue/40' :
                hasScheduled ? 'bg-luxury-gold/10 border border-luxury-gold/30' :
                hasCardio ? 'bg-luxury-red/10 border border-luxury-red/30' :
                'glass',
                isToday && 'ring-1 ring-luxury-blue',
                (hasWorkout || hasScheduled || hasCardio) && 'cursor-pointer hover:scale-105'
              )}
            >
              <span className={cn('text-xs font-medium', isToday && 'text-luxury-blue')}>{cell.day}</span>
              <div className="flex gap-0.5 mt-0.5">
                {hasWorkout && <Dumbbell size={9} className="text-luxury-blue" />}
                {hasCardio && <Flame size={9} className="text-luxury-red" />}
                {hasScheduled && !hasWorkout && <Check size={9} className="text-luxury-gold" />}
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Legend */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Dumbbell size={11} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Completed</span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Check size={11} className="text-luxury-gold" /> Planned</span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Flame size={11} className="text-luxury-red" /> Cardio</span>
      </div>

      {calendar.error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">Calendar could not load. <button onClick={() => calendar.refetch()} className="min-h-11 underline">Retry</button></p>}
      {calendar.hasNextPage && <Button variant="outline" className="w-full" disabled={calendar.isFetchingNextPage} onClick={() => calendar.fetchNextPage()}>{calendar.isFetchingNextPage ? 'Loading…' : 'Load more entries for this month'}</Button>}
      {!hasAny && (
        <EmptyState icon={CalIcon} title="No calendar entries yet" description="Completed workouts, planned sessions, and cardio will appear here on their dates." />
      )}

      {selected && (
        <WorkoutHistoryViewer session={selected.session} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { History, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import useWorkoutHistory from '@/hooks/useWorkoutHistory';
import WorkoutHistoryCard from '@/components/train/WorkoutHistoryCard';
import WorkoutHistoryViewer from '@/components/train/WorkoutHistoryViewer';

export default function TrainHistory() {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const { sessions, summaries, count, loading, error, hasMore, loadingMore, loadMore, hasMoreMatches, loadingMatches, loadMatches, searching } = useWorkoutHistory(search);
  return <div className="space-y-3">
    <div className="relative"><Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" /><Input aria-label="Search workout history" value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search notes, exercises, workouts…" className="pl-9 glass" /></div>
    {loading || searching ? <p role="status" className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading history…</p> : <>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{count ?? '—'} workouts{search.trim() ? ' matched' : ''}</p>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">History could not be loaded. Please reopen History to retry.</p>}
      {!sessions.length && !error && <EmptyState icon={History} title={search ? 'No matching workouts' : 'No completed workouts yet'} description={search ? 'Try another workout, exercise or note.' : 'Finish a workout to see its full details, notes and personal records.'} />}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-3">{sessions.map(session => <WorkoutHistoryCard key={session.id} session={session} summary={summaries[session.id]} onOpen={() => setSelected(session)} />)}</div>
      {hasMore && <Button variant="outline" disabled={loadingMore} onClick={() => loadMore()} className="w-full">{loadingMore ? 'Loading…' : 'Load more workouts'}</Button>}
      {hasMoreMatches && <Button variant="outline" disabled={loadingMatches} onClick={() => loadMatches()} className="w-full">{loadingMatches ? 'Searching…' : 'Find more exercise and note matches'}</Button>}
    </>}
    {selected && <WorkoutHistoryViewer session={selected} summary={summaries[selected.id]} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} />}
  </div>;
}

import React from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { X, Clock, Dumbbell, Trophy, StickyNote, TrendingUp } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn, localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';
import WorkoutHistoryActions from '@/components/train/WorkoutHistoryActions';
import ResponsiveSheet from '@/components/ui/ResponsiveSheet';

export default function WorkoutDetailSheet({ session, sets, onClose, totals, footer }) {
  if (!session) return null;
  const completed = sets.filter((s) => s.completed);
  const byExercise = {};
  completed.forEach((s) => {
    if (!byExercise[s.exercise_name]) byExercise[s.exercise_name] = [];
    byExercise[s.exercise_name].push(s);
  });
  const exerciseNames = Object.keys(byExercise);
  const volume = completed.reduce((a, s) => a + (Number(s.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(s.reps) || 0), 0);
  const prCount = completed.filter((s) => s.is_pr).length;
  const date = localDateStr(session.date);

  return (
    <ResponsiveSheet onClose={onClose} title={session.name || 'Workout'}>
      <div className="min-w-0 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg truncate">{session.name || 'Workout'}</h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              {date}
              {session.program_day_name ? ` · ${session.program_day_name}` : ''}
              {session.focus ? ` · ${session.focus}` : ''}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="shrink-0 min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>

        <WorkoutHistoryActions session={session} onChanged={onClose} />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 mb-4">
          <DetailStat icon={Clock} label="Duration" value={session.duration_minutes ? `${session.duration_minutes}m` : '—'} />
          <DetailStat icon={TrendingUp} label="Volume" value={`${Math.round(session.total_volume_kg ?? volume)}kg`} accent="blue" />
          <DetailStat icon={Dumbbell} label="Exercises" value={totals?.exerciseCount ?? exerciseNames.length} />
          <DetailStat icon={Trophy} label="PRs" value={session.pr_count ?? prCount} accent="gold" />
        </div>

        {session.notes && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 glass rounded-xl">
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1 flex items-center gap-1"><StickyNote size={11} /> Workout Notes</p>
            <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap" dir="auto">{session.notes}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {exerciseNames.map((name) => {
            const exSets = byExercise[name].sort((a, b) => (a.set_index || 0) - (b.set_index || 0));
            const exNotes = exSets.find((s) => s.notes)?.notes;
            const exVol = exSets.reduce((a, s) => a + (Number(s.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(s.reps) || 0), 0);
            return (
              <div key={name} className="glass rounded-xl p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <p className="font-medium text-sm truncate" dir="auto">{name}</p>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0 ml-2">{Math.round(exVol)}kg</span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  {exSets.map((s, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1 text-xs">
                      <span className="w-5 text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{i + 1}</span>
                      <span className="font-medium tabular-nums">{s.weight_kg || 0}kg</span>
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">×</span>
                      <span className="font-medium tabular-nums">{s.reps || 0}</span>
                      {(s.rpe != null || s.rir != null) && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-1">
                          {s.rpe != null ? `RPE ${s.rpe}` : ''}{s.rpe != null && s.rir != null ? ' · ' : ''}{s.rir != null ? `RIR ${s.rir}` : ''}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {s.is_pr && <Trophy size={11} className="text-luxury-gold ml-auto" />}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {exNotes && (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-border/40 whitespace-pre-wrap" dir="auto">
                    <StickyNote size={10} className="inline mr-1" />{exNotes}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {footer}
      </div>
    </ResponsiveSheet>
  );
}

function DetailStat({ icon: Icon, label, value, accent }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-xl p-2.5 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
      <Icon size={14} className={cn('mb-1', accent === 'blue' ? 'text-luxury-blue' : accent === 'gold' ? 'text-luxury-gold' : 'text-muted-foreground')} />
      <span className={cn('text-sm font-bold tabular-nums', accent === 'blue' ? 'text-luxury-blue' : accent === 'gold' ? 'text-luxury-gold' : 'text-foreground')}>{value}</span>
      <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/train/WorkoutHistoryActions.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Pencil, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import WorkoutHistoryEditor from '@/components/train/WorkoutHistoryEditor';
import { deleteWorkoutHistory } from '@/lib/workoutHistoryEditing';

export default function WorkoutHistoryActions({ session, onChanged }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const edit = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setError('');
    try { setPage(await base44.entities.WorkoutSet.filter({ session_id: session.id }, { sort: 'created_date', limit: 100 })); setMode('edit'); }
    catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Could not load saved sets.'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const remove = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setError('');
    try { await deleteWorkoutHistory(session); setMode(null); onChanged(); }
    catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Could not delete this workout.'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return <div className="mb-4 space-y-2">
    <div className="flex gap-2"><Button variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={edit} className="flex-1"><Pencil size={15} />{busy ? 'Please wait…' : 'Edit workout'}</Button><Button variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setMode('delete')} className="text-destructive"><Trash2 size={15} />Delete</Button></div>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
    {mode === 'edit' && page && <WorkoutHistoryEditor session={session} firstPage={page} onClose={() => setMode(null)} onSaved={() => { setMode(null); onChanged(); }} />}
    {mode === 'delete' && <Dialog open onOpenChange={open => { if (!open && !busy) setMode(null); }}><DialogContent className="record-dialog"><DialogTitle>Delete this workout?</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>The workout and its strength sets will be permanently removed. Any recorded cardio will be kept in Cardio History.</DialogDescription>{error && <p role="alert" className="text-destructive text-sm">{error}</p>}<div className="flex gap-3"><Button variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setMode(null)} className="flex-1">Cancel</Button><Button variant="destructive" disabled={busy} onClick={remove} className="flex-1">{busy ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete workout'}</Button></div></DialogContent></Dialog>}
  </div>;
}

FILE: src/components/train/WorkoutHistoryEditor.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import RecordField from '@/components/records/RecordField';
import WorkoutSetEditor from '@/components/train/WorkoutSetEditor';
import { workoutFields } from '@/lib/recordFields';
import { fieldValue } from '@/lib/recordEditing';
import { saveWorkoutHistory } from '@/lib/workoutHistoryEditing';

export default function WorkoutHistoryEditor({ session, firstPage, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => Object.fromEntries(workoutFields.map(field => [field.key, fieldValue(session, field)])));
  const [original, setOriginal] = useState(firstPage.items);
  const [sets, setSets] = useState(firstPage.items);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(firstPage);
  const [removed, setRemoved] = useState([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const more = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setError('');
    try { const next = await base44.entities.WorkoutSet.filter({ session_id: session.id }, { sort: 'created_date', limit: 100, cursor: page.next_cursor }); setOriginal(prev => [...prev, ...next.items]); setSets(prev => [...prev, ...next.items]); setPage(next); }
    catch (err) { setError(err.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const save = async event => {
    event.preventDefault(); setBusy(true); setError('');
    try { await saveWorkoutHistory(session, original, sets, removed, form); await onSaved(); }
    catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Changes could not be saved. Please retry.'); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return <Dialog open onOpenChange={open => { if (!open && !busy) onClose(); }}><DialogContent className="record-dialog">
    <DialogTitle>Edit workout</DialogTitle><DialogDescription>Correct workout details and saved sets. Removed sets are deleted only when you save.</DialogDescription>
    <form onSubmit={save} className="space-y-5"><fieldset disabled={busy} className="space-y-5">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">{workoutFields.map(field => <RecordField key={field.key} field={field} value={form[field.key]} onChange={value => setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field.key]: value }))} />)}</div>
      <h4 className="font-semibold">Saved sets</h4>
      {sets.map((set, index) => <WorkoutSetEditor key={set.id} set={set} index={index} removed={removed.includes(set.id)} onRemove={() => setRemoved(prev => prev.includes(set.id) ? prev.filter(id => id !== set.id) : [...prev, set.id])} onChange={(key, value) => setSets(prev => prev.map(item => item.id === set.id ? { ...item, [key]: value } : item))} />)}
      {page.has_more && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={more} className="w-full">Load remaining sets before saving</Button>}
    </fieldset>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
      <div className="sticky bottom-0 bg-background py-3 flex gap-3"><Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy} className="flex-1">Cancel</Button><Button type="submit" disabled={busy || page.has_more} className="flex-1">{busy ? 'Please wait…' : 'Save changes'}</Button></div>
    </form>
  </DialogContent></Dialog>;
}

import React from 'react';

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import WorkoutDetailSheet from '@/components/train/WorkoutDetailSheet';

export default function WorkoutHistoryViewer({ session, summary, onClose }) {
  const data = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['workout-history-sets', session.id], initialPageParam: undefined, queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => base44.entities.WorkoutSet.filter({ session_id: session.id }, { sort: 'created_date', limit: 100, cursor: pageParam }), getNextPageParam: page => page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined });
  return <WorkoutDetailSheet session={session} sets={data.data?.pages.flatMap(page => page.items) || []} totals={summary} onClose={onClose} footer={<>
    {data.isLoading && <p role="status" className="py-4 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading saved sets…</p>}
    {data.error && <p role="alert" className="text-destructive">Could not load sets. <button onClick={() => data.refetch()} className="underline min-h-11">Retry</button></p>}
    {data.hasNextPage && <Button variant="outline" disabled={data.isFetchingNextPage} onClick={() => data.fetchNextPage()} className="w-full mt-4">{data.isFetchingNextPage ? 'Loading…' : 'Load more saved sets'}</Button>}
  </>} />;
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Drawer, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle } from '@/components/ui/drawer';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Check, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function ActionSelect({ label, value, options, onChange, className, placeholder = 'Select' }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const display = value != null && value !== '' ? String(value) : placeholder;

  return (
    <div className={cn('flex flex-col gap-1', className)}>
      {label && <Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        className="h-11 min-h-[44px] rounded-lg glass border border-border bg-transparent px-3 text-sm flex items-center justify-between w-full"
      >
        <span className="truncate">{display}</span>
        <ChevronDown size={16} className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
      </button>
      <Drawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
        <DrawerContent className="max-w-md mx-auto">
          <DrawerHeader className="text-center">
            {label && <DrawerTitle>{label}</DrawerTitle>}
          </DrawerHeader>
          <div className="px-3 pb-6 space-y-1.5 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto safe-pb">
            {options.map((o) => {
              const val = typeof o === 'object' && o !== null ? o.value : o;
              const lbl = typeof o === 'object' && o !== null ? o.label : o;
              const selected = String(val) === String(value);
              return (
                <button
                  key={String(val)}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { onChange(val); setOpen(false); }}
                  className={cn(
                    'w-full min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-between px-4 rounded-xl text-sm transition-all',
                    selected ? 'bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue' : 'hover:bg-muted/40'
                  )}
                >
                  <span>{lbl}</span>
                  {selected && <Check size={16} />}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </DrawerContent>
      </Drawer>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ActionSelect;

import * as React from "react"
import { cva } from "class-variance-authority";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const alertVariants = cva(
  "relative w-full rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm [&>svg+div]:translate-y-[-3px] [&>svg]:absolute [&>svg]:left-4 [&>svg]:top-4 [&>svg]:text-foreground [&>svg~*]:pl-7",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-background text-foreground",
        destructive:
          "border-destructive/50 text-destructive dark:border-destructive [&>svg]:text-destructive",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

FILE: src/components/ui/carousel.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import * as React from "react"
import useEmblaCarousel from "embla-carousel-react";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

const CarouselContext = React.createContext(null)

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />")
  }

  return context
}

const Carousel = React.forwardRef((
  {
    orientation = "horizontal",
    opts,
    setApi,
    plugins,
    className,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref
) => {
  const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel({
    ...opts,
    axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
  }, plugins)
  const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false)
  const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false)

  const onSelect = React.useCallback((api) => {
    if (!api) {
      return
    }

    setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev())
    setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext())
  }, [])

  const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollPrev()
  }, [api])

  const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollNext()
  }, [api])

  const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback((event) => {
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
      event.preventDefault()
      scrollPrev()
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
      event.preventDefault()
      scrollNext()
    }
  }, [scrollPrev, scrollNext])

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api || !setApi) {
      return
    }

    setApi(api)
  }, [api, setApi])

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api) {
      return
    }

    onSelect(api)
    api.on("reInit", onSelect)
    api.on("select", onSelect)

    return () => {
      api?.off("select", onSelect)
    };
  }, [api, onSelect])

  return (
    (<CarouselContext.Provider
      value={{
        carouselRef,
        api: api,
        opts,
        orientation:
          orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
        scrollPrev,
        scrollNext,
        canScrollPrev,
        canScrollNext,
      }}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
        className={cn("relative", className)}
        role="region"
        aria-roledescription="carousel"
        {...props}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </CarouselContext.Provider>)
  );
})
Carousel.displayName = "Carousel"

const CarouselContent = React.forwardRef(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    (<div ref={carouselRef} className="overflow-hidden">
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex",
          orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props} />
    </div>)
  );
})
CarouselContent.displayName = "CarouselContent"

const CarouselItem = React.forwardRef(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    (<div
      ref={ref}
      role="group"
      aria-roledescription="slide"
      className={cn(
        "min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full",
        orientation === "horizontal" ? "pl-4" : "pt-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props} />)
  );
})
CarouselItem.displayName = "CarouselItem"

const CarouselPrevious = React.forwardRef(({ className, variant = "outline", size = "icon", ...props }, ref) => {
  const { orientation, scrollPrev, canScrollPrev } = useCarousel()

  return (
    (<Button
      ref={ref}
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn("absolute  h-8 w-8 rounded-full", orientation === "horizontal"
        ? "-left-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"
        : "-top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90", className)}
      disabled={!canScrollPrev}
      onClick={scrollPrev}
      {...props}>
      <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
      <span className="sr-only">Previous slide</span>
    </Button>)
  );
})
CarouselPrevious.displayName = "CarouselPrevious"

const CarouselNext = React.forwardRef(({ className, variant = "outline", size = "icon", ...props }, ref) => {
  const { orientation, scrollNext, canScrollNext } = useCarousel()

  return (
    (<Button
      ref={ref}
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn("absolute h-8 w-8 rounded-full", orientation === "horizontal"
        ? "-right-12 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"
        : "-bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90", className)}
      disabled={!canScrollNext}
      onClick={scrollNext}
      {...props}>
      <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
      <span className="sr-only">Next slide</span>
    </Button>)
  );
})
CarouselNext.displayName = "CarouselNext"

export { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselNext };
