"use client";
import * as React from "react"
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = {
  light: "",
  dark: ".dark"
}

const ChartContext = React.createContext(null)

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />")
  }

  return context
}

const ChartContainer = React.forwardRef(({ id, className, children, config, ...props }, ref) => {
  const uniqueId = React.useId()
  const chartId = `chart-${id || uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`

  return (
    (<ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-chart={chartId}
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-none [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-none [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-none",
          className
        )}
        {...props}>
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>)
  );
})
ChartContainer.displayName = "Chart"

const ChartStyle = ({
  id,
  config
}) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(([, config]) => config.theme || config.color)

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    (<style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
.map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
const color =
  itemConfig.theme?.[theme] ||
  itemConfig.color
return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null
})
.join("\n")}
}
`)
          .join("\n"),
      }} />)
  );
}

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip

const ChartTooltipContent = React.forwardRef((
  {
    active,
    payload,
    className,
    indicator = "dot",
    hideLabel = false,
    hideIndicator = false,
    label,
    labelFormatter,
    labelClassName,
    formatter,
    color,
    nameKey,
    labelKey,
  },
  ref
) => {
  const { config } = useChart()

  const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    const [item] = payload
    const key = `${labelKey || item.dataKey || item.name || "value"}`
    const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
    const value =
      !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
        ? config[label]?.label || label
        : itemConfig?.label

    if (labelFormatter) {
      return (
        (<div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
          {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
        </div>)
      );
    }

    if (!value) {
      return null
    }

    return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>;
  }, [
    label,
    labelFormatter,
    payload,
    hideLabel,
    labelClassName,
    config,
    labelKey,
  ])

  if (!active || !payload?.length) {
    return null
  }

  const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot"

  return (
    (<div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        "grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
        className
      )}>
      {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        {payload.map((item, index) => {
          const key = `${nameKey || item.name || item.dataKey || "value"}`
          const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
          const indicatorColor = color || item.payload.fill || item.color

          return (
            (<div
              key={item.dataKey}
              className={cn(
                "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
                indicator === "dot" && "items-center"
              )}>
              {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
              ) : (
                <>
                  {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                    <itemConfig.icon />
                  ) : (
                    !hideIndicator && (
                      <div
                        className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-[--color-border] bg-[--color-bg]", {
                          "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
                          "w-1": indicator === "line",
                          "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
                            indicator === "dashed",
                          "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                        })}
                        style={
                          {
                            "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                            "--color-border": indicatorColor
                          }
                        } />
                    )
                  )}
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                      nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center"
                    )}>
                    <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                      {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                        {itemConfig?.label || item.name}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {item.value && (
                      <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums text-foreground">
                        {item.value.toLocaleString()}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>)
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>)
  );
})
ChartTooltipContent.displayName = "ChartTooltip"

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend

const ChartLegendContent = React.forwardRef((
  { className, hideIcon = false, payload, verticalAlign = "bottom", nameKey },
  ref
) => {
  const { config } = useChart()

  if (!payload?.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    (<div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
        verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
        className
      )}>
      {payload.map((item) => {
        const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || "value"}`
        const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)

        return (
          (<div
            key={item.value}
            className={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
            )}>
            {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
              <itemConfig.icon />
            ) : (
              <div
                className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: item.color,
                }} />
            )}
            {itemConfig?.label}
          </div>)
        );
      })}
    </div>)
  );
})
ChartLegendContent.displayName = "ChartLegend"

// Helper to extract item config from a payload.
function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config,
  payload,
  key
) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined

  let configLabelKey = key

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key]
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[key]
  }

  return configLabelKey in config
    ? config[configLabelKey]
    : config[key];
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
}

}

export function Stat({ label, value, unit, accent, sub }) {
  const accentColor = accent === 'red' ? 'text-luxury-red' : accent === 'blue' ? 'text-luxury-blue' : 'text-foreground';
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col">
      <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <span className={cn('text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums', accentColor)}>
        {value}
        {unit && <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">{unit}</span>}
      </span>
      {sub && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{sub}</span>}

  );

export function Pill({ children, active, onClick, className }) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        'px-3.5 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all min-h-[44px] flex items-center',
        active
          ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white glow-blue'
          : 'glass text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
      )}

    </button>
  );
}

export function Ring({ value, size = 120, stroke = 10, label, sublabel, color = 'luxury-blue' }) {
  const radius = (size - stroke) / 2;
  const circ = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const offset = circ - (Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value || 0)) / 100) * circ;
  const colorClass = color === 'red' ? 'text-luxury-red' : color === 'gold' ? 'text-luxury-gold' : color === 'teal' ? 'text-luxury-teal' : 'text-luxury-blue';
  return (
    <div className="relative inline-flex items-center justify-center" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
      <svg width={size} height={size} className="-rotate-90">
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={stroke} className="text-muted/40" />
        <circle
          cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={stroke}
          strokeDasharray={circ} strokeDashoffset={offset} strokeLinecap="round"
          className={cn(colorClass, 'transition-all duration-700')}
        />
      </svg>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <span className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(value || 0)}</span>
        {label && <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>}
        {sublabel && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{sublabel}</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ConfidenceBadge({ level }) {
  const map = {
    'High Confidence': 'text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10',
    'Moderate Confidence': 'text-luxury-gold bg-luxury-gold/10',
    'Low Confidence': 'text-orange-400 bg-orange-500/10',
    'Insufficient Data': 'text-muted-foreground bg-muted/20',
  };
  return <span className={cn('text-[10px] font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full', map[level] || map['Insufficient Data'])}>{level}</span>;
}

export function EmptyState({ icon: Icon, title, description, action }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center py-16 px-6">
      {Icon && <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl glass flex items-center justify-center mb-4"><Icon size={26} className="text-muted-foreground" /></div>}
      <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg mb-1">{title}</h3>

  );
}

"use client";
import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { Controller, FormProvider, useFormContext } from "react-hook-form";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"

const Form = FormProvider

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext({})

const FormField = (
  {
    ...props
  }
) => {
  return (
    (<FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>)
  );
}

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext)
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext)
  const { getFieldState, formState } = useFormContext()

  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState)

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>")
  }

  const { id } = itemContext

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  }
}

const FormItemContext = React.createContext({})

const FormItem = React.forwardRef(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const id = React.useId()

  return (
    (<FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div ref={ref} className={cn("space-y-2", className)} {...props} />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>)
  );
})
FormItem.displayName = "FormItem"

const FormLabel = React.forwardRef(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField()

  return (
    (<Label
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(error && "text-destructive", className)}
      htmlFor={formItemId}
      {...props} />)
  );
})
FormLabel.displayName = "FormLabel"

const FormControl = React.forwardRef(({ ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } = useFormField()

  return (
    (<Slot
      ref={ref}
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props} />)
  );
})
FormControl.displayName = "FormControl"

const FormDescription = React.forwardRef(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField()

  return (
    (<p
      ref={ref}
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-[0.8rem] text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props} />)
  );
})
FormDescription.displayName = "FormDescription"

const FormMessage = React.forwardRef(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField()
  const body = error ? String(error?.message) : children

  if (!body) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    (<p
      ref={ref}
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn("text-[0.8rem] font-medium text-destructive", className)}
      {...props}>
      {body}
    </p>)
  );
})
FormMessage.displayName = "FormMessage"

export {
  useFormField,
  Form,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormMessage,
  FormField,
}

FILE: src/components/ui/image-helpers.js
------------------------------------------------------------
const WIX_MEDIA_HOSTS = {
  "media.base44.com": "/images/public/",
  "static.wixstatic.com": "/media/",
}

export const DEFAULT_TRANSFORM_WIDTH = 1024
export const IMAGE_LOAD_MODE = {
  OPTIMIZED: "optimized",
  ORIGINAL: "original",
  FALLBACK: "fallback",
}

const DEVICE_PIXEL_RATIOS = [1, 2, 3]
const MAX_DIMENSION = 6000

/** Returns transform metadata only for canonical public Wix image URLs. */
export function parseWixMediaUrl(src) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(src)
    if (
      url.protocol !== "https:" ||
      url.username ||
      url.password ||
      (url.port && url.port !== "443")
    ) {
      return null
    }

    const pathPrefix = WIX_MEDIA_HOSTS[url.hostname]
    if (!pathPrefix) return null

    const transformed = url.pathname.match(/^(.*)\/v1\/(?:fill|fit)\/[^/]+\/[^/]+$/i)
    const basePath = transformed ? transformed[1] : url.pathname
    const filename = basePath.split("/").pop()
    if (
      !basePath.startsWith(pathPrefix) ||
      !filename ||
      !/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i.test(filename) ||
      /\.svg$/i.test(filename)
    ) {
      return null
    }

    return { baseUrl: `${url.origin}${basePath}`, filename }
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

const clampDim = (n) => Math.min(Math.max(Math.round(n), 1), MAX_DIMENSION)
const clamp01 = (n) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, n))

export function buildTransformUrl(
  { baseUrl, filename },
  { width, height, crop, focalPoint, quality }
) {
  const params = [`w_${clampDim(width)}`, `h_${clampDim(height || width)}`]
  if (crop) {
    params.push(
      focalPoint
        ? `fp_${clamp01(focalPoint.x).toFixed(2)}_${clamp01(focalPoint.y).toFixed(2)}`
        : "al_c"
    )
  }
  params.push(`q_${quality}`, "usm_0.66_1.00_0.01", "enc_webp", "quality_auto")
  const outputName = /\.gif$/i.test(filename)
    ? filename
    : filename.replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i, "") + ".webp"
  return `${baseUrl}/v1/${crop ? "fill" : "fit"}/${params.join(",")}/${outputName}`
}

export function buildSrcSet(parsed, options) {
  return DEVICE_PIXEL_RATIOS.map(
    (dpr) =>
      `${buildTransformUrl(parsed, {
        ...options,
        width: options.width * dpr,
        height: options.height ? options.height * dpr : undefined,
      })} ${dpr}x`
  ).join(", ")
}

export function getOriginalImageUrl(src, parsed) {
  return parsed?.baseUrl || src
}

export function nextImageLoadMode(mode) {
  return mode === IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.OPTIMIZED
    ? IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.ORIGINAL
    : IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.FALLBACK
}

FILE: src/components/ui/image.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import * as React from "react"
import { useSize } from "@/hooks/use-size"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import {
  buildSrcSet,
  buildTransformUrl,
  DEFAULT_TRANSFORM_WIDTH,
  getOriginalImageUrl,
  IMAGE_LOAD_MODE,
  nextImageLoadMode,
  parseWixMediaUrl,
} from "./image-helpers"

const FALLBACK_IMAGE_URL =
  "https://static.wixstatic.com/media/12d367_4f26ccd17f8f4e3a8958306ea08c2332~mv2.png"

const ImageWrapper = React.forwardRef(({ aspectRatio, className, style, children }, ref) => (
  <span
    ref={ref}
    className={cn("inline-block relative", className)}
    style={{ aspectRatio, ...style }}
  >
    {children}
  </span>
))
ImageWrapper.displayName = "ImageWrapper"

const ResponsiveImage = React.forwardRef(
  ({ parsed, fittingType, focalPoint, quality, className, style, aspectRatio, onLoad, ...props }, parentRef) => {
    const wrapperRef = React.useRef(null)
    const imgRef = React.useRef(null)
    const size = useSize(wrapperRef)
    const [loaded, setLoaded] = React.useState(false)

    React.useImperativeHandle(parentRef, () => imgRef.current)

    // Reset the blur-up when the underlying image changes.
    React.useEffect(() => {
      setLoaded(false)
    }, [parsed.baseUrl])

    const crop = fittingType !== "fit"
    // `size` is null exactly once: the pre-measurement first render, which we
    // never let reach the network (see below — useSize measures before paint).
    // A *measured* zero (content-sized wrapper with no CSS dimensions) falls
    // back to a fixed transform width so the image itself can size the box.
    const options = size && {
      width: size.width || DEFAULT_TRANSFORM_WIDTH,
      height: size.height ? size.height : undefined,
      crop,
      focalPoint: crop ? focalPoint : undefined,
      quality,
    }

    // Both layers render only once the container is measured, so the first
    // URL the browser ever fetches is already the right size — never a
    // DEFAULT_TRANSFORM_WIDTH guess that gets replaced a frame later (a
    // wasted full-size download per image). useSize measures in
    // useLayoutEffect, so nothing is lost: measurement lands before the
    // first paint.
    return (
      <ImageWrapper ref={wrapperRef} aspectRatio={aspectRatio} className={className} style={style}>
        {/* Tiny blurred placeholder (a few hundred bytes) covering the main
            image's load time. Same crop shape and focal anchor as the main
            image — fp_ is relative to the crop box, so a square or centered
            placeholder would blur-preview a different region. */}
        {options && !loaded && (
          <img
            src={buildTransformUrl(parsed, {
              ...options,
              width: 20,
              height: options.height
                ? Math.max(1, Math.round((20 * options.height) / options.width))
                : undefined,
              quality: 20,
            })}
            alt=""
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="w-full h-full inset-0 absolute"
            style={{
              objectFit: fittingType === "fit" ? "contain" : "cover",
              filter: "blur(10px)",
              transform: "scale(1.1)",
            }}
          />
        )}
        {options && (
          <img
            ref={imgRef}
            src={buildTransformUrl(parsed, options)}
            srcSet={buildSrcSet(parsed, options)}
            loading="lazy"
            className={cn(
              "w-full h-full inset-0 absolute",
              fittingType === "fit" ? "object-contain" : "object-cover"
            )}
            onLoad={(e) => {
              setLoaded(true)
              onLoad?.(e)
            }}
            {...props}
          />
        )}
      </ImageWrapper>
    )
  }
)
ResponsiveImage.displayName = "ResponsiveImage"

/**
 * Image with built-in Wix Media Platform support: canonical public images on
 * media.base44.com and static.wixstatic.com/media are resized to the rendered
 * container per device pixel ratio and re-encoded to WebP; `fittingType="fill"`
 * crops server-side, optionally anchored at a focal point. Other URLs render
 * as a plain <img>. Failed transforms retry the original URL; only a broken
 * original swaps to the generic fallback image.
 */
const Image = React.forwardRef(
  (
    {
      src,
      fittingType = "fill",
      originWidth,
      originHeight,
      focalPointX,
      focalPointY,
      quality = 90,
      onError,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const parsedSource = src && src !== FALLBACK_IMAGE_URL ? parseWixMediaUrl(src) : null
    const initialMode = parsedSource ? IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.OPTIMIZED : IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.ORIGINAL
    const [loadState, setLoadState] = React.useState({ src, mode: initialMode })
    const mode = loadState.src === src ? loadState.mode : initialMode

    React.useEffect(() => {
      setLoadState({ src, mode: initialMode })
    }, [src, initialMode])

    const handleError = (event) => {
      if (mode === IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.FALLBACK) return
      const nextMode = nextImageLoadMode(mode)
      setLoadState({ src, mode: nextMode })
      if (nextMode === IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.FALLBACK) onError?.(event)
    }

    const imageProps = {
      ...props,
      onError: handleError,
    }

    if (!src) {
      // Renders as a real <img> (not a <div>) — the visual editor's
      // click-to-edit toolbar keys its "Replace Image" action off the DOM
      // tag being `img`, so a placeholder div would be unrecoverable in the
      // editor. FALLBACK_IMAGE_URL doubles as the "no image chosen" graphic.
      return <img ref={ref} src={FALLBACK_IMAGE_URL} {...imageProps} data-empty-image />
    }

    // A failed transform retries the underlying original as a plain image.
    // Only a failure of that original advances to the generic fallback.
    const parsed = mode === IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.OPTIMIZED ? parsedSource : null

    if (!parsed) {
      const isErrorMode = mode === IMAGE_LOAD_MODE.FALLBACK
      const imageSrc = isErrorMode ? FALLBACK_IMAGE_URL : getOriginalImageUrl(src, parsedSource)
      return (
        <img ref={ref} src={imageSrc} {...imageProps} data-error-image={isErrorMode || undefined} />
      )
    }

    const focalPoint =
      typeof focalPointX === "number" && typeof focalPointY === "number"
        ? { x: focalPointX, y: focalPointY }
        : undefined
    // Origin dimensions are optional — when known they stabilize layout via
    // the wrapper's aspect-ratio before the image loads.
    const aspectRatio =
      originWidth && originHeight ? `${originWidth} / ${originHeight}` : undefined

    return (
      <ResponsiveImage
        ref={ref}
        parsed={parsed}
        fittingType={fittingType}
        focalPoint={focalPoint}
        quality={quality}
        aspectRatio={aspectRatio}
        {...imageProps}
      />
    )
  }
)
Image.displayName = "Image"

export { Image }

      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      side: "right",
    },
  }
)

    <SheetPrimitive.Content ref={ref} className={cn(sheetVariants({ side }), className)} {...props}>
      <SheetPrimitive.Close

import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { cva } from "class-variance-authority";

import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/use-mobile"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar_state"
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem"
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b"

const SidebarContext = React.createContext(null)

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.")
  }

  return context
}

const SidebarProvider = React.forwardRef((
  {
    defaultOpen = true,
    open: openProp,
    onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
    className,
    style,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref
) => {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile()
  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)

  // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
  const open = openProp ?? _open
  const setOpen = React.useCallback((value) => {
    const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
    if (setOpenProp) {
      setOpenProp(openState)
    } else {
      _setOpen(openState)
    }

    // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
    document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
  }, [setOpenProp, open])

  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    return isMobile
      ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open)
      : setOpen((open) => !open);
  }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

  // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (
        event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
      ) {
        event.preventDefault()
        toggleSidebar()
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [toggleSidebar])

  // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
  // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
  const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

  const contextValue = React.useMemo(() => ({
    state,
    open,
    setOpen,
    isMobile,
    openMobile,
    setOpenMobile,
    toggleSidebar,
  }), [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar])

  return (
    (<SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
        <div
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
              "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
              ...style
            }
          }
          className={cn(
            "group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full has-[[data-variant=inset]]:bg-sidebar",
            className
          )}
          ref={ref}
          {...props}>
          {children}
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>)
  );
})
SidebarProvider.displayName = "SidebarProvider"

const Sidebar = React.forwardRef((
  {
    side = "left",
    variant = "sidebar",
    collapsible = "offcanvas",
    className,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref
) => {
  const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar()

  if (collapsible === "none") {
    return (
      (<div
        className={cn(
          "flex h-full w-[--sidebar-width] flex-col bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground",
          className
        )}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}>
        {children}
      </div>)
    );
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      (<Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
        <SheetContent
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          data-mobile="true"
          className="w-[--sidebar-width] bg-sidebar p-0 text-sidebar-foreground [&>button]:hidden"
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE
            }
          }
          side={side}>
          <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>)
    );
  }

  return (
    (<div
      ref={ref}
      className="group peer hidden text-sidebar-foreground md:block"
      data-state={state}
      data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
      data-variant={variant}
      data-side={side}>
      {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
      <div
        className={cn(
          "relative h-svh w-[--sidebar-width] bg-transparent transition-[width] duration-200 ease-linear",
          "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
          "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)_+_theme(spacing.4))]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[--sidebar-width-icon]"
        )} />
      <div
        className={cn(
          "fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-[--sidebar-width] transition-[left,right,width] duration-200 ease-linear md:flex",
          side === "left"
            ? "left-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]"
            : "right-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]",
          // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)_+_theme(spacing.4)_+2px)]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[--sidebar-width-icon] group-data-[side=left]:border-r group-data-[side=right]:border-l",
          className
        )}
        {...props}>
        <div
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          className="flex h-full w-full flex-col bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:border group-data-[variant=floating]:border-sidebar-border group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow">
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>)
  );
})
Sidebar.displayName = "Sidebar"

const SidebarTrigger = React.forwardRef(({ className, onClick, asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {

  return (

        side="right"
        align="center"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Skeleton({
  className,
  ...props
}) {

import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";
import {
  Toast,
  ToastClose,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastProvider,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastViewport,
} from "@/components/ui/toast";

export function Toaster() {
  const { toasts } = useToast();

  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      {toasts.map(function ({ id, title, description, action, ...props }) {
        return (
          <Toast key={id} {...props}>
            <div className="grid gap-1">
              {title && <ToastTitle>{title}</ToastTitle>}
              {description && (
                <ToastDescription>{description}</ToastDescription>
              )}
            </div>
            {action}
            <ToastClose />
          </Toast>
        );
      })}
      <ToastViewport />
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/ui/use-toast.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
// Inspired by react-hot-toast library
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

const TOAST_LIMIT = 20;
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
};

let count = 0;

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_VALUE;
  return count.toString();
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map();

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return;
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
    dispatch({
      type: actionTypes.REMOVE_TOAST,
      toastId,
    });
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
};

const _clearFromRemoveQueue = (toastId) => {
  const timeout = toastTimeouts.get(toastId);
  if (timeout) {
    clearTimeout(timeout);
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
  }
};

export const reducer = (state, action) => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case actionTypes.ADD_TOAST:
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      };

    case actionTypes.UPDATE_TOAST:
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      };

    case actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST: {
      const { toastId } = action;

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
        });
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t
        ),
      };
    }
    case actionTypes.REMOVE_TOAST:
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        };
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      };
  }
};

const listeners = [];

let memoryState = { toasts: [] };

function dispatch(action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState);
  });
}

function toast({ ...props }) {
  const id = genId();

  const update = (props) =>
    dispatch({
      type: actionTypes.UPDATE_TOAST,
      toast: { ...props, id },
    });

  const dismiss = () =>
    dispatch({ type: actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST, toastId: id });

  dispatch({
    type: actionTypes.ADD_TOAST,
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss();
      },
    },
  });

  return {
    id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  };
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = useState(memoryState);

  useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState);
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }, [state]);

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId) => dispatch({ type: actionTypes.DISMISS_TOAST, toastId }),
  };
}

export { useToast, toast };

FILE: src/components/widgets/NutritionWidget.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card, Ring } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Flame, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function NutritionWidget({ data, standalone }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { goal, nutrition, today, loading } = data;

  const totals = useMemo(() => {
    const foodLogs = (nutrition || []).filter((l) => l.date === today && l.food_name !== 'Water');
    return foodLogs.reduce((acc, n) => ({
      calories: acc.calories + (n.calories || 0),
      protein: acc.protein + (n.protein_g || 0),
      carbs: acc.carbs + (n.carbs_g || 0),
      fat: acc.fat + (n.fat_g || 0),
    }), { calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0 });
  }, [nutrition, today]);

  const target = goal?.calorie_target || 2000;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.round(target - totals.calories));
  const pct = Math.min(100, (totals.calories / target) * 100);

  if (loading) return <Card className={cn('animate-pulse', standalone ? 'min-h-[240px]' : 'min-h-[150px]')} />;

  return (
    <Card className={cn('flex flex-col items-center', standalone && 'min-h-[260px]')}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 self-start">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-luxury-red/15 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Flame size={16} className="text-luxury-red" />
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Calories</span>
      </div>
      <Ring value={pct} size={standalone ? 140 : 96} stroke={standalone ? 12 : 8} label="kcal" />
      <div className="text-center mt-2">
        <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(totals.calories).toLocaleString()}</p>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">/ {Math.round(target).toLocaleString()} · {remaining.toLocaleString()} left</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-3 mt-2 text-center">
        <div><p className="text-sm font-bold text-luxury-blue">{Math.round(totals.protein)}g</p><p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Protein</p></div>
        <div><p className="text-sm font-bold">{Math.round(totals.carbs)}g</p><p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Carbs</p></div>
        <div><p className="text-sm font-bold">{Math.round(totals.fat)}g</p><p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">Fat</p></div>
      </div>
      <Button variant="outline" className={cn('w-full mt-auto glass', standalone ? 'mt-4' : 'mt-3')} onClick={() => navigate('/nutrition')}>
        <Plus size={16} /> Log Food
      </Button>
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/widgets/StreakWidget.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Flame } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const DAY = 86400000;

function getWeek(d) {
  const date = new Date(d.getTime());
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + 3 - ((date.getDay() + 6) % 7));
  const week1 = new Date(date.getFullYear(), 0, 4);
  return 1 + Math.round(((date - week1) / 86400000 - 3 + ((week1.getDay() + 6) % 7)) / 7);
}

export default function StreakWidget({ data, standalone }) {
  const { sessions, goal, loading } = data;

  const { streak, thisWeek } = useMemo(() => {
    const weeks = {};
    (sessions || []).filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date).forEach((s) => {
      const d = new Date(s.date);
      weeks[`${d.getFullYear()}-${getWeek(d)}`] = true;
    });
    let count = 0;
    let cursor = new Date();
    if (weeks[`${cursor.getFullYear()}-${getWeek(cursor)}`]) count++;
    cursor = new Date(cursor.getTime() - 7 * DAY);
    while (weeks[`${cursor.getFullYear()}-${getWeek(cursor)}`]) { count++; cursor = new Date(cursor.getTime() - 7 * DAY); }
    const thisWk = (sessions || []).filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date && Date.now() - new Date(s.date).getTime() < 7 * DAY).length;
    return { streak: count, thisWeek: thisWk };
  }, [sessions]);

  const target = goal?.days_per_week || 4;

  if (loading) return <Card className={cn('animate-pulse', standalone ? 'min-h-[240px]' : 'min-h-[150px]')} />;

  return (
    <Card className={cn('flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center', standalone && 'min-h-[260px]')}>
      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-luxury-red/15 flex items-center justify-center mb-2">
        <Flame size={24} className="text-luxury-red" />
      </div>
      <p className={cn('font-bold tabular-nums text-gradient-red', standalone ? 'text-4xl' : 'text-2xl')}>{streak}</p>
      <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">week streak</p>
      <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/40 w-full">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{thisWeek} / {target} <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">this week</span></p>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dumbbell, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function TodayWorkoutWidget({ data, standalone }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { scheduled, programs, sessions, loading } = data;

  const todayProgramDay = useMemo(() => {
    if (!scheduled?.program_id) return null;
    const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === scheduled.program_id);
    if (!prog?.days) return null;
    return prog.days[scheduled.day_index] || null;
  }, [scheduled, programs]);

  const workoutName = scheduled?.name || todayProgramDay?.focus || todayProgramDay?.day_name || 'Quick Workout';
  const exerciseCount = todayProgramDay?.exercises?.length || 0;
  const hasWorkouts = sessions.length > 0;

  const startUrl = scheduled?.program_id && scheduled.day_index != null
    ? `/workout/new?programId=${scheduled.program_id}&dayIndex=${scheduled.day_index}`
    : '/workout/new';

  if (loading) return <Card className={cn('animate-pulse', standalone ? 'min-h-[240px]' : 'min-h-[150px]')} />;

  return (
    <Card className={cn('flex flex-col', standalone && 'min-h-[260px]')}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">

          <Dumbbell size={16} className="text-luxury-blue" />
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Today's Workout</span>
      </div>

      {exerciseCount > 0 && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{exerciseCount} exercises · {todayProgramDay?.focus || ''}</p>}
      {!hasWorkouts && !scheduled && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 leading-relaxed">No workout scheduled. Start a quick session.</p>}

FILE: src/components/widgets/WaterWidget.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, Ring } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Droplets } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const WATER_TARGET = 3000;

export default function WaterWidget({ data, standalone }) {
  const { nutrition, today, loading, reload } = data;
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const waterMl = useMemo(() => {
    return (nutrition || [])
      .filter((l) => l.date === today && l.food_name === 'Water')
      .reduce((a, n) => a + (n.quantity || 0), 0);
  }, [nutrition, today]);

  const pct = Math.min(100, (waterMl / WATER_TARGET) * 100);
  const remaining = Math.max(0, WATER_TARGET - waterMl);

  const addWater = async (ml) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await base44.entities.NutritionLog.create({
        date: today, meal: 'Snack', food_name: 'Water',
        quantity: ml, unit: 'ml', calories: 0, protein_g: 0, carbs_g: 0, fat_g: 0,
        fiber_g: 0, sugar_g: 0, sodium_mg: 0, source: 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      reload?.();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  if (loading) return <Card className={cn('animate-pulse', standalone ? 'min-h-[240px]' : 'min-h-[150px]')} />;

  return (
    <Card className={cn('flex flex-col items-center', standalone && 'min-h-[260px]')}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 self-start">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-luxury-blue/15 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Droplets size={16} className="text-luxury-blue" />
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Water</span>
      </div>
      <Ring value={pct} size={standalone ? 140 : 96} stroke={standalone ? 12 : 8} label="ml" color="blue" />
      <div className="text-center mt-2">
        <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(waterMl).toLocaleString()} ml</p>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">/ {WATER_TARGET.toLocaleString()} · {Math.round(remaining).toLocaleString()} left</p>
      </div>
      {standalone && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 w-full mt-4">
          {[250, 500, 750].map((ml) => (
            <Button key={ml} variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" disabled={busy} onClick={() => addWater(ml)}>
              +{ml}ml
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function WeightGoalValues({ current, start, target, standalone, imperial }) {
  const factor = imperial ? 2.2046226218 : 1, unit = imperial ? 'lb' : 'kg';
  const display = value => Number((value * factor).toFixed(1));
  const pct = start != null && target != null ? start === target ? current === target ? 100 : 0 : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (current - start) / (target - start) * 100)) : null;
  if (current == null) return <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 leading-relaxed">No weight logged yet. Add your first measurement to start tracking.</p>;
  return <>
    <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-2">
      <div><p className={cn('font-bold tabular-nums', standalone ? 'text-3xl' : 'text-xl')}>{display(current)}<span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-1">{unit}</span></p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">current</p></div>
      {target != null && <div className="text-right"><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{display(target)}<span className="text-xs ml-1">{unit}</span></p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">target</p></div>}
    </div>
    {pct != null && <><div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/40 overflow-hidden mt-3"><div className="h-full bg-luxury-gold" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} /></div><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-center">{Math.round(pct)}% to goal</p></>}
    {target == null && <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">No target weight set.</p>}
  </>;
}

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Scale, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function WeightGoalWidget({ data, standalone }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { measurements, goal, user, loading } = data;

  const { current, start, target, pct } = useMemo(() => {
    const weights = (measurements || []).map((m) => m.weight_kg).filter(Boolean);
    const current = weights[weights.length - 1] || user?.weight_kg;
    const start = weights[0];
    const target = goal?.target_weight_kg;
    let pct = 0;
    if (current != null && target != null && start != null && start !== target) {
      pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ((current - start) / (target - start)) * 100));
    }
    return { current, start, target, pct };
  }, [measurements, goal, user]);

  if (loading) return <Card className={cn('animate-pulse', standalone ? 'min-h-[240px]' : 'min-h-[150px]')} />;

  return (
    <Card className={cn('flex flex-col', standalone && 'min-h-[260px]')}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-luxury-gold/15 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Scale size={16} className="text-luxury-gold" />
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Weight Goal</span>
      </div>
      {current != null ? (
        <>
          <div className="flex items-end justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className={cn('font-bold tabular-nums', standalone ? 'text-3xl' : 'text-xl')}>
                {current}<span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-1">kg</span>
              </p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">current</p>
            </div>
            {target != null && (
              <div className="text-right">
                <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                  {target}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-1">kg</span>
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">target</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {target != null && start != null && (
            <>
              <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/40 overflow-hidden mt-3">
                <div className="h-full bg-luxury-gold transition-all" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-center">{Math.round(pct)}% to goal</p>
            </>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 leading-relaxed">No weight logged yet. Add your first measurement to start tracking.</p>
      )}
      <Button variant="outline" className={cn('w-full mt-auto glass', standalone ? 'mt-4' : 'mt-3')} onClick={() => navigate('/progress')}>
        <Plus size={16} /> Log Weight
      </Button>
    </Card>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

export default function WidgetStatus({ title, loading, error, hasData, refreshing, onRetry, children }) {
  if (error && !hasData) return <Card className="min-h-[150px] flex flex-col justify-center gap-3"><p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">Could not load {title.toLowerCase()}.</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{error.message}</p><Button variant="outline" disabled={refreshing} onClick={onRetry}>Try again</Button></Card>;
  if (loading && !hasData) return <Card aria-busy="true" role="status" className="min-h-[150px] flex items-center justify-center"><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Loading {title.toLowerCase()}…</p></Card>;
  return <>{error && <div role="status" className="mb-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Could not refresh; showing the last loaded data. <button onClick={onRetry} disabled={refreshing} className="min-h-11 underline">Retry</button></div>}{children}</>;
}

import React from 'react';
import { X, Activity, Bike, Waves, Mountain, Timer } from 'lucide-react';
import { ACTIVITIES } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';

function actIcon(id) {
  const a = ACTIVITIES.find((x) => x.id === id);
  const g = a?.group;
  if (g === 'Bike') return Bike;
  if (g === 'Swim' || g === 'Row') return Waves;
  if (g === 'Walk' && id === 'hiking') return Mountain;
  if (g === 'Jump' || g === 'Ropes') return Timer;
  return Activity;
}

// Activity picker for adding ad-hoc cardio to a workout. Same catalog as Cardio Session.
export default function CardioPickerSheet({ open, onClose, onPick }) {

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-4 pb-2 shrink-0">
          <p className="font-semibold">Add cardio</p>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground"><X size={20} /></button>

FILE: src/components/workout/RestCountdown.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Timer } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

export default function RestCountdown({ deadline, onSkip }) {
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval;
    const update = () => {
      const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(((deadline || 0) - Date.now()) / 1000));
      setRemaining(seconds);
      if (!seconds) clearInterval(interval);
    };
    update();
    if (deadline > Date.now()) interval = setInterval(update, 1000);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', update);
    return () => { clearInterval(interval); document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', update); };
  }, [deadline]);
  if (!remaining) return null;
  return <Card className="mb-4 border-primary/40 flex items-center justify-between gap-3" role="timer" aria-label="Rest timer">
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><Timer size={20} className="text-primary shrink-0" /><div>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums">{Math.floor(remaining / 60)}:{String(remaining % 60).padStart(2, '0')}</p>
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Rest timer</p>
    </div></div>
    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onSkip}>Skip</Button>
  </Card>;
}

      </div>
    </div>
  );

// Deterministic warm-up ramp planner. Percentages of the work-set weight.
export default function WarmupPlanner({ open, onClose, exerciseName, suggestedWeight }) {

          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            A ramp of progressively heavier sets approaching your work weight. Deterministic percentages (40 / 55 / 70 / 80 / 90%).
            Weights round to the nearest 2.5 kg and never drop below the bar.
          </p>

          <Input
            type="number"
            inputMode="decimal"
            placeholder="Work-set weight (kg)"
            value={workWeight}
            onChange={(e) => setWorkWeight(e.target.value)}
            className="h-12 glass text-base"
          />

                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{s.label} · {s.pct}%</p>
                  </div>

              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-3">Enter a work-set weight to generate your warm-up ramp.</p>
          )}

          <Button variant="outline" className="w-full min-h-[44px]" onClick={onClose}>Close</Button>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Check, Trophy, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const COLS = 'grid grid-cols-[1.25rem_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_2.5rem] gap-1.5';

export default function WorkoutSetGrid({ block, bi, updateSet, completeSet, removeSet, isPr }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      {/* Header row */}
      <div className={cn(COLS, 'px-0.5')}>
        <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground text-center">#</span>
        <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground text-center">Weight</span>
        <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground text-center">Reps</span>
        <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground text-center">RPE</span>

        <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground text-center">Done</span>
      </div>
      {/* Data rows */}
      {block.sets.map((set, index) => (

          <div className={cn(COLS, 'items-center')}>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center tabular-nums">{index + 1}</span>

            <SetInput value={set.reps} placeholder="reps" mode="numeric" onChange={(v) => updateSet(bi, index, 'reps', v)} label={`Set ${index + 1} reps`} />
            <SetInput value={set.rpe ?? ''} placeholder="rpe" mode="numeric" onChange={(v) => updateSet(bi, index, 'rpe', v)} label={`Set ${index + 1} RPE`} />
            <SetInput value={set.rir ?? ''} placeholder="rir" mode="numeric" onChange={(v) => updateSet(bi, index, 'rir', v)} label={`Set ${index + 1} RIR`} />
            <button
              aria-label={`Mark set ${index + 1} ${set.completed ? 'incomplete' : 'complete'}`}
              aria-pressed={set.completed}
              onClick={() => completeSet(bi, index)}
              className={cn(
                'flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border transition-all',
                set.completed ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:border-primary/50'
              )}
            >
              {set.completed && isPr ? <Trophy size={16} /> : <Check size={18} />}
            </button>
          </div>
          {block.sets.length > 1 && (

              <Trash2 size={11} /> remove set
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

const SetInput = React.memo(function SetInput({ value, placeholder, mode, onChange, label }) {
  return (
    <Input
      aria-label={label}
      type="number"
      inputMode={mode}
      min="0"
      value={value}
      onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      className="h-10 min-w-0 px-1 text-center text-sm tabular-nums rounded-xl"
    />
  );
});

FILE: src/hooks/use-mobile.jsx

import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

FILE: src/hooks/use-size.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import * as React from "react"

export function useSize(ref) {
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState(null)

  // useLayoutEffect (not useEffect): the initial measurement must land before
  // the browser paints, so consumers can render their real content on the
  // very first painted frame instead of a guess. A ResizeObserver's first
  // callback arrives too late for that — by then an <img> src guess has
  // already been dispatched to the network.
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current
    if (!element) return

    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect()
    setSize({ width: rect.width, height: rect.height })

    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      const { width, height } = entry.contentRect
      setSize({ width, height })
    })

    observer.observe(element)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [ref])

  return size
}

FILE: src/hooks/useAddWater.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { fitnessSummaryQuery } from '@/lib/fitnessDataCache';
import { recordsChanged } from '@/lib/fitnessInvalidation';

export default function useAddWater(userId, today) {
  const client = useQueryClient(), locked = useRef(false);
  const mutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: ml => base44.entities.NutritionLog.create({ date: today, meal: 'Snack', food_name: 'Water', quantity: ml, unit: 'ml', calories: 0, protein_g: 0, carbs_g: 0, fat_g: 0, fiber_g: 0, sugar_g: 0, sodium_mg: 0, source: 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
    onSuccess: (record, ml) => {
      const query = fitnessSummaryQuery('NutritionLog', userId, { query: { date: today, food_name: 'Water' }, groupBy: 'unit', sum: 'quantity' });
      client.setQueryData(query.queryKey, previous => {
        if (!previous) return previous;
        const exists = previous.rows.some(row => row.unit === 'ml');
        const rows = previous.rows.map(row => row.unit === 'ml' ? { ...row, sum_quantity: (row.sum_quantity || 0) + ml, count: (row.count || 0) + 1 } : row);
        return { ...previous, rows: exists ? rows : [...rows, { unit: 'ml', sum_quantity: ml, count: 1 }] };
      });
      recordsChanged('NutritionLog');
    } });
  const add = async ml => {
    if (locked.current) return;
    locked.current = true;
    try { await mutation.mutateAsync(ml); } finally { locked.current = false; }
  };
  return { add, busy: mutation.isPending, error: mutation.error };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useCardioHistory.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useInfiniteQuery, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import useLocalDay from '@/hooks/useLocalDay';
import { rangeCutoff, getActivity } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';

export default function useCardioHistory(range) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const today = useLocalDay();
  const query = useMemo(() => {
    const owner = { created_by_id: user?.id };
    if (range === 'all') return owner;
    if (range === 'today') { const start = new Date(`${today}T00:00:00`); const end = new Date(start); end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1); return { ...owner, date: { $gte: start.toISOString(), $lt: end.toISOString() } }; }
    return { ...owner, date: { $gte: new Date(rangeCutoff(range)).toISOString() } };
  }, [range, user?.id, today]);
  const list = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['cardio-history', user?.id, range, today], enabled: !!user, initialPageParam: undefined, queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => base44.entities.CardioSession.filter(query, { sort: '-date', limit: 50, cursor: pageParam }), getNextPageParam: page => page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined });
  const totals = useQuery({ queryKey: ['cardio-summary', user?.id, range, today], enabled: !!user, queryFn: () => base44.entities.CardioSession.aggregate({ query, groupBy: ['activity', 'calorie_source'], sum: ['duration_seconds', 'distance_km', 'calories'], limit: 1000 }) });
  const sessions = useMemo(() => list.data?.pages.flatMap(page => page.items) || [], [list.data]);
  const agg = useMemo(() => {
    const out = { sessions: 0, totalSeconds: 0, totalDistance: 0, totalCalories: 0, estimatedCalories: 0, recordedCalories: 0, breakdown: [], inRange: sessions };
    const activities = new Map();
    (totals.data?.rows || []).forEach(row => {
      const seconds = row.sum_duration_seconds || 0, distance = row.sum_distance_km || 0, calories = row.sum_calories || 0;
      out.sessions += row.count; out.totalSeconds += seconds; out.totalDistance += distance; out.totalCalories += calories;
      out[row.calorie_source === 'Estimated' ? 'estimatedCalories' : 'recordedCalories'] += calories;
      const item = activities.get(row.activity) || { activity: row.activity, label: getActivity(row.activity).label, sessions: 0, seconds: 0, distance: 0, calories: 0 };
      item.sessions += row.count; item.seconds += seconds; item.distance += distance; item.calories += calories; activities.set(row.activity, item);
    });
    out.avgDuration = out.sessions ? out.totalSeconds / out.sessions : 0;
    out.avgDistance = out.sessions ? out.totalDistance / out.sessions : 0;
    out.breakdown = [...activities.values()].sort((a, b) => b.seconds - a.seconds);
    return out;
  }, [sessions, totals.data]);
  return { agg, loading: list.isLoading || totals.isLoading, error: list.error || totals.error, hasMore: list.hasNextPage, loadingMore: list.isFetchingNextPage, loadMore: list.fetchNextPage, refresh: () => Promise.all([list.refetch(), totals.refetch()]) };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useDashboardPreferences.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { normalizeDashboardPreferences } from '@/lib/dashboardWidgets';

export default function useDashboardPreferences() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const key = ['dashboard-preferences', user?.id];
  const preference = useQuery({ queryKey: key, enabled: !!user, staleTime: Infinity,
    initialData: () => {
      if (!user) return undefined;
      if (user.dashboard_preferences) return normalizeDashboardPreferences(user.dashboard_preferences);
      try { return normalizeDashboardPreferences(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`lraz_dashboard_${user.id}`) || 'null')); }
      catch { return normalizeDashboardPreferences(); }
    }, queryFn: async () => normalizeDashboardPreferences((await base44.auth.me()).dashboard_preferences) });
  const mutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: async value => {
    if (!user) throw new Error('Please sign in to save your dashboard.');
    const next = normalizeDashboardPreferences(value);
    await base44.auth.updateMe({ dashboard_preferences: next });
    return next;
  }, onSuccess: next => {
    client.setQueryData(key, next);
    try { localStorage.setItem(`lraz_dashboard_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { /* Account preferences remain saved. */ }
  } });
  return { preferences: preference.data || normalizeDashboardPreferences(), save: mutation.mutateAsync, saving: mutation.isPending, error: mutation.error, resetError: mutation.reset };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useExerciseHistoryData.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useInfiniteQuery, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { estimate1RM } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';

export default function useExerciseHistoryData(name, limit = 40) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const query = { created_by_id: user?.id, exercise_name: name, set_type: { $ne: 'warmup' } };
  const list = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['exercise-history', user?.id, name, limit], enabled: !!user && !!name, initialPageParam: undefined,
    queryFn: async ({ pageParam }) => {
      const page = await base44.entities.WorkoutSet.filter(query, { sort: '-created_date', limit, cursor: pageParam });
      const ids = [...new Set(page.items.map((set) => set.session_id).filter(Boolean))];
      const sessions = ids.length ? await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.filter({ created_by_id: user.id, id: { $in: ids } }, { limit, fields: ['date'] }) : { items: [] };
      const dates = Object.fromEntries(sessions.items.map((session) => [session.id, session.date]));
      return { ...page, points: page.items.map((set) => ({ id: set.id, date: (dates[set.session_id] || set.created_date || '').slice(0, 10), weight: set.weight_kg, reps: set.reps, e1rm: Math.round(set.estimated_1rm || estimate1RM(set.weight_kg, set.reps) || 0), isPr: set.is_pr, volume: Math.round((set.weight_kg || 0) * (set.reps || 0)) })) };
    }, getNextPageParam: (page) => page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined });
  const stats = useQuery({ queryKey: ['exercise-history-summary', user?.id, name], enabled: !!user && !!name,
    queryFn: () => base44.entities.WorkoutSet.aggregate({ query, groupBy: 'is_pr', max: 'estimated_1rm' }) });
  const points = useMemo(() => (list.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.points) || []).sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)), [list.data]);
  const rows = stats.data?.rows || [];
  return { points, loading: list.isLoading, error: list.error || stats.error, retry: () => Promise.all([list.refetch(), stats.refetch()]),
    bestE1rm: Math.max(0, ...rows.map((row) => row.max_estimated_1rm || 0), ...points.map((point) => point.e1rm)),
    totalSets: stats.data ? rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.count, 0) : undefined,
    prCount: rows.find((row) => row.is_pr === true)?.count || 0,
    shownVolume: points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.volume, 0),
    hasMore: list.hasNextPage, loadingMore: list.isFetchingNextPage, loadMore: list.fetchNextPage };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useHomeData.js

import { useQueries, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { fitnessRecordQuery } from '@/lib/fitnessDataCache';
import { queryClientInstance } from '@/lib/query-client';
import homeQueries from '@/lib/homeQueries';

const EMPTY = [];
export default function useHomeData(user, today, visible) {
  const signature = visible.join('|');
  const definitions = useMemo(() => homeQueries(user?.id, today, signature.split('|')), [user?.id, today, signature]);
  const results = useQueries({ queries: definitions.map(definition => ({ ...definition, enabled: !!user?.onboarding_completed })) });
  const resources = Object.fromEntries(definitions.map((definition, index) => [definition.name, results[index]]));
  const value = name => resources[name]?.data;
  const scheduled = value('scheduled')?.[0] || null;
  const programs = useQuery({ ...fitnessRecordQuery('TrainingProgram', user?.id, { id: scheduled?.program_id }, { limit: 1 }), enabled: !!user && visible.includes('today') && !!scheduled?.program_id });
  if (scheduled?.program_id) resources.programs = programs;
  const active = Object.values(resources).filter(Boolean);
  const loading = active.some(r => r.isPending);
  const loadError = active.find(r => r.error)?.error;
  const hasData = active.length > 0 && active.every(r => r.data !== undefined);
  return { goal: value('goal')?.[0] || null, measurements: value('measurements') || EMPTY, nutrition: value('nutrition') || EMPTY,
    sessions: value('sessions') || EMPTY, sets: value('sets') || EMPTY, recovery: value('recovery')?.[0] || null,
    achievements: value('achievements') || EMPTY, scheduled, programs: programs.data || EMPTY, cardio: value('cardio') || EMPTY,
    training: value('training'), resources, loading, error: loadError, hasData,
    reload: () => queryClientInstance.refetchQueries({ predicate: query => query.isActive() && (['fitness-records', 'fitness-summary'].includes(query.queryKey[0]) && query.queryKey[2] === user?.id || query.queryKey[0] === 'widget-training' && query.queryKey[1] === user?.id) }) };
}

import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

export default function useLatestCallback(callback) {
  const latest = useRef(callback);
  latest.current = callback;
  return useCallback((...args) => latest.current(...args), []);
}

FILE: src/hooks/useLocalDay.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

let day = localDateStr(), timer;
const listeners = new Set();
function update() {
  const next = localDateStr();
  if (next !== day) { day = next; listeners.forEach(listener => listener()); }
  clearTimeout(timer);
  if (listeners.size) { const midnight = new Date(); midnight.setHours(24, 0, 0, 0); timer = setTimeout(update, midnight.getTime() - Date.now() + 100); }
}
function visible() { if (!document.hidden) update(); }
function subscribe(listener) {
  listeners.add(listener);
  if (listeners.size === 1) { update(); document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', visible); }
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener); if (!listeners.size) { clearTimeout(timer); document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', visible); } };
}
const snapshot = () => day;
export default function useLocalDay() { return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, snapshot); }

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useInfiniteQuery, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function useNutritionHistoryData(selectedDate, month) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const today = localDateStr();
  const since = useMemo(() => { const date = new Date(); date.setDate(date.getDate() - 60); return localDateStr(date); }, [today]);
  const data = useQuery({ queryKey: ['nutrition-history-summary', user?.id, month, today], enabled: !!user, placeholderData: previous => previous, queryFn: async () => {
    const [year, m] = month.split('-').map(Number);
    const monthEnd = localDateStr(new Date(year, m, 1));
    const owner = { created_by_id: user.id };
    const recentSince = new Date(); recentSince.setDate(recentSince.getDate() - 30);
    const [goals, daily, recent, training] = await Promise.all([
      base44.entities.Goal.filter({ ...owner, status: 'active' }, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 1 }),
      base44.entities.NutritionLog.aggregate({ query: { ...owner, $or: [{ date: { $gte: since, $lte: today } }, { date: { $gte: `${month}-01`, $lt: monthEnd } }] }, groupBy: 'date', sum: ['calories', 'protein_g', 'carbs_g', 'fat_g', 'fiber_g'], limit: 1000 }),
      base44.entities.NutritionLog.aggregate({ query: { ...owner, date: { $gte: localDateStr(recentSince) }, food_name: { $ne: 'Water' } }, groupBy: 'food_name', avg: ['calories', 'protein_g'], max: 'logged_at', sort: '-max_logged_at', limit: 30 }),
      base44.entities.WorkoutSession.aggregate({ query: { ...owner, status: 'completed', date: { $gte: new Date(`${since}T00:00:00`).toISOString() } }, groupBy: 'date', limit: 1000 }),
    ]);
    return { goal: goals.items[0] || null, byDate: Object.fromEntries(daily.rows.map(row => [row.date, { date: row.date, calories: row.sum_calories || 0, protein: row.sum_protein_g || 0, carbs: row.sum_carbs_g || 0, fat: row.sum_fat_g || 0, fiber: row.sum_fiber_g || 0 }])), recentFoods: recent.rows.map(row => ({ food_name: row.food_name, calories: row.avg_calories || 0, protein_g: row.avg_protein_g || 0, _count: row.count })), sessions: training.rows.map(row => ({ date: row.date, status: 'completed' })) };
  } });
  const day = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['nutrition-history-day', user?.id, selectedDate], enabled: !!user, initialPageParam: undefined, queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => base44.entities.NutritionLog.filter({ created_by_id: user.id, date: selectedDate }, { sort: 'logged_at', limit: 50, cursor: pageParam }), getNextPageParam: page => page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined });
  const dayLogs = useMemo(() => day.data?.pages.flatMap(page => page.items) || [], [day.data]);
  const latestFood = async name => {
    const page = await base44.entities.NutritionLog.filter({ created_by_id: user.id, food_name: name }, { sort: '-logged_at', limit: 1 });
    return page.items[0];
  };
  return { goal: data.data?.goal, byDate: data.data?.byDate || {}, sessions: data.data?.sessions || [], recentFoods: data.data?.recentFoods || [], dayLogs, loading: data.isLoading, dayLoading: day.isLoading, error: data.error || day.error, hasMore: day.hasNextPage, loadingMore: day.isFetchingNextPage, loadMore: day.fetchNextPage, latestFood, refresh: () => Promise.all([data.refetch(), day.refetch()]) };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useProgressData.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { fitnessRecords, fitnessSummary } from '@/lib/fitnessDataCache';
import { queryClientInstance } from '@/lib/query-client';

const EMPTY = { measurements: [], workouts: [], achievements: [], cardio: [], sets: [], workoutTotals: {}, cardioTotals: {} };
const ENTITIES = { body: ['BodyMeasurement'], performance: ['WorkoutSession', 'WorkoutSet'], awards: ['Achievement'], cardio: ['CardioSession'], photos: [] };
export default function useProgressData(user, tab) {
  const result = useQuery({ queryKey: ['progress-data', user?.id, tab], enabled: !!user,
    queryFn: async () => {
      const id = user.id;
      if (tab === 'body') return { measurements: await fitnessRecords('BodyMeasurement', id, {}, { limit: 200 }) };
      if (tab === 'awards') return { achievements: await fitnessRecords('Achievement', id, {}, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 50 }) };
      if (tab === 'performance') {
        const [workouts, sets, summary] = await Promise.all([
          fitnessRecords('WorkoutSession', id, {}, { limit: 60 }),
          fitnessRecords('WorkoutSet', id, {}, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 500 }),
          fitnessSummary('WorkoutSession', id, { query: { status: 'completed' }, sum: ['total_volume_kg', 'pr_count'], max: 'estimated_1rm_top_set' }),
        ]);
        return { workouts, sets, workoutTotals: summary.rows[0] || {} };
      }
      if (tab === 'cardio') {
        const [cardio, summary] = await Promise.all([
          fitnessRecords('CardioSession', id, {}, { limit: 200 }),
          fitnessSummary('CardioSession', id, { sum: ['duration_seconds', 'calories'] }),
        ]);
        return { cardio, cardioTotals: summary.rows[0] || {} };
      }
      return {};
    } });
  const reload = async () => {
    await queryClientInstance.invalidateQueries({ predicate: (query) => ['fitness-records', 'fitness-summary'].includes(query.queryKey[0]) && query.queryKey[2] === user?.id && ENTITIES[tab].includes(query.queryKey[1]), refetchType: 'none' });
    return result.refetch();
  };
  return { ...EMPTY, ...result.data, loading: result.isLoading, error: result.error, reload };
}
