FILE: src/hooks/usePullRefreshGesture.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import useLatestCallback from '@/hooks/useLatestCallback';

export default function usePullRefreshGesture(onRefresh, threshold, setRefreshing) {
  const root = useRef(null), content = useRef(null), indicator = useRef(null);
  const refresh = useLatestCallback(onRefresh);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = root.current;
    let start = null, pull = 0, busy = false, frame = 0, alive = true;
    const paint = (animate = false) => {
      if (!content.current || !indicator.current) return;
      content.current.style.transition = animate ? 'transform .2s ease-out' : 'none';
      content.current.style.transform = pull ? `translateY(${pull}px)` : '';
      indicator.current.style.transform = `translateY(${pull - threshold}px)`;
      indicator.current.style.opacity = busy ? '1' : String(Math.min(1, pull / threshold));
    };
    const begin = (event) => {
      if (busy || window.scrollY > 0 || event.touches.length !== 1 || event.target.closest('button,a,input,textarea,select,[role="dialog"],.overflow-y-auto,.overflow-x-auto')) return;
      start = event.touches[0].clientY;
    };
    const move = (event) => {
      if (start == null || busy) return;
      const dy = event.touches[0].clientY - start;
      if (dy < 0 || window.scrollY > 0) { start = null; pull = 0; } else pull = Math.min(threshold * 1.6, dy * .5);
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { frame = 0; paint(); });
    };
    const finish = async (event) => {
      if (start == null || busy) return;
      start = null; cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0;
      if (event.type !== 'touchcancel' && pull >= threshold) {
        busy = true; pull = threshold; setRefreshing(true); paint(true);
        try { await refresh(); } finally { busy = false; pull = 0; if (alive) { setRefreshing(false); paint(true); } }
      } else { pull = 0; paint(true); }
    };
    el.addEventListener('touchstart', begin, { passive: true }); el.addEventListener('touchmove', move, { passive: true });
    el.addEventListener('touchend', finish, { passive: true }); el.addEventListener('touchcancel', finish, { passive: true });
    return () => { alive = false; cancelAnimationFrame(frame); el.removeEventListener('touchstart', begin); el.removeEventListener('touchmove', move); el.removeEventListener('touchend', finish); el.removeEventListener('touchcancel', finish); };
  }, [refresh, threshold, setRefreshing]);
  return { root, content, indicator };
}

import { useInfiniteQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function useTrainingCalendar(month) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const start = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), 1);
  const end = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + 1, 1);
  const result = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['training-calendar', user?.id, localDateStr(start)], enabled: !!user, initialPageParam: undefined,
    queryFn: async ({ pageParam }) => {
      const load = (entity, dates, cursor, fields) => cursor === false ? Promise.resolve({ items: [], has_more: false }) : base44.entities[entity].filter({ created_by_id: user.id, date: dates, ...(entity === 'WorkoutSession' ? { status: 'completed' } : {}) }, { sort: '-date', limit: 50, cursor, fields });
      const [sessions, cardio, scheduled] = await Promise.all([
        load('WorkoutSession', { $gte: start.toISOString(), $lt: end.toISOString() }, pageParam?.sessions, ['name', 'date', 'status', 'focus', 'duration_minutes', 'pr_count', 'total_volume_kg', 'notes', 'program_day_name']),
        load('CardioSession', { $gte: start.toISOString(), $lt: end.toISOString() }, pageParam?.cardio, ['date']),
        load('ScheduledWorkout', { $gte: localDateStr(start), $lt: localDateStr(end) }, pageParam?.scheduled, ['date', 'program_id']),
      ]);
      return { sessions, cardio, scheduled };
    }, getNextPageParam: (page) => Object.values(page).some((part) => part.has_more) ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(page).map(([key, part]) => [key, part.has_more ? part.next_cursor : false])) : undefined });
  return { ...result, data: result.data ? { sessions: result.data.pages.flatMap((page) => page.sessions.items), cardio: result.data.pages.flatMap((page) => page.cardio.items), scheduled: result.data.pages.flatMap((page) => page.scheduled.items) } : null };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useWidgetData.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';

const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

/**
 * Shared data hook for all widget components.
 * Loads goal, nutrition logs, workout sessions, body measurements,
 * today's scheduled workout, and training programs in a single batch.
 * Returns a stable `reload` function so widgets can refresh after mutations.
 */
export function useWidgetData() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [data, setData] = useState({
    goal: null,
    nutrition: [],
    sessions: [],
    measurements: [],
    scheduled: null,
    programs: [],
    loading: true,
  });

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [goals, nut, sess, meas, sched, progs] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 60),
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 30),
        base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.filter({ date: TODAY, completed: false }, '-date', 1),
        base44.entities.TrainingProgram.list('-created_date', 5),
      ]);
      setData({
        goal: goals?.[0] || null,
        nutrition: nut || [],
        sessions: sess || [],
        measurements: meas || [],
        scheduled: sched?.[0] || null,
        programs: progs || [],
        loading: false,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('useWidgetData error', e);
      setData((d) => ({ ...d, loading: false }));
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  return { ...data, user, today: TODAY, reload: load };
}

FILE: src/hooks/useWorkoutDraft.js

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

const KEY = 'lraz_active_workout';
export default function useWorkoutDraft(draft, enabled) {
  const latest = useRef(null);
  latest.current = enabled ? draft : null;
  const flush = useCallback(() => {
    if (!latest.current) return;
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify({ ...latest.current, savedAt: Date.now() })); } catch { /* Keep the active session usable if storage is full. */ }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const timeout = setTimeout(flush, 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [draft, enabled, flush]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onHidden = () => { if (document.hidden) flush(); };
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', flush);
    window.addEventListener('blur', flush);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onHidden);
    return () => {
      flush();
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', flush);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', flush);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onHidden);
    };
  }, [flush]);
  return useCallback(() => {
    latest.current = null;
    localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
  }, []);
}

FILE: src/hooks/useWorkoutHistory.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useInfiniteQuery, useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';

export default function useWorkoutHistory(search) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [term, setTerm] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => { const timer = setTimeout(() => setTerm(search.trim()), 350); return () => clearTimeout(timer); }, [search]);
  const regex = useMemo(() => ({ $regex: term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), $options: 'i' }), [term]);
  const matches = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['workout-search-sets', user?.id, term], enabled: !!user && !!term, initialPageParam: undefined, queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => base44.entities.WorkoutSet.filter({ created_by_id: user.id, $or: [{ exercise_name: regex }, { notes: regex }] }, { distinct: 'session_id', limit: 100, cursor: pageParam }), getNextPageParam: page => page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined });
  const matchingIds = useMemo(() => matches.data?.pages.flatMap(page => page.items) || [], [matches.data]);
  const query = useMemo(() => ({ created_by_id: user?.id, status: 'completed', ...(term ? { $or: [{ name: regex }, { notes: regex }, { program_day_name: regex }, { id: { $in: matchingIds } }] } : {}) }), [user?.id, term, regex, matchingIds]);
  const enabled = !!user && (!term || matches.isSuccess);
  const list = useInfiniteQuery({ queryKey: ['workout-history', query], enabled, initialPageParam: undefined, queryFn: async ({ pageParam }) => {
    const page = await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.filter(query, { sort: '-date', limit: 50, cursor: pageParam });
    const summaries = Object.fromEntries(page.items.map(session => [session.id, { exerciseCount: 0, totalSets: 0, hasNotes: false }]));
    if (page.items.length) {
      const totals = await base44.entities.WorkoutSet.aggregate({ query: { created_by_id: user.id, session_id: { $in: page.items.map(session => session.id) }, completed: true }, groupBy: ['session_id', 'exercise_name'], max: 'notes', limit: 1000 });
      totals.rows.forEach(row => { const item = summaries[row.session_id]; if (item) { item.exerciseCount++; item.totalSets += row.count; item.hasNotes ||= !!row.max_notes; } });
    }
    return { ...page, summaries };
  }, getNextPageParam: page => page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined });
  const count = useQuery({ queryKey: ['workout-history-count', query], enabled, queryFn: () => base44.entities.WorkoutSession.count(query) });
  const sessions = useMemo(() => list.data?.pages.flatMap(page => page.items) || [], [list.data]);
  const summaries = useMemo(() => Object.assign({}, ...(list.data?.pages.map(page => page.summaries) || [])), [list.data]);
  return { sessions, summaries, count: count.data, loading: list.isLoading || (!!term && matches.isLoading), error: list.error || matches.error || count.error, hasMore: list.hasNextPage, loadingMore: list.isFetchingNextPage, loadMore: list.fetchNextPage, hasMoreMatches: !!term && matches.hasNextPage, loadingMatches: matches.isFetchingNextPage, loadMatches: matches.fetchNextPage, searching: search.trim() !== term };
}

import React, { createContext, useState, useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { appParams } from '@/lib/app-params';
import { createAxiosClient } from '@base44/sdk/dist/utils/axios-client';

const AuthContext = createContext();

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [isLoadingAuth, setIsLoadingAuth] = useState(true);
  const [isLoadingPublicSettings, setIsLoadingPublicSettings] = useState(true);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState(null);
  const [authChecked, setAuthChecked] = useState(false);
  const [appPublicSettings, setAppPublicSettings] = useState(null); // Contains only { id, public_settings }

  useEffect(() => {
    checkAppState();
  }, []);

  const checkAppState = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoadingPublicSettings(true);
      setAuthError(null);
      
      // First, check app public settings (with token if available)
      // This will tell us if auth is required, user not registered, etc.
      const appClient = createAxiosClient({
        baseURL: `/api/apps/public`,
        headers: {
          'X-App-Id': appParams.appId
        },
        token: appParams.token, // Include token if available
        interceptResponses: true
      });
      
      try {
        const publicSettings = await appClient.get(`/prod/public-settings/by-id/${appParams.appId}`);
        setAppPublicSettings(publicSettings);
        
        // If we got the app public settings successfully, check if user is authenticated
        if (appParams.token) {
          await checkUserAuth();
        } else {
          setIsLoadingAuth(false);
          setIsAuthenticated(false);
          setAuthChecked(true);
        }
        setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
      } catch (appError) {
        console.error('App state check failed:', appError);
        
        // Handle app-level errors
        if (appError.status === 403 && appError.data?.extra_data?.reason) {
          const reason = appError.data.extra_data.reason;
          if (reason === 'auth_required') {
            setAuthError({
              type: 'auth_required',
              message: 'Authentication required'
            });
          } else if (reason === 'user_not_registered') {
            setAuthError({
              type: 'user_not_registered',
              message: 'User not registered for this app'
            });
          } else {
            setAuthError({
              type: reason,
              message: appError.message
            });
          }
        } else {
          setAuthError({
            type: 'unknown',
            message: appError.message || 'Failed to load app'
          });
        }
        setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
        setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Unexpected error:', error);
      setAuthError({
        type: 'unknown',
        message: error.message || 'An unexpected error occurred'
      });
      setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
    }
  };

  const checkUserAuth = async () => {
    try {
      // Now check if the user is authenticated
      setIsLoadingAuth(true);
      const currentUser = await base44.auth.me();
      setUser(currentUser);
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      setAuthChecked(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('User auth check failed:', error);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
      setAuthChecked(true);
      
      // If user auth fails, it might be an expired token
      if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403) {
        setAuthError({
          type: 'auth_required',
          message: 'Authentication required'
        });
      }
    }
  };

  const logout = (shouldRedirect = true) => {
    setUser(null);
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    
    if (shouldRedirect) {
      // Use the SDK's logout method which handles token cleanup and redirect
      base44.auth.logout(window.location.href);
    } else {
      // Just remove the token without redirect
      base44.auth.logout();
    }
  };

  const navigateToLogin = () => {
    // Use the SDK's redirectToLogin method
    base44.auth.redirectToLogin(window.location.href);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ 
      user, 
      isAuthenticated, 
      isLoadingAuth,
      isLoadingPublicSettings,
      authError,
      appPublicSettings,
      authChecked,
      logout,
      navigateToLogin,
      checkUserAuth,
      checkAppState
    }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

FILE: src/lib/PageNotFound.jsx

import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';


export default function PageNotFound({}) {
    const location = useLocation();
    const pageName = location.pathname.substring(1);

    const { data: authData, isFetched } = useQuery({
        queryKey: ['user'],
        queryFn: async () => {
            try {
                const user = await base44.auth.me();
                return { user, isAuthenticated: true };
            } catch (error) {
                return { user: null, isAuthenticated: false };
            }
        }
    });
    
    return (

                                        This could mean that the AI hasn't implemented this page yet. Ask it to implement it in the chat.
                                    </p>

                            </div>

                    {/* Action Button */}
                    <div className="pt-6">

                            onClick={() => window.location.href = '/'}

                        </button>

                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    )

import React, { createContext, useState, useContext, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';

export const THEMES = [
  { id: 'obsidian', name: 'Noir', desc: 'Premium dark' },
  { id: 'midnight', name: 'Midnight', desc: 'Deep dark' },
  { id: 'graphite', name: 'Graphite', desc: 'Neutral dark' },
  { id: 'slate', name: 'Slate', desc: 'Cool blue-gray' },
  { id: 'carbon', name: 'Carbon', desc: 'Warm charcoal' },
  { id: 'frost', name: 'Frost', desc: 'Cool teal dark' },
  { id: 'rose', name: 'Rose', desc: 'Warm rose' },
  { id: 'onyx', name: 'Onyx', desc: 'Monochrome silver' },
  { id: 'porcelain', name: 'Porcelain', desc: 'Premium light' },
  { id: 'custom', name: 'Custom', desc: 'Build your own' },
  { id: 'system', name: 'System', desc: 'Follow device' },
];

export const ACCENTS = [
  { id: 'champagne', name: 'Champagne Gold' },
  { id: 'blue', name: 'Signature Blue' },
  { id: 'ice', name: 'Ice Blue' },
  { id: 'platinum', name: 'Platinum' },
  { id: 'emerald', name: 'Emerald' },
  { id: 'violet', name: 'Violet' },
];

export const FONTS = [
  { id: 'inter', name: 'Inter' },
  { id: 'system', name: 'System' },
  { id: 'serif', name: 'Playfair' },
  { id: 'rounded', name: 'Quicksand' },
  { id: 'mono', name: 'Mono' },
];

const FONT_MAP = {
  inter: { heading: 'Inter', body: 'Inter', display: 'Inter' },
  system: { heading: 'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif', body: 'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif', display: 'ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif' },
  serif: { heading: "'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif", body: 'Inter, sans-serif', display: "'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif" },
  rounded: { heading: 'Quicksand, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif', body: 'Quicksand, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif', display: 'Quicksand, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif' },
  mono: { heading: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace', body: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace', display: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace' },
};

const LS_THEME = 'lraz_theme';
const LS_ACCENT = 'lraz_accent';
const LS_OLED = 'lraz_oled';

function resolveTheme(t) {
  if (t === 'system') return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches ? 'porcelain' : 'obsidian';
  return t || 'obsidian';
}

function hexToHsl(hex) {
  let h = String(hex || '#000000').replace('#', '');
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split('').map((c) => c + c).join('');
  const r = parseInt(h.slice(0, 2), 16) / 255;
  const g = parseInt(h.slice(2, 4), 16) / 255;
  const b = parseInt(h.slice(4, 6), 16) / 255;
  const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b);
  let hue = 0, sat = 0;
  const li = (max + min) / 2;
  if (max !== min) {
    const d = max - min;
    sat = li > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min);
    if (max === r) hue = (g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0);
    else if (max === g) hue = (b - r) / d + 2;
    else hue = (r - g) / d + 4;
    hue /= 6;
  }
  return { h: Math.round(hue * 360), s: Math.round(sat * 100), l: Math.round(li * 100) };
}
function hslStr(c) { return `${c.h} ${c.s}% ${c.l}%`; }
function shiftL(c, dl) { return { h: c.h, s: c.s, l: Math.max(8, Math.min(96, c.l + dl)) }; }

const CUSTOM_VARS = ['--background','--foreground','--card','--card-foreground','--popover','--popover-foreground','--primary','--primary-foreground','--secondary','--secondary-foreground','--muted','--muted-foreground','--border','--input','--ring','--luxury-blue','--luxury-blue-deep','--chart-1','--sidebar-background','--sidebar-foreground','--sidebar-primary','--sidebar-primary-foreground','--sidebar-accent','--sidebar-accent-foreground','--sidebar-border','--sidebar-ring'];

function applyCustomTheme(root, c) {
  const bg = hexToHsl(c.bg), card = hexToHsl(c.card), accent = hexToHsl(c.accent), text = hexToHsl(c.text);
  const isLight = text.l < 50;
  const mutedFg = isLight ? shiftL(text, 18) : shiftL(text, -22);
  const borderC = isLight ? shiftL(card, -12) : shiftL(card, -4);
  const mutedC = isLight ? shiftL(card, -6) : shiftL(card, -2);
  const secondaryC = isLight ? shiftL(card, -3) : shiftL(card, 3);
  const blueDeep = shiftL(accent, -25);
  const onAccent = accent.l > 62 ? '0 0% 8%' : '0 0% 100%';
  const set = (k, v) => root.style.setProperty(k, v);
  set('--background', hslStr(bg));
  set('--foreground', hslStr(text));
  set('--card', hslStr(card));
  set('--card-foreground', hslStr(text));
  set('--popover', hslStr(bg));
  set('--popover-foreground', hslStr(text));
  set('--primary', hslStr(accent));
  set('--primary-foreground', onAccent);
  set('--secondary', hslStr(secondaryC));
  set('--secondary-foreground', hslStr(text));
  set('--muted', hslStr(mutedC));
  set('--muted-foreground', hslStr(mutedFg));
  set('--border', hslStr(borderC));
  set('--input', hslStr(borderC));
  set('--ring', hslStr(accent));
  set('--luxury-blue', hslStr(accent));
  set('--luxury-blue-deep', hslStr(blueDeep));
  set('--chart-1', hslStr(accent));
  set('--sidebar-background', hslStr(bg));
  set('--sidebar-foreground', hslStr(isLight ? shiftL(text, -8) : shiftL(text, -10)));
  set('--sidebar-primary', hslStr(accent));
  set('--sidebar-primary-foreground', onAccent);
  set('--sidebar-accent', hslStr(card));
  set('--sidebar-accent-foreground', hslStr(text));
  set('--sidebar-border', hslStr(borderC));
  set('--sidebar-ring', hslStr(accent));
}
function clearCustomTheme(root) { CUSTOM_VARS.forEach((k) => root.style.removeProperty(k)); }

const ThemeContext = createContext();

export const ThemeProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(LS_THEME) || 'obsidian');
  const [accent, setAccentState] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(LS_ACCENT) || 'champagne');
  const [oled, setOledState] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem(LS_OLED) === '1');
  const [font, setFontState] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem('lraz_font') || 'inter');

  const apply = useCallback((t, a, o) => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const resolved = resolveTheme(t);
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', resolved);
    root.setAttribute('data-accent', a);
    const isLight = resolved === 'porcelain';
    root.classList.toggle('oled', !!o && !isLight);
    root.classList.toggle('dark', !isLight);
    root.classList.toggle('light', isLight);
    if (resolved === 'custom') {
      try { const c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lraz_custom') || '{}'); if (c.bg) applyCustomTheme(root, c); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    } else {
      clearCustomTheme(root);
    }
  }, []);

  // Apply on every change
  useEffect(() => { apply(theme, accent, oled); }, [theme, accent, oled, apply]);

  // Apply font family
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = FONT_MAP[font] || FONT_MAP.inter;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.style.setProperty('--font-heading', f.heading);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-body', f.body);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-display', f.display);
  }, [font]);

  // Listen for system changes when in system mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (theme !== 'system') return;
    const mql = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)');
    const handler = () => apply(theme, accent, oled);
    mql.addEventListener('change', handler);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', handler);
  }, [theme, accent, oled, apply]);

  // Adopt profile preference once user loads (profile is source of truth when present)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const t = user.theme_preference;
    const a = user.accent_color;
    const o = user.oled_mode;
    if (t && THEMES.some((x) => x.id === t)) { setThemeState(t); localStorage.setItem(LS_THEME, t); }
    if (a && ACCENTS.some((x) => x.id === a)) { setAccentState(a); localStorage.setItem(LS_ACCENT, a); }
    if (typeof o === 'boolean') { setOledState(o); localStorage.setItem(LS_OLED, o ? '1' : '0'); }
  }, [user]);

  const persist = useCallback(async (t, a, o) => {
    localStorage.setItem(LS_THEME, t);
    localStorage.setItem(LS_ACCENT, a);
    localStorage.setItem(LS_OLED, o ? '1' : '0');
    try { if (user) await base44.auth.updateMe({ theme_preference: t, accent_color: a, oled_mode: o }); } catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }
  }, [user]);

  const setTheme = useCallback((t) => { setThemeState(t); persist(t, accent, oled); }, [accent, oled, persist]);
  const setAccent = useCallback((a) => { setAccentState(a); persist(theme, a, oled); }, [theme, oled, persist]);
  const setOled = useCallback((o) => { setOledState(o); persist(theme, accent, o); }, [theme, accent, persist]);

  const setCustomTheme = useCallback((colors) => {
    localStorage.setItem('lraz_custom', JSON.stringify(colors));
    apply(theme, accent, oled);
  }, [theme, accent, oled, apply]);

  const setFont = useCallback((f) => { setFontState(f); localStorage.setItem('lraz_font', f); }, []);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, accent, oled, font, setTheme, setAccent, setOled, setCustomTheme, setFont }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = () => {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider');
  return ctx;
};

// Activity feed + challenges — deterministic, no AI. All operations use the
// Base44 client SDK and rely on per-entity RLS for authorization.
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';

// ---- Activity Posts ----

// Create an activity post. Only posts if the user has opted in via share_to_feed.
export async function createPost(type, title, body, snapshot = null, entityType = null, entityId = null) {
  try {
    const me = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!me) return null;
    const arr = await base44.entities.SocialProfile.filter({ user_id: me.id });
    const p = arr && arr[0];
    if (!p || !p.share_to_feed) return null;
    return await base44.entities.ActivityPost.create({
      user_id: me.id,
      user_name: p.display_name || me.full_name || 'Athlete',
      avatar_url: p.avatar_url || '',
      type, title, body, snapshot,
      entity_type: entityType, entity_id: entityId,
      likes: [], comment_count: 0,
    });
  } catch (e) { console.error('createPost', e); return null; }
}

export async function listFeed(limit = 50) {
  return await base44.entities.ActivityPost.list('-created_date', limit);
}

export async function toggleLike(post, me) {
  if (!me || !post) return post;
  const uid = me.user_id || me.id;
  const liked = (post.likes || []).includes(uid);
  if (liked) {
    await base44.entities.ActivityPost.updateMany({ id: post.id }, { $pull: { likes: uid } }).catch(() => {});
    return { ...post, likes: (post.likes || []).filter((l) => l !== uid) };
  }
  await base44.entities.ActivityPost.updateMany({ id: post.id }, { $push: { likes: uid } }).catch(() => {});
  if (post.user_id !== uid) {
    await base44.entities.AppNotification.create({
      user_id: post.user_id, type: 'social', actor_id: uid, actor_name: me.display_name || 'Someone',
      text: `${me.display_name || 'Someone'} liked your post.`, entity_type: 'post', entity_id: post.id, read: false,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
  return { ...post, likes: [...(post.likes || []), uid] };
}

export async function deletePost(postId) {
  try {
    await base44.entities.ActivityComment.deleteMany({ post_id: postId }).catch(() => {});
    await base44.entities.ActivityPost.delete(postId);
  } catch (e) { console.error('deletePost', e); }
}

// ---- Comments ----

export async function listComments(postId) {
  return await base44.entities.ActivityComment.filter({ post_id: postId }, 'created_date', 200);
}

export async function addComment(post, me, content) {
  if (!me || !content?.trim()) return null;
  const uid = me.user_id || me.id;
  const c = await base44.entities.ActivityComment.create({
    post_id: post.id, user_id: uid,
    user_name: me.display_name || 'Athlete', avatar_url: me.avatar_url || '',
    content: content.trim(),
  });
  await base44.entities.ActivityPost.updateMany({ id: post.id }, { $inc: { comment_count: 1 } }).catch(() => {});
  if (post.user_id !== uid) {
    await base44.entities.AppNotification.create({
      user_id: post.user_id, type: 'social', actor_id: uid, actor_name: me.display_name || 'Someone',
      text: `${me.display_name || 'Someone'} commented on your post.`, entity_type: 'post', entity_id: post.id, read: false,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
  return c;
}

// ---- Challenges ----

export async function listChallenges(limit = 50) {
  return await base44.entities.Challenge.list('-created_date', limit);
}

export async function createChallenge(data, me) {
  if (!me) return null;
  const uid = me.user_id || me.id;
  const name = me.display_name || 'Athlete';
  return await base44.entities.Challenge.create({
    ...data,
    creator_id: uid, creator_name: name,
    participant_ids: [uid], participant_names: [name],
    status: 'active',
  });
}

export async function joinChallenge(challenge, me) {
  if (!me || !challenge) return;
  const uid = me.user_id || me.id;
  if ((challenge.participant_ids || []).includes(uid)) return;
  await base44.entities.Challenge.updateMany({ id: challenge.id }, {
    $push: { participant_ids: uid, participant_names: me.display_name || 'Athlete' }
  }).catch(() => {});
}

export async function leaveChallenge(challenge, me) {
  if (!me || !challenge) return;
  const uid = me.user_id || me.id;
  await base44.entities.Challenge.updateMany({ id: challenge.id }, {
    $pull: { participant_ids: uid, participant_names: me.display_name || 'Athlete' }
  }).catch(() => {});
}

// ---- Public Training Stats ----

// Recompute the current user's aggregate training stats and persist them to
// their SocialProfile so other users can see them (only if share_training_stats is on).
// Deterministic — reads the user's own records, no AI.
export async function refreshMyTrainingStats() {
  try {
    const me = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!me) return;
    const arr = await base44.entities.SocialProfile.filter({ user_id: me.id });
    if (!arr?.length) return;
    const p = arr[0];
    if (!p.share_training_stats) return;
    const [workouts, sets, cardio] = await Promise.all([
      base44.entities.WorkoutSession.filter({ status: 'completed' }, '-date', 500),
      base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 1000),
      base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 500),
    ]);
    const totalVolume = (sets || []).reduce((a, s) => a + (s.completed ? (Number(s.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(s.reps) || 0) : 0), 0);
    const prCount = (sets || []).filter((s) => s.is_pr).length;
    const days = new Set((workouts || []).map((w) => (w.date || '').slice(0, 10)));
    let streak = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 365; i++) {
      const d = new Date(Date.now() - i * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      if (days.has(d)) streak++; else if (i > 0) break;
    }
    await base44.entities.SocialProfile.update(p.id, {
      public_workout_count: (workouts || []).length,
      public_total_volume: Math.round(totalVolume),
      public_pr_count: prCount,
      public_cardio_count: (cardio || []).length,
      public_streak: streak,
    });
  } catch (e) { console.error('refreshMyTrainingStats', e); }
}

FILE: src/lib/app-params.js

const isNode = typeof window === 'undefined';
const windowObj = isNode ? { localStorage: new Map() } : window;
const storage = windowObj.localStorage;

const toSnakeCase = (str) => {
	return str.replace(/([A-Z])/g, '_$1').toLowerCase();
}

const getAppParamValue = (paramName, { defaultValue = undefined, removeFromUrl = false } = {}) => {
	if (isNode) {
		return defaultValue;
	}
	const storageKey = `base44_${toSnakeCase(paramName)}`;
	const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
	const searchParam = urlParams.get(paramName);
	if (removeFromUrl) {
		urlParams.delete(paramName);
		const newUrl = `${window.location.pathname}${urlParams.toString() ? `?${urlParams.toString()}` : ""
			}${window.location.hash}`;
		window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, newUrl);
	}
	if (searchParam) {
		storage.setItem(storageKey, searchParam);
		return searchParam;
	}
	if (defaultValue) {
		storage.setItem(storageKey, defaultValue);
		return defaultValue;
	}
	const storedValue = storage.getItem(storageKey);
	if (storedValue) {
		return storedValue;
	}
	return null;
}

const getAppParams = () => {
	if (getAppParamValue("clear_access_token") === 'true') {
		storage.removeItem('base44_access_token');
		storage.removeItem('token');
	}
	return {
		appId: getAppParamValue("app_id", { defaultValue: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_APP_ID }),
		token: getAppParamValue("access_token", { removeFromUrl: true }),
		fromUrl: getAppParamValue("from_url", { defaultValue: window.location.href }),
		functionsVersion: getAppParamValue("functions_version", { defaultValue: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_FUNCTIONS_VERSION }),
		appBaseUrl: getAppParamValue("app_base_url", { defaultValue: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL }),
	}
}


export const appParams = {
	...getAppParams()
}

// Shared by the auth pages (Login, Register, and any page that resumes a flow
// after sign-in, e.g. the MCP OAuth consent page). Keep the redirect
// validation in one place — it is security-sensitive and easy to drift.

// Resolve ?returnTo= to a safe same-origin path, else "/".
//
// The same-origin check alone is not enough: a value like /.//evil.com or
// /\evil.com parses same-origin but normalizes to a protocol-relative
// //evil.com when assigned to location.href — an open redirect. So require the
// resolved path to be exactly one leading slash (no "//" prefix, no backslash).
export function safeReturnTo() {
  const raw = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("returnTo");
  if (!raw) return "/";
  try {
    const url = new URL(raw, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return "/";
    // Strip app-bootstrap params: app-params.js persists these from the URL into
    // localStorage before the SDK initializes, so a crafted returnTo could
    // otherwise poison the freshly issued session — repointing the app at an
    // attacker's backend (app_base_url/app_id/functions_version) or overwriting
    // the token. Normal app-flow params (e.g. the OAuth consent ctx) are kept.
    // The full app-params.js bootstrap set (src/lib/app-params.js) — any of
    // these in a crafted returnTo would be persisted at next load.
    for (const p of ["access_token", "clear_access_token", "app_id", "app_base_url", "functions_version", "from_url"]) {
      url.searchParams.delete(p);
    }
    const path = url.pathname + url.search;
    if (!path.startsWith("/") || path.startsWith("//") || path.includes("\\")) return "/";
    return path;
  } catch {
    return "/";
  }
}

// Deterministic cardio analytics — formulas, MET values, aggregation, PRs.
// Zero AI / zero credit. All calculations are local and documented.

// Activity catalog: id, label, base MET, metrics to show, icon hint.
// MET values are generalized adult averages (Ainsworth compendium approximations).
export const ACTIVITIES = [
  { id: 'walking', label: 'Outdoor Walking', met: 3.5, metrics: ['distance', 'pace', 'calories'], group: 'Walk' },
  { id: 'treadmill-walking', label: 'Treadmill Walking', met: 3.5, metrics: ['distance', 'speed', 'incline', 'calories'], group: 'Walk' },

export const ACTIVITY_MAP = Object.fromEntries(ACTIVITIES.map((a) => [a.id, a]));

export function getActivity(id) { return ACTIVITY_MAP[id] || ACTIVITY_MAP['custom']; }

// MET-based calorie estimation. For incline walking, MET scales with incline.
// Formula: kcal = MET × bodyWeightKg × hours. Returns rounded integer.
export function estimateCalories(activityId, durationSec, weightKg, incline) {
  const act = getActivity(activityId);
  let met = act.met;
  if ((activityId === 'treadmill-walking' || activityId === 'incline-walking') && Number(incline) > 0) {
    met = 3.5 + Number(incline) * 0.15; // incline-adjusted walking MET
  }
  const kg = Number(weightKg) > 0 ? Number(weightKg) : 70;
  const hours = (Number(durationSec) || 0) / 3600;
  if (hours <= 0 || !isFinite(met)) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(met * kg * hours));
}

export function computePace(durationSec, distanceKm) {
  if (!distanceKm || distanceKm <= 0 || !durationSec) return null;
  return durationSec / distanceKm; // sec per km
}

export function computeSpeed(distanceKm, durationSec) {
  if (!durationSec || durationSec <= 0) return null;
  return (distanceKm || 0) / (durationSec / 3600); // km/h
}

export function formatDuration(totalSec) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSec || 0));
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
  const sec = s % 60;
  if (h > 0) return `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(sec).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  return `${m}:${String(sec).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function formatPace(secPerKm) {
  if (secPerKm == null || !isFinite(secPerKm)) return '—';
  const m = Math.floor(secPerKm / 60);
  const s = Math.round(secPerKm % 60);
  return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function formatDistance(km) {
  if (km == null) return '—';
  return (Math.round(km * 100) / 100).toFixed(2);
}

// Range → milliseconds cutoff from now.
export function rangeCutoff(range) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const day = 86400000;
  switch (range) {
    case 'today': return now - day; // include today
    case 'week': return now - 7 * day;
    case 'month': return now - 30 * day;
    case '3m': return now - 90 * day;
    case '6m': return now - 182 * day;
    case '1y': return now - 365 * day;
    default: return 0;
  }
}

export function aggregateHistory(sessions, range) {
  const cutoff = rangeCutoff(range);
  const todayStart = new Date(); todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const inRange = (sessions || []).filter((s) => {
    if (!s.date) return false;
    const t = new Date(s.date).getTime();
    if (range === 'today') return t >= todayStart.getTime();
    return t >= cutoff;
  });
  const totalSeconds = inRange.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.duration_seconds || 0), 0);
  const totalDistance = inRange.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.distance_km || 0), 0);
  const totalCalories = inRange.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.calories || 0), 0);
  const estCal = inRange.filter((s) => s.calorie_source === 'Estimated').reduce((a, s) => a + (s.calories || 0), 0);
  const recCal = inRange.filter((s) => s.calorie_source !== 'Estimated').reduce((a, s) => a + (s.calories || 0), 0);

  const breakdownMap = {};
  inRange.forEach((s) => {
    const key = s.activity;
    if (!breakdownMap[key]) breakdownMap[key] = { activity: s.activity, label: s.activity_label || getActivity(s.activity).label, sessions: 0, seconds: 0, distance: 0, calories: 0 };
    breakdownMap[key].sessions++;
    breakdownMap[key].seconds += s.duration_seconds || 0;
    breakdownMap[key].distance += s.distance_km || 0;
    breakdownMap[key].calories += s.calories || 0;
  });
  const breakdown = Object.values(breakdownMap).sort((a, b) => b.seconds - a.seconds);

  const paced = inRange.filter((s) => s.distance_km > 0.2 && s.duration_seconds > 0);
  const avgPace = paced.length ? paced.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.duration_seconds / s.distance_km), 0) / paced.length : null;
  const avgSpeed = totalSeconds > 0 ? (totalDistance / (totalSeconds / 3600)) : null;
  const workload = inRange.reduce((a, s) => a + (getActivity(s.activity).met || 0) * ((Number(s.duration_seconds) || 0) / 3600), 0); // MET-hours
  return {
    sessions: inRange.length,
    totalSeconds,
    totalDistance,
    totalCalories,
    estimatedCalories: estCal,
    recordedCalories: recCal,
    avgDuration: inRange.length ? totalSeconds / inRange.length : 0,
    avgDistance: inRange.length ? totalDistance / inRange.length : 0,
    avgPace,
    avgSpeed,
    workload: +workload.toFixed(1),
    breakdown,
    inRange,
  };
}

// Weekly aggregates for charts: last numWeeks weeks (Mon start).
export function weeklyAggregates(sessions, numWeeks = 12) {
  const day = 86400000;
  const getWeekStart = (d) => { const x = new Date(d); x.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); x.setDate(x.getDate() - ((x.getDay() + 6) % 7)); return x.getTime(); };
  const thisWeekStart = getWeekStart(new Date());
  const weeks = [];
  for (let i = numWeeks - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const start = thisWeekStart - i * 7 * day;
    weeks.push({ weekStart: start, label: new Date(start).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }), seconds: 0, distance: 0, calories: 0, sessions: 0 });
  }
  const weekByStart = Object.fromEntries(weeks.map((w) => [w.weekStart, w]));
  (sessions || []).forEach((s) => {
    if (!s.date) return;
    const ws = getWeekStart(new Date(s.date));
    const w = weekByStart[ws];
    if (!w) return;
    w.seconds += s.duration_seconds || 0;
    w.distance += s.distance_km || 0;
    w.calories += s.calories || 0;
    w.sessions += 1;
  });
  return weeks;
}

// Deterministic cardio personal records.
export function detectCardioPRs(sessions) {
  const list = sessions || [];
  if (!list.length) return [];
  const prs = [];
  const running = list.filter((s) => s.activity.includes('running'));
  const walking = list.filter((s) => ['walking', 'treadmill-walking', 'incline-walking', 'hiking'].includes(s.activity));
  const cycling = list.filter((s) => ['cycling', 'stationary-bike', 'spin-bike', 'air-bike'].includes(s.activity));

  // Fastest pace (sec/km) among distance sessions
  const paced = list.filter((s) => s.distance_km > 0.2 && s.duration_seconds > 0);
  if (paced.length) {
    let best = paced[0], bestPace = best.duration_seconds / best.distance_km;
    paced.forEach((s) => { const p = s.duration_seconds / s.distance_km; if (p < bestPace) { bestPace = p; best = s; } });
    prs.push({ id: 'fastest-pace', label: 'Fastest Pace', value: bestPace, display: `${formatPace(bestPace)} /km`, date: best.date, activity: best.activity_label });
  }
  // Fastest 5K (running, distance >= 4.9)
  const fiveK = running.filter((s) => s.distance_km >= 4.9 && s.duration_seconds > 0);
  if (fiveK.length) {
    let best = fiveK[0], bestTime = best.duration_seconds * (5 / best.distance_km);
    fiveK.forEach((s) => { const t = s.duration_seconds * (5 / s.distance_km); if (t < bestTime) { bestTime = t; best = s; } });
    prs.push({ id: 'fastest-5k', label: 'Fastest 5K', value: bestTime, display: formatDuration(bestTime), date: best.date, activity: best.activity_label });
  }
  if (running.length) {
    const longest = running.reduce((a, s) => (s.distance_km > a.distance_km ? s : a));
    prs.push({ id: 'longest-run', label: 'Longest Run', value: longest.distance_km, display: `${formatDistance(longest.distance_km)} km`, date: longest.date, activity: longest.activity_label });
  }
  if (walking.length) {
    const longest = walking.reduce((a, s) => (s.distance_km > a.distance_km ? s : a));
    if (longest.distance_km > 0) prs.push({ id: 'longest-walk', label: 'Longest Walk', value: longest.distance_km, display: `${formatDistance(longest.distance_km)} km`, date: longest.date, activity: longest.activity_label });
  }
  if (cycling.length) {
    const longest = cycling.reduce((a, s) => (s.distance_km > a.distance_km ? s : a));
    if (longest.distance_km > 0) prs.push({ id: 'longest-ride', label: 'Longest Ride', value: longest.distance_km, display: `${formatDistance(longest.distance_km)} km`, date: longest.date, activity: longest.activity_label });
  }
  // Highest distance any
  const distSessions = list.filter((s) => s.distance_km > 0);
  if (distSessions.length) {
    const top = distSessions.reduce((a, s) => (s.distance_km > a.distance_km ? s : a));
    prs.push({ id: 'highest-distance', label: 'Highest Distance', value: top.distance_km, display: `${formatDistance(top.distance_km)} km`, date: top.date, activity: top.activity_label });
  }
  // Longest session
  const longestSession = list.reduce((a, s) => (s.duration_seconds > a.duration_seconds ? s : a));
  prs.push({ id: 'longest-session', label: 'Longest Cardio Session', value: longestSession.duration_seconds, display: formatDuration(longestSession.duration_seconds), date: longestSession.date, activity: longestSession.activity_label });

  // Most cardio minutes in one week / highest weekly distance
  const weeks = weeklyAggregates(list, 200);
  const activeWeeks = weeks.filter((w) => w.sessions > 0);
  if (activeWeeks.length) {
    const bestMin = activeWeeks.reduce((a, w) => (w.seconds > a.seconds ? w : a));
    prs.push({ id: 'most-weekly-minutes', label: 'Most Cardio Minutes / Week', value: bestMin.seconds, display: formatDuration(bestMin.seconds), date: new Date(bestMin.weekStart).toISOString() });
    const distWeeks = activeWeeks.filter((w) => w.distance > 0);
    if (distWeeks.length) {
      const bestDist = distWeeks.reduce((a, w) => (w.distance > a.distance ? w : a));
      prs.push({ id: 'highest-weekly-distance', label: 'Highest Weekly Distance', value: bestDist.distance, display: `${formatDistance(bestDist.distance)} km`, date: new Date(bestDist.weekStart).toISOString() });
    }
  }
  return prs;
}

// Performance comparison for a specific activity (first vs current), distance-paced activities.
export function performanceComparison(sessions, activityId) {
  const act = getActivity(activityId);
  if (!act.metrics.includes('pace') && !act.metrics.includes('speed')) return null;
  const ofAct = (sessions || []).filter((s) => s.activity === activityId && s.distance_km > 0.2 && s.duration_seconds > 0).sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
  if (ofAct.length < 2) return null;
  const first = ofAct[0];
  const current = ofAct[ofAct.length - 1];
  const firstPace = first.duration_seconds / first.distance_km;
  const currentPace = current.duration_seconds / current.distance_km;
  const improvement = firstPace - currentPace; // positive = faster
  return {
    firstPace, currentPace, improvement,
    firstDuration: first.duration_seconds, firstDistance: first.distance_km,
    currentDuration: current.duration_seconds, currentDistance: current.distance_km,
    firstDate: first.date, currentDate: current.date,
    faster: improvement > 0,
  };
}

// Time in HR zones 1-5 from sessions with heart_rate_avg. Zones calculated from estimated HR max (220 - age).
// Clearly a calculated estimate, not a medical measurement.
export function computeTimeInZone(sessions, age) {
  const hrMax = age ? 220 - age : 190;
  const zones = [
    { zone: 1, label: 'Z1 Recovery', min: 0.5, max: 0.6, seconds: 0 },
    { zone: 2, label: 'Z2 Base', min: 0.6, max: 0.7, seconds: 0 },
    { zone: 3, label: 'Z3 Tempo', min: 0.7, max: 0.8, seconds: 0 },
    { zone: 4, label: 'Z4 Threshold', min: 0.8, max: 0.9, seconds: 0 },
    { zone: 5, label: 'Z5 Max', min: 0.9, max: 1.01, seconds: 0 },
  ];
  let total = 0;
  (sessions || []).forEach((s) => {
    const hr = Number(s.heart_rate_avg), dur = Number(s.duration_seconds);
    if (!isFinite(hr) || hr <= 0 || !isFinite(dur) || dur <= 0) return; // ignore invalid
    if (hr < 30 || hr > 240) return; // implausible HR — skip
    const ratio = hr / hrMax;
    const z = zones.find((z) => ratio >= z.min && ratio < z.max) || zones[zones.length - 1];
    z.seconds += dur; total += dur;
  });
  return { zones, total, hrMax, calculated: true };
}

// Cardio progress over a range: compares recent vs prior equivalent window for
// pace, distance, duration, and calories. Includes workload (MET-hours). Returns
// sufficient=false with a note when there isn't enough data to compare.
export function computeCardioProgress(sessions, range = 'month') {
  const cutoff = rangeCutoff(range);
  const span = Date.now() - cutoff;
  const midCutoff = Date.now() - span / 2;
  const all = (sessions || []).filter((s) => s.date && new Date(s.date).getTime() >= cutoff);
  const recent = all.filter((s) => new Date(s.date).getTime() >= midCutoff);
  const prior = all.filter((s) => new Date(s.date).getTime() < midCutoff);
  const sum = (arr, k) => arr.reduce((a, s) => a + (Number(s[k]) || 0), 0);
  const avgPace = (arr) => {
    const p = arr.filter((s) => s.distance_km > 0.2 && s.duration_seconds > 0);
    return p.length ? p.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.duration_seconds / s.distance_km), 0) / p.length : null;
  };
  const r = {
    sufficient: recent.length >= 2 && prior.length >= 2,
    sessions: recent.length,
    priorSessions: prior.length,
    totalDistance: +sum(recent, 'distance_km').toFixed(2),
    priorDistance: +sum(prior, 'distance_km').toFixed(2),
    totalSeconds: sum(recent, 'duration_seconds'),
    priorSeconds: sum(prior, 'duration_seconds'),
    totalCalories: Math.round(sum(recent, 'calories')),
    priorCalories: Math.round(sum(prior, 'calories')),
    avgPace: avgPace(recent),
    priorPace: avgPace(prior),
  };
  r.distanceDelta = +(r.totalDistance - r.priorDistance).toFixed(2);
  r.durationDelta = r.totalSeconds - r.priorSeconds;
  r.paceDelta = (r.avgPace != null && r.priorPace != null) ? +(r.avgPace - r.priorPace).toFixed(1) : null; // negative = faster
  return r;
}

export function cardioElapsed(session) {
  if (!session) return 0;
  return (session.baseElapsed || 0) + (session.runningSince ? (Date.now() - session.runningSince) / 1000 : 0);
}
export function cardioIntervalPhase(elapsed, interval) {
  if (!interval) return null;
  const cycle = interval.workSec + interval.restSec;
  const total = cycle * interval.rounds;
  if (!cycle || elapsed >= total) return { phase: 'Done', round: interval.rounds, remaining: 0, total };
  const round = Math.floor(elapsed / cycle) + 1;
  const within = elapsed % cycle;
  const isWork = within < interval.workSec;
  return { phase: isWork ? 'Work' : 'Rest', round, remaining: isWork ? interval.workSec - within : cycle - within, total };
}

];
export const WIDGET_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(DASHBOARD_WIDGETS.map(widget => [widget.id, widget]));
export function normalizeDashboardPreferences(value) {
  const saved = Array.isArray(value?.items) ? value.items : [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const items = saved.filter(item => item && WIDGET_BY_ID[item.id] && !seen.has(item.id) && seen.add(item.id)).map(item => ({ id: item.id, added: item.added !== false, enabled: item.enabled !== false, size: item.size === 'compact' ? 'compact' : 'standard' }));
  DASHBOARD_WIDGETS.forEach(widget => { if (!seen.has(widget.id)) items.push({ id: widget.id, added: !widget.type, enabled: true, size: widget.type ? 'compact' : 'standard' }); });
  return { version: 1, items };
}
export const activeDashboardIds = preferences => preferences.items.filter(item => item.added && item.enabled).map(item => item.id);

// ===== Helpers =====

export function normalizeName(name) {
  return (name || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim();
}

export function searchExercises(query, filters = {}, library = EXERCISES) {
  const { muscle = 'All', equipment = 'All', movement = 'All', difficulty = 'All', category = 'All' } = filters;
  const q = (query || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  return library.filter((ex) => {
    if (muscle !== 'All' && ex.muscle_group !== muscle) return false;
    if (equipment !== 'All' && !(ex.equipment || []).includes(equipment)) return false;
    if (movement !== 'All' && ex.movement_pattern !== movement) return false;
    if (difficulty !== 'All' && ex.difficulty !== difficulty) return false;
    if (category !== 'All' && ex.category !== category) return false;
    if (q) {
      const hay = `${ex.name} ${ex.primary_muscle} ${(ex.secondary_muscles || []).join(' ')} ${(ex.equipment || []).join(' ')} ${ex.movement_pattern} ${ex.muscle_group}`.toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
}

// Rule-based substitutions: same primary muscle + same movement pattern,
// different exercise, filtered by available equipment when provided.
export function getSubstitutions(exercise, availableEquipment = null) {
  if (!exercise) return [];
  const avail = availableEquipment && availableEquipment.length ? availableEquipment : null;
  const pool = EXERCISES.filter((e) => e.slug !== exercise.slug && e.primary_muscle === exercise.primary_muscle);
  // Prefer same movement pattern first, then same muscle group
  const samePattern = pool.filter((e) => e.movement_pattern === exercise.movement_pattern);
  const sameGroup = pool.filter((e) => e.muscle_group === exercise.muscle_group && e.movement_pattern !== exercise.movement_pattern);
  let ranked = [...samePattern, ...sameGroup];
  if (avail) {
    // Prioritize exercises whose equipment is fully available
    ranked = ranked.sort((a, b) => {
      const aOk = (a.equipment || []).every((eq) => avail.includes(eq)) ? 0 : 1;
      const bOk = (b.equipment || []).every((eq) => avail.includes(eq)) ? 0 : 1;
      return aOk - bOk;
    });
  }
  // Dedupe by slug
  const seen = new Set();
  return ranked.filter((e) => { if (seen.has(e.slug)) return false; seen.add(e.slug); return true; }).slice(0, 6);
}

// Merge the static library with the user's custom exercises from the Exercise entity.
// Custom exercises that match a default by normalized name are skipped (no duplicates).
let _exerciseCache = null;
let _exerciseCachePromise = null;
let _exerciseCacheTime = 0;

export function clearExerciseCache() { _exerciseCache = null; _exerciseCachePromise = null; _exerciseCacheTime = 0; }

export async function getAllExercises() {
  if (_exerciseCache && Date.now() - _exerciseCacheTime < 60000) return _exerciseCache;
  if (_exerciseCachePromise) return _exerciseCachePromise;
  _exerciseCachePromise = (async () => {
    let custom = [];
    try {
      const { base44 } = await import('@/api/base44Client');
      custom = (await base44.entities.Exercise.list('-created_date', 200)) || [];
    } catch (e) { /* ignore — static library still works */ }
    const defaultNames = new Set(EXERCISES.map((e) => normalizeName(e.name)));
    const customs = custom.filter((c) => c.name && !defaultNames.has(normalizeName(c.name)));
    _exerciseCache = [...EXERCISES, ...customs.map(adaptCustomExercise)];
    _exerciseCacheTime = Date.now();
    return _exerciseCache;
  })();
  try { return await _exerciseCachePromise; }
  finally { _exerciseCachePromise = null; }
}

// Adapt a custom Exercise entity record to the same shape as a static entry.
export function adaptCustomExercise(c) {
  return {
    slug: c.canonical_id || `custom-${c.id}`,
    name: c.name,
    muscle_group: c.subcategory || 'Other',
    primary_muscle: c.primary_muscle || 'Other',
    secondary_muscles: c.secondary_muscles || [],
    equipment: c.equipment || [],
    category: c.category || 'Resistance',
    movement_pattern: c.movement_pattern || 'Other',
    force_type: 'Other',
    laterality: c.unilateral ? 'Unilateral' : 'Bilateral',
    difficulty: c.difficulty || 'Beginner',
    rep_low: c.rep_range_low || 8,
    rep_high: c.rep_range_high || 12,
    rest: c.rest_seconds || 60,
    instructions: c.instructions || '',
    mistakes: c.common_mistakes || [],
    safety: c.safety_tips || [],
    alternatives: c.alternatives || [],
    custom: true,
    id: c.id,
  };
}

// Muscle-group-based fallback for custom exercises not in the MAP.
// Only groups with male-athlete photos have a fallback; others return null.
const GROUP_FALLBACK = {
  Chest: IMG.bench_press,
  Back: IMG.barbell_row,
  Shoulders: IMG.overhead_press,
};

function normalize(name) {
  return (name || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\(.*?\)/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')
    .replace(/_+/g, '_');
}

// name: exercise name or slug. muscleGroup: optional muscle group for smart fallback.
// Returns null when no male-athlete photo is available — caller should show placeholder.
export function getExerciseImage(name, muscleGroup) {
  if (!name) return null;
  const key = normalize(name);
  if (MAP[key]) return MAP[key];
  if (muscleGroup && GROUP_FALLBACK[muscleGroup]) return GROUP_FALLBACK[muscleGroup];
  return null;
}

// Load a user-uploaded photo for an exercise from localStorage.
export function getUserExercisePhoto(slug) {
  if (!slug) return null;
  return localStorage.getItem(`exercise_photo_${slug}`);
}

FILE: src/lib/feedbackMessages.js

// Deterministic, rule-based motivational feedback messages.
// No AI, no credits — just predefined professional messages selected by data.
// Each function returns { title, message } or null when there's nothing meaningful to say.

// Deterministic pseudo-random index from arbitrary values. Same inputs → same pick,
// so a given session always shows the same message, but different sessions vary.
function pick(arr, ...seeds) {
  if (!arr || !arr.length) return null;
  let h = 0;
  for (const s of seeds) {
    const str = String(s ?? '');
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h = ((h << 5) - h + str.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; }
  }
  return arr[Math.abs(h) % arr.length];
}

// ── Workout completion ──────────────────────────────────────────────
export function getWorkoutFeedback({ score, volume, prCount, durationMinutes, exerciseCount, completedSets }) {
  const title = prCount > 0 ? 'Outstanding Session' : 'Session Complete';
  let pool;
  if (prCount > 0) {
    pool = [
      'Outstanding — you set a new personal record. That is the result of consistent, focused work.',
      'Excellent session. A new PR shows your training is producing real, measurable progress.',
      'Strong work. Setting a PR today confirms the program is working — keep tracking it.',
    ];
    return { title, message: pick(pool, volume, durationMinutes, prCount) };
  }
  if (score >= 85) {
    pool = [
      'Excellent session. Your training quality was outstanding today — high engagement across the board.',
      'Top-tier effort. Sessions like this are what compound into real strength and physique changes.',
      'Outstanding work. The volume, intensity, and consistency all aligned today.',
    ];
  } else if (score >= 70) {
    pool = [
      'Solid workout. Consistent effort at this level drives steady, reliable progress.',
      'Good session. You hit your targets with quality reps and controlled volume.',
      'Well-executed. Showing up and delivering this level of work is what builds results over time.',
    ];
  } else if (score >= 55) {
    pool = [

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { queryClientInstance } from '@/lib/query-client';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

// Session-only, user-scoped cache. No health records are persisted to browser storage.
export function fitnessRecordQuery(entity, userId, query = {}, options = {}) {
  const filter = { ...query, created_by_id: userId };
  const pageOptions = { sort: '-date', limit: 50, ...options };
  return { queryKey: ['fitness-records', entity, userId, filter, pageOptions],
    queryFn: async () => (await base44.entities[entity].filter(filter, pageOptions)).items };
}
export function fitnessRecords(entity, userId, query = {}, options = {}) {
  if (!userId) throw new Error('Please sign in to load your data.');
  return queryClientInstance.fetchQuery(fitnessRecordQuery(entity, userId, query, options));
}

export function fitnessSummaryQuery(entity, userId, config = {}) {
  const settings = { ...config, query: { ...config.query, created_by_id: userId } };
  return { queryKey: ['fitness-summary', entity, userId, settings], staleTime: 300000,
    queryFn: () => base44.entities[entity].aggregate(settings) };
}
export function fitnessSummary(entity, userId, config = {}) {
  if (!userId) throw new Error('Please sign in to load your data.');
  return queryClientInstance.fetchQuery(fitnessSummaryQuery(entity, userId, config));
}

export async function nutritionTrendRecords(userId, today = localDateStr()) {
  const start = new Date(`${today}T12:00:00`); start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
  const fields = ['calories', 'protein_g', 'carbs_g', 'fat_g', 'fiber_g'];
  const result = await fitnessSummary('NutritionLog', userId, { query: { date: { $gte: localDateStr(start), $lte: today } }, groupBy: ['date', 'meal'], sum: fields, limit: 100 });
  if (result.truncated) throw new Error('The nutrition summary could not be completed. Your records are still saved.');
  return result.rows.map((row) => ({ date: row.date, meal: row.meal, ...Object.fromEntries(fields.map((key) => [key, row[`sum_${key}`] || 0])) }));
}

export async function recentCardioTotals(userId, today = localDateStr()) {
  const start = new Date(`${today}T00:00:00`); start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
  const result = await fitnessSummary('CardioSession', userId, { query: { date: { $gte: start.toISOString() } }, groupBy: 'date', sum: ['duration_seconds', 'calories', 'distance_km'], limit: 1000 });
  if (result.truncated) throw new Error('The cardio summary could not be completed. Your records are still saved.');
  return result.rows.map((row) => ({ date: row.date, count: row.count, duration_seconds: row.sum_duration_seconds || 0, calories: row.sum_calories || 0, distance_km: row.sum_distance_km || 0 }));
}

FILE: src/lib/fitnessInvalidation.js
------------------------------------------------------------
import { queryClientInstance as client } from '@/lib/query-client';
import { clearWorkoutCache } from '@/lib/workoutData';

const QUERY_ENTITIES = {
  'widget-training': ['WorkoutSession'], 'workout-data': ['WorkoutSession', 'WorkoutSet', 'CardioSession', 'ScheduledWorkout'],
  'home-data': ['Goal', 'BodyMeasurement', 'NutritionLog', 'WorkoutSession', 'WorkoutSet', 'RecoveryRecord', 'Achievement', 'ScheduledWorkout', 'TrainingProgram', 'CardioSession'],
  'widget-data': ['Goal', 'BodyMeasurement', 'NutritionLog', 'WorkoutSession', 'ScheduledWorkout', 'TrainingProgram'],
  'progress-data': ['BodyMeasurement', 'WorkoutSession', 'WorkoutSet', 'Achievement', 'CardioSession'],
  'monthly-report': ['BodyMeasurement', 'WorkoutSession', 'WorkoutSet', 'NutritionLog', 'RecoveryRecord', 'CardioSession', 'Habit', 'HabitLog'],
  'measurement-history': ['BodyMeasurement'], 'recovery-records': ['RecoveryRecord'], 'training-calendar': ['ScheduledWorkout', 'WorkoutSession', 'CardioSession'],
  'workout-history': ['WorkoutSession'], 'workout-history-count': ['WorkoutSession'], 'workout-history-sets': ['WorkoutSet'],
  'workout-search-sets': ['WorkoutSet'], 'exercise-history': ['WorkoutSet', 'WorkoutSession'], 'exercise-history-summary': ['WorkoutSet'],
  'cardio-history': ['CardioSession'], 'cardio-summary': ['CardioSession'],
  'nutrition-history-summary': ['NutritionLog'], 'nutrition-history-day': ['NutritionLog'], 'habit-history': ['HabitLog', 'Habit'],
};
const pending = new Set();
let timer;
export function flushFitnessChanges() {
  clearTimeout(timer); timer = undefined;
  if (!pending.size) return;
  clearWorkoutCache();
  const entities = [...pending]; pending.clear();
  const affected = new Set(entities.flatMap(entity => entity === 'WorkoutSession' ? ['WorkoutSession', 'WorkoutSet', 'CardioSession'] : entity === 'BodyMeasurement' ? ['BodyMeasurement', 'Goal'] : [entity]));
  const predicate = query => {
    const [kind, entity] = query.queryKey;
    if (['fitness-records', 'fitness-summary', 'fitness-count'].includes(kind)) return affected.has(entity);
    return QUERY_ENTITIES[kind]?.some(name => affected.has(name)) || false;
  };
  client.cancelQueries({ predicate }, { silent: true });
  client.invalidateQueries({ predicate, refetchType: 'active' });
  entities.forEach(entity => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fitness-records-changed', { detail: { entity } })));
}
export function recordsChanged(entity) {
  pending.add(entity);
  clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(flushFitnessChanges, 100);
}
export function cancelFitnessChanges() { clearTimeout(timer); timer = undefined; pending.clear(); }

FILE: src/lib/fitnessScience.js

// Fitness science calculations — versioned, evidence-based.
// All formulas are estimates; never present as clinical measurements.

export const CALC_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export const kgToLbs = (kg) => kg * 2.2046226218;
export const lbsToKg = (lbs) => lbs / 2.2046226218;
export const cmToIn = (cm) => cm / 2.54;
export const inToCm = (inches) => inches * 2.54;

// BMR — Mifflin-St Jeor (1990), widely adopted estimate.
export function calcBMR({ weightKg, heightCm, age, sex }) {
  if (!weightKg || !heightCm || !age) return null;
  const base = 10 * weightKg + 6.25 * heightCm - 5 * age;
  return sex === 'female' ? base - 161 : base + 5;
}

export const ACTIVITY_MULTIPLIERS = {
  sedentary: 1.2, light: 1.375, moderate: 1.55, active: 1.725, very_active: 1.9,
};

export function calcTDEE(bmr, activity = 'moderate') {
  if (!bmr) return null;
  return bmr * (ACTIVITY_MULTIPLIERS[activity] || 1.55);
}

export function calcCalorieTarget(tdee, goal, ratePreference = 'Moderate') {
  if (!tdee) return null;
  const rateFactor = ratePreference === 'Conservative' ? 0.85 : ratePreference === 'Faster' ? 0.78 : 0.82;
  const surplusFactor = ratePreference === 'Conservative' ? 1.05 : ratePreference === 'Faster' ? 1.12 : 1.08;
  if (goal === 'Fat Loss') return Math.round(tdee * rateFactor);
  if (goal === 'Muscle Gain' || goal === 'Strength Gain') return Math.round(tdee * surplusFactor);
  if (goal === 'Body Recomposition') return Math.round(tdee * 0.98);
  return Math.round(tdee);
}

export function calcMacros({ weightKg, calorieTarget, goal }) {
  if (!weightKg || !calorieTarget) return null;
  const proteinPerKg = goal === 'Fat Loss' ? 2.2 : goal === 'Muscle Gain' ? 1.8 : 2.0;
  const proteinG = Math.round(weightKg * proteinPerKg);
  const fatG = Math.round(weightKg * 0.9);
  const proteinCal = proteinG * 4;
  const fatCal = fatG * 9;
  const carbCal = Math.max(0, calorieTarget - proteinCal - fatCal);
  const carbG = Math.round(carbCal / 4);
  const fiberG = Math.round((calorieTarget / 1000) * 14);
  const waterMl = Math.round(weightKg * 35);
  return { proteinG, carbG, fatG, fiberG, waterMl };
}

// Estimated one-rep max. Epley (1 + reps/30) for reps ≤ 12, Brzycki (37 - reps)
// for 13-20 reps; reps capped at 20 so very high-rep sets don't overestimate.
// Returns null for invalid/non-positive inputs. Always an estimate, not a measurement.
export function estimate1RM(weightKg, reps) {
  const w = Number(weightKg), r = Number(reps);
  if (!isFinite(w) || !isFinite(r) || w <= 0 || r < 1) return null;
  if (r === 1) return +w.toFixed(1);
  const rr = Math.min(20, r); // cap influence of very high-rep sets
  if (rr <= 12) return +(w * (1 + rr / 30)).toFixed(1); // Epley
  return +((w * 36) / (37 - rr)).toFixed(1); // Brzycki
}

export function calcBMI(weightKg, heightCm) {
  if (!weightKg || !heightCm) return null;
  const m = heightCm / 100;
  return +(weightKg / (m * m)).toFixed(1);
}

// Navy method — clearly labeled estimate
export function navyBodyFat({ sex, heightCm, neckCm, waistCm, hipCm }) {
  if (!heightCm || !neckCm || !waistCm) return null;
  if (sex === 'female' && !hipCm) return null;
  if (sex === 'female') {
    const v = 163.205 * Math.log10(waistCm + hipCm - neckCm) - 97.684 * Math.log10(heightCm) - 78.387;
    return Math.max(0, +v.toFixed(1));
  }
  const v = 86.01 * Math.log10(waistCm - neckCm) - 70.041 * Math.log10(heightCm) + 36.76;
  return Math.max(0, +v.toFixed(1));
}

export function fatMassLeanMass(weightKg, bodyFatPercent) {
  if (!weightKg || bodyFatPercent == null) return { fatMass: null, leanMass: null };
  const fatMass = +(weightKg * bodyFatPercent / 100).toFixed(1);
  const leanMass = +(weightKg - fatMass).toFixed(1);
  return { fatMass, leanMass };
}

export function calcFFMI(weightKg, bodyFatPercent, heightCm) {
  if (!weightKg || bodyFatPercent == null || !heightCm) return null;
  const ffm = weightKg * (1 - bodyFatPercent / 100);
  const m = heightCm / 100;
  return +(ffm / (m * m)).toFixed(1);
}

export function waistToHeight(waistCm, heightCm) {
  if (!waistCm || !heightCm) return null;
  return +(waistCm / heightCm).toFixed(2);
}
export function waistToHip(waistCm, hipCm) {
  if (!waistCm || !hipCm) return null;
  return +(waistCm / hipCm).toFixed(2);
}

export function rollingAverage(values, window) {
  if (!values || values.length < window) return null;
  const slice = values.slice(-window);
  return +(slice.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / slice.length).toFixed(1);
}

// Trailing moving-average series (one output per input, trailing window).
export function movingAverage(values, window = 7) {
  if (!values || !values.length) return [];
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    const start = Math.max(0, i - window + 1);
    const slice = values.slice(start, i + 1);
    out.push(+(slice.reduce((a, b) => a + (isFinite(b) ? b : 0), 0) / slice.length).toFixed(2));
  }
  return out;
}

// Smoothed average of the most recent `window` numeric values. Falls back to the
// overall average when fewer than `window` points exist; null when empty.
export function smoothedAverage(values, window = 7) {
  const v = (values || []).filter((x) => x != null && isFinite(x));
  if (!v.length) return null;
  const slice = v.slice(-window);
  return +(slice.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / slice.length).toFixed(2);
}

// Sufficient-data gate: true when at least `min` valid (finite, non-null) samples exist.
export function sufficientData(values, min) {
  const n = Array.isArray(values) ? values.filter((x) => x != null && isFinite(x)).length : (values != null ? 1 : 0);
  return n >= min;
}

export function weeklyRateOfChange(values) {
  if (!values || values.length < 2) return null;
  const recent = values.slice(-7);
  const prior = values.slice(-14, -7);
  if (prior.length === 0) return null;
  const recentAvg = recent.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / recent.length;
  const priorAvg = prior.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / prior.length;
  return +(recentAvg - priorAvg).toFixed(1);
}

export function trendDirection(values) {
  const r = weeklyRateOfChange(values);
  if (r == null) return 'insufficient';
  if (Math.abs(r) < 0.15) return 'stable';
  return r > 0 ? 'increasing' : 'decreasing';
}

export function dataConfidence(sampleSize, consistency = 1) {
  if (!sampleSize || sampleSize < 3) return 'Insufficient Data';
  if (sampleSize < 7) return 'Low Confidence';
  if (consistency < 0.6) return 'Low Confidence';
  if (sampleSize < 14) return 'Moderate Confidence';
  return 'High Confidence';
}

export function wilksScore(totalKg, bodyweightKg, sex) {
  if (!totalKg || !bodyweightKg) return null;
  const coeff = sex === 'female'
    ? 0.7528583238 / Math.pow(bodyweightKg, 0.1537689053)
    : 0.7906124566 / Math.pow(bodyweightKg, 0.1618720159);
  return +((totalKg * coeff * 100) / 0.7906124566).toFixed(1);
}

export function dotsScore(totalKg, bodyweightKg, sex) {
  if (!totalKg || !bodyweightKg) return null;
  const c = sex === 'female'
    ? [0.7528583238, 0.1537689053]
    : [0.7906124566, 0.1618720159];
  return +((totalKg * 500) / (c[0] * Math.pow(bodyweightKg, c[1]))).toFixed(1);
}

// Warm-up ramp planner. Deterministic percentages of the work-set weight.
// Weights rounded to the nearest 2.5 kg (and never below bar weight).
export function computeWarmupSets(workWeightKg, barWeightKg = 20) {
  if (!workWeightKg || workWeightKg <= 0) return [];
  const w = Number(workWeightKg);
  const steps = [
    { pct: 0.40, reps: 8, label: 'General warm-up' },
    { pct: 0.55, reps: 5, label: 'Prep' },
    { pct: 0.70, reps: 3, label: 'Activation' },
    { pct: 0.80, reps: 2, label: 'Heavy prep' },
    { pct: 0.90, reps: 1, label: 'Readiness' },
  ];
  return steps.map((s) => {
    const target = Math.max(barWeightKg, Math.round((w * s.pct) / 2.5) * 2.5);
    return { ...s, weight: target, pct: Math.round(s.pct * 100) };
  });
}

// ============================================================
// Quantity parsing & proportional nutrition helpers (deterministic)
// ============================================================

// Parse a quantity string that may use '.' or ',' as decimal separator.
// Normalizes comma to dot and returns a decimal number (never NaN).
export function parseQty(val) {
  if (val == null || val === '') return 0;
  const s = String(val).replace(/,/g, '.').replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');
  const n = parseFloat(s);
  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
}

// Whether a food is defined per 100g (quantity entered as a multiplier of 100g).
export function isPer100g(food) {
  return Number(food.quantity) === 100 && food.unit === 'g';
}

// Default quantity when the user enters nothing.
// Per-100g foods default to 1 (one 100g portion); other foods default to their base quantity.
export function defaultQty(food) {
  return isPer100g(food) ? 1 : Number(food.quantity) || 1;
}

// Compute the proportional factor for a food given an entered quantity.
// Per-100g foods: qty is a multiplier (0.5 = 50g = 50% of 100g values).
// Other foods: qty is the actual amount/count, factor = qty / base quantity.
export function foodFactor(food, qty) {
  const q = parseQty(qty);
  if (!q) return 0;
  return isPer100g(food) ? q : q / (Number(food.quantity) || 1);
}

// Convert a FoodItem entity record to the FOODS shape used by the nutrition UI.
export function foodItemToFood(item) {
  return {
    name: item.name,
    category: item.category || 'Custom',
    quantity: item.serving_size || 100,
    unit: item.serving_unit || 'g',
    calories: item.calories_per_serving || 0,
    protein_g: item.protein_g || 0,
    carbs_g: item.carbs_g || 0,
    fat_g: item.fat_g || 0,
    fiber_g: item.fiber_g || 0,
    sugar_g: item.sugar_g || 0,
    sodium_mg: item.sodium_mg || 0,
    _custom: true,
    _foodItemId: item.id,
  };
}
