// Deterministic Goal Journey & contribution analytics. Zero AI.
// All values come from database records + formulas. No causal claims are made.

const DAY = 86400000;
const WEEK = 7 * DAY;

export function weeksBetween(a, b) {
  return Math.max(0.01, (new Date(b) - new Date(a)) / WEEK);
}

// 7-day moving average of the most recent weights (trend weight).
// 7-day moving average of the most recent weigh-ins (trend weight). Measurements
// are sorted newest-first so the average reflects the latest week, not array order.
export function trendWeight(measurements) {
  const pts = (measurements || [])
    .filter((m) => m.weight_kg && m.date)
    .map((m) => ({ w: Number(m.weight_kg), t: new Date(m.date).getTime() }))
    .filter((p) => isFinite(p.w))
    .sort((a, b) => b.t - a.t);
  if (!pts.length) return null;
  const recent = pts.slice(0, 7);
  return +(recent.reduce((a, p) => a + p.w, 0) / recent.length).toFixed(1);
}

// Average weekly rate of weight change (kg/week) over the period, using a 4-week recent window.
// Average weekly rate of weight change (kg/week). Uses two equivalent windows
// (recent vs prior, up to 8 points each) and their midpoint distance so a single
// off-day doesn't dominate. Falls back to first/last when not enough points.
export function weeklyRate(measurements, startDate) {
  const pts = (measurements || [])
    .filter((m) => m.weight_kg && m.date && new Date(m.date) >= new Date(startDate))
    .map((m) => ({ w: Number(m.weight_kg), d: m.date }))
    .filter((p) => isFinite(p.w))
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.d) - new Date(b.d));
  if (pts.length < 2) return 0;
  const n = pts.length;
  const half = Math.min(8, Math.floor(n / 2));
  if (n < half * 2 || half < 1) {
    const first = pts[0], last = pts[n - 1];
    const wks = weeksBetween(first.d, last.d);
    if (wks < 0.5) return 0;
    return (last.w - first.w) / wks;
  }
  const recent = pts.slice(n - half, n);
  const prior = pts.slice(n - half * 2, n - half);
  const recentAvg = recent.reduce((a, p) => a + p.w, 0) / half;
  const priorAvg = prior.reduce((a, p) => a + p.w, 0) / half;
  const recentMid = new Date(recent[Math.floor(half / 2)].d).getTime();
  const priorMid = new Date(prior[Math.floor(half / 2)].d).getTime();
  const wks = weeksBetween(new Date(priorMid), new Date(recentMid));
  if (wks < 0.5) return 0;
  return (recentAvg - priorAvg) / wks; // negative = loss
}

function targetRateFor(goal) {
  const pref = goal?.rate_preference || 'Moderate';
  const map = { Conservative: 0.25, Moderate: 0.5, Faster: 0.75 };
  return map[pref] ?? 0.5;
}

export function computeJourney({ goal, measurements, workouts, sets, cardio, nutrition, scheduled, programDaysPerWeek }) {
  if (!goal) return null;
  const start = goal.created_at ? new Date(goal.created_at) : new Date(Date.now() - 30 * DAY);
  const now = new Date();
  const weeksElapsed = weeksBetween(start, now);
  const totalDays = Math.max(1, Math.round((now - start) / DAY));

  const isLoss = goal.primary_goal === 'Fat Loss' || (goal.target_weight_kg && goal.starting_weight_kg && goal.target_weight_kg < goal.starting_weight_kg);
  const isGain = goal.primary_goal === 'Muscle Gain' || (goal.target_weight_kg && goal.starting_weight_kg && goal.target_weight_kg > goal.starting_weight_kg);

  // Weight points in period
  const weightPts = (measurements || [])
    .filter((m) => m.weight_kg && new Date(m.date) >= start)
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));

  const startWeight = goal.starting_weight_kg || weightPts[0]?.weight_kg || null;
  const currentWeight = weightPts[weightPts.length - 1]?.weight_kg || null;
  const targetWeight = goal.target_weight_kg || null;

  let progressPct = 0;
  if (startWeight != null && currentWeight != null && targetWeight != null && startWeight !== targetWeight) {
    if (isLoss) progressPct = ((startWeight - currentWeight) / (startWeight - targetWeight)) * 100;
    else progressPct = ((currentWeight - startWeight) / (targetWeight - startWeight)) * 100;
    progressPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progressPct));
  }

  const change = (startWeight != null && currentWeight != null) ? (currentWeight - startWeight) : null;
  const remaining = (currentWeight != null && targetWeight != null) ? Math.abs(currentWeight - targetWeight) : null;

  // Rate + projection
  const rate = weeklyRate(measurements, start); // kg/week (negative = loss)
  const absRate = Math.abs(rate);
  let projectedDate = null;
  if (remaining != null && absRate > 0.05) {
    const weeksToGoal = remaining / absRate;
    projectedDate = new Date(now.getTime() + weeksToGoal * WEEK);
  }

  // Status
  const targetRate = targetRateFor(goal);
  const actualRate = isLoss ? -rate : rate; // positive = progressing toward goal
  let status = 'On Track', statusReason = '';
  if (targetWeight != null && startWeight != null) {
    if (actualRate >= targetRate * 1.1) { status = 'Ahead'; statusReason = `Your recent trend (~${Math.abs(rate).toFixed(2)} kg/week) is faster than your ${goal.rate_preference?.toLowerCase() || 'moderate'} target (~${targetRate} kg/week).`; }
    else if (actualRate >= targetRate * 0.9) { status = 'On Track'; statusReason = `Your recent trend (~${Math.abs(rate).toFixed(2)} kg/week) is close to your ${goal.rate_preference?.toLowerCase() || 'moderate'} target (~${targetRate} kg/week).`; }
    else if (actualRate >= targetRate * 0.5) { status = 'Slightly Behind'; statusReason = `Your recent trend (~${Math.abs(rate).toFixed(2)} kg/week) is below your target (~${targetRate} kg/week).`; }
    else { status = 'Needs Attention'; statusReason = actualRate <= 0 ? `Weight is not yet moving toward your target over the recent window.` : `Your recent trend (~${Math.abs(rate).toFixed(2)} kg/week) is well below your target (~${targetRate} kg/week).`; }
  }

  // ---- Cardio contributors ----
  const cardioIn = (cardio || []).filter((c) => new Date(c.date) >= start);
  const cardioSeconds = cardioIn.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.duration_seconds || 0), 0);
  const cardioDistance = cardioIn.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.distance_km || 0), 0);
  const cardioCalories = cardioIn.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.calories || 0), 0);
  const cardioEst = cardioIn.filter((c) => c.calorie_source === 'Estimated').reduce((a, c) => a + (c.calories || 0), 0);
  const cardioRec = cardioIn.filter((c) => c.calorie_source !== 'Estimated').reduce((a, c) => a + (c.calories || 0), 0);

  // ---- Strength contributors ----
  const workoutsIn = (workouts || []).filter((w) => new Date(w.date) >= start);
  const completedWorkouts = workoutsIn.filter((w) => w.status === 'completed' || w.status === 'in_progress');
  const setsIn = (sets || []).filter((s) => new Date(s.created_date) >= start);
  const totalSets = setsIn.length;
  const exercisesCompleted = new Set(setsIn.map((s) => s.exercise_name?.toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)).size;
  const totalVolume = setsIn.reduce((a, s) => a + ((s.weight_kg || 0) * (s.reps || 0)), 0);
  const prs = setsIn.filter((s) => s.is_pr).length + workoutsIn.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.pr_count || 0), 0);

  // Training adherence
  const scheduledIn = (scheduled || []).filter((s) => new Date(s.date) >= start && new Date(s.date) <= now);
  let adherence = null, plannedWorkouts = 0;
  if (scheduledIn.length > 0) {
    plannedWorkouts = scheduledIn.length;
    adherence = scheduledIn.filter((s) => s.completed).length / plannedWorkouts;
  } else {
    const freq = programDaysPerWeek || 3;
    plannedWorkouts = Math.round(freq * weeksElapsed);
    adherence = plannedWorkouts > 0 ? Math.min(1, completedWorkouts.length / plannedWorkouts) : 0;
  }

  // ---- Nutrition contributors ----
  const byDay = {};
  (nutrition || []).forEach((n) => {
    if (!n.date) return;
    const d = n.date.slice(0, 10);
    if (new Date(d) < start) return;
    if (!byDay[d]) byDay[d] = { calories: 0, protein: 0 };
    byDay[d].calories += n.calories || 0;
    byDay[d].protein += n.protein_g || 0;
  });
  const loggingDays = Object.keys(byDay).length;
  const dailyVals = Object.values(byDay);
  const avgCalories = dailyVals.length ? dailyVals.reduce((a, d) => a + d.calories, 0) / dailyVals.length : 0;
  const avgProtein = dailyVals.length ? dailyVals.reduce((a, d) => a + d.protein, 0) / dailyVals.length : 0;
  const proteinTarget = goal.protein_target_g || 0;
  const proteinGoalDays = proteinTarget ? dailyVals.filter((d) => d.protein >= proteinTarget * 0.9).length : 0;
  const calorieTarget = goal.calorie_target || 0;
  const calorieGoalDays = calorieTarget ? dailyVals.filter((d) => d.calories >= calorieTarget * 0.85 && d.calories <= calorieTarget * 1.15).length : 0;
  const nutritionAdherence = loggingDays ? proteinGoalDays / loggingDays : 0;

  const measurementCount = weightPts.length;

  return {
    goal, start, now, weeksElapsed, totalDays,
    isLoss, isGain,
    startWeight, currentWeight, targetWeight,
    progressPct, change, remaining,
    weightTimeline: weightPts,
    trendWt: trendWeight(measurements),
    rate, projectedDate, status, statusReason,
    cardio: { sessions: cardioIn.length, totalSeconds: cardioSeconds, distance: cardioDistance, calories: cardioCalories, est: cardioEst, rec: cardioRec, avgPerWeek: cardioIn.length / weeksElapsed },
    strength: { workouts: completedWorkouts.length, exercises: exercisesCompleted, sets: totalSets, volume: totalVolume, prs, adherence, planned: plannedWorkouts },
    nutrition: { avgCalories, avgProtein, loggingDays, proteinGoalDays, calorieGoalDays, adherence: nutritionAdherence, proteinTarget, calorieTarget },
    body: { start: startWeight, finish: currentWeight, change, entries: measurementCount },
    habits: {
      strengthSessions: completedWorkouts.length,
      cardioSessions: cardioIn.length,
      nutritionTracking: { done: loggingDays, total: totalDays },
      proteinGoal: { done: proteinGoalDays, total: totalDays },
      weightLogs: measurementCount,
    },
  };
}

export function fmtKg(v) { return v == null ? '—' : `${(Math.round(v * 10) / 10).toFixed(1)} kg`; }
export function fmtDur(sec) {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sec || 0));
  const h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
  if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`;
  return `${m}m`;
}
export function fmtDate(d) { return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }); }

import { fitnessRecordQuery, fitnessSummaryQuery } from '@/lib/fitnessDataCache';
import { WIDGET_BY_ID } from '@/lib/dashboardWidgets';
import { widgetTrainingQuery } from '@/lib/widgetTrainingStats';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

const nutritionFields = ['calories', 'protein_g', 'carbs_g', 'fat_g', 'fiber_g'];
function nutritionRows(result) {
  if (result.truncated) throw new Error('Nutrition totals could not be completed.');
  return result.rows.map(row => ({ date: row.date, meal: row.meal, ...Object.fromEntries(nutritionFields.map(key => [key, row[`sum_${key}`] || 0])) }));
}
function cardioRows(result) {
  if (result.truncated) throw new Error('Cardio totals could not be completed.');
  return result.rows.map(row => ({ date: row.date, count: row.count, duration_seconds: row.sum_duration_seconds || 0, calories: row.sum_calories || 0, distance_km: row.sum_distance_km || 0 }));
}
export default function homeQueries(userId, today, visible) {
  const needs = new Set(visible.flatMap(id => WIDGET_BY_ID[id]?.resources || []));
  if (visible.includes('summary')) ['goal', 'nutrition', 'sessions', 'training'].forEach(name => needs.add(name));
  const start = new Date(`${today}T12:00:00`); start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
  const cardioStart = new Date(`${localDateStr(start)}T00:00:00`);
  const definitions = [
    { name: 'goal', ...fitnessRecordQuery('Goal', userId, { status: 'active' }, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 1 }) },
    { name: 'measurements', ...fitnessRecordQuery('BodyMeasurement', userId, {}, { limit: 30 }) },
    { name: 'nutrition', ...fitnessSummaryQuery('NutritionLog', userId, { query: { date: { $gte: localDateStr(start), $lte: today } }, groupBy: ['date', 'meal'], sum: nutritionFields, limit: 100 }), select: nutritionRows },
    { name: 'sessions', ...fitnessRecordQuery('WorkoutSession', userId, {}, { limit: 60 }) },
    { name: 'sets', ...fitnessRecordQuery('WorkoutSet', userId, {}, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 300 }) },
    { name: 'recovery', ...fitnessRecordQuery('RecoveryRecord', userId, {}, { limit: 7 }) },
    { name: 'achievements', ...fitnessRecordQuery('Achievement', userId, {}, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 6 }) },
    { name: 'scheduled', ...fitnessRecordQuery('ScheduledWorkout', userId, { date: today, completed: false }, { sort: 'created_date', limit: 1 }) },
    { name: 'cardio', ...fitnessSummaryQuery('CardioSession', userId, { query: { date: { $gte: cardioStart.toISOString() } }, groupBy: 'date', sum: ['duration_seconds', 'calories', 'distance_km'], limit: 1000 }), select: cardioRows },
    { name: 'training', ...widgetTrainingQuery(userId, today) },
  ];
  return definitions.filter(definition => needs.has(definition.name));
}

FILE: src/lib/monthlyReportData.js

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { fitnessRecords, fitnessSummary } from '@/lib/fitnessDataCache';
import { estimate1RM } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';

export default async function monthlyReportData(userId, month) {
  const end = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + 1, 1);
  const key = (date) => `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
  const range = { $gte: key(month), $lt: key(end) };
  const query = { date: range };
  const [training, cardio, nutrition, recovery, first, last, habitCount, logCount, sets] = await Promise.all([
    fitnessSummary('WorkoutSession', userId, { query: { ...query, status: 'completed' }, sum: ['total_volume_kg', 'pr_count'] }),
    fitnessSummary('CardioSession', userId, { query, sum: ['duration_seconds', 'calories'] }),
    fitnessSummary('NutritionLog', userId, { query, groupBy: 'date', sum: ['calories', 'protein_g'], limit: 31 }),
    fitnessSummary('RecoveryRecord', userId, { query, sum: 'readiness_score' }),
    fitnessRecords('BodyMeasurement', userId, query, { sort: 'date', limit: 1, fields: ['date', 'weight_kg'] }),
    fitnessRecords('BodyMeasurement', userId, query, { sort: '-date', limit: 1, fields: ['date', 'weight_kg'] }),
    base44.entities.Habit.count({ created_by_id: userId }),
    base44.entities.HabitLog.count({ created_by_id: userId, ...query }),
    fitnessSummary('WorkoutSet', userId, { query: { created_date: range }, groupBy: ['exercise_name', 'weight_kg', 'reps'], limit: 1000 }),
  ]);
  if ([nutrition, sets].some((result) => result.truncated)) throw new Error('This report has more exercise groups than can be summarized at once. Your records are still saved.');
  const workout = training.rows[0] || {}, aerobic = cardio.rows[0] || {}, rest = recovery.rows[0] || {};
  const daily = nutrition.rows;
  const exercises = new Map();
  sets.rows.forEach((row) => {
    const entry = exercises.get(row.exercise_name) || { name: row.exercise_name, vol: 0, topE1rm: 0 };
    entry.vol += (row.weight_kg || 0) * (row.reps || 0) * row.count;
    entry.topE1rm = Math.max(entry.topE1rm, estimate1RM(row.weight_kg, row.reps) || 0);
    exercises.set(row.exercise_name, entry);
  });
  const firstWeight = first[0]?.weight_kg, lastWeight = last[0]?.weight_kg;
  const days = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  return {
    mWorkouts: workout.count || 0, totalVolume: Math.round(workout.sum_total_volume_kg || 0), prCount: workout.sum_pr_count || 0,
    cardioCount: aerobic.count || 0, cardioMinutes: Math.round((aerobic.sum_duration_seconds || 0) / 60), cardioCals: Math.round(aerobic.sum_calories || 0),
    avgCals: Math.round(daily.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.sum_calories || 0), 0) / (daily.length || 1)),
    avgProtein: Math.round(daily.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.sum_protein_g || 0), 0) / (daily.length || 1)),
    avgReadiness: rest.count && rest.sum_readiness_score ? Math.round(rest.sum_readiness_score / rest.count) : null,
    weightChange: first[0]?.id !== last[0]?.id && firstWeight != null && lastWeight != null ? lastWeight - firstWeight : null,
    habitRate: habitCount ? Math.min(100, Math.round(logCount / (habitCount * days) * 100)) : null,
    topExercises: [...exercises.values()].sort((a, b) => b.vol - a.vol).slice(0, 5),
  };
}

// Performance Analytics engine — computes real, data-driven insights from the
// user's actual training, nutrition, recovery, and body data. Pure functions;
// no medical claims. All recovery/plateau/weak-point outputs are estimates.
import { estimate1RM } from './fitnessScience';

export const MUSCLE_GROUPS = ['Chest', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Biceps', 'Triceps', 'Quads', 'Hamstrings', 'Glutes', 'Calves', 'Core'];

// Ordered rules — first match wins. Specific muscles before broad ones.
const RULES = [
  { muscle: 'Biceps', kw: ['bicep', 'curl'] },
  { muscle: 'Triceps', kw: ['tricep', 'pushdown', 'skull', 'tricep extension'] },
  { muscle: 'Core', kw: ['leg raise', 'hanging leg', 'crunch', 'sit up', 'situp', 'plank', 'core', 'abs'] },
  { muscle: 'Hamstrings', kw: ['leg curl', 'romanian', 'rdl', 'hamstring', 'good morning'] },
  { muscle: 'Glutes', kw: ['glute', 'hip thrust', 'hip raise'] },
  { muscle: 'Calves', kw: ['calf'] },
  { muscle: 'Shoulders', kw: ['overhead', 'shoulder', 'lateral', 'raise', 'shrug', 'arnold'] },
  { muscle: 'Quads', kw: ['squat', 'leg press', 'leg extension', 'lunge', 'quad', 'bulgarian', 'goblet', 'split squat'] },
  { muscle: 'Chest', kw: ['bench', 'chest', 'fly', 'dip', 'push-up', 'push up', 'pushup', 'crossover'] },
  { muscle: 'Back', kw: ['row', 'pull', 'pulldown', 'chin', 'deadlift', 'face pull'] },
];

export function muscleGroupForExercise(name) {
  if (!name) return null;
  const n = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const r of RULES) {
    if (r.kw.some((k) => n.includes(k))) return r.muscle;
  }
  return null;
}

export function sessionDateMap(sessions) {
  const map = {};
  for (const s of sessions) {
    if (s?.id && s?.date) map[s.id] = new Date(s.date).getTime();
  }
  return map;
}

// Volume + set count per muscle over the last `days` days.
export function computeVolumeByMuscle(sessions, sets, days = 7) {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86400000;
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const vol = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    if (!s) continue;
    const t = dates[s.session_id];
    if (!t || t < cutoff) continue;
    const w = Number(s.weight_kg), r = Number(s.reps);
    if (!isFinite(w) || !isFinite(r) || w < 0 || r < 0) continue; // ignore invalid records
    const m = muscleGroupForExercise(s.exercise_name);
    if (!m) continue;
    if (!vol[m]) vol[m] = { volume: 0, sets: 0 };
    vol[m].volume += w * r;
    vol[m].sets += 1;
  }
  return vol;
}

// Per-muscle recovery estimate from time since last trained + volume + soreness.
export function computeMuscleRecovery(sessions, sets, recovery) {
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const now = Date.now();
  const lastTrained = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    const t = dates[s.session_id];
    if (!t) continue;
    const m = muscleGroupForExercise(s.exercise_name);
    if (!m) continue;
    if (!lastTrained[m] || t > lastTrained[m]) lastTrained[m] = t;
  }
  const weekly = computeVolumeByMuscle(sessions, sets, 7);
  const result = {};
  for (const m of MUSCLE_GROUPS) {
    const lt = lastTrained[m];
    const hoursSince = lt ? (now - lt) / 3600000 : null;
    const wv = weekly[m]?.volume || 0;
    let status = 'unknown';
    if (hoursSince != null) {
      if (hoursSince < 24) status = 'needs';
      else if (hoursSince < 48) status = 'partial';
      else if (hoursSince < 72) status = wv > 5000 ? 'partial' : 'ready';
      else status = 'ready';
      if (recovery?.soreness_level >= 7 && hoursSince < 48) status = 'needs';
    }
    result[m] = {
      status,
      hoursSince: hoursSince != null ? Math.round(hoursSince) : null,
      lastTrained: lt,
      weeklyVolume: Math.round(wv),
      weeklySets: weekly[m]?.sets || 0,
    };
  }
  return result;
}

// Readiness 0-100. Uses stored score if present, else estimates from signals.
export function computeReadiness(recovery, recentSessions) {
  if (recovery?.readiness_score != null) return Math.round(recovery.readiness_score);
  if (!recovery) return null;
  const sleepScore = Math.min(100, ((recovery.sleep_hours || 0) / 8) * 100);
  const sorenessScore = 100 - (recovery.soreness_level || 0) * 10;
  const energyScore = (recovery.energy || 5) * 10;
  const stressScore = 100 - (recovery.stress_level || 0) * 10;
  const score = sleepScore * 0.3 + sorenessScore * 0.25 + energyScore * 0.25 + stressScore * 0.2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(score)));
}

// Best lifts: top estimated 1RM, max weight, max reps per exercise.
export function computeBestLifts(sets) {
  const byEx = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    if (!s || !s.exercise_name) continue;
    if (s.set_type === 'warmup') continue; // warm-ups aren't performance lifts
    const w = Number(s.weight_kg), r = Number(s.reps);
    if (!isFinite(w) || !isFinite(r) || w <= 0 || r < 1) continue; // ignore invalid/incomplete
    const e1rm = estimate1RM(w, r);
    const cur = byEx[s.exercise_name] || { exercise: s.exercise_name, maxWeight: 0, bestE1RM: 0, maxReps: 0 };
    cur.maxWeight = Math.max(cur.maxWeight, w);
    cur.bestE1RM = Math.max(cur.bestE1RM, e1rm || 0);
    cur.maxReps = Math.max(cur.maxReps, r);
    byEx[s.exercise_name] = cur;
  }
  return Object.values(byEx).sort((a, b) => b.bestE1RM - a.bestE1RM);
}

// Plateau detection: flat e1RM across last 5+ sessions of an exercise.
export function detectPlateaus(sessions, sets) {
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const byEx = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    const t = dates[s.session_id];
    if (!t || !s.exercise_name) continue;
    const e1rm = estimate1RM(s.weight_kg, s.reps);
    if (!e1rm) continue;
    if (!byEx[s.exercise_name]) byEx[s.exercise_name] = {};
    byEx[s.exercise_name][t] = Math.max(byEx[s.exercise_name][t] || 0, e1rm);
  }
  const plateaus = [];
  for (const [ex, byDate] of Object.entries(byEx)) {
    const vals = Object.keys(byDate).sort().map((k) => byDate[k]);
    if (vals.length < 5) continue;
    const last5 = vals.slice(-5);
    const avg = last5.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / last5.length;
    const range = Math.max(...last5) - Math.min(...last5);
    if (range < avg * 0.04 && last5[last5.length - 1] <= last5[0]) {
      plateaus.push({ exercise: ex, weeks: 5, e1rm: +avg.toFixed(1) });
    }
  }
  return plateaus;
}

// Weak points: muscles with < 50% of the max muscle's monthly volume.
export function detectWeakPoints(monthlyVolume) {
  const entries = MUSCLE_GROUPS.map((m) => ({ muscle: m, volume: monthlyVolume[m]?.volume || 0 }));
  const max = Math.max(...entries.map((e) => e.volume));
  if (!max) return [];
  return entries.filter((e) => e.volume < max * 0.5).map((e) => e.muscle);
}

// Nutrition trends over last `days` days.
export function computeNutritionTrends(logs, goal, days = 7) {
  const byDate = {};
  const add = (d, l) => {
    if (!byDate[d]) byDate[d] = { calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0, fiber: 0 };
    byDate[d].calories += Number.isFinite(l.calories) ? l.calories : 0;
    byDate[d].protein += Number.isFinite(l.protein_g) ? l.protein_g : 0;
    byDate[d].carbs += Number.isFinite(l.carbs_g) ? l.carbs_g : 0;
    byDate[d].fat += Number.isFinite(l.fat_g) ? l.fat_g : 0;
    byDate[d].fiber += Number.isFinite(l.fiber_g) ? l.fiber_g : 0;
  };
  for (const l of logs || []) {
    if (!l || !l.date) continue;
    add(l.date, l);
  }
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - days * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const recent = Object.entries(byDate).filter(([d]) => d >= cutoff).sort();
  const daysLogged = recent.length;
  const empty = { daysLogged: 0, avgCalories: null, avgProtein: null, avgCarbs: null, avgFat: null, avgFiber: null, proteinAdherence: null, proteinDaysHit: 0, calorieAdherence: null, calorieDaysHit: 0, sufficient: false, todayCalories: 0, todayProtein: 0 };
  if (!daysLogged) return empty;
  const sum = (k) => recent.reduce((a, [, v]) => a + v[k], 0);
  const avgCalories = Math.round(sum('calories') / daysLogged);
  const avgProtein = Math.round(sum('protein') / daysLogged);
  const avgCarbs = Math.round(sum('carbs') / daysLogged);
  const avgFat = Math.round(sum('fat') / daysLogged);
  const avgFiber = Math.round(sum('fiber') / daysLogged);
  const proTarget = goal?.protein_target_g || 0;
  const calTarget = goal?.calorie_target || 0;
  const proteinDaysHit = proTarget ? recent.filter(([, v]) => v.protein >= proTarget).length : 0;
  const proteinAdherence = proTarget ? proteinDaysHit / daysLogged : null;
  const calorieDaysHit = calTarget ? recent.filter(([, v]) => v.calories >= calTarget * 0.85 && v.calories <= calTarget * 1.15).length : 0;
  const calorieAdherence = calTarget ? calorieDaysHit / daysLogged : null;
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const tv = byDate[today] || { calories: 0, protein: 0 };
  return { daysLogged, avgCalories, avgProtein, avgCarbs, avgFat, avgFiber, proteinAdherence, proteinDaysHit, calorieAdherence, calorieDaysHit, sufficient: daysLogged >= 3, todayCalories: Math.round(tv.calories), todayProtein: Math.round(tv.protein) };
}

// Performance DNA — estimated 0-100 scores from accumulated data.
export function computePerformanceDNA({ bestLifts, measurements, sessions, recovery, goal }) {
  const latestWeight = [...measurements].reverse().find((m) => m.weight_kg)?.weight_kg;
  const topE1RM = bestLifts[0]?.bestE1RM || 0;
  const strengthRatio = latestWeight ? topE1RM / latestWeight : 0;
  const strength = Math.min(100, Math.round(strengthRatio * 50));
  const workouts30 = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && Date.now() - new Date(s.date).getTime() < 30 * 86400000).length;
  const targetSessions = (goal?.days_per_week || 4) * 4;
  const consistency = Math.min(100, Math.round((workouts30 / targetSessions) * 100));
  const recoveryScore = recovery?.readiness_score ?? 70;
  const hypertrophy = Math.min(100, Math.round((bestLifts.length / 6) * 100));
  return { strength, hypertrophy, recovery: Math.round(recoveryScore), consistency };
}

// Today's workout recommendation from recovery + weak points + schedule.
export function recommendTodaysWorkout({ muscleRecovery, weakPoints, scheduledToday, lastWorkout }) {
  if (scheduledToday) return { focus: scheduledToday.title || scheduledToday.focus || 'Scheduled workout', reason: 'Pulled from your training schedule.', scheduled: true };
  const ready = MUSCLE_GROUPS.filter((m) => muscleRecovery[m]?.status === 'ready');
  const readyWeak = ready.filter((m) => weakPoints.includes(m));
  if (readyWeak.length) return { focus: `${readyWeak[0]} Focus`, reason: `${readyWeak[0]} is recovered and a current weak point — ideal time to bring it up.` };
  if (ready.length) return { focus: `${ready[0]} Focus`, reason: `${ready[0]} is fully recovered and ready to train.` };
  const needs = MUSCLE_GROUPS.filter((m) => muscleRecovery[m]?.status === 'needs');
  if (needs.length >= 6) return { focus: 'Rest Day', reason: 'Most muscle groups are still recovering. A rest day protects your progress.' };
  return { focus: 'Light Recovery', reason: 'No muscle is fully recovered yet — light technique work is fine.' };
}

// Data-driven insight generation. Returns up to `limit` insights.
export function generateInsights({ muscleRecovery, nutritionTrends, weakPoints, plateaus, goal, weights, weeklyRate }) {
  const out = [];
  const neglected = MUSCLE_GROUPS.filter((m) => (muscleRecovery[m]?.hoursSince != null && muscleRecovery[m].hoursSince > 7 * 24) || muscleRecovery[m]?.status === 'unknown');
  if (neglected.length) out.push({ icon: 'alert', title: `${neglected[0]} not trained this week`, body: `You haven't trained ${neglected[0]} in over 7 days. Consider scheduling a session this week.`, severity: 'warn' });

  if (nutritionTrends.proteinAdherence != null && nutritionTrends.proteinAdherence < 0.7 && nutritionTrends.daysLogged >= 3) {
    out.push({ icon: 'flame', title: 'Protein below target', body: `You hit your protein target on ${nutritionTrends.proteinDaysHit} of ${nutritionTrends.daysLogged} recent days. Aim for ${Math.round(goal?.protein_target_g || 0)}g daily.`, severity: 'warn' });
  }

  if (weakPoints.length) out.push({ icon: 'target', title: `Weak point: ${weakPoints[0]}`, body: `${weakPoints[0]} volume is well below your most-trained muscle. Add a set or session this week.`, severity: 'info' });

  if (plateaus.length) out.push({ icon: 'trending', title: `${plateaus[0].exercise} plateau`, body: `Estimated 1RM has been flat for ~${plateaus[0].weeks} weeks. Consider a deload or a rep-range change.`, severity: 'info' });

  if (goal && weeklyRate != null && weights.length >= 7) {
    if (goal.primary_goal === 'Fat Loss' && weeklyRate >= 0) out.push({ icon: 'scale', title: 'Weight not dropping', body: 'Average weight is stable while cutting. KAI suggests a small calorie review.', severity: 'warn' });
    if ((goal.primary_goal === 'Muscle Gain' || goal.primary_goal === 'Strength Gain') && weeklyRate <= 0) out.push({ icon: 'scale', title: 'Weight not rising', body: 'Weight is flat during a gaining phase. Consider +150–200 kcal/day.', severity: 'warn' });
  }

  return out.slice(0, 4);
}

// Readiness from raw check-in inputs (sleep, soreness, energy, stress, mood).
export function computeReadinessFromInputs(i) {
  const sleepScore = Math.min(100, ((i.sleep_hours || 0) / 8) * 100);
  const sorenessScore = 100 - (i.soreness_level || 0) * 10;
  const energyScore = (i.energy || 5) * 10;
  const stressScore = 100 - (i.stress_level || 0) * 10;
  const moodScore = (i.mood || 5) * 10;
  const score = sleepScore * 0.3 + sorenessScore * 0.2 + energyScore * 0.2 + stressScore * 0.15 + moodScore * 0.15;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(score)));
}

// Deload recommendation from volume trend + recovery signals. Deterministic.
export function detectDeload({ weeklyVolumes, recovery }) {
  const reasons = [];
  let severity = 'none';
  const vols = (weeklyVolumes || []).slice(-4).map((w) => w.volume || 0);
  if (vols.length >= 4 && vols.every((v, i) => i === 0 || v >= vols[i - 1] * 0.97)) {
    reasons.push('Training volume has climbed for 4+ straight weeks — a deload reduces accumulated fatigue.');
    severity = 'recommended';
  }
  if (recovery?.readiness_score != null && recovery.readiness_score < 40) {
    reasons.push('Readiness is low — your body may benefit from lighter loading.');
    if (severity === 'none') severity = 'recommended';
  }
  if (recovery?.soreness_level >= 8) {
    reasons.push('Soreness is very high — a lighter week supports recovery.');
    if (severity === 'none') severity = 'suggested';
  }
  if (recovery?.sleep_quality != null && recovery.sleep_quality <= 3 && recovery?.sleep_hours < 6) {
    reasons.push('Sleep has been poor — recovery is compromised.');
    if (severity === 'none') severity = 'suggested';
  }
  return { recommended: reasons.length > 0, reasons, severity };
}

// Per-muscle volume landmarks (MEV/MAV/MRV) in weekly sets. Heuristic ranges.
export function volumeLandmarks(weeklyVolumeByMuscle) {
  const ranges = {
    'Chest': { mev: 6, mav: 14, mrv: 20 }, 'Back': { mev: 8, mav: 16, mrv: 22 }, 'Shoulders': { mev: 6, mav: 12, mrv: 16 },
    'Biceps': { mev: 4, mav: 8, mrv: 12 }, 'Triceps': { mev: 4, mav: 8, mrv: 12 }, 'Quads': { mev: 6, mav: 14, mrv: 20 },
    'Hamstrings': { mev: 4, mav: 8, mrv: 12 }, 'Glutes': { mev: 4, mav: 10, mrv: 16 }, 'Calves': { mev: 4, mav: 8, mrv: 12 }, 'Core': { mev: 4, mav: 8, mrv: 12 },
  };
  const out = {};
  for (const m of MUSCLE_GROUPS) {
    const r = ranges[m] || { mev: 6, mav: 12, mrv: 18 };
    const sets = weeklyVolumeByMuscle[m]?.sets || 0;
    let status = 'Undertrained';
    if (sets >= r.mrv) status = 'Overreaching';
    else if (sets >= r.mav) status = 'Optimal';
    else if (sets >= r.mev) status = 'Maintenance';
    out[m] = { ...r, sets, status };
  }
  return out;
}

// Push / pull classifier from exercise name keywords.
const PUSH_KW = ['bench', 'press', 'push', 'dip', 'fly', 'crossover', 'extension', 'pushdown', 'skull', 'lateral', 'raise', 'shrug', 'squat', 'lunge', 'leg press', 'leg extension', 'calf'];
const PULL_KW = ['row', 'pull', 'pulldown', 'chin', 'curl', 'deadlift', 'face pull', 'leg curl', 'hamstring', 'good morning', 'hip thrust'];
export function forceTypeForExercise(name) {
  if (!name) return null;
  const n = name.toLowerCase();
  if (PULL_KW.some((k) => n.includes(k))) return 'Pull';
  if (PUSH_KW.some((k) => n.includes(k))) return 'Push';
  return null;
}

// Training distribution across paired muscle groups. Deterministic volume balance.
export function computeTrainingDistribution(sessions, sets, days = 30) {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86400000;
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const vol = (test) => {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    for (const set of sets) {
      const t = dates[set.session_id];
      if (!t || t < cutoff) continue;
      if (!test(set)) continue;
      v += (set.weight_kg || 0) * (set.reps || 0);
      s += 1;
    }
    return { volume: Math.round(v), sets: s };
  };
  const group = (g) => vol((set) => muscleGroupForExercise(set.exercise_name) === g);
  const push = vol((set) => forceTypeForExercise(set.exercise_name) === 'Push');
  const pull = vol((set) => forceTypeForExercise(set.exercise_name) === 'Pull');
  const chest = group('Chest'); const back = group('Back');
  const quads = group('Quads'); const hams = group('Hamstrings');
  const biceps = group('Biceps'); const triceps = group('Triceps');
  const upperGroups = ['Chest', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Biceps', 'Triceps'];
  const lowerGroups = ['Quads', 'Hamstrings', 'Glutes', 'Calves'];
  const upper = vol((set) => upperGroups.includes(muscleGroupForExercise(set.exercise_name)));
  const lower = vol((set) => lowerGroups.includes(muscleGroupForExercise(set.exercise_name)));
  const frontDelt = vol((set) => { const n = (set.exercise_name || '').toLowerCase(); return n.includes('overhead') || n.includes('shoulder press') || n.includes('military') || n.includes('arnold') || n.includes('push press'); });
  const rearDelt = vol((set) => { const n = (set.exercise_name || '').toLowerCase(); return n.includes('face pull') || n.includes('rear delt') || n.includes('reverse fly') || n.includes('reverse pec'); });
  const pairs = [
    { name: 'Push / Pull', a: push, b: pull },
    { name: 'Chest / Back', a: chest, b: back },
    { name: 'Quads / Hamstrings', a: quads, b: hams },
    { name: 'Biceps / Triceps', a: biceps, b: triceps },
    { name: 'Upper / Lower', a: upper, b: lower },
    { name: 'Front / Rear Delts', a: frontDelt, b: rearDelt },
  ];
  const result = pairs.map((p) => {
    const total = p.a.volume + p.b.volume;
    const minor = Math.min(p.a.volume, p.b.volume);
    const major = Math.max(p.a.volume, p.b.volume);
    let balance = 'No data';
    if (total > 0) {
      const r = major ? minor / major : 0;
      balance = r >= 0.8 ? 'Balanced' : r >= 0.6 ? 'Slightly Imbalanced' : 'Imbalanced';
    }
    const ratio = total ? `${Math.round((p.a.volume / total) * 100)} / ${Math.round((p.b.volume / total) * 100)}` : '—';
    return { name: p.name, a: p.a, b: p.b, total, ratio, balance };
  });
  return { pairs: result, days };
}

// Post-workout Session Quality 0-100 — only measurable completion, sets, reps, RPE/RIR, volume.
export function computeSessionQuality({ blocks, totalVolume, completedSets, totalSets }) {
  const entered = totalSets || blocks.reduce((a, b) => a + b.sets.length, 0);
  const done = completedSets || blocks.reduce((a, b) => a + b.sets.filter((s) => s.completed).length, 0);
  const completion = entered ? Math.round((done / entered) * 100) : 0;
  let rpeLogged = 0;
  blocks.forEach((b) => b.sets.forEach((s) => { if (s.completed && (s.rpe || s.rir)) rpeLogged++; }));
  const rpeRatio = done ? Math.round((rpeLogged / done) * 100) : 0;
  const density = Math.min(100, Math.round((done / 6) * 100));
  const volScore = totalVolume > 0 ? 100 : 0;
  const score = Math.round(completion * 0.5 + rpeRatio * 0.2 + density * 0.2 + volScore * 0.1);
  const grade = score >= 85 ? 'Excellent' : score >= 70 ? 'Good' : score >= 55 ? 'Fair' : 'Needs Work';
  const breakdown = [
    { label: 'Set completion', value: `${completion}%`, weight: '50%', detail: `${done} of ${entered} entered sets completed` },
    { label: 'RPE/RIR logging', value: `${rpeRatio}%`, weight: '20%', detail: `${rpeLogged} of ${done} completed sets logged an RPE/RIR` },
    { label: 'Working-set density', value: `${density}%`, weight: '20%', detail: `${done} completed sets (target ~6+ for a full session)` },
    { label: 'Volume recorded', value: totalVolume > 0 ? 'Yes' : 'No', weight: '10%', detail: `${Math.round(totalVolume)} kg total volume` },
  ];
  return { score, grade, breakdown };
}

// Weekly strength volume (weight × reps) for the last numWeeks weeks (Mon start).
export function computeWeeklyVolume(sessions, sets, numWeeks = 8) {
  const day = 86400000;
  const getWeekStart = (d) => { const x = new Date(d); x.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); x.setDate(x.getDate() - ((x.getDay() + 6) % 7)); return x.getTime(); };
  const thisWeekStart = getWeekStart(new Date());
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const weeks = [];
  for (let i = numWeeks - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const start = thisWeekStart - i * 7 * day; weeks.push({ weekStart: start, volume: 0, sets: 0 }); }
  const byStart = Object.fromEntries(weeks.map((w) => [w.weekStart, w]));
  sets.forEach((s) => {
    const t = dates[s.session_id]; if (!t) return;
    const ws = getWeekStart(t); const w = byStart[ws]; if (!w) return;
    w.volume += (s.weight_kg || 0) * (s.reps || 0); w.sets += 1;
  });
  return weeks;
}

// Deterministic progression suggestion from a lifter's last completed sets for an exercise.
export function suggestProgression(lastSets, method = 'double', config = {}) {
  if (!lastSets || !lastSets.length) return null;
  const top = lastSets.reduce((a, s) => (estimate1RM(s.weight_kg, s.reps) || 0) > (estimate1RM(a.weight_kg, a.reps) || 0) ? s : a, lastSets[0]);
  const weight = top.weight_kg || 0;
  const reps = top.reps || 0;
  const inc = config.incrementKg || 2.5;
  const repLow = config.repLow || 8;
  const repHigh = config.repHigh || 12;
  switch (method) {
    case 'fixed':
      if (reps >= repHigh) return { method, action: 'increase-weight', newWeight: +(weight + inc).toFixed(1), newReps: repLow, reason: `Top set hit ${reps} reps (upper target ${repHigh}) — add ${inc} kg next session.` };
      return { method, action: 'add-reps', newWeight: weight, newReps: reps + 1, reason: `Top set ${reps} reps is below upper target ${repHigh} — add 1 rep next session.` };
    case 'percentage':
      if (reps >= repHigh) { const nw = +(weight * 1.025).toFixed(1); return { method, action: 'increase-weight', newWeight: nw, newReps: repLow, reason: `Top set hit ${repHigh} reps — +2.5% → ${nw} kg next session.` }; }
      return { method, action: 'add-reps', newWeight: weight, newReps: reps + 1, reason: `Below upper target — add 1 rep next session.` };
    case 'reps':
      return { method, action: 'add-reps', newWeight: weight, newReps: reps + 1, reason: `Rep-focused progression: add 1 rep at ${weight} kg.` };
    case 'rir':
      return { method, action: 'reduce-rir', newWeight: weight, newReps: reps, newRir: Math.max(0, (config.rirTarget || 2) - 1), reason: `Reduce target RIR by 1 next session to push closer to failure.` };
    case 'double':
    default:
      if (reps >= repHigh) return { method, action: 'increase-weight', newWeight: +(weight + inc).toFixed(1), newReps: repLow, reason: `Double progression: top set reached ${reps} reps (upper target ${repHigh}) — increase weight ${inc} kg and drop reps to ${repLow}.` };
      return { method, action: 'add-reps', newWeight: weight, newReps: reps + 1, reason: `Double progression: ${reps} reps below upper target ${repHigh} — add 1 rep before increasing weight.` };
  }
}

// Next-time progression suggestions per exercise from the most recent completed session.
export function computeProgressionSuggestions(sessions, sets, limit = 6) {
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const completed = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && dates[s.id]).sort((a, b) => dates[b.id] - dates[a.id]);
  if (!completed.length) return [];
  const last = completed[0];
  const byEx = {};
  sets.filter((s) => s.session_id === last.id && s.exercise_name).forEach((s) => { (byEx[s.exercise_name] ||= []).push(s); });
  const out = [];
  Object.entries(byEx).forEach(([ex, exSets]) => {
    const sug = suggestProgression(exSets, 'double', {});
    if (sug) out.push({ exercise: ex, lastWeight: exSets[0].weight_kg, lastReps: exSets[0].reps, ...sug });
  });
  return out.slice(0, limit);
}

// Rep-range distribution over the last `days` days. Buckets: 1-5, 6-8, 9-12, 13-20, 21+.
export function computeRepRangeDistribution(sets, sessions, days = 90) {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86400000;
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const buckets = { '1-5': 0, '6-8': 0, '9-12': 0, '13-20': 0, '21+': 0 };
  let total = 0;
  sets.forEach((s) => {
    const t = dates[s.session_id]; if (!t || t < cutoff) return;
    const r = s.reps; if (!r) return;
    const b = r <= 5 ? '1-5' : r <= 8 ? '6-8' : r <= 12 ? '9-12' : r <= 20 ? '13-20' : '21+';
    buckets[b]++; total++;
  });
  return { buckets, total };
}

// Muscle training frequency: sessions per muscle averaged over N weeks.
export function computeMuscleFrequency(sessions, sets, weeks) {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - weeks * 7 * 86400000;
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const counts = {};
  MUSCLE_GROUPS.forEach((m) => (counts[m] = 0));
  const seen = new Set();
  sets.forEach((s) => {
    const t = dates[s.session_id]; if (!t || t < cutoff) return;
    const m = muscleGroupForExercise(s.exercise_name); if (!m) return;
    const key = s.session_id + '|' + m; if (seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key); counts[m]++;
  });
  const out = {};
  MUSCLE_GROUPS.forEach((m) => { out[m] = { sessions: counts[m], perWeek: +(counts[m] / weeks).toFixed(1) }; });
  return out;
}

// Goal status from weight trend vs goal direction. Deterministic thresholds.
export function computeGoalStatus(goal, weights) {
  if (!goal) return null;
  const w = (weights || []).filter((x) => x != null && isFinite(x));
  if (w.length < 2) return { status: 'Needs Attention', label: 'Not enough data', detail: 'Log more weigh-ins to assess progress.' };
  const recent = w.slice(-7), prior = w.slice(-14, -7);
  if (!prior.length) return { status: 'On Track', label: 'Tracking started', detail: 'Keep logging to measure your trend.' };
  const rAvg = recent.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / recent.length;
  const pAvg = prior.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / prior.length;
  const weeklyRate = +(rAvg - pAvg).toFixed(2);
  const target = goal.target_weight_kg;
  const start = goal.starting_weight_kg || weights[0];
  const goalDir = target && start ? (target > start ? 1 : -1) : (goal.primary_goal === 'Fat Loss' ? -1 : 1);
  const actualDir = Math.sign(weeklyRate) || 0;
  let status, label, detail;
  if (actualDir === goalDir && Math.abs(weeklyRate) >= 0.5) { status = 'Ahead'; label = `${weeklyRate > 0 ? '+' : ''}${weeklyRate} kg/week`; detail = 'Progressing faster than the moderate target rate.'; }
  else if (actualDir === goalDir && Math.abs(weeklyRate) >= 0.2) { status = 'On Track'; label = `${weeklyRate > 0 ? '+' : ''}${weeklyRate} kg/week`; detail = 'Moving in the right direction at a healthy rate.'; }
  else if (Math.abs(weeklyRate) < 0.2) { status = 'Slightly Behind'; label = 'Stalling'; detail = 'Weight trend is flat — review nutrition or training.'; }
  else { status = 'Needs Attention'; label = 'Wrong direction'; detail = 'Trend is moving against your goal — adjust calories or activity.'; }
  return { status, label, detail, weeklyRate };
}

// Unified Personal Best timeline across strength, cardio, and weight.
export function computePersonalBestTimeline(sessions, sets, measurements, cardioSessions) {
  const events = [];
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const maxByEx = {};
  sets.forEach((s) => {
    const t = dates[s.session_id]; if (!t || !s.exercise_name) return;
    const w = s.weight_kg || 0;
    if (w > (maxByEx[s.exercise_name] || 0)) { maxByEx[s.exercise_name] = w; events.push({ type: 'strength', date: new Date(t).toISOString(), label: s.exercise_name, value: `${w} kg`, sort: t }); }
  });
  (cardioSessions || []).forEach((s) => { if (s.distance_km > 0) events.push({ type: 'cardio', date: s.date, label: s.activity_label || 'Cardio', value: `${s.distance_km} km`, sort: new Date(s.date).getTime() }); });
  (measurements || []).forEach((m) => { if (m.weight_kg) events.push({ type: 'weight', date: m.date, label: 'Weigh-in', value: `${m.weight_kg} kg`, sort: new Date(m.date).getTime() }); });
  return events.sort((a, b) => b.sort - a.sort).slice(0, 50);
}

// Recovery history aggregation over a range (7d / 30d / 3m / 6m). Deterministic averages.
export function computeRecoveryHistory(records, range) {
  const days = { '7d': 7, '30d': 30, '3m': 90, '6m': 182 }[range] || 30;
  const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86400000;
  const inRange = (records || []).filter((r) => r.date && new Date(r.date).getTime() >= cutoff);
  if (!inRange.length) return { count: 0, avgSleep: null, avgReadiness: null, avgRestingHr: null, avgSoreness: null };
  const avg = (arr) => { const v = arr.filter(Boolean); return v.length ? +(v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length).toFixed(1) : null; };
  return {
    count: inRange.length,
    avgSleep: avg(inRange.map((r) => r.sleep_hours)),
    avgReadiness: avg(inRange.map((r) => r.readiness_score)),
    avgRestingHr: avg(inRange.map((r) => r.resting_hr)),
    avgSoreness: avg(inRange.map((r) => r.soreness_level)),
  };
}

// Current vs previous comparable completed session. Deterministic deltas.
export function compareLastSessions(sessions, sets) {
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const completed = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && dates[s.id]).sort((a, b) => dates[b.id] - dates[a.id]);
  if (completed.length < 2) return null;
  const prev = completed[1], curr = completed[0];
  const setsOf = (sid) => sets.filter((s) => s.session_id === sid);
  const vol = (sid) => setsOf(sid).reduce((a, s) => a + (s.weight_kg || 0) * (s.reps || 0), 0);
  const topE = (sid) => setsOf(sid).reduce((a, s) => Math.max(a, estimate1RM(s.weight_kg, s.reps) || 0), 0);
  const cv = vol(curr.id), pv = vol(prev.id);
  return {
    curr: { name: curr.name, date: curr.date, volume: Math.round(cv), sets: setsOf(curr.id).length, topE1RM: Math.round(topE(curr.id)) },
    prev: { name: prev.name, date: prev.date, volume: Math.round(pv), sets: setsOf(prev.id).length, topE1RM: Math.round(topE(prev.id)) },
    volumeDelta: Math.round(cv - pv),
    setsDelta: setsOf(curr.id).length - setsOf(prev.id).length,
    e1rmDelta: Math.round(topE(curr.id) - topE(prev.id)),
  };
}

// Equipment-based substitutions: exercises matching the same movement pattern + primary muscle,
// optionally filtered to those whose equipment is available in the user's profile.
export function findSubstitutions(exercise, allExercises, equipmentProfile) {
  if (!exercise || !allExercises) return [];
  const same = allExercises.filter((e) => e.id !== exercise.id && e.movement_pattern === exercise.movement_pattern && e.primary_muscle === exercise.primary_muscle);
  let pool = same;
  if (equipmentProfile && equipmentProfile.length) {
    const matches = same.filter((e) => !e.equipment?.length || e.equipment.some((eq) => equipmentProfile.includes(eq)));
    pool = matches.length ? matches : same;
  }
  return pool.slice(0, 6);
}

// Historical progressive-overload metric per exercise: compares the average
// top-set e1RM of the recent `recentN` sessions vs the prior `priorN` sessions.
// Returns [] when there isn't enough data. Deterministic from logged sets.
export function computeProgressiveOverload(sessions, sets, { recentN = 4, priorN = 4 } = {}) {
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const byEx = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    if (!s || !s.exercise_name || s.set_type === 'warmup') continue;
    const t = dates[s.session_id];
    if (!t) continue;
    const w = Number(s.weight_kg), r = Number(s.reps);
    if (!isFinite(w) || !isFinite(r) || w <= 0 || r < 1) continue;
    const e1rm = estimate1RM(w, r);
    if (!e1rm) continue;
    (byEx[s.exercise_name] ||= []).push({ t, e1rm });
  }
  const out = [];
  for (const [ex, arr] of Object.entries(byEx)) {
    const perSession = {};
    arr.forEach((p) => { perSession[p.t] = Math.max(perSession[p.t] || 0, p.e1rm); });
    const vals = Object.keys(perSession).sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b)).map((k) => perSession[k]);
    if (vals.length < recentN + priorN) continue;
    const recent = vals.slice(-recentN);
    const prior = vals.slice(-(recentN + priorN), -recentN);
    const recentAvg = recent.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / recent.length;
    const priorAvg = prior.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / prior.length;
    const delta = +(recentAvg - priorAvg).toFixed(1);
    const pct = priorAvg ? +((delta / priorAvg) * 100).toFixed(1) : null;
    out.push({ exercise: ex, recentAvg: +recentAvg.toFixed(1), priorAvg: +priorAvg.toFixed(1), delta, pct, sessions: vals.length });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => (b.pct || 0) - (a.pct || 0));
}

// Per-exercise trend series (best e1RM + total volume by session date) for charting.
export function computeExerciseTrends(sessions, sets, exerciseName) {
  if (!exerciseName) return [];
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const rows = [];
  for (const s of sets) {
    if (!s || s.exercise_name !== exerciseName || s.set_type === 'warmup') continue;
    const t = dates[s.session_id];
    if (!t) continue;
    const w = Number(s.weight_kg), r = Number(s.reps);
    if (!isFinite(w) || !isFinite(r) || w <= 0 || r < 1) continue;
    rows.push({ t, e1rm: estimate1RM(w, r) || 0, volume: w * r });
  }
  rows.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
  const bySession = {};
  rows.forEach((row) => {
    if (!bySession[row.t]) bySession[row.t] = { date: new Date(row.t).toISOString(), e1rm: 0, volume: 0 };
    bySession[row.t].e1rm = Math.max(bySession[row.t].e1rm, row.e1rm);
    bySession[row.t].volume += row.volume;
  });
  return Object.values(bySession);
}

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';

const TABLES = [
  ['BodyMeasurement', 'body_measurements', 'body measurements'], ['WorkoutSession', 'workout_sessions', 'workouts'],
  ['WorkoutSet', 'workout_sets', 'workout sets'], ['NutritionLog', 'nutrition_logs', 'nutrition logs'],
  ['CardioSession', 'cardio_sessions', 'cardio sessions'], ['Goal', 'goals', 'goals'],
  ['TrainingProgram', 'training_programs', 'training programs'], ['ScheduledWorkout', 'scheduled_workouts', 'scheduled workouts'],
  ['RecoveryRecord', 'recovery_records', 'recovery records'], ['Achievement', 'achievements', 'achievements'],
  ['ProgressPhoto', 'progress_photos', 'photo details'], ['FoodItem', 'food_items', 'custom foods'],
  ['SavedMeal', 'saved_meals', 'saved meals'], ['Habit', 'habits', 'habits'], ['HabitLog', 'habit_logs', 'habit history'],
  ['Favorite', 'favorites', 'favorites'], ['CoachMessage', 'coaching_history', 'coaching history'], ['Exercise', 'custom_exercises', 'custom exercises'],
];
const PROFILE_FIELDS = ['id', 'email', 'full_name', 'username', 'age', 'sex', 'height_cm', 'weight_kg', 'goal_weight_kg', 'preferred_units', 'activity_level', 'primary_goal', 'experience_level', 'days_per_week', 'preferred_split', 'gym_or_home', 'equipment', 'session_duration_minutes', 'dietary_preference', 'allergies', 'injury_history', 'medical_notes', 'onboarding_completed', 'theme_preference', 'notification_preferences', 'accent_color', 'oled_mode', 'profile_private', 'push_enabled'];
const csvCell = (value) => {
  let text = value == null ? '' : typeof value === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value);
  if (typeof value === 'string' && /^[\s]*[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(text)) text = `'${text}`;
  return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
};

export async function downloadPersonalData(user, format, onProgress) {
  if (!user?.id) throw new Error('Please sign in before downloading your data.');
  const currentUser = await base44.auth.me();
  if (currentUser.id !== user.id) throw new Error('Your account changed. Please reopen Settings and try again.');
  const payload = { exported_at: new Date().toISOString(), app: 'LRAZ 63 Performance OS', profile: Object.fromEntries(PROFILE_FIELDS.filter((key) => currentUser[key] !== undefined).map((key) => [key, currentUser[key]])) };
  for (const [entity, key, label] of TABLES) {
    const records = []; let cursor;
    do {
      onProgress(`Preparing ${label}… ${records.length} records`);
      const page = await base44.entities[entity].filter({ created_by_id: user.id }, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 200, cursor });
      records.push(...page.items.map((record) => entity === 'ProgressPhoto' ? { ...record, photo_url: '[private photo omitted]' } : record));
      cursor = page.has_more ? page.next_cursor : undefined;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
    } while (cursor);
    payload[key] = records;
  }
  onProgress('Preparing your download…');
  const csv = format === 'csv' ? '\uFEFF' + [['profile', [payload.profile]], ...TABLES.map(([, key]) => [key, payload[key]])].map(([key, rows]) => {
    const columns = [...new Set(rows.flatMap((row) => Object.keys(row)))];
    return `# ${key}\r\n${columns.map(csvCell).join(',')}\r\n${rows.map((row) => columns.map((column) => csvCell(row[column])).join(',')).join('\r\n')}`;
  }).join('\r\n\r\n') : null;
  const blob = new Blob([csv ?? JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: format === 'csv' ? 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' : 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = url; link.download = `lraz63-my-data-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.${format}`;
  document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); link.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60000);
}

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { calcBMR, calcTDEE, calcCalorieTarget, calcMacros } from './fitnessScience';

// Recompute nutrition targets from the user's current stats + goal.
export function recalcGoalTargets(user, goal) {
  if (!user || !goal) return null;
  const weightKg = user.weight_kg;
  if (!weightKg || !user.height_cm || !user.age) return null;
  const bmr = calcBMR({ weightKg, heightCm: user.height_cm, age: user.age, sex: user.sex });
  if (!bmr) return null;
  const tdee = calcTDEE(bmr, user.activity_level || 'moderate');
  const calorieTarget = calcCalorieTarget(tdee, goal.primary_goal, goal.rate_preference);
  const macros = calcMacros({ weightKg, calorieTarget, goal: goal.primary_goal });
  if (!calorieTarget || !macros) return null;
  return {
    calorie_target: calorieTarget,
    protein_target_g: macros.proteinG,
    carb_target_g: macros.carbG,
    fat_target_g: macros.fatG,
    fiber_target_g: macros.fiberG,
    water_target_ml: macros.waterMl,
  };
}

// After a new body measurement, sync the user's weight and auto-recalc goal targets.
// Loads the active goal if not provided so callers only need the measurement + user.
export async function syncProfileFromMeasurement(measurement, user, goal) {
  if (!measurement?.weight_kg) return null;
  if (user) {
    try { await base44.auth.updateMe({ weight_kg: measurement.weight_kg }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  }
  let activeGoal = goal;
  if (!activeGoal) {
    try {
      const goals = await base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1);
      activeGoal = goals[0];
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  }
  if (!activeGoal || !user) return null;
  const newTargets = recalcGoalTargets({ ...user, weight_kg: measurement.weight_kg }, activeGoal);
  if (!newTargets) return null;
  try { await base44.entities.Goal.update(activeGoal.id, newTargets); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  return newTargets;
}

// Deterministic program templates — zero AI / zero credits.
// Builds a real, periodized-style program from fixed templates scaled by experience.

const clone = (d) => ({ ...d, exercises: d.exercises.map((e) => ({ ...e })) });

function scaleDay(day, level, idx) {
  const d = clone(day);
  d.exercises.forEach((e) => {
    if (level === 'Beginner') { e.sets = Math.max(2, e.sets - 1); e.rir_target = Math.min(3, (e.rir_target || 2) + 1); e.rest_seconds = (e.rest_seconds || 90) + 15; }
    else if (level === 'Advanced') { e.sets = e.sets + 1; e.rir_target = Math.max(0, (e.rir_target || 2) - 1); }
  });
  return d;
}

const GOAL_MAP = { 'Strength Gain': 'Strength', 'Fat Loss': 'Fat Loss', 'Muscle Gain': 'Muscle Gain', 'Body Recomposition': 'Body Recomposition', 'Athletic Performance': 'Athletic Performance', 'Endurance': 'Endurance', 'General Fitness': 'General Fitness', 'Maintenance': 'Maintenance' };

export function generateProgram({ user, goal, preferences }) {
  const prefs = preferences || {};
  const split = prefs.split || 'Upper Lower';
  const daysPerWeek = prefs.days_per_week || 4;
  const level = user?.experience_level || 'Intermediate';
  const template = DAY_TEMPLATES[split] || DAY_TEMPLATES['Upper Lower'];
  const days = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < daysPerWeek; i++) days.push(scaleDay(template[i % template.length], level, i));

  return {
    name: `${split} ${level} Block`,
    description: `A deterministic ${split.toLowerCase()} program built from fixed templates, scaled for a ${level.toLowerCase()} trainee. No AI — fully editable.`,
    goal: (goal && GOAL_MAP[goal.primary_goal]) || 'Hypertrophy',
    split,
    days_per_week: daysPerWeek,
    session_duration_minutes: prefs.session_duration_minutes || 60,
    experience_level: level,
    duration_weeks: prefs.duration_weeks || 8,
    phase: goal?.phase || 'Hypertrophy',
    days,
    is_ai_generated: false,
  };
}

// Deterministic text parser for the "Import Text" flow.
// Parses lines like "Bench Press 4x6-8" into a program. Day headers are short lines
// ending with ":" or containing no digits.
export function parseProgramText(text) {
  const lines = (text || '').split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const days = [];
  let current = null;
  const exRe = /(.+?)\s+(\d+)\s*[x×]\s*(\d+)(?:\s*[-–]\s*(\d+))?/i;
  lines.forEach((line) => {
    const isHeader = (line.endsWith(':') && !/\d\s*[x×]/.test(line)) || /^(day|upper|lower|push|pull|legs|chest|back|shoulders?|arms?|full body)/i.test(line) && !exRe.test(line);
    if (isHeader) {
      current = { day_name: line.replace(/:$/, '').trim(), focus: '', exercises: [] };
      days.push(current);
      return;
    }
    const m = line.match(exRe);
    if (!m) return;
    if (!current) { current = { day_name: 'Day 1', focus: '', exercises: [] }; days.push(current); }
    current.exercises.push({
      exercise_name: m[1].trim(),
      sets: parseInt(m[2], 10) || 3,
      reps_low: parseInt(m[3], 10) || 8,
      reps_high: m[4] ? parseInt(m[4], 10) : (parseInt(m[3], 10) || 12),
      rir_target: 2,
      rest_seconds: 90,
      notes: '',
    });
  });
  return { name: 'Imported Program', description: 'Imported from pasted text. Editable.', goal: 'Hypertrophy', split: 'Full Body', days_per_week: Math.max(1, days.length), session_duration_minutes: 60, experience_level: 'Intermediate', duration_weeks: 8, phase: 'Hypertrophy', days: days.length ? days : [{ day_name: 'Day 1', focus: '', exercises: [] }] };
}

------------------------------------------------------------
FILE: src/lib/progressEngine.js
------------------------------------------------------------
// Consolidated deterministic progress engine — upgrades the app's progress
// calculations with input validation, rolling/smoothed averages, equivalent-
// period comparisons, and explicit sufficient-data rules. No AI, no credits.
// Every value is reproducible from stored records with a clear formula; when
// there isn't enough data, callers get { sufficient: false, note: 'Not enough data yet' }.
import { smoothedAverage } from './fitnessScience';
import { sessionDateMap, computeBestLifts, computeProgressiveOverload } from './performanceAnalytics';
import { computeCardioProgress, detectCardioPRs, aggregateHistory, rangeCutoff } from './cardioAnalytics';

const DAY = 86400000;
const WEEK = 7 * DAY;
const NOT_ENOUGH = 'Not enough data yet';

// Strength progress over `days`: volume, top e1RM, PR count, weekly frequency,
// consistency, exercises trained, and progressive-overload leaders.
export function computeStrengthProgress(sessions, sets, days = 30) {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - days * DAY;
  const dates = sessionDateMap(sessions);
  const inRange = (sessions || []).filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && dates[s.id] && dates[s.id] >= cutoff);
  const setsInRange = (sets || []).filter((s) => dates[s.session_id] != null && dates[s.session_id] >= cutoff);
  if (!inRange.length) return { sufficient: false, note: NOT_ENOUGH };

  let totalVolume = 0;
  for (const s of setsInRange) {
    const w = Number(s.weight_kg), r = Number(s.reps);
    if (!isFinite(w) || !isFinite(r) || w < 0 || r < 0) continue; // ignore invalid
    totalVolume += w * r;
  }
  const validSets = setsInRange.filter((s) => {
    const w = Number(s.weight_kg), r = Number(s.reps);
    return isFinite(w) && isFinite(r) && w > 0 && r >= 1 && s.set_type !== 'warmup';
  });
  const bestLifts = computeBestLifts(validSets);
  const topE1RM = bestLifts[0]?.bestE1RM || 0;
  const prCount = setsInRange.filter((s) => s.is_pr).length + inRange.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.pr_count || 0), 0);
  const weeks = days / 7;
  const frequency = +(inRange.length / weeks).toFixed(1);
  // consistency: fraction of weeks that had at least one session
  const weekSet = new Set(inRange.map((s) => Math.floor((dates[s.id] - (Date.now() - days * DAY)) / WEEK)));
  const consistency = inRange.length ? Math.min(100, Math.round((weekSet.size / weeks) * 100)) : 0;
  const overload = computeProgressiveOverload(sessions, sets, { recentN: 4, priorN: 4 });
  return {
    sufficient: true,
    sessions: inRange.length,
    totalVolume: Math.round(totalVolume),
    topE1RM: Math.round(topE1RM),
    prCount,
    frequencyPerWeek: frequency,
    consistencyPct: consistency,
    exercisesTrained: bestLifts.length,
    progressiveOverload: overload.slice(0, 5),
    bestLifts: bestLifts.slice(0, 6),
  };
}

// Body progress: smoothed trend weight, start/current, equivalent-period
// comparison (recent half vs prior half), and weekly rate from the span.
export function computeBodyProgress(measurements, days = 90) {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - days * DAY;
  const pts = (measurements || [])
    .filter((m) => m.weight_kg && m.date && new Date(m.date).getTime() >= cutoff)
    .map((m) => ({ w: Number(m.weight_kg), t: new Date(m.date).getTime() }))
    .filter((p) => isFinite(p.w))
    .sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);
  if (pts.length < 2) return { sufficient: false, note: NOT_ENOUGH };
  const weights = pts.map((p) => p.w);
  const trend = smoothedAverage(weights, 7);
  const half = Math.floor(pts.length / 2);
  const recentW = pts.slice(half);
  const priorW = pts.slice(0, half);
  const recentAvg = recentW.reduce((a, p) => a + p.w, 0) / recentW.length;
  const priorAvg = priorW.length ? priorW.reduce((a, p) => a + p.w, 0) / priorW.length : null;
  const change = priorAvg != null ? +(recentAvg - priorAvg).toFixed(1) : null;
  const first = pts[0], last = pts[pts.length - 1];
  const spanWeeks = (last.t - first.t) / WEEK;
  return {
    sufficient: true,
    count: pts.length,
    trendWeight: trend,
    startWeight: first.w,
    currentWeight: last.w,
    recentAvg: +recentAvg.toFixed(1),
    priorAvg: priorAvg != null ? +priorAvg.toFixed(1) : null,
    change,
    weeklyRate: change != null && spanWeeks > 0 ? +((last.w - first.w) / spanWeeks).toFixed(2) : null,
  };
}

// Nutrition progress: calorie/macro averages and adherence from logged days.
export function computeNutritionProgress(logs, goal, days = 30) {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - days * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const byDate = {};
  for (const l of logs || []) {
    if (!l || !l.date || l.date < cutoff) continue;
    if (!byDate[l.date]) byDate[l.date] = { calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0, fiber: 0 };
    byDate[l.date].calories += Number.isFinite(l.calories) ? l.calories : 0;
    byDate[l.date].protein += Number.isFinite(l.protein_g) ? l.protein_g : 0;
    byDate[l.date].carbs += Number.isFinite(l.carbs_g) ? l.carbs_g : 0;
    byDate[l.date].fat += Number.isFinite(l.fat_g) ? l.fat_g : 0;
    byDate[l.date].fiber += Number.isFinite(l.fiber_g) ? l.fiber_g : 0;
  }
  const entries = Object.values(byDate);
  if (entries.length < 3) return { sufficient: false, note: NOT_ENOUGH, daysLogged: entries.length };
  const avg = (k) => Math.round(entries.reduce((a, e) => a + e[k], 0) / entries.length);
  const proTarget = goal?.protein_target_g || 0;
  const calTarget = goal?.calorie_target || 0;
  const proteinDaysHit = proTarget ? entries.filter((e) => e.protein >= proTarget * 0.9).length : 0;
  const calorieDaysHit = calTarget ? entries.filter((e) => e.calories >= calTarget * 0.85 && e.calories <= calTarget * 1.15).length : 0;
  return {
    sufficient: true,
    daysLogged: entries.length,
    avgCalories: avg('calories'),
    avgProtein: avg('protein'),
    avgCarbs: avg('carbs'),
    avgFat: avg('fat'),
    avgFiber: avg('fiber'),
    proteinAdherence: proTarget ? Math.round((proteinDaysHit / entries.length) * 100) : null,
    calorieAdherence: calTarget ? Math.round((calorieDaysHit / entries.length) * 100) : null,
  };
}

// Recovery progress: logging completion rate, current streak, and smoothed
// averages of sleep, readiness, soreness, and energy over the window.
export function computeRecoveryProgress(records, days = 30) {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - days * DAY;
  const inRange = (records || [])
    .filter((r) => r.date && new Date(r.date).getTime() >= cutoff)
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
  if (!inRange.length) return { sufficient: false, note: NOT_ENOUGH };
  const dayKeys = new Set(inRange.map((r) => new Date(r.date).toISOString().slice(0, 10)));
  const completionRate = Math.min(100, Math.round((dayKeys.size / days) * 100));
  const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  let streak = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
    const k = new Date(today.getTime() - i * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    if (dayKeys.has(k)) streak++;
    else if (i > 0) break; // allow today missing, break on a prior missing day
  }
  const avg = (k) => {
    const v = inRange.map((r) => Number(r[k])).filter((x) => isFinite(x));
    return v.length ? +(v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length).toFixed(1) : null;
  };
  return {
    sufficient: true,
    entries: inRange.length,
    daysLogged: dayKeys.size,
    completionRate,
    currentStreak: streak,
    avgSleep: avg('sleep_hours'),
    avgReadiness: avg('readiness_score'),
    avgSoreness: avg('soreness_level'),
    avgEnergy: avg('energy'),
  };
}

// Habit progress: per-habit completion count, completion rate, and current streak.
export function computeHabitProgress(habits, habitLogs, days = 30) {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - days * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const active = (habits || []).filter((h) => h.active);
  if (!active.length) return { sufficient: false, note: NOT_ENOUGH, habits: [] };
  const logsByHabit = {};
  (habitLogs || []).forEach((l) => {
    if (!l || !l.habit_id || !l.date || l.date < cutoff || !l.completed) return;
    (logsByHabit[l.habit_id] ||= new Set()).add(l.date);
  });
  const habitsOut = active.map((h) => {
    const doneSet = logsByHabit[h.id] || new Set();
    const doneCount = doneSet.size;
    const completionRate = Math.min(100, Math.round((doneCount / days) * 100));
    let streak = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
      const k = new Date(today.getTime() - i * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      if (doneSet.has(k)) streak++;
      else if (i > 0) break;
    }
    return { id: h.id, name: h.name, doneCount, completionRate, currentStreak: streak };
  });
  return { sufficient: true, habits: habitsOut };
}

// Re-export the cardio helpers so callers can import all progress calcs from one place.
export { computeCardioProgress, detectCardioPRs, aggregateHistory, rangeCutoff };

// Push notification helpers — deterministic, no AI.
// On native builds the platform handles device-token registration and the
// permission prompt automatically; on web we request the browser permission.
// Delivery is triggered through a backend function (service role) so a logged-in
// user can never push to another user directly. If backend functions are not
// available on the current plan, calls degrade silently — in-app notifications
// (AppNotification records) still work inside the app.
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';

export async function requestPushPermission() {
  try {
    if (typeof Notification !== 'undefined' && Notification.permission === 'default') {
      await Notification.requestPermission();
    }
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
}

export async function sendPush(user_id, title, content, action_url) {
  if (!user_id || !title || !content) return;
  try {
    await base44.functions.invoke('push-notify', { user_id, title, content, action_url });
  } catch (e) { /* backend functions may require Builder+; degrade silently */ }
}

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { queryClientInstance } from '@/lib/query-client';
import { recordsChanged } from '@/lib/fitnessInvalidation';
export { recordsChanged } from '@/lib/fitnessInvalidation';
import { computeReadinessFromInputs } from '@/lib/performanceAnalytics';
import { getActivity } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';
import { syncProfileFromMeasurement } from '@/lib/profileSync';

export async function syncLatestMeasurement(user) {
  if (!user) return false;
  const page = await base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.filter({ created_by_id: user.id, weight_kg: { $gt: 0 } }, { sort: '-date', limit: 1, fields: ['weight_kg', 'date'] });
  const latest = page.items[0];
  if (!latest || latest.weight_kg === user.weight_kg) return false;
  await syncProfileFromMeasurement(latest, user);
  return true;
}

export function fieldValue(record, field) {
  const value = record[field.key];
  if (value == null) return '';
  if (field.type !== 'datetime-local') return String(value);
  const date = new Date(value.length === 10 ? `${value}T12:00:00` : value);
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}T${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
export function recordPatch(record, fields, form) {
  const data = {}, unset = {};
  fields.forEach(field => {
    const value = form[field.key];
    if (value === fieldValue(record, field)) return;
    if (value === '' && !field.required) { unset[field.key] = ''; return; }
    data[field.key] = field.type === 'number' ? Number(value) : field.type === 'datetime-local' ? new Date(value).toISOString() : value;
  });
  return { data, unset };
}
export async function updateRecord(entity, record, patch) {
  const { data, unset } = patch;
  const next = { ...record, ...data };
  Object.keys(unset).forEach(key => delete next[key]);
  if (entity === 'RecoveryRecord') { data.readiness_score = computeReadinessFromInputs(next); data.recovery_score = data.readiness_score; }
  if (entity === 'BodyMeasurement' && ('weight_kg' in data || 'body_fat_percent' in data || 'weight_kg' in unset || 'body_fat_percent' in unset)) {
    if (next.weight_kg > 0 && next.body_fat_percent != null) {
      data.fat_mass_kg = +(next.weight_kg * next.body_fat_percent / 100).toFixed(2);
      data.lean_mass_kg = +(next.weight_kg - data.fat_mass_kg).toFixed(2);
    } else { unset.fat_mass_kg = ''; unset.lean_mass_kg = ''; }
    if (next.weight_kg > 0) data.weight_lbs = +(next.weight_kg * 2.2046226218).toFixed(2); else unset.weight_lbs = '';
  }
  if (entity === 'CardioSession') {
    if (data.activity) data.activity_label = getActivity(data.activity).label;
    data.avg_speed_kmh = next.duration_seconds > 0 && next.distance_km > 0 ? next.distance_km * 3600 / next.duration_seconds : 0;
    data.avg_pace_sec_per_km = next.distance_km > 0 ? next.duration_seconds / next.distance_km : 0;
  }
  if (Object.keys(data).length) await base44.entities[entity].update(record.id, data);
  if (Object.keys(unset).length) await base44.entities[entity].updateMany({ id: record.id }, { $unset: unset });
  recordsChanged(entity);
}
