// Deterministic reminder engine — no AI, no credits. Computes what the user
// "must do" from their own data and surfaces actionable notifications.
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { sendPush } from '@/lib/pushNotifications';

const TODAY = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const DAY = 86400000;

// Loads every dataset the reminder engine needs. Shared by the Notifications
// page and the live scheduler so both stay in sync.
export async function loadReminderData() {
  const [goals, sess, nut, sched, recs, meas, habits, habitLogs, cardio] = await Promise.all([
    base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
    base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 30),
    base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 100),
    base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.filter({ date: TODAY(), completed: false }, '-date', 1),
    base44.entities.RecoveryRecord.list('-date', 7),
    base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 30),
    base44.entities.Habit.filter({ active: true }, '-created_date', 50),
    base44.entities.HabitLog.list('-date', 100),
    base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 60),
  ]);
  return { goal: goals[0], sessions: sess, nutrition: nut, scheduled: sched[0], recovery: recs[0], measurements: meas, habits, habitLogs, cardio };
}

export function computeReminders(data) {
  const { goal, sessions, nutrition, scheduled, recovery, measurements, cardio, habits, habitLogs } = data || {};
  const out = [];
  const today = TODAY();
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  const todayNut = (nutrition || []).filter((n) => n.date === today);

  // 1. Scheduled workout today
  if (scheduled && !scheduled.completed) {
    out.push({ id: 'train-today', priority: 'high', icon: 'Dumbbell', title: scheduled.title || "Today's workout", body: scheduled.focus ? `${scheduled.focus} — your scheduled session is ready.` : 'Tap to start your scheduled session.', action: '/workout/new', cta: 'Start' });
  }

  // 2. No strength workout in 3 days (and nothing scheduled today)
  const lastSession = (sessions || []).find((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date);
  const daysSince = lastSession ? Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(lastSession.date).getTime()) / DAY) : null;
  if (!scheduled && (daysSince == null || daysSince >= 3)) {
    out.push({ id: 'train-soon', priority: 'high', icon: 'Dumbbell', title: daysSince == null ? 'Start training' : `${daysSince} days since last workout`, body: daysSince == null ? 'Log your first workout to begin tracking progress.' : 'A session keeps your momentum and recovery on track.', action: '/workout/new', cta: 'Train' });
  }

  // 3. Fuel: nothing logged today
  if (!todayNut.length) {
    out.push({ id: 'log-fuel', priority: 'high', icon: 'Apple', title: 'Log your fuel', body: 'No meals logged today. Stay on track with your calorie and protein targets.', action: '/nutrition', cta: 'Log Food' });
  } else if (goal && goal.calorie_target && hour >= 14) {
    const cal = todayNut.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.calories || 0), 0);
    if (cal < goal.calorie_target * 0.5) {
      out.push({ id: 'keep-fueling', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Apple', title: 'Keep fueling', body: `Only ${Math.round(cal)} of ${Math.round(goal.calorie_target)} kcal logged — add your remaining meals.`, action: '/nutrition', cta: 'Log Food' });
    }
  }

  // 4. Post-workout meal: completed a session today but no Post-Workout meal logged
  const sessionToday = (sessions || []).some((s) => s.status === 'completed' && (s.date || '').slice(0, 10) === today);
  const hasPostWorkoutMeal = todayNut.some((n) => n.meal === 'Post-Workout');
  if (sessionToday && !hasPostWorkoutMeal) {
    out.push({ id: 'post-workout-meal', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Apple', title: 'Log your post-workout meal', body: 'Refuel with protein and carbs within 1-2 hours of training to support recovery.', action: '/nutrition', cta: 'Log Food' });
  }

  // 5. Recovery check-in overdue (no recovery in 2 days)
  const lastRec = recovery && recovery.date ? new Date(recovery.date) : null;
  const recDays = lastRec ? Math.floor((Date.now() - lastRec.getTime()) / DAY) : null;
  if (recDays == null || recDays >= 2) {
    out.push({ id: 'recovery-checkin', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Heart', title: 'Recovery check-in', body: 'Log sleep, soreness and energy to sharpen your readiness score.', action: '/progress', cta: 'Check In' });
  }

  // 6. Sleep reminder: late evening and no recovery log today
  if (hour >= 22 && recDays == null) {
    out.push({ id: 'sleep-log', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Moon', title: 'Log your sleep', body: "Recording your sleep hours and quality sharpens tomorrow's readiness score.", action: '/progress', cta: 'Log Sleep' });
  }

  // 7. Weight: morning nudge, or overdue reminder
  const weighedToday = (measurements || []).some((m) => (m.date || '').slice(0, 10) === today && m.weight_kg);
  const lastMeas = (measurements || []).find((m) => m.weight_kg);
  const measDays = lastMeas && lastMeas.date ? Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(lastMeas.date).getTime()) / DAY) : null;
  if (!weighedToday && hour >= 6 && hour <= 11) {
    out.push({ id: 'morning-weigh', priority: 'low', icon: 'Scale', title: 'Morning weigh-in', body: 'Weigh yourself now for the most consistent reading.', action: '/progress', cta: 'Log Weight' });
  } else if (measDays == null || measDays >= 7) {
    out.push({ id: 'log-weight', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Scale', title: measDays == null ? 'Log your weight' : `${measDays} days since last weigh-in`, body: 'Regular weigh-ins keep your progress chart and goal journey accurate.', action: '/progress', cta: 'Log Weight' });
  }

  // 8. No cardio this week
  const weekCardio = (cardio || []).filter((c) => c.date && Date.now() - new Date(c.date).getTime() < 7 * DAY);
  if (!weekCardio.length) {
    out.push({ id: 'cardio-week', priority: 'low', icon: 'Activity', title: 'No cardio this week', body: 'A short session supports recovery and heart health.', action: '/cardio', cta: 'Start Cardio' });
  }

  // 9. Goal setup / target calculation
  if (!goal) {
    out.push({ id: 'setup-goal', priority: 'high', icon: 'Target', title: 'Set your goal', body: 'Define your target so the app can calculate calories, macros and training focus for you.', action: '/profile', cta: 'Set Goal' });
  } else if (!goal.calorie_target) {
    out.push({ id: 'calc-targets', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Brain', title: 'Calculate your targets', body: 'We can compute your daily calorie and macro targets from your goal and weight.', action: '/profile', cta: 'Calculate' });
  }

  // 10. Goal deadline approaching
  if (goal && goal.target_date) {
    const daysLeft = Math.floor((new Date(goal.target_date).getTime() - Date.now()) / DAY);
    if (daysLeft >= 0 && daysLeft <= 14) {
      out.push({ id: 'goal-deadline', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Target', title: `${daysLeft} days to your goal`, body: `Your target date is ${goal.target_date}. Stay consistent to finish strong.`, action: '/goal-journey', cta: 'View Journey' });
    }
  }

  // 11. Deload suggestion: high training frequency + high RPE
  const last7 = (sessions || []).filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date && Date.now() - new Date(s.date).getTime() < 7 * DAY);
  if (last7.length >= 5) {
    const avgRpe = last7.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.rpe_session || 0), 0) / last7.length;
    if (avgRpe >= 8) {
      out.push({ id: 'deload-week', priority: 'medium', icon: 'Activity', title: 'Consider a deload', body: `You trained ${last7.length}× this week at high intensity (avg RPE ${avgRpe.toFixed(1)}). A lighter week aids recovery.`, action: '/coach', cta: 'View Insights' });
    }
  }

  // 12. Monthly report available at the start of a new month
  const dom = new Date().getDate();
  if (dom === 1 || (dom === 2 && hour < 12)) {
    out.push({ id: 'monthly-report', priority: 'low', icon: 'BarChart3', title: 'Monthly report ready', body: 'Your full deterministic monthly summary is available to review.', action: '/report', cta: 'Open Report' });
  }

  // 13. Habits due today (urgent in the evening)
  const activeHabits = (habits || []).filter((h) => h.active);
  if (activeHabits.length) {
    const doneToday = (habitLogs || []).filter((l) => l.date === today && l.completed).map((l) => l.habit_id);
    const pending = activeHabits.filter((h) => !doneToday.includes(h.id));
    if (pending.length) {
      out.push({ id: 'habits-today', priority: hour >= 20 ? 'high' : 'low', icon: 'Droplet', title: `${pending.length} habit${pending.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} to complete`, body: pending.slice(0, 3).map((h) => h.name).join(' · '), action: '/habits', cta: 'Complete' });
    }
  }

  const order = { high: 0, medium: 1, low: 2 };
  return out.sort((a, b) => order[a.priority] - order[b.priority]);
}

// Fires browser notifications for due reminders, once per reminder per day.
export function fireBrowserNotifications(reminders, userId) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  const today = TODAY();
  const browserOk = ('Notification' in window) && Notification.permission === 'granted';
  reminders.slice(0, 5).forEach((r) => {
    const key = `lraz_notified_${r.id}_${today}`;
    if (localStorage.getItem(key)) return;
    if (browserOk) {
      try { new Notification(`LRAZ 63 · ${r.title}`, { body: r.body }); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    if (userId) sendPush(userId, `LRAZ 63 · ${r.title}`, r.body, r.action || '/');
    localStorage.setItem(key, '1');
  });
}

// Live scheduler: re-checks reminders on load and every 20 minutes while the
// app is open (foreground or background tab) and fires due notifications.
// Returns a cleanup function that clears the interval.
export function startLiveNotificationScheduler() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
  const tick = async () => {
    try {
      let me = null;
      try { me = await base44.auth.me(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      const data = await loadReminderData();
      const r = computeReminders(data);
      fireBrowserNotifications(r, me?.id);
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  };
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(tick, 10000);
  const intervalId = setInterval(tick, 20 * 60 * 1000);
  return () => { clearTimeout(timeoutId); clearInterval(intervalId); };
}

// Social + messaging helpers — deterministic, no AI. All operations use the
// Base44 client SDK and rely on per-entity RLS for authorization.
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { sendPush } from '@/lib/pushNotifications';

// Ensure the current user has a SocialProfile (creates one on first launch).
// Every app account automatically becomes part of the social system — no opt-in.
export async function ensureMyProfile() {
  try {
    const me = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!me) return null;
    const name = me.full_name || (me.email ? me.email.split('@')[0] : 'Athlete');
    const username = me.username || (me.email ? me.email.split('@')[0] : '');
    const avatar = me.avatar_url || '';
    const existing = await base44.entities.SocialProfile.filter({ user_id: me.id });
    if (existing && existing.length) {
      const p = existing[0];
      const patch = {};
      if (!p.display_name) patch.display_name = name;
      if (!p.username && username) patch.username = username;
      if (avatar && p.avatar_url !== avatar) patch.avatar_url = avatar;
      if (Object.keys(patch).length) {
        await base44.entities.SocialProfile.update(p.id, patch).catch(() => {});
        Object.assign(p, patch);
      }
      return p;
    }
    return await base44.entities.SocialProfile.create({
      user_id: me.id, display_name: name, username, avatar_url: avatar, is_private: !!me.profile_private,
    });
  } catch (e) { console.error('ensureMyProfile', e); return null; }
}

// Push profile fields (username, avatar, display_name, bio, is_private) to the
// current user's SocialProfile so they are visible to other users.
export async function syncMyProfile(fields) {
  try {
    const me = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!me) return;
    const arr = await base44.entities.SocialProfile.filter({ user_id: me.id });
    if (arr && arr.length) await base44.entities.SocialProfile.update(arr[0].id, fields).catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) { console.error('syncMyProfile', e); }
}

export async function getFollow(followerId, followingId) {

  return arr && arr.length ? arr[0] : null;
}

// Follow a user. Public profiles auto-accept; private profiles create a pending request.
export async function followUser(target, me) {
  if (!target || !me) return null;
  const existing = await getFollow(me.user_id, target.user_id);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const isPrivate = !!target.is_private;
  const status = isPrivate ? 'pending' : 'accepted';
  const rec = await base44.entities.Follow.create({
    follower_id: me.user_id, follower_name: me.display_name,
    following_id: target.user_id, following_name: target.display_name,
    status, acted_at: isPrivate ? null : new Date().toISOString(),
  });
  await notify(target.user_id, isPrivate ? 'follow_request' : 'follow', me.user_id, me.display_name,
    isPrivate ? `${me.display_name} requested to follow you.` : `${me.display_name} started following you.`,
    'profile', me.user_id);
  return rec;
}
export async function unfollowUser(target, me) {

}

    `${me.display_name} accepted your follow request.`, 'profile', me.user_id);
}

async function notify(userId, type, actorId, actorName, text, entityType, entityId) {
  if (userId === actorId) return; // never notify yourself
  await base44.entities.AppNotification.create({
    user_id: userId, type, actor_id: actorId, actor_name: actorName, text, entity_type: entityType, entity_id: entityId, read: false,
  }).catch(() => {});
  const action_url = entityType === 'conversation' && entityId ? `/messages/${entityId}` : entityType === 'profile' && actorId ? `/user/${actorId}` : '/';
  await sendPush(userId, 'LRAZ 63', text, action_url);
}

// ---- Messaging ----
export async function listConversations() {
  return await base44.entities.Conversation.list('-last_message_at', 100);
}
export async function createOrGetConversation(otherUserId, myName, otherName) {
  const me = await base44.auth.me();
  const existing = await base44.entities.Conversation.list('-last_message_at', 200);
  const found = (existing || []).find((c) => Array.isArray(c.participant_ids) && c.participant_ids.length === 2 && c.participant_ids.includes(me.id) && c.participant_ids.includes(otherUserId));
  if (found) return found;
  const ids = [me.id, otherUserId];
  const names = ids.map((id) => (id === me.id ? myName : otherName));
  return await base44.entities.Conversation.create({ participant_ids: ids, participant_names: names, last_message_at: new Date().toISOString(), last_message_preview: '' });
}
export async function sendMessage(conversation, content, attachments = []) {
  const me = await base44.auth.me();
  const msg = await base44.entities.Message.create({
    conversation_id: conversation.id, sender_id: me.id, participant_ids: conversation.participant_ids,
    content: content || '', attachments,
  });
  const preview = content || (attachments.length ? `Shared ${attachments[0].type}` : '');
  await base44.entities.Conversation.update(conversation.id, { last_message_at: new Date().toISOString(), last_message_preview: preview.slice(0, 80) }).catch(() => {});
  const otherId = conversation.participant_ids.find((id) => id !== me.id);
  if (otherId) await notify(otherId, 'message', me.id, me.full_name || 'Someone', content || 'Sent you content', 'conversation', conversation.id);
  return msg;
}
export async function listMessages(conversationId) {
  return await base44.entities.Message.filter({ conversation_id: conversationId }, 'created_date', 500);
}
export function subscribeMessages(conversationId, cb) {
  return base44.entities.Message.subscribe((event) => {
    if (event?.data?.conversation_id !== conversationId) return;
    cb(event);
  });
}

import { clsx } from "clsx"
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge"

export function cn(...inputs) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
} 


export const isIframe = window.self !== window.top;

// Local-timezone YYYY-MM-DD — avoids the UTC off-by-one bug from toISOString()
export const localDateStr = (value = new Date()) => {
  if (typeof value === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return value;
  const d = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
};

export const localDayOffset = (days, value = new Date()) => {
  const date = new Date(typeof value === 'string' && value.length === 10 ? `${value}T12:00:00` : value);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
  return localDateStr(date);
};

import { fitnessRecordQuery, fitnessSummaryQuery } from '@/lib/fitnessDataCache';
import { widgetTrainingQuery } from '@/lib/widgetTrainingStats';

const firstTotal = result => result.rows[0] || {};
function waterTotal(result) {
  if (result.truncated) throw new Error('Water totals could not be completed.');
  const units = { ml: 1, milliliter: 1, milliliters: 1, l: 1000, liter: 1000, liters: 1000, oz: 29.5735295625, 'fl oz': 29.5735295625, cup: 236.5882365, cups: 236.5882365, g: 1 };
  return result.rows.reduce((sum, row) => {
    const unit = (row.unit || 'ml').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!units[unit]) throw new Error('A water entry has an unsupported unit. Edit it in Nutrition to use ml, l, cups or oz.');
    return sum + (row.sum_quantity || 0) * units[unit];
  }, 0);
}
export default function widgetQueries(type, userId, today) {
  const goal = { name: 'goal', ...fitnessRecordQuery('Goal', userId, { status: 'active' }, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 1 }) };
  const query = { date: today };
  switch (type) {
    case 'nutrition': return [goal, { name: 'totals', ...fitnessSummaryQuery('NutritionLog', userId, { query: { ...query, food_name: { $ne: 'Water' } }, sum: ['calories', 'protein_g', 'carbs_g', 'fat_g'] }), select: firstTotal }];
    case 'water': return [goal, { name: 'waterMl', ...fitnessSummaryQuery('NutritionLog', userId, { query: { ...query, food_name: 'Water' }, groupBy: 'unit', sum: 'quantity' }), select: waterTotal }];
    case 'weight': return [goal,
      { name: 'latest', ...fitnessRecordQuery('BodyMeasurement', userId, { weight_kg: { $gt: 0 } }, { sort: '-date', limit: 1, fields: ['date', 'weight_kg'] }) },
      { name: 'first', ...fitnessRecordQuery('BodyMeasurement', userId, { weight_kg: { $gt: 0 } }, { sort: 'date', limit: 1, fields: ['date', 'weight_kg'] }) }];
    case 'streak': return [{ name: 'training', ...widgetTrainingQuery(userId, today) }];
    case 'workout': return [{ name: 'scheduled', ...fitnessRecordQuery('ScheduledWorkout', userId, { date: today, completed: false }, { sort: 'created_date', limit: 1 }) }];
    default: return [];
  }
}

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

export function weekStart(value) {
  const date = new Date(value); date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() - (date.getDay() + 6) % 7);
  return date;
}
export default async function widgetTrainingStats(userId, today) {
  const current = weekStart(`${today}T12:00:00`);
  const previous = new Date(current); previous.setDate(previous.getDate() - 7);
  const next = new Date(current); next.setDate(next.getDate() + 7);
  const weeks = new Set();
  let before = next.toISOString(), thisWeek = 0, volume = 0, previousVolume = 0;
  while (true) {
    const result = await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.aggregate({ query: { created_by_id: userId, status: 'completed', date: { $lt: before } }, groupBy: 'date', sum: 'total_volume_kg', sort: '-date', limit: 1000 });
    result.rows.forEach(row => {
      const date = new Date(row.date);
      if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return;
      weeks.add(localDateStr(weekStart(date)));
      if (date >= current && date < next) { thisWeek += row.count; volume += row.sum_total_volume_kg || 0; }
      else if (date >= previous && date < current) previousVolume += row.sum_total_volume_kg || 0;
    });
    let cursor = new Date(current), streak = 0;
    if (!weeks.has(localDateStr(cursor))) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 7);
    while (weeks.has(localDateStr(cursor))) { streak++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 7); }
    const oldest = result.rows.at(-1)?.date;
    if (!result.truncated || !oldest || (new Date(oldest) < previous && cursor > weekStart(oldest))) {
      return { streak, thisWeek, volumeChange: previousVolume ? Math.round((volume - previousVolume) / previousVolume * 100) : null };
    }
    before = oldest;
  }
}
export const widgetTrainingQuery = (userId, today) => ({ queryKey: ['widget-training', userId, today], queryFn: () => widgetTrainingStats(userId, today), staleTime: 60000, refetchOnWindowFocus: true });

// Shared workout data loader + deterministic analysis helpers.
// NO AI. Pure calculations from actual user data.
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { localDateStr } from '@/lib/utils';

let _cache = null;
let _promise = null;
let _ts = 0;
const TTL = 60_000; // 1 minute cache to avoid duplicate fetches across tabs

export async function loadWorkoutData(force = false) {
  const stale = Date.now() - _ts > TTL;
  if (_cache && !force && !stale) return _cache;
  if (_promise && !force) return _promise;
  _promise = (async () => {
    const [sessions, sets, cardio, scheduled] = await Promise.all([
      base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 500),
      base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 3000),
      base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 500),
      base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.list('-date', 200),
    ]);
    _cache = {
      sessions: (sessions || []).filter((s) => s.status === 'completed'),
      sets: sets || [],
      cardio: (cardio || []),
      scheduled: scheduled || [],
      allSessions: sessions || [],
    };
    _ts = Date.now();
    _promise = null;
    return _cache;
  })();
  const pending = _promise;
  try { return await pending; }
  finally { if (_promise === pending) _promise = null; }
}

export function clearWorkoutCache() { _cache = null; _promise = null; _ts = 0; }

// Group sets by session_id for quick lookup
export function groupSetsBySession(sets) {
  const map = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    if (!map[s.session_id]) map[s.session_id] = [];
    map[s.session_id].push(s);
  }
  return map;
}

// Compute per-session summary from sets
export function sessionSummary(session, sets) {
  const completed = sets.filter((s) => s.completed);
  const volume = completed.reduce((a, s) => a + (Number(s.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(s.reps) || 0), 0);
  const exerciseNames = [...new Set(completed.map((s) => s.exercise_name))];
  const prCount = completed.filter((s) => s.is_pr).length;
  const totalSets = completed.length;
  const totalReps = completed.reduce((a, s) => a + (Number(s.reps) || 0), 0);
  return {
    volume: Math.round(volume),
    exerciseCount: exerciseNames.length,
    prCount,
    totalSets,
    totalReps,
    exercises: exerciseNames,
  };
}

// Muscle-group volume distribution from sets + exercise lookup
export function muscleGroupVolume(sets, exerciseMap) {
  const map = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    if (!s.completed) continue;
    const ex = exerciseMap[s.exercise_name];
    const group = ex?.muscle_group || ex?.primary_muscle || 'Other';
    const vol = (Number(s.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(s.reps) || 0);
    map[group] = (map[group] || 0) + vol;
  }
  return Object.entries(map)
    .map(([group, volume]) => ({ group, volume: Math.round(volume) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.volume - a.volume);
}

// Weekly volume trend (last 12 weeks)
export function weeklyVolumeTrend(sessions, setsBySession) {
  const now = new Date();
  const weeks = [];
  for (let i = 11; i >= 0; i--) {
    const end = new Date(now); end.setDate(now.getDate() - i * 7);
    const start = new Date(end); start.setDate(end.getDate() - 6);
    const sStart = localDateStr(start);
    const sEnd = localDateStr(end);
    const weekSessions = sessions.filter((s) => {
      const d = (s.date || '').slice(0, 10);
      return d >= sStart && d <= sEnd;
    });
    let vol = 0;
    let duration = 0;
    for (const ws of weekSessions) {
      const ss = setsBySession[ws.id] || [];
      vol += ss.filter((x) => x.completed).reduce((a, x) => a + (Number(x.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(x.reps) || 0), 0);
      duration += ws.duration_minutes || 0;
    }
    weeks.push({
      label: `${start.getMonth() + 1}/${start.getDate()}`,
      volume: Math.round(vol),
      sessions: weekSessions.length,
      duration: Math.round(duration),
    });
  }
  return weeks;
}

// Top exercises by total volume
export function topExercisesByVolume(sets, limit = 8) {
  const map = {};
  for (const s of sets) {
    if (!s.completed) continue;
    const vol = (Number(s.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(s.reps) || 0);
    if (!map[s.exercise_name]) map[s.exercise_name] = { name: s.exercise_name, volume: 0, sets: 0 };
    map[s.exercise_name].volume += vol;
    map[s.exercise_name].sets += 1;
  }
  return Object.values(map)
    .map((e) => ({ ...e, volume: Math.round(e.volume) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.volume - a.volume)
    .slice(0, limit);
}

// Workout frequency: sessions per week for last 8 weeks
export function workoutFrequency(sessions) {
  const now = new Date();
  const weeks = [];
  for (let i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
    const end = new Date(now); end.setDate(now.getDate() - i * 7);
    const start = new Date(end); start.setDate(end.getDate() - 6);
    const sStart = localDateStr(start);
    const sEnd = localDateStr(end);
    const count = sessions.filter((s) => {
      const d = (s.date || '').slice(0, 10);
      return d >= sStart && d <= sEnd;
    }).length;
    weeks.push({ label: `${start.getMonth() + 1}/${start.getDate()}`, sessions: count });
  }
  return weeks;
}

// Training consistency: current streak + total days trained
export function trainingConsistency(sessions) {
  const dates = new Set(sessions.map((s) => (s.date || '').slice(0, 10)));
  let streak = 0;
  const cur = new Date();
  // Allow today or yesterday to start streak
  let check = new Date(cur);
  if (!dates.has(localDateStr(check))) {
    check.setDate(check.getDate() - 1);
    if (!dates.has(localDateStr(check))) {
      return { streak: 0, totalDays: dates.size };
    }
  }
  while (dates.has(localDateStr(check))) {
    streak++;
    check.setDate(check.getDate() - 1);
  }
  return { streak, totalDays: dates.size };
}

// PR progression: all PR sets chronologically
export function prProgression(sets, sessionsMap) {
  return sets
    .filter((s) => s.is_pr && s.completed)
    .map((s) => {
      const sess = sessionsMap[s.session_id];
      return {
        date: (sess?.date || s.created_date || '').slice(0, 10),
        exercise: s.exercise_name,
        weight: s.weight_kg,
        reps: s.reps,
        e1rm: s.estimated_1rm || 0,
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
}

// Duration trend
export function durationTrend(sessions) {
  return sessions
    .filter((s) => s.duration_minutes)
    .map((s) => ({ date: (s.date || '').slice(0, 10), duration: s.duration_minutes }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
    .slice(-20);
}

// Cardio vs training: weekly cardio duration vs training duration
export function cardioVsTraining(sessions, cardio) {
  const now = new Date();
  const weeks = [];
  for (let i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
    const end = new Date(now); end.setDate(now.getDate() - i * 7);
    const start = new Date(end); start.setDate(end.getDate() - 6);
    const sStart = localDateStr(start);
    const sEnd = localDateStr(end);
    const trainMin = sessions
      .filter((s) => { const d = (s.date || '').slice(0, 10); return d >= sStart && d <= sEnd; })
      .reduce((a, s) => a + (s.duration_minutes || 0), 0);
    const cardioSec = cardio
      .filter((c) => { const d = (c.date || '').slice(0, 10); return d >= sStart && d <= sEnd; })
      .reduce((a, c) => a + (c.duration_seconds || 0), 0);
    weeks.push({
      label: `${start.getMonth() + 1}/${start.getDate()}`,
      training: Math.round(trainMin),
      cardio: Math.round(cardioSec / 60),
    });
  }
  return weeks;
}

FILE: src/lib/workoutHistoryEditing.js

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { estimate1RM } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';
import { recordPatch, recordsChanged } from '@/lib/recordEditing';
import { workoutFields } from '@/lib/recordFields';

export async function saveWorkoutHistory(session, originalSets, sets, removed, form) {
  const deleted = originalSets.filter(set => removed.includes(set.id));
  const changed = sets.filter(set => !removed.includes(set.id) && JSON.stringify(set) !== JSON.stringify(originalSets.find(original => original.id === set.id)));
  for (let index = 0; index < changed.length; index += 500) await base44.entities.WorkoutSet.bulkUpdate(changed.slice(index, index + 500).map(set => ({ id: set.id, exercise_name: set.exercise_name.trim(), weight_kg: Number(set.weight_kg) || 0, weight_lbs: (Number(set.weight_kg) || 0) * 2.2046226218, reps: Number(set.reps) || 0, rpe: set.rpe === '' ? null : Number(set.rpe) || null, rir: set.rir === '' ? null : Number(set.rir), rest_seconds: Number(set.rest_seconds) || 0, set_type: set.set_type, notes: set.notes || '', is_pr: !!set.is_pr, estimated_1rm: estimate1RM(Number(set.weight_kg), Number(set.reps)) || 0 })));
  if (deleted.length) await base44.entities.WorkoutSet.deleteMany({ session_id: session.id, id: { $in: deleted.map(set => set.id) } });
  const remaining = sets.filter(set => !removed.includes(set.id) && set.completed);
  const { data, unset } = recordPatch(session, workoutFields, form);
  await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.update(session.id, { ...data, total_volume_kg: remaining.reduce((total, set) => total + (Number(set.weight_kg) || 0) * (Number(set.reps) || 0), 0), estimated_1rm_top_set: Math.max(0, ...remaining.map(set => estimate1RM(Number(set.weight_kg), Number(set.reps)) || 0)), pr_count: remaining.filter(set => set.is_pr).length });
  if (Object.keys(unset).length) await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.updateMany({ id: session.id }, { $unset: unset });
  if (data.date) await base44.entities.CardioSession.updateMany({ workout_session_id: session.id }, { $set: { date: data.date } });
  recordsChanged('WorkoutSession');
}
export async function deleteWorkoutHistory(session) {
  await base44.entities.CardioSession.updateMany({ workout_session_id: session.id }, { $set: { session_type: 'standalone' }, $unset: { workout_session_id: '' } });
  await base44.entities.WorkoutSet.deleteMany({ session_id: session.id });
  await base44.entities.WorkoutSession.delete(session.id);
  recordsChanged('WorkoutSession');
}

      setPrograms(progs || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const year = cursor.getFullYear();
  const month = cursor.getMonth();
  const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
  const startWeekday = firstDay.getDay();
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const monthName = firstDay.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });

  const eventsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    events.forEach((e) => { (map[e.date] = map[e.date] || []).push(e); });
    return map;
  }, [events]);

  const cells = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < startWeekday; i++) cells.push(null);
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) cells.push(d);

  const dateStr = (d) => `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const prevMonth = () => setCursor(new Date(year, month - 1, 1));
  const nextMonth = () => setCursor(new Date(year, month + 1, 1));

  const monthEvents = events.filter((e) => e.date?.startsWith(`${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`));

  const deleteEvent = (event) => {
    setEvents((e) => e.filter((x) => x.id !== event.id));
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.delete(event.id).catch(() => loadAll());
      setPendingDelete(null);
    }, 5000);
    setPendingDelete({ event, timer });
  };
  const undoDelete = () => {
    if (!pendingDelete) return;
    clearTimeout(pendingDelete.timer);
    setEvents((e) => [...e, pendingDelete.event]);
    setPendingDelete(null);
  };

  const createEntry = async (entry) => {
    const tempId = `tmp-${Date.now()}`;
    setEvents((e) => [...e, { ...entry, id: tempId }]);
    setAddMode(null); setSelectedDate(null);
    try {
      const created = await base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.create(entry);
      const realId = created?.id || created?._id;
      if (realId) setEvents((e) => e.map((x) => x.id === tempId ? { ...x, id: realId } : x));
    }
    catch (e) { loadAll(); console.error(e); }
  };

  const copyWeekForward = async () => {
    if (!selectedDate) return;
    const base = new Date(selectedDate + 'T00:00:00');
    const dow = base.getDay();
    const monday = new Date(base); monday.setDate(base.getDate() - ((dow + 6) % 7));
    const weekEvents = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const d = new Date(monday); d.setDate(monday.getDate() + i);
      const ds = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      (eventsByDate[ds] || []).forEach((e) => weekEvents.push(e));
    }
    if (!weekEvents.length) return;
    await Promise.all(weekEvents.map((e) => {
      const nd = new Date(e.date + 'T00:00:00'); nd.setDate(nd.getDate() + 7);
      return base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.create({ date: nd.toISOString().slice(0, 10), title: e.title, program_id: e.program_id, program_day_name: e.program_day_name, day_index: e.day_index, focus: e.focus, notes: e.notes, source: e.source, completed: false });
    }));
    loadAll();
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => navigate('/train')} className="min-h-[44px]"><ArrowLeft size={18} /></Button>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">Schedule</p>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Calendar</h1>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => { setSelectedDate(todayStr); setAddMode(null); }}><Plus size={16} /> Add</Button>
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={prevMonth} className="min-h-[40px]"><ChevronLeft size={18} /></Button>
          <p className="font-semibold">{monthName}</p>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={nextMonth} className="min-h-[40px]"><ChevronRight size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center">
          {WEEKDAYS.map((w, i) => <span key={i} className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase pb-1">{w}</span>)}
          {cells.map((d, i) => {
            if (!d) return <span key={i} />;
            const ds = dateStr(d);
            const dayEvents = eventsByDate[ds] || [];
            return (
              <button key={i} onClick={() => { setSelectedDate(ds); setAddMode(null); }}
                className={cn('aspect-square rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-sm transition-all relative',
                  ds === todayStr ? 'bg-luxury-blue/15 border border-luxury-blue/40' : 'hover:bg-muted/40',
                  selectedDate === ds && 'ring-1 ring-luxury-blue')}>
                <span className="font-medium">{d}</span>
                {dayEvents.length > 0 && <span className="absolute bottom-1 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-luxury-red" />}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {selectedDate && !addMode && (
        <Card className="mb-4 animate-scale-in">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">{new Date(selectedDate + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' })}</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setAddMode('program')}><Dumbbell size={14} /> From Program</Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setAddMode('manual')}><Pencil size={14} /> Manual</Button>
          </div>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px] w-full mt-2" onClick={copyWeekForward}><Copy size={14} /> Copy this week → next week</Button>
          {(eventsByDate[selectedDate] || []).map((e) => (
            <div key={e.id} className="flex items-center justify-between mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/40">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">{e.title}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{e.focus || ''}{e.source === 'program' ? ' · Program' : ' · Manual'}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                {e.source === 'program' && e.program_id && e.day_index != null && (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-luxury-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => navigate(`/workout/new?programId=${e.program_id}&dayIndex=${e.day_index}`)}><Play size={14} /></Button>
                )}
                <button onClick={() => deleteEvent(e)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </Card>
      )}

      {selectedDate && addMode === 'manual' && (
        <ManualScheduler date={selectedDate} onSave={createEntry} onCancel={() => setAddMode(null)} />
      )}
      {selectedDate && addMode === 'program' && (
        <ProgramScheduler date={selectedDate} programs={programs} onSave={createEntry} onCancel={() => setAddMode(null)} />
      )}

      <div className="space-y-2 mt-2">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{monthName} Schedule</p>
        {monthEvents.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-6 text-center glass rounded-xl">No workouts scheduled this month</p>
        ) : monthEvents.map((e) => (
          <Card key={e.id} className="p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex-1">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">{e.title}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{new Date(e.date + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}{e.focus ? ` · ${e.focus}` : ''}{e.source === 'program' ? ' · Program' : ''}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {e.source === 'program' && e.program_id && e.day_index != null && (
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-luxury-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => navigate(`/workout/new?programId=${e.program_id}&dayIndex=${e.day_index}`)}><Play size={14} /></Button>
              )}
              <button onClick={() => deleteEvent(e)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
            </div>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
      {pendingDelete && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 glass-strong rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-3 animate-fade-up">
          <span className="text-xs">Workout deleted</span>
          <button onClick={undoDelete} className="text-xs font-semibold text-luxury-blue">Undo</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ProgramScheduler({ date, programs, onSave, onCancel }) {

      ) : (

            {programs.map((p) => (
              <button key={p.id} onClick={() => { setProgramId(p.id); setDayIndex(0); }}
                className={cn('w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl border transition-all',
                  programId === p.id ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/10' : 'border-border glass')}>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">{p.name}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{p.goal} · {p.split}</p>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {selected?.days?.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
              {selected.days.map((d, i) => (
                <Pill key={i} active={dayIndex === i} onClick={() => setDayIndex(i)}>{d.day_name || `Day ${i + 1}`}</Pill>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" disabled={!day} onClick={() => onSave({ date, title: day?.day_name || selected.name, program_id: selected.id, program_day_name: day?.day_name, day_index: dayIndex, focus: day?.focus || '', source: 'program' })}>
            <Plus size={16} /> Schedule {day?.day_name || ''}
          </Button>
        </>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

        ) : (

              <Card><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Avg Duration</p><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{formatDuration(agg.avgDuration)}</p></Card>

                      </div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-luxury-blue tabular-nums">{pct}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted/30 mt-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div className="h-full bg-luxury-blue transition-all" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-2">Recent Sessions</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {agg.inRange.slice(0, 20).map((s) => (
                <Card key={s.id} className="p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">{s.activity_label}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{new Date(s.date).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })} · {formatDuration(s.duration_seconds)}{s.distance_km ? ` · ${formatDistance(s.distance_km)} km` : ''}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <p className="text-sm font-bold text-luxury-red tabular-nums">{s.calories || 0}<span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal"> kcal</span></p>
                    <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground uppercase">{(s.calorie_source || 'estimated').slice(0, 4)}</p>
                  </div>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </PullToRefresh>
  );
}

function SummaryStat({ icon: Icon, label, value, unit, accent, sub }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1"><Icon size={13} className="text-muted-foreground" /><span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</span></div>
      <span className={`text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums ${accent ? 'text-luxury-red' : ''}`}>{value}{unit && <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">{unit}</span>}</span>
      {sub && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{sub}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Play, Pause, Square, ChevronLeft, Check, X, Activity, Bike, Waves, Mountain, Timer } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { ACTIVITIES, getActivity, estimateCalories, computeSpeed, computePace, formatDuration, formatPace, formatDistance, aggregateHistory, computeTimeInZone } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';
import { createPost, refreshMyTrainingStats } from '@/lib/activityFeed';
import { getCardioFeedback } from '@/lib/feedbackMessages';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'lraz_active_cardio';

function actIcon(id) {
  const g = getActivity(id).group;
  if (g === 'Bike') return Bike;
  if (g === 'Swim' || g === 'Row') return Waves;
  if (g === 'Walk' && id === 'hiking') return Mountain;
  if (g === 'Jump' || g === 'Ropes') return Timer;
  return Activity;
}

// Deterministic HIIT phase from elapsed time and interval config.
function intervalPhase(elapsed, interval) {
  if (!interval) return null;
  const cycle = interval.workSec + interval.restSec;
  const total = cycle * interval.rounds;
  if (elapsed >= total) return { phase: 'Done', round: interval.rounds, remaining: 0, total };
  const round = Math.floor(elapsed / cycle) + 1;
  const within = elapsed % cycle;
  const isWork = within < interval.workSec;
  const remaining = isWork ? interval.workSec - within : cycle - within;
  return { phase: isWork ? 'Work' : 'Rest', round, remaining, total };
}

export default function CardioSession() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [session, setSession] = useState(null);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState(null);
  const [finishing, setFinishing] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(null);
  const [weekTotals, setWeekTotals] = useState(null);
  const [showIntervals, setShowIntervals] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); if (raw) setSession(JSON.parse(raw)); } catch (e) {}
    base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 1).then((m) => { setWeight(m?.[0]?.weight_kg || user?.weight_kg || null); }).catch(() => setWeight(user?.weight_kg || null));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.runningSince) return;
    const iv = setInterval(() => setTick((t) => t + 1), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [session?.runningSince]);

  const persist = (s) => { setSession(s); if (s) localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); else localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); };

  const elapsed = useMemo(() => {
    if (!session) return 0;
    return (session.baseElapsed || 0) + (session.runningSince ? (Date.now() - session.runningSince) / 1000 : 0);
  }, [session, tick]);

  const activity = session ? getActivity(session.activity) : null;
  const liveCalories = useMemo(() => activity ? estimateCalories(session.activity, elapsed, weight, session.metrics?.incline ? Number(session.metrics.incline) : null) : 0, [session, elapsed, weight]);
  const speed = useMemo(() => activity && session.metrics?.distance ? computeSpeed(Number(session.metrics.distance), elapsed) : null, [session, elapsed, activity]);
  const pace = useMemo(() => activity && session.metrics?.distance ? computePace(elapsed, Number(session.metrics.distance)) : null, [session, elapsed, activity]);
  const phase = useMemo(() => intervalPhase(elapsed, session?.interval), [elapsed, session?.interval]);

  const startSession = (act) => {
    persist({ activity: act.id, activityLabel: act.label, runningSince: Date.now(), baseElapsed: 0, metrics: {} });
  };

  const togglePause = () => {
    if (session.runningSince) persist({ ...session, runningSince: null, baseElapsed: elapsed });
    else persist({ ...session, runningSince: Date.now() });
  };

  const setMetric = (k, v) => persist({ ...session, metrics: { ...session.metrics, [k]: v } });
  const applyInterval = (interval) => { persist({ ...session, interval }); setShowIntervals(false); };

  const finish = () => {
    if (session.runningSince) persist({ ...session, runningSince: null, baseElapsed: elapsed });
    setFinishing(true);
  };

  const saveSession = async (finalData) => {
    const duration = Math.round(finalData.duration_seconds ?? elapsed);
    const record = {
      date: new Date().toISOString(),
      activity: session.activity,
      activity_label: session.activityLabel,
      duration_seconds: duration,
      distance_km: finalData.distance ? Number(finalData.distance) : undefined,
      calories: finalData.calories,
      calorie_source: finalData.calSource,
      avg_speed_kmh: speed ?? undefined,
      avg_pace_sec_per_km: pace ?? undefined,
      incline_percent: session.metrics?.incline ? Number(session.metrics.incline) : undefined,
      resistance_level: session.metrics?.resistance ? Number(session.metrics.resistance) : undefined,
      steps: session.metrics?.steps ? Number(session.metrics.steps) : undefined,
      floors: session.metrics?.floors ? Number(session.metrics.floors) : undefined,
      heart_rate_avg: finalData.avgHr ? Number(finalData.avgHr) : undefined,
      notes: finalData.notes || undefined,
      interval_config: session.interval || undefined,
      session_type: 'standalone',
    };
    const created = await base44.entities.CardioSession.create(record);
    createPost('cardio', `${session.activityLabel} · ${formatDuration(duration)}`,
      `${Math.round(record.calories || 0)} kcal${record.distance_km ? ` · ${record.distance_km} km` : ''}`,
      { summary: [{ label: 'Duration', value: formatDuration(duration) }, { label: 'Calories', value: Math.round(record.calories || 0) }, { label: 'Distance', value: record.distance_km ? record.distance_km + 'km' : '—' }] },
    ).catch(() => {});
    refreshMyTrainingStats().catch(() => {});
    persist(null);
    setFinishing(false);
    const all = await base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 200);
    setWeekTotals(aggregateHistory(all || [], 'week'));
    setSaved({ ...record, id: created?.id });
  };

  if (saved) return <SessionSummary saved={saved} weekTotals={weekTotals} onDone={() => navigate('/cardio/history')} onAnother={() => { setSaved(null); setSession(null); }} />;
  if (!session) return <ActivityPicker onPick={startSession} onBack={() => navigate('/train')} />;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36 min-h-screen flex flex-col">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/train')} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground min-h-[44px]"><ChevronLeft size={18} /> Cancel</button>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">{session.activityLabel}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/40 flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
          {session.runningSince ? <Pause size={32} className="text-white" /> : <Play size={32} className="text-white" />}
        </div>
        {phase && phase.phase !== 'Done' && (
          <div className={cn('glass rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 mb-4 w-full max-w-xs text-center', phase.phase === 'Work' ? 'border-luxury-red/40' : 'border-luxury-blue/40')}>
            <p className={cn('text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest', phase.phase === 'Work' ? 'text-luxury-red' : 'text-luxury-blue')}>{phase.phase} · Round {phase.round}/{session.interval.rounds}</p>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{formatDuration(Math.ceil(phase.remaining))}</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {phase && phase.phase === 'Done' && (
          <div className="glass rounded-2xl px-4 py-2 mb-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400">Intervals Complete</p>
          </div>
        )}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">{session.runningSince ? 'In Progress' : 'Paused'}</p>
        <p className="text-6xl font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight">{formatDuration(elapsed)}</p>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 w-full mt-8">
          {activity.metrics.includes('distance') && <MetricField label="Distance (km)" value={session.metrics?.distance || ''} onChange={(v) => setMetric('distance', v)} />}
          {activity.metrics.includes('incline') && <MetricField label="Incline (%)" value={session.metrics?.incline || ''} onChange={(v) => setMetric('incline', v)} />}
          {(activity.metrics.includes('resistance') || activity.metrics.includes('level')) && <MetricField label="Level / Resistance" value={session.metrics?.resistance || ''} onChange={(v) => setMetric('resistance', v)} />}
          {activity.metrics.includes('steps') && <MetricField label="Steps" value={session.metrics?.steps || ''} onChange={(v) => setMetric('steps', v)} />}
          {activity.metrics.includes('floors') && <MetricField label="Floors" value={session.metrics?.floors || ''} onChange={(v) => setMetric('floors', v)} />}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 w-full mt-4">
          {activity.metrics.includes('speed') && speed != null && <LiveStat label="Avg Speed" value={`${(Math.round(speed * 10) / 10).toFixed(1)}`} unit="km/h" />}
          {activity.metrics.includes('pace') && pace != null && <LiveStat label="Avg Pace" value={formatPace(pace)} unit="/km" />}
          {activity.metrics.includes('calories') && <LiveStat label="Est. Calories" value={liveCalories} unit="kcal" accent />}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[48px] text-sm mb-3" onClick={() => setShowIntervals(true)}>
        <Timer size={16} /> {session.interval ? `Intervals: ${session.interval.workSec}s work / ${session.interval.restSec}s rest × ${session.interval.rounds}` : 'Configure HIIT Intervals'}
      </Button>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-6">
        <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[52px] text-base" onClick={togglePause}>
          {session.runningSince ? <><Pause size={18} /> Pause</> : <><Play size={18} /> Resume</>}
        </Button>
        <Button className="bg-luxury-red glow-red min-h-[52px] text-base" onClick={finish}><Square size={16} /> Finish</Button>
      </div>

      {finishing && (
        <FinishSheet duration={elapsed} activity={activity} distance={session.metrics?.distance} speed={speed} pace={pace}
          estimatedCalories={liveCalories} onClose={() => setFinishing(false)} onSave={saveSession} />
      )}
      {showIntervals && (
        <IntervalConfig current={session.interval} onApply={applyInterval} onClear={() => { persist({ ...session, interval: null }); setShowIntervals(false); }} onClose={() => setShowIntervals(false)} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ActivityPicker({ onPick, onBack }) {
  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <button onClick={onBack} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground min-h-[44px]"><ChevronLeft size={18} /> Back</button>
        <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold">Start Cardio</h1>
        <span className="w-12" />
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-4">Choose an activity. Your session is saved locally so navigation won't lose it.</p>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        {ACTIVITIES.map((a) => {
          const Icon = actIcon(a.id);
          return (
            <button key={a.id} onClick={() => onPick(a)} className="glass rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-start gap-2 hover:border-luxury-blue/40 transition-all min-h-[88px] text-left">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center"><Icon size={20} /></div>
              <span className="text-sm font-medium leading-tight">{a.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MetricField({ label, value, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <Label className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>
      <Input type="number" inputMode="decimal" value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} placeholder="—" className="glass text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums h-12" />
    </div>
  );
}

function LiveStat({ label, value, unit, accent }) {
  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 text-center">
      <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <p className={cn('text-xl font-bold tabular-nums', accent && 'text-luxury-red')}>{value}{unit && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">{unit}</span>}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function FinishSheet({ duration, activity, distance, speed, pace, estimatedCalories, onClose, onSave }) {
  const [calSource, setCalSource] = useState('Estimated');
  const [calOverride, setCalOverride] = useState('');
  const [durationMin, setDurationMin] = useState((duration / 60).toFixed(1));
  const [distanceVal, setDistanceVal] = useState(distance || '');
  const [avgHr, setAvgHr] = useState('');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const finalCalories = calSource === 'Estimated' ? estimatedCalories : (calOverride ? Number(calOverride) : 0);

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try { await onSave({ distance: distanceVal, duration_seconds: Math.round((Number(durationMin) || 0) * 60), calSource, calories: finalCalories, avgHr, notes }); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 max-h-[88vh] overflow-y-auto animate-fade-up">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Finish Session</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-4 mb-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">{activity.label}</p>
          <p className="text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums mt-1">{formatDuration(duration)}</p>
          {distance && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">{formatDistance(Number(distance))} km{speed != null ? ` · ${(Math.round(speed * 10) / 10).toFixed(1)} km/h` : ''}{pace != null ? ` · ${formatPace(pace)}/km` : ''}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Time (min)</Label>
            <Input type="number" inputMode="decimal" value={durationMin} onChange={(e) => setDurationMin(e.target.value)} placeholder={(duration / 60).toFixed(1)} className="glass text-lg font-semibold h-12" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Distance (km)</Label>
            <Input type="number" inputMode="decimal" value={distanceVal} onChange={(e) => setDistanceVal(e.target.value)} placeholder={distance || '0'} className="glass text-lg font-semibold h-12" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2">Calories</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-3">
          {['Estimated', 'Recorded', 'Manual'].map((s) => (
            <button key={s} onClick={() => setCalSource(s)} className={cn('text-xs px-2 py-2 rounded-xl border min-h-[40px]', calSource === s ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue' : 'border-border glass text-muted-foreground')}>{s}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {calSource === 'Estimated' ? (
          <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">MET × weight × time</span>
            <span className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-luxury-red">{estimatedCalories} kcal</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Input type="number" value={calOverride} onChange={(e) => setCalOverride(e.target.value)} placeholder={String(estimatedCalories)} className="glass text-lg font-semibold h-12" />
        )}
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">{calSource === 'Estimated' ? 'Calculated from MET values, body weight and duration. An estimate, not a measurement.' : calSource === 'Recorded' ? 'From a cardio machine or wearable. More accurate than estimates.' : 'Manually entered by you.'}</p>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-3"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Avg Heart Rate (bpm)</Label><Input type="number" value={avgHr} onChange={(e) => setAvgHr(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optional" className="glass" /></div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-3"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Notes</Label><Input value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optional session notes" /></div>
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="w-full mt-4 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]">{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={18} /> Save Session</>}</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SessionSummary({ saved, weekTotals, onDone, onAnother }) {
  const zones = useMemo(() => computeTimeInZone([saved], null), [saved]);
  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-10 pb-36 min-h-screen flex flex-col">
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
        <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center mb-5 glow-blue"><Check size={40} /></div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-widest">Session Complete</p>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">{saved.activity_label}</h1>
        <p className="text-5xl font-bold tabular-nums mt-4">{formatDuration(saved.duration_seconds)}</p>
        {saved.distance_km && <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground mt-1">{formatDistance(saved.distance_km)} km</p>}
        <p className="text-xl font-bold text-luxury-red mt-3">{saved.calories} kcal <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-normal lowercase">{saved.calorie_source}</span></p>
        <p className="text-sm text-foreground/80 mt-4 max-w-xs leading-relaxed">{getCardioFeedback({ durationSeconds: saved.duration_seconds, calories: saved.calories, distanceKm: saved.distance_km, activityLabel: saved.activity_label })?.message}</p>
        {saved.heart_rate_avg && <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-luxury-blue mt-2">{saved.heart_rate_avg} bpm <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-normal">avg HR</span></p>}
        {saved.heart_rate_avg && zones.total > 0 && (
          <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-4 mt-5 w-full max-w-sm text-left">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2">Time in Zones · estimated</p>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {zones.zones.filter((z) => z.seconds > 0).map((z) => (
                <div key={z.zone} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] w-24 text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{z.label}</span>
                  <div className="flex-1 h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/40 overflow-hidden"><div className="h-full bg-luxury-blue" style={{ width: `${zones.total ? Math.round(z.seconds / zones.total * 100) : 0}%` }} /></div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] tabular-nums w-12 text-right shrink-0">{formatDuration(z.seconds)}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {weekTotals && (
        <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-5 mb-4">
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-3">This Week</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center">
            <div><p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums">{formatDuration(weekTotals.totalSeconds)}</p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase">Cardio</p></div>
            <div><p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-luxury-red">{Math.round(weekTotals.totalCalories)}</p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase">kcal</p></div>
            <div><p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums">{weekTotals.sessions}</p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase">Sessions</p></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[48px]" onClick={onAnother}>Another</Button>
        <Button className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]" onClick={onDone}>Done</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function IntervalConfig({ current, onApply, onClear, onClose }) {
  const [work, setWork] = useState(current?.workSec?.toString() || '30');
  const [rest, setRest] = useState(current?.restSec?.toString() || '30');
  const [rounds, setRounds] = useState(current?.rounds?.toString() || '8');
  const total = ((Number(work) || 0) + (Number(rest) || 0)) * (Number(rounds) || 0);
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 pb-8 safe-pb animate-fade-up">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">HIIT Intervals</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-4">Set work/rest intervals. The timer cues each phase and counts rounds.</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1"><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase">Work (s)</Label><Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={work} onChange={(e) => setWork(e.target.value)} className="glass text-lg font-semibold h-12 text-center" /></div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1"><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase">Rest (s)</Label><Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={rest} onChange={(e) => setRest(e.target.value)} className="glass text-lg font-semibold h-12 text-center" /></div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1"><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase">Rounds</Label><Input type="number" inputMode="numeric" value={rounds} onChange={(e) => setRounds(e.target.value)} className="glass text-lg font-semibold h-12 text-center" /></div>
        </div>
        <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 mb-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Total time</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{formatDuration(total)}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {current ? <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[48px]" onClick={onClear}>Clear</Button> : <div />}
          <Button className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]" onClick={() => onApply({ workSec: Number(work) || 30, restSec: Number(rest) || 30, rounds: Number(rounds) || 8 })}>Apply Intervals</Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { ArrowLeft, Send, Share2, Dumbbell, Apple, Activity, Image as ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import * as social from '@/lib/social';
import ShareContentSheet from '@/components/social/ShareContentSheet';
import SharedContentSheet from '@/components/social/SharedContentSheet';

function AttachmentCard({ a, onOpen }) {
  const icons = { program: Dumbbell, meal: Apple, exercise: Dumbbell, workout: Activity, photo: ImageIcon };
  const Icon = icons[a.type] || Share2;
  return (
    <button onClick={() => onOpen(a)} className="mt-1.5 w-full flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-black/10 p-2 text-left">
      {a.image_url ? (
        <img src={a.image_url} alt={a.name} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0" />
      ) : (
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-white/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Icon size={16} /></div>
      )}
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold truncate">{a.name}</p>
        {a.subtitle && <p className="text-[10px] opacity-70 truncate">{a.subtitle}</p>}
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

export default function Chat() {
  const { conversationId } = useParams();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [conv, setConv] = useState(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [shareOpen, setShareOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const bottomRef = useRef(null);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [list, convs] = await Promise.all([social.listMessages(conversationId), social.listConversations()]);
      setMessages(list || []);
      setConv((convs || []).find((x) => x.id === conversationId) || null);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [conversationId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = social.subscribeMessages(conversationId, () => { load(); });
    return unsub;
  }, [conversationId]);
  useEffect(() => { bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }, [messages]);

  const send = async () => {
    if (!text.trim() || !conv) return;
    setSending(true);
    try { await social.sendMessage(conv, text.trim(), []); setText(''); load(); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setSending(false); }
  };
  const share = async (attachment) => {
    if (!conv) return;
    await social.sendMessage(conv, '', [attachment]);
    setShareOpen(false);
    load();
  };

  const otherName = () => {
    if (!conv) return 'Chat';
    const idx = (conv.participant_ids || []).findIndex((id) => id !== user?.id);
    return conv.participant_names?.[idx] || 'Chat';
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col bg-background safe-pt md:pt-0 md:static md:z-auto md:mx-auto md:max-w-3xl md:h-[calc(100dvh-2.5rem)] md:-mb-10 h-[100dvh]">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-border shrink-0">
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/messages')} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={20} /></button>
        <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full luxury-gradient flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold shrink-0">{(otherName() || '?')[0]?.toUpperCase()}</div>
        <p className="font-semibold truncate flex-1">{otherName()}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 space-y-3">
        {messages.map((m) => {
          const mine = m.sender_id === user?.id;
          return (
            <div key={m.id} className={mine ? 'flex justify-end' : 'flex justify-start'}>
              <div className={cn('max-w-[78%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5', mine ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass')}>
                {m.content && <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{m.content}</p>}
                {(m.attachments || []).map((a, i) => <AttachmentCard key={i} a={a} onOpen={setSelected} />)}
                <p className={cn('text-[9px] mt-1', mine ? 'text-white/60' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>{new Date(m.created_date).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        <div ref={bottomRef} />
      </div>
      <div className="px-3 py-3 border-t border-border shrink-0 safe-pb flex items-center gap-2">
        <button onClick={() => setShareOpen(true)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-luxury-blue"><Share2 size={20} /></button>
        <Input value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') send(); }} placeholder="Message…" className="glass flex-1 min-h-[44px]" />
        <Button onClick={send} disabled={sending || !text.trim()} className="bg-luxury-blue min-h-[44px] px-3"><Send size={18} /></Button>
      </div>
      <ShareContentSheet open={shareOpen} onClose={() => setShareOpen(false)} onShare={share} />
      <SharedContentSheet attachment={selected} open={!!selected} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} />
    </div>
  );
}
