import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ArrowLeft, TrendingUp, Trophy, Flame, Target, AlertTriangle, Scale, Activity, Dumbbell, Info } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  MUSCLE_GROUPS, computeMuscleRecovery, detectPlateaus, detectWeakPoints, computeVolumeByMuscle,
  computeNutritionTrends, generateInsights, muscleGroupForExercise, volumeLandmarks,
  computeTrainingDistribution, computeWeeklyVolume, computeProgressionSuggestions,
  computeRepRangeDistribution, computeMuscleFrequency, computePersonalBestTimeline,
  computeRecoveryHistory, compareLastSessions,
} from '@/lib/performanceAnalytics';
import { estimate1RM } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import PullToRefresh from '@/components/PullToRefresh';
import TrainingDistribution from '@/components/coach/TrainingDistribution';
import DeloadActionCard from '@/components/coach/DeloadActionCard';
import ProgressionSuggestions from '@/components/coach/ProgressionSuggestions';
import RepRangeDistribution from '@/components/coach/RepRangeDistribution';
import MuscleFrequency from '@/components/coach/MuscleFrequency';
import PersonalBestTimeline from '@/components/coach/PersonalBestTimeline';
import RecoveryHistory from '@/components/coach/RecoveryHistory';
import SessionComparison from '@/components/coach/SessionComparison';

const DAY = 86400000;
const INSIGHT_ICONS = { alert: AlertTriangle, flame: Flame, target: Target, trending: TrendingUp, scale: Scale };

export default function Coach() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState(null);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState([]);
  const [sets, setSets] = useState([]);
  const [measurements, setMeasurements] = useState([]);
  const [nutrition, setNutrition] = useState([]);
  const [recovery, setRecovery] = useState(null);
  const [recoveryList, setRecoveryList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => { loadAll(); }, []);
  const loadAll = async () => {
    try {
      const [goals, sess, st, meas, nut, recs] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 60),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 400),
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 30),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.RecoveryRecord.list('-date', 200),
      ]);
      setGoal(goals[0] || null);
      setSessions(sess || []);
      setSets(st || []);
      setMeasurements(meas || []);
      setNutrition(nut || []);
      setRecovery(recs?.[0] || null);
      setRecoveryList(recs || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const muscleRecovery = useMemo(() => computeMuscleRecovery(sessions, sets, recovery), [sessions, sets, recovery]);
  const monthlyVolume = useMemo(() => computeVolumeByMuscle(sessions, sets, 30), [sessions, sets]);
  const weekVolume = useMemo(() => computeVolumeByMuscle(sessions, sets, 7), [sessions, sets]);
  const prevWeekVolume = useMemo(() => {
    // sets from 7-14 days ago
    const dates = {}; sessions.forEach((s) => { if (s.id && s.date) dates[s.id] = new Date(s.date).getTime(); });
    const cutoff1 = Date.now() - 7 * DAY, cutoff2 = Date.now() - 14 * DAY;
    const vol = {};
    sets.forEach((s) => {
      const t = dates[s.session_id]; if (!t || t < cutoff2 || t >= cutoff1) return;
      const m = muscleGroupForExercise(s.exercise_name); if (!m) return;
      if (!vol[m]) vol[m] = { volume: 0, sets: 0 };
      vol[m].volume += (s.weight_kg || 0) * (s.reps || 0); vol[m].sets += 1;
    });
    return vol;
  }, [sessions, sets]);
  const weakPoints = useMemo(() => detectWeakPoints(monthlyVolume), [monthlyVolume]);
  const landmarks = useMemo(() => volumeLandmarks(weekVolume), [weekVolume]);
  const plateaus = useMemo(() => detectPlateaus(sessions, sets), [sessions, sets]);
  const nutritionTrends = useMemo(() => computeNutritionTrends(nutrition, goal, 7), [nutrition, goal]);
  const weights = useMemo(() => measurements.map((m) => m.weight_kg).filter(Boolean).reverse(), [measurements]);
  const insights = useMemo(() => generateInsights({ muscleRecovery, nutritionTrends, weakPoints, plateaus, goal, weights }), [muscleRecovery, nutritionTrends, weakPoints, plateaus, goal, weights]);

  const recentPRs = useMemo(() => detectRecentPRs(sessions, sets), [sessions, sets]);
  const distribution = useMemo(() => computeTrainingDistribution(sessions, sets, 30), [sessions, sets]);
  const weeklyVolume = useMemo(() => computeWeeklyVolume(sessions, sets, 8), [sessions, sets]);
  const progression = useMemo(() => computeProgressionSuggestions(sessions, sets, 6), [sessions, sets]);
  const repDist = useMemo(() => computeRepRangeDistribution(sets, sessions, 90), [sets, sessions]);
  const freq4 = useMemo(() => computeMuscleFrequency(sessions, sets, 4), [sessions, sets]);
  const freq8 = useMemo(() => computeMuscleFrequency(sessions, sets, 8), [sessions, sets]);
  const freq12 = useMemo(() => computeMuscleFrequency(sessions, sets, 12), [sessions, sets]);
  const pbTimeline = useMemo(() => computePersonalBestTimeline(sessions, sets, measurements, []), [sessions, sets, measurements]);
  const sessionCompare = useMemo(() => compareLastSessions(sessions, sets), [sessions, sets]);

  const consistency = useMemo(() => {
    const completed = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date && Date.now() - new Date(s.date).getTime() < 28 * DAY).length;
    const target = (goal?.days_per_week || 4) * 4;
    return { completed, target, pct: target ? Math.min(100, Math.round((completed / target) * 100)) : 0 };
  }, [sessions, goal]);

  const setMaintenanceMode = async () => {
    if (!goal) return;
    try {
      const updated = await base44.entities.Goal.update(goal.id, { phase: 'Maintenance', primary_goal: 'Maintenance' });
      setGoal({ ...goal, ...updated });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  const hasData = sessions.length > 0;

  return (
    <PullToRefresh onRefresh={loadAll}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><ArrowLeft size={18} /></Button>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">Analytics</p>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Training Insights</h1>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Card className="border-luxury-blue/30 bg-luxury-blue/5 mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <Info size={15} className="text-luxury-blue shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">These insights are generated from your logged training, nutrition and body data using fixed rules — not AI. They're training estimates, not medical advice.</p>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <DeloadActionCard weeklyVolume={weeklyVolume} recovery={recovery} />

        <Card className="mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Training Phase</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{goal ? `${goal.primary_goal} · ${goal.phase || '—'}` : 'No active goal'}</p>
            </div>
            {goal && goal.phase !== 'Maintenance' ? (
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[40px]" onClick={setMaintenanceMode}>Switch to Maintenance</Button>
            ) : goal ? (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/10 rounded-full px-2 py-1">MAINTENANCE</span>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">Maintenance mode holds your physique — calories and training balance around your current output. Switch any time.</p>
        </Card>

        {!hasData ? (
          <EmptyState icon={Dumbbell} title="No training data yet" description="Complete a few workouts to unlock insights about your strength, volume, consistency and recovery." action={<Button className="bg-luxury-blue mt-4 min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/workout/new')}><Dumbbell size={16} /> Start Workout</Button>} />
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* RECENT PRs */}
            <SectionLabel icon={Trophy}>Recent PRs</SectionLabel>
            {recentPRs.length ? (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-4">
                {recentPRs.map((pr, i) => (
                  <Card key={i} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-3">
                    <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Trophy size={17} /></div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{pr.exercise}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{pr.oldWeight} → <span className="text-luxury-blue font-semibold">{pr.newWeight} kg</span> · +{pr.delta} kg</p>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Card className="mb-4"><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-2">No new personal records in your latest session. Keep pushing — they'll show up here automatically.</p></Card>
            )}

            {/* PROGRESSION SUGGESTIONS */}
            <SectionLabel icon={TrendingUp}>Progression Suggestions</SectionLabel>
            <ProgressionSuggestions suggestions={progression} />

            {/* VOLUME BY MUSCLE */}
            <SectionLabel icon={Activity}>Volume This Week</SectionLabel>
            <Card className="mb-4">
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {MUSCLE_GROUPS.filter((m) => weekVolume[m]?.sets || prevWeekVolume[m]?.sets).map((m) => {
                  const cur = weekVolume[m]?.volume || 0;
                  const prev = prevWeekVolume[m]?.volume || 0;
                  const delta = prev ? Math.round(((cur - prev) / prev) * 100) : null;
                  return (
                    <div key={m} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{m}</span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
                        <span className="text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{Math.round(cur).toLocaleString()} kg</span>
                        {delta != null && <span className={cn('text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums w-12 text-right', delta > 0 ? 'text-luxury-blue' : delta < 0 ? 'text-luxury-red' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>{delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}{delta}%</span>}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
                {!MUSCLE_GROUPS.some((m) => weekVolume[m]?.sets) && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-2">No volume logged this week yet.</p>}
              </div>
            </Card>

            <SectionLabel icon={Target}>Volume Landmarks</SectionLabel>
            <Card className="mb-4">
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Weekly sets per muscle vs estimated MEV (maintenance entry), MAV (growth range) and MRV (recovery ceiling). Heuristic ranges — a training guide, not a prescription.</p>
              <div className="space-y-2">

                  const l = landmarks[m];
                  const statusColor = l.status === 'Optimal' ? 'text-emerald-400' : l.status === 'Overreaching' ? 'text-luxury-red' : l.status === 'Maintenance' ? 'text-luxury-blue' : 'text-muted-foreground';
                  return (

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{m}</span>
                        <span className={cn('text-xs font-semibold shrink-0', statusColor)}>{l.status}</span>

function SectionLabel({ children, icon: Icon }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-6 mb-3">
      <Icon size={16} className="text-luxury-blue" />
      <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground">{children}</h2>
    </div>
  );
}

// Detect PRs from the most recent completed session vs all prior sessions.
function detectRecentPRs(sessions, sets) {
  const dates = {};
  sessions.forEach((s) => { if (s.id && s.date) dates[s.id] = new Date(s.date).getTime(); });
  const sorted = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && dates[s.id]).sort((a, b) => dates[b.id] - dates[a.id]);
  if (!sorted.length) return [];
  const latest = sorted[0];
  const latestTime = dates[latest.id];
  const before = {};
  sets.forEach((s) => { const t = dates[s.session_id]; if (t && t < latestTime && s.exercise_name) before[s.exercise_name] = Math.max(before[s.exercise_name] || 0, s.weight_kg || 0); });
  const now = {};
  sets.filter((s) => s.session_id === latest.id && s.exercise_name).forEach((s) => { now[s.exercise_name] = Math.max(now[s.exercise_name] || 0, s.weight_kg || 0); });
  const prs = [];
  Object.keys(now).forEach((ex) => {
    if (now[ex] > 0 && (!before[ex] || now[ex] > before[ex])) {
      prs.push({ exercise: ex, newWeight: now[ex], oldWeight: before[ex] || 0, delta: +(now[ex] - (before[ex] || 0)).toFixed(1) });
    }
  });
  return prs.sort((a, b) => b.delta - a.delta).slice(0, 6);
}

import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, Pill, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Search, Users, UserPlus, Check, Clock, X, Bell, MessageCircle, Activity, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import * as social from '@/lib/social';
import ActivityFeed from '@/components/community/ActivityFeed';
import ChallengeList from '@/components/community/ChallengeList';

export default function Community() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('discover');
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState([]);
  const [follows, setFollows] = useState({});
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [feedKey, setFeedKey] = useState(0);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const myProfile = await social.ensureMyProfile();
      setMe(myProfile);
      const [all, myFollowing, reqs, notifs] = await Promise.all([
        social.listProfiles(100).catch(() => []),
        base44.entities.Follow.filter({ follower_id: myProfile?.user_id || '' }).catch(() => []),
        social.listIncomingRequests(myProfile?.user_id || '').catch(() => []),
        social.listNotifications(myProfile?.user_id || '').catch(() => []),
      ]);
      setProfiles(all || []);
      const fmap = {};
      (myFollowing || []).forEach((f) => (fmap[f.following_id] = f));
      setFollows(fmap);
      setRequests(reqs || []);
      setNotifications(notifs || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const doFollow = async (p) => {
    if (!me) return;
    const f = await social.followUser(p, me);
    setFollows((prev) => ({ ...prev, [p.user_id]: f }));
  };
  const doUnfollow = async (p) => {
    if (!me) return;
    await social.unfollowUser(p, me);
    setFollows((prev) => { const n = { ...prev }; delete n[p.user_id]; return n; });
  };
  const doCancel = async (p) => {
    if (!me) return;
    await social.cancelRequest(p, me);
    setFollows((prev) => { const n = { ...prev }; delete n[p.user_id]; return n; });
  };
  const accept = async (f) => {
    if (!me) return;
    await social.acceptRequest(f, me);
    setRequests((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== f.id));
  };
  const decline = async (f) => {
    await social.declineRequest(f);
    setRequests((prev) => prev.filter((r) => r.id !== f.id));
  };
  const openNotif = async (n) => {
    if (!n.read) await social.markNotificationRead(n.id);
    if (n.entity_type === 'profile' && n.actor_id) navigate(`/user/${n.actor_id}`);
    else if (n.entity_type === 'conversation' && n.entity_id) navigate(`/messages/${n.entity_id}`);
    else load();
  };

  const filtered = (profiles || []).filter((p) => p.user_id !== user?.id && (!q || (p.display_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()) || (p.username || '').toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))));

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'discover', label: 'Discover' },
    { id: 'feed', label: 'Feed' },
    { id: 'challenges', label: 'Challenges' },
    { id: 'requests', label: 'Requests', badge: requests.length },
    { id: 'alerts', label: 'Alerts' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="mb-4">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Community</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">Discover athletes, share progress, and compete.</p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4 no-scrollbar overflow-x-auto md:flex-wrap">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <Pill key={t.id} active={tab === t.id} onClick={() => { setTab(t.id); if (t.id === 'feed' || t.id === 'challenges') setFeedKey((k) => k + 1); }}>
            {t.label}{t.badge ? ` (${t.badge})` : ''}
          </Pill>
        ))}
      </div>

      {tab === 'discover' && (
        <>
          <div className="relative mb-3">
            <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search athletes…" className="glass pl-9 min-h-[44px]" />
          </div>
          {loading ? (
            <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-10 text-sm">Loading…</p>
          ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState icon={Users} title="No athletes yet" description="Invite friends to join LRAZ 63 to see them here." />
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {filtered.map((p) => {
                const f = follows[p.user_id];
                return (
                  <Card key={p.user_id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <button onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${p.user_id}`)} className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full luxury-gradient flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold shrink-0 overflow-hidden">
                      {p.avatar_url ? <img src={p.avatar_url} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> : (p.display_name || '?')[0]?.toUpperCase()}
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${p.user_id}`)} className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{p.display_name}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate">@{p.username || (p.user_id || '').slice(-6)} · {p.is_private ? '🔒 Private' : 'Public'}</p>
                    </button>
                    {!f ? (
                      <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => doFollow(p)}>{p.is_private ? 'Request' : 'Follow'}</Button>
                    ) : f.status === 'pending' ? (
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => doCancel(p)}><Clock size={14} /> Requested</Button>
                    ) : (
                      <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => doUnfollow(p)}><Check size={14} /> Following</Button>
                    )}
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {tab === 'feed' && <ActivityFeed refreshKey={feedKey} />}

      {tab === 'challenges' && <ChallengeList refreshKey={feedKey} />}

      {tab === 'requests' && (
        requests.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon={UserPlus} title="No pending requests" description="Follow requests to you will appear here." />
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {requests.map((f) => (
              <Card key={f.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${f.follower_id}`)} className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full luxury-gradient flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold shrink-0">
                  {(f.follower_name || '?')[0]?.toUpperCase()}
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${f.follower_id}`)} className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{f.follower_name || 'Athlete'}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">wants to follow you</p>
                </button>
                <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => accept(f)}><Check size={14} /></Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => decline(f)}><X size={14} /></Button>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        )
      )}

      {tab === 'alerts' && (
        notifications.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon={Bell} title="No alerts yet" description="Follows, likes, comments, and messages will show here." />
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {notifications.map((n) => (
              <Card key={n.id} className={cn('flex items-center gap-3', !n.read && 'border-luxury-blue/40')}>
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  {n.type === 'message' ? <MessageCircle size={16} /> : n.type === 'social' ? <Activity size={16} /> : <Bell size={16} />}
                </div>
                <button className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-left" onClick={() => openNotif(n)}>
                  <p className="text-sm">{n.text}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{new Date(n.created_date).toLocaleString()}</p>
                </button>
                {!n.read && <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-luxury-blue shrink-0" />}
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        )
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  ArrowLeft, Heart, Plus, ChevronRight, MoreHorizontal,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getAllExercises, getSubstitutions, EXERCISES, normalizeName } from '@/lib/exerciseDatabase';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import ExerciseOverviewTab from '@/components/exercises/ExerciseOverviewTab';
import ExerciseMusclesTab from '@/components/exercises/ExerciseMusclesTab';
import ExerciseTechniqueTab from '@/components/exercises/ExerciseTechniqueTab';
import ExerciseHeroImage from '@/components/exercises/ExerciseHeroImage';
import useExerciseHistoryData from '@/hooks/useExerciseHistoryData';

const TABS = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
  { id: 'muscles', label: 'Muscles' },
  { id: 'technique', label: 'Technique' },
];

function normalizeExercise(ex) {
  if (!ex) return null;
  return {
    ...ex,
    instructions: ex.instructions || ex.execution_instructions || '',
    setup: ex.setup_instructions || '',
    mistakes: ex.mistakes || ex.common_mistakes || [],
    safety: ex.safety || ex.safety_tips || [],
    coaching_cues: ex.coaching_cues || [],
    progressions: ex.progressions || [],
    regressions: ex.regressions || [],
    alternatives: ex.alternatives || [],
    rep_low: ex.rep_low ?? ex.rep_range_low,
    rep_high: ex.rep_high ?? ex.rep_range_high,
    rest: ex.rest ?? ex.rest_seconds,
  };
}

export default function ExerciseDetail() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [exercise, setExercise] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('overview');
  const [isFavorite, setIsFavorite] = useState(false);
  const performance = useExerciseHistoryData(exercise?.name, 12);
  const history = performance.points;
  const historyLoading = performance.loading;

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true);
    setTab('overview');
    const builtIn = EXERCISES.find((item) => item.slug === slug || item.canonical_id === slug);
    if (builtIn) { setExercise(normalizeExercise(builtIn)); setLoading(false); return; }
    (async () => {
      try {
        const all = await getAllExercises();
        if (!active) return;
        const found = all.find((e) => e.slug === slug || e.canonical_id === slug || String(e.id) === slug);
        setExercise(normalizeExercise(found));
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      finally { if (active) setLoading(false); }
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [slug]);



  useEffect(() => {
    if (!exercise) return;
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const favs = await base44.entities.Favorite.filter({ type: 'exercise', $or: [{ ref_id: exercise.slug }, { name: exercise.name }] }, { limit: 1, fields: ['ref_id', 'name'] });
        if (!active) return;
        setIsFavorite(favs.items.length > 0);
      } catch (e) {}
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [exercise]);

  const toggleFavorite = async () => {
    if (!exercise) return;
    try {
      if (isFavorite) {
        const favs = await base44.entities.Favorite.filter({ type: 'exercise', $or: [{ ref_id: exercise.slug }, { name: exercise.name }] }, { limit: 1 });
        const match = favs.items[0];
        if (match) await base44.entities.Favorite.delete(match.id);
        setIsFavorite(false);
      } else {
        await base44.entities.Favorite.create({ type: 'exercise', ref_id: exercise.slug, name: exercise.name, subtitle: exercise.primary_muscle });
        setIsFavorite(true);
      }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const addToWorkout = () => {
    try { localStorage.setItem('lraz_pending_exercise', JSON.stringify(exercise)); } catch (e) {}
    navigate('/workout/new');
  };

  const subs = useMemo(() => getSubstitutions(exercise, user?.equipment), [exercise, user]);
  const altExercises = useMemo(() => (exercise?.alternatives || []).map((n) => EXERCISES.find((e) => normalizeName(e.name) === normalizeName(n))).filter(Boolean), [exercise]);

  const bestE1rm = performance.bestE1rm;
  const totalVolume = performance.shownVolume;
  const prCount = performance.prCount;
  const lastSession = history[0];

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-32"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-primary/30 border-t-primary rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;
  if (!exercise) return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-10 text-center">
      <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-4">Exercise not found.</p>
      <Button onClick={() => navigate('/train')}><ArrowLeft size={16} /> Back to Training</Button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="exercise-detail force-porcelain mx-auto w-full min-w-0 max-w-[480px] pb-[calc(7rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] md:max-w-3xl">
      {/* Header — back, centered serif title, favorite + menu */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-20 bg-background/90 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between safe-pt">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center -ml-2" aria-label="Back">
          <ArrowLeft size={22} />
        </button>
        <h1 className="min-w-0 flex-1 px-2 text-center font-serif-display text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight [overflow-wrap:anywhere]">{exercise.name}</h1>
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <button onClick={toggleFavorite} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center" aria-label="Favorite">
            <Heart size={20} className={cn(isFavorite && 'fill-luxury-red text-luxury-red')} />
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => navigate('/train')} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center -mr-2" aria-label="More">
            <MoreHorizontal size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Hero image */}
      <div className="px-4 mt-3">
        <ExerciseHeroImage exercise={exercise} className="aspect-[16/10]" />
        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">{exercise.muscle_group} · {exercise.movement_pattern}</p>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs — pill container */}
      <div className="px-4 mt-4">
        <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 rounded-full bg-muted">
          {TABS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
              className={cn(
                'flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold transition-colors min-h-[44px] min-w-0',
                tab === t.id ? 'btn-gold text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground'
              )}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tab content */}
      <div className="px-4 mt-5">
        {tab === 'overview' && (
          <ExerciseOverviewTab
            exercise={exercise}
            history={history}
            historyLoading={historyLoading}
            bestE1rm={bestE1rm}
            totalVolume={totalVolume}
            prCount={prCount}
            lastSession={lastSession}
            onViewHistory={() => navigate(`/exercise-history?name=${encodeURIComponent(exercise.name)}`)}
          />
        )}
        {tab === 'muscles' && <ExerciseMusclesTab exercise={exercise} />}
        {tab === 'technique' && <ExerciseTechniqueTab exercise={exercise} />}
      </div>

      {/* Alternatives & substitutions */}
      {(altExercises.length > 0 || subs.length > 0) && (
        <div className="px-4 mt-5 space-y-4">
          {altExercises.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-card p-4">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2">Alternatives</p>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                {altExercises.map((a) => (
                  <button key={a.slug} onClick={() => navigate(`/exercise/${a.slug}`)} className="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl glass hover:bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-between min-h-[44px]">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">{a.name}</span>
                    <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-muted-foreground" />
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {subs.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-card p-4">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1">Smart Substitutions</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">Same primary muscle and movement pattern.</p>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                {subs.slice(0, 5).map((s) => (
                  <button key={s.slug} onClick={() => navigate(`/exercise/${s.slug}`)} className="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl glass hover:bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-between min-h-[44px]">
                    <div className="min-w-0"><p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{s.name}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{(s.equipment || []).join(' · ')}</p></div>
                    <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Sticky Add to Workout */}
      <div className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-30 px-4 pb-[calc(1rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] pt-3 bg-background border-t border-border/50">
        <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[448px] md:max-w-3xl">
          <Button onClick={addToWorkout} className="w-full btn-gold min-h-[52px] text-base font-semibold">
            <Plus size={18} /> Add to Workout
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/ExerciseHistory.jsx

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card, Stat, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { ArrowLeft, Dumbbell, TrendingUp, Trophy, Activity } from 'lucide-react';
import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid } from 'recharts';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import useExerciseHistoryData from '@/hooks/useExerciseHistoryData';

export default function ExerciseHistory() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const name = params.get('name') || '';
  const data = useExerciseHistoryData(name);
  const { points, loading } = data;
  const summary = { totalSets: data.totalSets ?? '—', totalVolume: data.shownVolume, bestE1rm: data.bestE1rm, prCount: data.prCount };
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    const byDate = {};
    points.forEach((point) => { byDate[point.date] = Math.max(byDate[point.date] || 0, point.e1rm); });
    return Object.entries(byDate).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([date, e1rm]) => ({ date: date.slice(5), e1rm }));
  }, [points]);

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-20"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-semibold text-lg leading-tight">{name}</h1>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Exercise History</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {data.error && <p role="alert" className="mb-3 text-sm text-destructive">History could not fully load. <button onClick={() => data.retry()} className="min-h-11 underline">Retry</button></p>}
      {!points.length ? (
        <EmptyState icon={Dumbbell} title="No history yet" description={`You haven't logged any sets of ${name}. Start a workout and add this exercise to build its history.`} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-4">
            <Card><Stat label="Best e1RM" value={summary.bestE1rm} unit="kg" accent="blue" /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="Shown Volume" value={summary.totalVolume} unit="kg" accent="red" /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="Sets Logged" value={summary.totalSets} /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="PRs" value={summary.prCount} /></Card>
          </div>

          {chartData.length > 1 && (
            <Card className="mb-4">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><TrendingUp size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Estimated 1RM Trend</p>
              <div className="h-40">
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                  <LineChart data={chartData}>
                    <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" />
                    <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                    <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} domain={['dataMin - 5', 'dataMax + 5']} />
                    <Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: 'hsl(var(--card))', border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12 }} />
                    <Line isAnimationActive={false} type="monotone" dataKey="e1rm" stroke="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" strokeWidth={2.5} dot={{ r: 3 }} />
                  </LineChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}

          <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2 px-1">Recent Sets</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
            {points.map((p, i) => (
              <Card key={i} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2.5">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg glass flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Activity size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /></div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{p.weight}kg × {p.reps} reps</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{p.date} · {p.volume}kg volume</p>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-gradient-blue">{p.e1rm}kg</p>
                  {p.isPr && <p className="text-[10px] text-luxury-gold flex items-center gap-0.5 justify-end"><Trophy size={10} /> PR</p>}
                </div>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
          {data.hasMore && <Button variant="outline" className="mt-4 w-full" disabled={data.loadingMore} onClick={() => data.loadMore()}>{data.loadingMore ? 'Loading…' : 'Load earlier sets'}</Button>}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card, Pill, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Dumbbell, Search, Plus, SlidersHorizontal, X, Check, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getAllExercises, searchExercises, clearExerciseCache, EQUIPMENT_OPTIONS, MOVEMENT_PATTERNS, DIFFICULTY_LEVELS } from '@/lib/exerciseDatabase';
import CreateExerciseSheet from '@/components/exercises/CreateExerciseSheet';

const MUSCLE_PILLS = ['All', 'Chest', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Biceps', 'Triceps', 'Quads', 'Hamstrings', 'Glutes', 'Calves', 'Core', 'Forearms', 'Full Body', 'Cardio'];

export default function ExerciseLibrary() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [exercises, setExercises] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const deferredQuery = useDeferredValue(query);
  const [visibleExercises, setVisibleExercises] = useState(40);
  const [muscle, setMuscle] = useState('All');
  const [equipment, setEquipment] = useState('All');
  const [movement, setMovement] = useState('All');
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState('All');
  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    getAllExercises().then((items) => { if (active) { setExercises(items); setLoading(false); } });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [creating]);

  useEffect(() => { setVisibleExercises(40); }, [query, muscle, equipment, movement, difficulty]);

  const exerciseMatches = useMemo(() => searchExercises(deferredQuery, { muscle, equipment, movement, difficulty }, exercises), [deferredQuery, muscle, equipment, movement, difficulty, exercises]);
  const filteredExercises = exerciseMatches.slice(0, visibleExercises);
  const activeFilterCount = [equipment, movement, difficulty].filter((f) => f !== 'All').length;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-6 pb-36">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/train')} className="glass rounded-xl w-11 h-11 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] shrink-0"><ArrowLeft size={18} /></button>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">Training</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">Exercises</h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mb-3">
        <Search size={16} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search exercises…" className="pl-9 glass min-h-[48px]" />
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar mb-3">
        {MUSCLE_PILLS.map((m) => <Pill key={m} active={muscle === m} onClick={() => setMuscle(m)}>{m}</Pill>)}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setFiltersOpen(true)}>
          <SlidersHorizontal size={14} /> Filters{activeFilterCount > 0 && <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] bg-luxury-blue text-white rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5">{activeFilterCount}</span>}
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setCreating(true)}><Plus size={14} /> Create</Button>
      </div>

      <LibraryView exercises={filteredExercises} loading={loading} onOpen={(ex) => navigate(`/exercise/${ex.slug || ex.id}`)} totalCount={exerciseMatches.length} />
      {filteredExercises.length < exerciseMatches.length && <Button variant="outline" className="mt-4 w-full min-h-[48px]" onClick={() => setVisibleExercises((count) => count + 40)}>Load more</Button>}

      {creating && <CreateExerciseSheet onClose={() => setCreating(false)} onCreated={() => { clearExerciseCache(); }} />}
      {filtersOpen && (
        <FiltersSheet equipment={equipment} setEquipment={setEquipment} movement={movement} setMovement={setMovement}
          difficulty={difficulty} setDifficulty={setDifficulty} onClose={() => setFiltersOpen(false)} onClear={() => { setEquipment('All'); setMovement('All'); setDifficulty('All'); }} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const ExerciseRow = React.memo(function ExerciseRow({ ex, onOpen }) {
  return (
    <Card className="p-3 hover:border-luxury-blue/40 transition-all cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onOpen(ex)}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <p className="font-medium text-sm truncate">{ex.name}{ex.custom && <span className="ml-2 text-[9px] font-bold bg-luxury-gold/15 text-luxury-gold rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 align-middle">CUSTOM</span>}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 truncate">{ex.primary_muscle} · {ex.movement_pattern} · {(ex.equipment || []).join(', ') || '—'}</p>
        </div>
        <span className={cn('text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0 ml-2',
          ex.difficulty === 'Beginner' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400' :
          ex.difficulty === 'Intermediate' ? 'bg-luxury-gold/10 text-luxury-gold' :
          ex.difficulty === 'Advanced' ? 'bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-400' :
          'bg-luxury-red/10 text-luxury-red')}>{ex.difficulty}</span>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
});

function LibraryView({ exercises, loading, onOpen, totalCount }) {
  if (loading) return <div className="py-16 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">Loading library…</div>;
  if (!exercises.length) return <EmptyState icon={Dumbbell} title="No exercises found" description="Try a different search or filter." />;
  return (
    <>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">{exercises.length} of {totalCount} exercises</p>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
        {exercises.map((ex) => <ExerciseRow key={ex.slug || ex.id} ex={ex} onOpen={onOpen} />)}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function FiltersSheet({ equipment, setEquipment, movement, setMovement, difficulty, setDifficulty, onClose, onClear }) {
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 pb-32 max-h-[85dvh] overflow-y-auto animate-fade-up">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Filters</h3>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClear} className="text-xs min-h-[40px]">Clear</Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <FilterGroup label="Equipment" options={EQUIPMENT_OPTIONS} value={equipment} onChange={setEquipment} />
        <FilterGroup label="Movement Pattern" options={MOVEMENT_PATTERNS} value={movement} onChange={setMovement} />
        <FilterGroup label="Difficulty" options={DIFFICULTY_LEVELS} value={difficulty} onChange={setDifficulty} />
        <Button onClick={onClose} className="w-full mt-4 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]"><Check size={16} /> Apply</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FilterGroup({ label, options, value, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-4">
      <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2">{label}</p>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
        {options.map((o) => (
          <button key={o} onClick={() => onChange(o)} className={cn('text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border transition-all min-h-[36px]', value === o ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue' : 'border-border glass text-muted-foreground')}>{o}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { ArrowLeft, Dumbbell, Apple, Star, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function Favorites() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [favs, setFavs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    try { setFavs((await base44.entities.Favorite.list('-created_date', 200)) || []); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const remove = async (f) => {
    try { await base44.entities.Favorite.delete(f.id); setFavs((p) => p.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id)); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const exercises = useMemo(() => favs.filter((f) => f.type === 'exercise'), [favs]);
  const foods = useMemo(() => favs.filter((f) => f.type === 'food'), [favs]);

  const open = (f) => {
    if (f.type === 'exercise') navigate(`/exercise-history?name=${encodeURIComponent(f.name)}`);
    else navigate('/nutrition');
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-20"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">Favorites</h1>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{favs.length} saved</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {!favs.length ? (
        <EmptyState icon={Star} title="No favorites yet" description="Tap the star on any exercise or food in Search to pin it here for quick access." />
      ) : (
        <>
          {exercises.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mb-5">
              <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2 px-1">Exercises ({exercises.length})</p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {exercises.map((f) => (
                  <Card key={f.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <button onClick={() => open(f)} className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-luxury-blue/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Dumbbell size={18} className="text-luxury-blue" /></div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"><p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{f.name}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{f.subtitle}</p></div>
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => remove(f)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[44px] min-w-[40px] flex items-center justify-center"><X size={15} /></button>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {foods.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2 px-1">Foods ({foods.length})</p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {foods.map((f) => (
                  <Card key={f.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <button onClick={() => open(f)} className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-luxury-red/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Apple size={18} className="text-luxury-red" /></div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0"><p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{f.name}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{f.subtitle}</p></div>
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => remove(f)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[44px] min-w-[40px] flex items-center justify-center"><X size={15} /></button>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/FollowList.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ArrowLeft, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import * as social from '@/lib/social';

export default function FollowList() {
  const { userId, type } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const list = type === 'followers' ? await social.listFollowers(userId) : await social.listFollowing(userId);
        const idList = (list || []).map((f) => (type === 'followers' ? f.follower_id : f.following_id));
        const profs = [];
        for (const id of idList) { const p = await social.getProfile(id); if (p) profs.push(p); }
        setProfiles(profs);
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      finally { setLoading(false); }
    })();
  }, [userId, type]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] flex items-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground mb-3"><ArrowLeft size={18} /> Back</button>
      <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-3 capitalize">{type}</h1>
      {loading ? (
        <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8 text-sm">Loading…</p>
      ) : profiles.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon={Users} title={`No ${type} yet`} />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {profiles.map((p) => (
            <Card key={p.user_id} className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${p.user_id}`)}>
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full luxury-gradient flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold shrink-0">{(p.display_name || '?')[0]?.toUpperCase()}</div>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{p.display_name}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{p.is_private ? '🔒 Private' : 'Public profile'}</p>
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/ForgotPassword.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Mail, ArrowLeft, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";

export default function ForgotPassword() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.resetPasswordRequest(email);
    } catch {
      // Always show success regardless
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setSent(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={Mail}
      title="Reset password"
      subtitle="We'll send you a link to reset it"
      footer={
        <Link to="/login" className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline">
          <ArrowLeft className="w-3 h-3 inline mr-1" />Back to log in
        </Link>
      }
    >
      {sent ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-foreground text-center">
          If an account exists with that email, you'll receive a password reset link shortly.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="email">Email address</Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
              <Input
                id="email"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                autoFocus
                placeholder="you@example.com"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-10 h-12"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                Sending...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Send reset link"
            )}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/GoalJourney.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, Ring, EmptyState, ConfidenceBadge } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ChevronLeft, Target, TrendingUp, Activity, Dumbbell, Apple, Scale, Heart, Info, Flag, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { computeJourney, fmtKg, fmtDur, fmtDate } from '@/lib/goalJourney';
import { formatDistance } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { getGoalFeedback } from '@/lib/feedbackMessages';

export default function GoalJourney() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [goals, measurements, workouts, sets, cardio, nutrition, scheduled, programs] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 1000),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.TrainingProgram.list('-created_date', 50),
      ]);
      const goal = goals[0];
      const activeProgram = (programs || []).find((p) => p.days_per_week);
      setData(computeJourney({
        goal, measurements: measurements || [], workouts: workouts || [], sets: sets || [],
        cardio: cardio || [], nutrition: nutrition || [], scheduled: scheduled || [],
        programDaysPerWeek: activeProgram?.days_per_week,
      }));
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;
  if (!data || !data.goal) return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
      <Header onBack={() => navigate('/progress')} />
      <EmptyState icon={Target} title="No active goal" description="Set a goal with a target weight in Profile → Goals & Targets to see your journey and contribution report." action={<Button className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue mt-4 min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/profile')}>Set a Goal</Button>} />
    </div>
  );

  const j = data;
  const lossLabel = j.isLoss ? 'Lost' : j.isGain ? 'Gained' : 'Change';

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
      <Header onBack={() => navigate('/progress')} />

      {/* Weight goal overview */}
      <Card className="mb-4 luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/30">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Ring value={j.progressPct} label="progress" size={104} color="blue" />
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
            <Row label="Starting" value={fmtKg(j.startWeight)} />
            <Row label="Current" value={fmtKg(j.currentWeight)} accent />
            <Row label="Goal" value={fmtKg(j.targetWeight)} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-white/10">
          <div><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-white/50">{lossLabel}</p><p className="text-lg font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{j.change != null ? `${j.change > 0 ? '+' : ''}${(Math.round(j.change * 10) / 10).toFixed(1)} kg` : '—'}</p></div>
          <div><p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-white/50">Remaining</p><p className="text-lg font-bold text-luxury-red tabular-nums">{j.remaining != null ? fmtKg(j.remaining) : '—'}</p></div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* Status + why */}
      <Card className="mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Goal Status</p>
          <StatusBadge status={j.status} />
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{j.statusReason || 'Set a target weight and target date for a status estimate.'}</p>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2 flex items-start gap-1"><Info size={11} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> Status compares your recent weight trend to your selected rate preference. This is not medical advice.</p>
      </Card>

      {(() => { const fb = getGoalFeedback({ progressPct: j.progressPct, status: j.status }); return fb ? <Card className="mb-4 border-luxury-blue/20 bg-luxury-blue/5"><p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1">{fb.title}</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">{fb.message}</p></Card> : null; })()}

      {/* Trend + projection */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">
        <Card>
          <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">7-Day Trend</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums">{j.trendWt != null ? fmtKg(j.trendWt) : '—'}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Smooths daily water fluctuation</p>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Weekly Rate</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums">{j.rate ? `${j.rate > 0 ? '+' : ''}${(Math.round(j.rate * 100) / 100).toFixed(2)} kg` : '—'}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">4-week recent average</p>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {j.projectedDate && (
        <Card className="mb-4 border-luxury-blue/30">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2"><Calendar size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Projected Goal Date</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold mt-1">{fmtDate(j.projectedDate)}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">Based on your recent trend of ~{Math.abs(j.rate).toFixed(2)} kg/week. <span className="text-luxury-gold">This is a projection, not a guarantee.</span></p>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Weight timeline */}
      {j.weightTimeline.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="mb-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Weight Timeline</p>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <TimelineRow label="Start" value={fmtKg(j.startWeight)} date={fmtDate(j.start)} />
            {j.weightTimeline.slice(1, -1).map((p, i) => (
              <TimelineRow key={i} label="" value={fmtKg(p.weight_kg)} date={fmtDate(p.date)} muted />
            ))}
            {j.currentWeight !== j.startWeight && <TimelineRow label="Current" value={fmtKg(j.currentWeight)} date={fmtDate(j.now)} accent />}
            <TimelineRow label="Goal" value={fmtKg(j.targetWeight)} date="Target" goal />
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* What contributed — trust-safe */}
      <Card className="mb-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1">Activities During Your Goal Period</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Everything you consistently did between {fmtKg(j.startWeight)} and {fmtKg(j.currentWeight)}. Weight change is influenced by many factors — these are activities associated with the period, not causes.</p>

        <Contrib icon={Activity} title="Cardio" rows={[
          ['Sessions', `${j.cardio.sessions}`],
          ['Total time', fmtDur(j.cardio.totalSeconds)],
          ['Distance', `${formatDistance(j.cardio.distance)} km`],
          ['Calories', `${Math.round(j.cardio.calories)} kcal`],
          ['Source', j.cardio.rec > 0 && j.cardio.est > 0 ? 'est + recorded' : j.cardio.est > 0 ? 'estimated' : 'recorded'],
          ['Avg / week', `${(Math.round(j.cardio.avgPerWeek * 10) / 10).toFixed(1)} sessions`],
        ]} />

        <Contrib icon={Dumbbell} title="Strength Training" rows={[
          ['Workouts', `${j.strength.workouts}`],
          ['Exercises', `${j.strength.exercises}`],
          ['Total sets', `${j.strength.sets}`],
          ['Total volume', `${Math.round(j.strength.volume).toLocaleString()} kg`],
          ['PRs', `${j.strength.prs}`],
          ['Adherence', `${Math.round(j.strength.adherence * 100)}%`],
        ]} />

        <Contrib icon={Apple} title="Nutrition" rows={[
          ['Avg daily calories', `${Math.round(j.nutrition.avgCalories)} kcal`],

          ['Weight entries', `${j.body.entries}`],
        ]} />
      </Card>

      {/* What you did — habits */}
      <Card className="mb-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Habits You Performed</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">These are the habits you consistently performed during your goal period.</p>

          <HabitRow icon={Activity} label="Cardio" value={`${j.habits.cardioSessions} sessions`} />
          <HabitRow icon={Apple} label="Nutrition Tracking" value={`${j.habits.nutritionTracking.done} / ${j.habits.nutritionTracking.total} days`} />
          <HabitRow icon={Heart} label="Protein Goal" value={`${j.habits.proteinGoal.done} / ${j.habits.proteinGoal.total} days`} />
          <HabitRow icon={Scale} label="Daily Weight Logs" value={`${j.habits.weightLogs} entries`} />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card className="mb-4 border-luxury-gold/20">
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-1.5"><Info size={13} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-luxury-gold" /> LRAZ 63 does not claim any single activity caused a specific amount of weight change. Weight is affected by nutrition, training, sleep, stress, hydration, hormones, and more. This report documents what you did — your consistency is what you can control.</p>
      </Card>

      <Button variant="outline" className="w-full glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/progress')}><ChevronLeft size={16} /> Back to Progress</Button>
    </div>
  );
}

  return <span className={cn('text-[11px] font-medium px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full', map[status] || map['On Track'])}>{status}</span>;
}

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { ArrowLeft, Heart } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const ZONES = [
  { name: 'Zone 1', label: 'Very Light', pct: [50, 60], color: 'bg-sky-500', desc: 'Recovery, warm-up' },
  { name: 'Zone 2', label: 'Light', pct: [60, 70], color: 'bg-emerald-500', desc: 'Endurance, fat burn' },
  { name: 'Zone 3', label: 'Moderate', pct: [70, 80], color: 'bg-luxury-gold', desc: 'Aerobic, tempo' },
  { name: 'Zone 4', label: 'Hard', pct: [80, 90], color: 'bg-orange-500', desc: 'Anaerobic threshold' },
  { name: 'Zone 5', label: 'Max', pct: [90, 100], color: 'bg-luxury-red', desc: 'VO2 max, intervals' },
];

export default function HRZones() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [age, setAge] = useState('');
  const [resting, setResting] = useState('');

  const maxHr = useMemo(() => (age ? Math.round(220 - Number(age)) : null), [age]);

  const zones = useMemo(() => {
    if (!maxHr) return [];
    return ZONES.map((z) => {
      const low = Math.round((z.pct[0] / 100) * maxHr);
      const high = Math.round((z.pct[1] / 100) * maxHr);
      return { ...z, low, high };
    });
  }, [maxHr]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">Heart Rate Zones</h1>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Determine your training zones</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Age</Label><Input type="number" value={age} onChange={(e) => setAge(e.target.value)} placeholder="30" className="glass" /></div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Resting HR (optional)</Label><Input type="number" value={resting} onChange={(e) => setResting(e.target.value)} placeholder="60" className="glass" /></div>
        </div>
        {maxHr && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-3">Estimated Max HR: <span className="font-bold text-luxury-blue">{maxHr} bpm</span> <span className="text-[10px]">(220 − age)</span></p>}
      </Card>

      {!zones.length ? (
        <Card className="text-center py-8"><Heart size={28} className="text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-2" /><p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Enter your age to calculate zones.</p></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
          {zones.map((z) => (
            <Card key={z.name} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className={cn('w-2.5 h-12 rounded-full shrink-0', z.color)} />
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{z.name} · {z.label}</p>
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums">{z.low}–{z.high} bpm</p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{z.desc}</p>
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground text-center mt-3">Zones use the simple % of max HR method. For precision, use Karvonen (with resting HR) or a lab test. Estimates, not medical guidance.</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Habits.jsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { ListChecks, Plus, X, Check, Trash2, Flame } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast';
import { getHabitFeedback } from '@/lib/feedbackMessages';

const todayStr = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

export default function Habits() {
  const [habits, setHabits] = useState([]);
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [h, l] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Habit.list('-created_date', 100),
        base44.entities.HabitLog.list('-date', 120),
      ]);
      setHabits(h || []);
      setLogs(l || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const logsByHabit = useMemo(() => {
    const m = {};
    (logs || []).forEach((log) => {
      if (!m[log.habit_id]) m[log.habit_id] = new Set();
      m[log.habit_id].add(log.date);
    });
    return m;
  }, [logs]);

  const streakFor = (habitId) => {
    const set = logsByHabit[habitId];
    if (!set) return 0;
    let streak = 0;
    const d = new Date();
    // if today not done, start from yesterday so streak isn't broken mid-day
    if (!set.has(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10))) d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1);
    while (set.has(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10))) { streak++; d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); }
    return streak;
  };

  const toggle = async (habit) => {
    const today = todayStr();
    const done = logsByHabit[habit.id]?.has(today);
    try {
      if (done) {
        const log = logs.find((l) => l.habit_id === habit.id && l.date === today);
        if (log) { await base44.entities.HabitLog.delete(log.id); setLogs((p) => p.filter((l) => l.id !== log.id)); }
      } else {
        const created = await base44.entities.HabitLog.create({ habit_id: habit.id, date: today, completed: true, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
        setLogs((p) => [created, ...p]);
        const newStreak = (() => { const set = new Set(logsByHabit[habit.id] || []); set.add(today); let s = 0; const d = new Date(); while (set.has(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10))) { s++; d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); } return s; })();
        const fb = getHabitFeedback({ streak: newStreak, habitName: habit.name });
        if (fb) toast({ title: fb.title, description: fb.message });
      }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const remove = async (habit) => {
    try {
      await base44.entities.HabitLog.deleteMany({ habit_id: habit.id });
      await base44.entities.Habit.delete(habit.id);
      setHabits((p) => p.filter((h) => h.id !== habit.id));
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const completedToday = habits.filter((h) => logsByHabit[h.id]?.has(todayStr())).length;

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-20"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Habits</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{completedToday}/{habits.length} done today</p>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => setAdding(true)}><Plus size={16} /> New</Button>
      </div>

      {!habits.length ? (
        <EmptyState icon={ListChecks} title="No habits yet" description="Build daily consistency — add water intake, sleep, mobility, or any habit to track streaks." action={<Button className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px] mt-2" onClick={() => setAdding(true)}><Plus size={16} /> Add First Habit</Button>} />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
          {habits.map((h) => {
            const done = logsByHabit[h.id]?.has(todayStr());
            const streak = streakFor(h.id);
            return (
              <Card key={h.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button onClick={() => toggle(h)} className={cn(
                  'w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-all min-h-[44px]',
                  done ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white glow-blue' : 'glass text-muted-foreground border border-border'
                )}>
                  <Check size={22} strokeWidth={done ? 3 : 2} />
                </button>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{h.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">{h.description || `${h.target_per_day}× / ${h.frequency}`}{streak > 0 && <><Flame size={11} className="text-luxury-red" /> {streak} day streak</>}</p>
                </div>
                <button onClick={() => remove(h)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[44px] min-w-[40px] flex items-center justify-center"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {adding && <AddHabitSheet onClose={() => setAdding(false)} onSaved={() => { setAdding(false); load(); }} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function AddHabitSheet({ onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', description: '', target_per_day: 1, frequency: 'daily' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const set = (k, v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await base44.entities.Habit.create({ ...form, target_per_day: Number(form.target_per_day) || 1, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
      onSaved();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 animate-fade-up safe-pb">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">New Habit</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Field label="Name"><Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Drink 3L Water" /></Field>
          <Field label="Description (optional)"><Input value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Morning and evening" /></Field>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <Field label="Target / day"><Input type="number" value={form.target_per_day} onChange={(e) => set('target_per_day', e.target.value)} /></Field>
            <Field label="Frequency">
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {['daily', 'weekly'].map((f) => (
                  <button key={f} onClick={() => set('frequency', f)} className={cn('flex-1 min-h-[44px] rounded-lg text-xs font-medium capitalize', form.frequency === f ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>{f}</button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Field>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving || !form.name} className="w-full mt-4 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]">{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Add Habit</>}</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({ label, children }) {
  return <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>{children}</div>;
}
