import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Card, Ring } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Flame, Dumbbell, TrendingUp, ChevronRight, Trophy, ArrowRight, AlertTriangle, Target, Scale, Plus, Sparkles, Activity, LayoutGrid, Bell, Apple, Droplets } from 'lucide-react';
import { trendDirection } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';
import {
  MUSCLE_GROUPS, computeMuscleRecovery, computeReadiness, computeBestLifts, detectPlateaus,
  detectWeakPoints, computeVolumeByMuscle, computeNutritionTrends, recommendTodaysWorkout,
  generateInsights, computeGoalStatus,
} from '@/lib/performanceAnalytics';
import ReadinessCheckIn from '@/components/recovery/ReadinessCheckIn';
import WeeklyReview from '@/components/recovery/WeeklyReview';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import PullToRefresh from '@/components/PullToRefresh';
import GoalStatusBadge from '@/components/home/GoalStatusBadge';
import HomeCustomizeSheet from '@/components/home/HomeCustomizeSheet';
import { computeReminders, fireBrowserNotifications } from '@/lib/reminders';
import { getDailySummary } from '@/lib/feedbackMessages';

const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const DAY = 86400000;
const INSIGHT_ICONS = { alert: AlertTriangle, flame: Flame, target: Target, trending: TrendingUp, scale: Scale };

function recPct(m) {
  if (!m || m.hoursSince == null) return null;
  return Math.min(98, Math.round((m.hoursSince / 72) * 100));
}

export default function Home() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState(null);
  const [measurements, setMeasurements] = useState([]);
  const [nutrition, setNutrition] = useState([]);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState([]);
  const [sets, setSets] = useState([]);
  const [recovery, setRecovery] = useState(null);
  const [achievements, setAchievements] = useState([]);
  const [scheduled, setScheduled] = useState(null);
  const [programs, setPrograms] = useState([]);
  const [cardio, setCardio] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [checkIn, setCheckIn] = useState(false);
  const [review, setReview] = useState(false);
  const [customize, setCustomize] = useState(false);
  const [cardConfig, setCardConfig] = useState(() => {
    const defaults = { readiness: true, insights: true, bestLifts: true, achievements: false };
    try { return { ...defaults, ...(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lraz_home_cards') || '{}')) }; }
    catch (e) { return defaults; }
  });
  const updateCardConfig = (cfg) => { setCardConfig(cfg); try { localStorage.setItem('lraz_home_cards', JSON.stringify(cfg)); } catch (e) {} };
  const cardVisible = (id) => cardConfig[id] !== false;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user && !user.onboarding_completed) { navigate('/onboarding'); return; }
    loadAll();
  }, [user]);

  const loadAll = async () => {
    try {
      const [goals, meas, nut, sess, st, recs, achs, sched, progs, card] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 30),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 60),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 300),
        base44.entities.RecoveryRecord.list('-date', 7),
        base44.entities.Achievement.list('-created_date', 6),
        base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.filter({ date: TODAY, completed: false }, '-date', 1),
        base44.entities.TrainingProgram.list('-created_date', 5),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 60),
      ]);
      setGoal(goals[0] || null);
      setMeasurements(meas || []);
      setNutrition(nut || []);
      setSessions(sess || []);
      setSets(st || []);
      setRecovery(recs?.[0] || null);
      setAchievements(achs || []);
      setScheduled(sched?.[0] || null);
      setPrograms(progs || []);
      setCardio(card || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const weights = useMemo(() => measurements.map((m) => m.weight_kg).filter(Boolean).reverse(), [measurements]);
  const latestWeight = weights[weights.length - 1] || user?.weight_kg;
  const trend = trendDirection(weights);

  const muscleRecovery = useMemo(() => computeMuscleRecovery(sessions, sets, recovery), [sessions, sets, recovery]);
  const readiness = useMemo(() => {
    const r = computeReadiness(recovery, sessions);
    if (r != null) return r;
    const known = MUSCLE_GROUPS.filter((m) => muscleRecovery[m]?.hoursSince != null);
    if (!known.length) return null;
    const ready = known.filter((m) => muscleRecovery[m].status === 'ready').length;
    return Math.round((ready / known.length) * 100);
  }, [recovery, sessions, muscleRecovery]);
  const monthlyVolume = useMemo(() => computeVolumeByMuscle(sessions, sets, 30), [sessions, sets]);
  const weakPoints = useMemo(() => detectWeakPoints(monthlyVolume), [monthlyVolume]);
  const bestLifts = useMemo(() => computeBestLifts(sets), [sets]);
  const plateaus = useMemo(() => detectPlateaus(sessions, sets), [sessions, sets]);
  const nutritionTrends = useMemo(() => computeNutritionTrends(nutrition, goal, 7), [nutrition, goal]);
  const todaysWorkout = useMemo(() => recommendTodaysWorkout({ muscleRecovery, weakPoints, scheduledToday: scheduled, lastWorkout: sessions[0] }), [muscleRecovery, weakPoints, scheduled, sessions]);
  const insights = useMemo(() => generateInsights({ muscleRecovery, nutritionTrends, weakPoints, plateaus, goal, weights }), [muscleRecovery, nutritionTrends, weakPoints, plateaus, goal, weights]);
  const goalStatus = useMemo(() => computeGoalStatus(goal, weights), [goal, weights]);

  const reminders = useMemo(() => computeReminders({ goal, sessions, nutrition, scheduled, recovery, measurements, cardio }), [goal, sessions, nutrition, scheduled, recovery, measurements, cardio]);
  useEffect(() => { fireBrowserNotifications(reminders); }, [reminders]);

  const todayStrength = useMemo(() => sessions.find((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date && s.date.slice(0, 10) === TODAY), [sessions]);

  const nutritionTotals = useMemo(() => nutrition.filter((n) => n.date === TODAY).reduce((acc, n) => ({
    calories: acc.calories + (n.calories || 0), protein: acc.protein + (n.protein_g || 0),
    carbs: acc.carbs + (n.carbs_g || 0), fat: acc.fat + (n.fat_g || 0),
  }), { calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0 }), [nutrition]);

  const completedThisWeek = useMemo(() => sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && Date.now() - new Date(s.date).getTime() < 7 * DAY).length, [sessions]);
  const targetDays = goal?.days_per_week || user?.days_per_week || 4;

  const streak = useMemo(() => {
    const weeks = {};
    sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date).forEach((s) => {
      const d = new Date(s.date);
      const key = `${d.getFullYear()}-${getWeek(d)}`;
      weeks[key] = true;
    });
    let count = 0;
    let cursor = new Date();
    if (weeks[`${cursor.getFullYear()}-${getWeek(cursor)}`]) count++;
    cursor = new Date(cursor.getTime() - 7 * DAY);
    while (weeks[`${cursor.getFullYear()}-${getWeek(cursor)}`]) { count++; cursor = new Date(cursor.getTime() - 7 * DAY); }
    return count;
  }, [sessions]);

  const volumeChange = useMemo(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const thisWk = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date && now - new Date(s.date).getTime() < 7 * DAY).reduce((a, s) => a + (s.total_volume_kg || 0), 0);
    const lastWk = sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed' && s.date).filter((s) => { const t = now - new Date(s.date).getTime(); return t >= 7 * DAY && t < 14 * DAY; }).reduce((a, s) => a + (s.total_volume_kg || 0), 0);
    return lastWk ? Math.round(((thisWk - lastWk) / lastWk) * 100) : null;
  }, [sessions]);

  const strengthProgress = useMemo(() => {
    const dates = {};
    sessions.forEach((s) => { if (s.id && s.date) dates[s.id] = new Date(s.date).getTime(); });
    const now = Date.now();
    const recent = {}, older = {};
    sets.forEach((s) => {
      const t = dates[s.session_id]; if (!t || !s.exercise_name) return;
      const w = s.weight_kg || 0;
      if (t >= now - 21 * DAY) recent[s.exercise_name] = Math.max(recent[s.exercise_name] || 0, w);
      else if (t >= now - 63 * DAY) older[s.exercise_name] = Math.max(older[s.exercise_name] || 0, w);
    });
    let best = null;
    Object.keys(recent).forEach((ex) => {
      if (older[ex]) {
        const delta = +(recent[ex] - older[ex]).toFixed(1);
        if (delta > 0 && (!best || delta > best.delta)) best = { exercise: ex, delta, recent: recent[ex], older: older[ex] };
      }
    });
    return best;
  }, [sets, sessions]);

  const todayProgramDay = useMemo(() => {
    if (!scheduled?.program_id) return null;
    const prog = programs.find((p) => p.id === scheduled.program_id);
    if (!prog?.days) return null;
    return prog.days[scheduled.day_index] || null;
  }, [scheduled, programs]);

  const startWorkoutUrl = useMemo(() => {
    if (scheduled?.program_id && scheduled.day_index != null) return `/workout/new?programId=${scheduled.program_id}&dayIndex=${scheduled.day_index}`;
    return '/workout/new';
  }, [scheduled]);

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  const hasWorkouts = sessions.length > 0;

  return (
    <PullToRefresh onRefresh={loadAll}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-6 pb-36">
        <Header user={user} onCustomize={() => setCustomize(true)} onNotifications={() => navigate('/notifications')} count={reminders.length} />

        {/* Daily feedback */}
        {(() => {
          const fb = getDailySummary({ workoutsToday: todayStrength ? 1 : 0, calories: nutritionTotals.calories, calorieTarget: goal?.calorie_target, habitsDone: 0, habitsTotal: 0, streak });
          return fb ? (
            <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-3 mb-4 border-primary/20 flex items-center gap-2.5 animate-fade-up">
              <Sparkles size={16} className="text-primary shrink-0" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold">{fb.title}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">{fb.message}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null;
        })()}

        {/* 1 — Today's Focus (Hero) */}
        <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-primary/30 mb-4 animate-fade-up">
          {hasWorkouts || scheduled ? (
            <>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-white/60 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">{scheduled ? 'Scheduled' : 'Recommended'}</p>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">{todaysWorkout.focus}</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-white/75 mt-1 leading-relaxed">{todaysWorkout.reason}</p>
              {todayProgramDay && <p className="text-xs text-white/60 mt-2">{todayProgramDay.exercises?.length || 0} exercises · {todayProgramDay.focus || ''}</p>}
              <Button size="lg" className="w-full mt-4 h-12 font-semibold" onClick={() => navigate(startWorkoutUrl)}>
                <Dumbbell size={18} /> Start Workout <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </Button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Welcome to LRAZ 63</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-white/75 mt-1 leading-relaxed">Complete your first workout to start tracking strength, recovery and progress.</p>
              <Button size="lg" className="w-full mt-4 h-12 font-semibold" onClick={() => navigate('/workout/new')}>
                <Dumbbell size={18} /> Start First Workout
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* 2 — Quick Actions */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 mb-5">
          <QuickTile icon={Dumbbell} label="Train" onClick={() => navigate('/train')} />
          <QuickTile icon={Apple} label="Fuel" onClick={() => navigate('/nutrition')} />
          <QuickTile icon={Activity} label="Cardio" onClick={() => navigate('/cardio')} />
          <QuickTile icon={Scale} label="Progress" onClick={() => navigate('/progress')} />
        </div>

        {/* 3 — Daily Targets */}
        <SectionLabel action={() => navigate('/nutrition')}>Daily Targets</SectionLabel>
        <Card className="mb-4">
          {goal?.calorie_target ? (
            <>
              <div className="flex items-end justify-between mb-3">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(nutritionTotals.calories).toLocaleString()}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">/ {Math.round(goal.calorie_target).toLocaleString()} kcal · {Math.max(0, Math.round(goal.calorie_target - nutritionTotals.calories)).toLocaleString()} left</p>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-primary">{Math.round(nutritionTotals.protein)}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">g</span></p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">/ {Math.round(goal.protein_target_g)}g protein</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/40 overflow-hidden">
                <div className="h-full bg-primary transition-all" style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (nutritionTotals.calories / (goal.calorie_target || 1)) * 100)}%` }} />
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Start tracking nutrition</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Set a goal to see daily calorie and macro targets.</p>
              <Button variant="outline" className="w-full mt-3 glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/nutrition')}><Plus size={16} /> Log Food</Button>
            </>
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* 4 — This Week */}
        <SectionLabel action={() => setReview(true)}>This Week</SectionLabel>
        <Card className="mb-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <WeekStat label="Workouts" value={`${completedThisWeek}`} sub={`/ ${targetDays}`} />
            <WeekStat label="Streak" value={streak ? `${streak}w` : '—'} sub="consistency" />
            <WeekStat label="Volume" value={volumeChange != null ? `${volumeChange > 0 ? '+' : ''}${volumeChange}%` : '—'} sub="vs last week" accent={volumeChange != null ? (volumeChange >= 0 ? 'blue' : 'red') : null} />
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* Optional: Readiness */}
        {cardVisible('readiness') && (
          <>
            <SectionLabel action={() => navigate('/progress')}>Readiness</SectionLabel>
            <Card className="mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="shrink-0"><Ring value={readiness ?? 0} label="Ready" size={88} color="blue" /></div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{readiness != null ? (readiness >= 70 ? 'Ready to train' : readiness >= 40 ? 'Recovering' : 'Rest recommended') : 'No recovery data yet'}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">{readiness != null ? 'Based on sleep, soreness, energy and load.' : 'Log recovery or complete workouts to estimate.'}</p>
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="glass mt-2 min-h-[36px] text-xs" onClick={() => setCheckIn(true)}><Plus size={13} /> Check In</Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </Card>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Optional: Insights */}
        {insights.length > 0 && cardVisible('insights') && (
          <>
            <SectionLabel>Insights</SectionLabel>
            <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
              {insights.slice(0, 3).map((ins, i) => {
                const Icon = INSIGHT_ICONS[ins.icon] || Sparkles;
                return (
                  <Card key={i} className="flex items-start gap-3 py-3">
                    <div className={cn('w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0', ins.severity === 'warn' ? 'bg-luxury-red/15 text-luxury-red' : 'bg-primary/15 text-primary')}>
                      <Icon size={15} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{ins.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mt-0.5">{ins.body}</p>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Optional: Best Lifts */}
        {bestLifts.length > 0 && cardVisible('bestLifts') && (
          <>
            <SectionLabel action={() => navigate('/progress')}>Best Lifts</SectionLabel>
            <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1 mb-4">
              {bestLifts.slice(0, 6).map((b, i) => (
                <Card key={i} className="min-w-[130px]">
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold truncate">{b.exercise}</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-gradient-blue mt-1">{Math.round(b.bestE1RM)}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">kg</span></p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">est 1RM · {Math.round(b.maxWeight)}kg top</p>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Optional: Achievements */}
        {achievements.length > 0 && cardVisible('achievements') && (
          <>
            <SectionLabel action={() => navigate('/progress')}>Achievements</SectionLabel>
            <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-2 mb-4">
              {achievements.map((a) => (
                <Card key={a.id} className="min-w-[140px] flex flex-col items-center text-center">
                  <div className={cn('w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-2', a.unlocked ? 'bg-primary/15 text-primary' : 'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground')}>
                    <Trophy size={22} />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold">{a.title}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{a.unlocked ? 'Unlocked' : `${Math.round(a.progress_percent || 0)}%`}</p>

        <div className="h-4" />

      {review && <WeeklyReview onClose={() => setReview(false)} />}
      {customize && <HomeCustomizeSheet config={cardConfig} onChange={updateCardConfig} onClose={() => setCustomize(false)} />}

function getWeek(d) {
  const date = new Date(d.getTime());
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  date.setDate(date.getDate() + 3 - ((date.getDay() + 6) % 7));
  const week1 = new Date(date.getFullYear(), 0, 4);
  return 1 + Math.round(((date - week1) / 86400000 - 3 + ((week1.getDay() + 6) % 7)) / 7);
}

function Header({ user, onCustomize, onNotifications, count }) {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  const greeting = hour < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hour < 18 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening';
  const initials = (user?.full_name || 'A').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).slice(0, 2).join('').toUpperCase();
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5 animate-fade-up">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full luxury-gradient flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
          <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm">{initials || 'A'}</span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">{greeting}</p>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">{user?.full_name?.split(' ')[0] || 'Athlete'}</h1>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button onClick={onNotifications} className="relative w-10 h-10 rounded-xl glass flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]">
          <Bell size={18} className="text-muted-foreground" />
          {count > 0 && <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 min-w-[16px] h-4 px-1 rounded-full bg-luxury-red text-white text-[9px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center">{count}</span>}
        </button>
        <button onClick={onCustomize} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl glass flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]"><LayoutGrid size={18} className="text-muted-foreground" /></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function QuickTile({ icon: Icon, label, onClick }) {
  return (
    <button onClick={onClick} className="glass rounded-2xl py-3 flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 hover:border-primary/30 transition-all min-h-[76px]">
      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center"><Icon size={18} /></div>
      <span className="text-[11px] font-medium">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

function SectionLabel({ children, action }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-6 mb-3">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground">{children}</h2>
      {action && (
        <button onClick={action} className="text-xs text-primary flex items-center gap-0.5 hover:gap-1.5 transition-all">
          View <ChevronRight size={14} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function WeekStat({ label, value, sub, accent }) {
  const color = accent === 'red' ? 'text-luxury-red' : accent === 'blue' ? 'text-primary' : 'text-foreground';
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
      <span className={cn('text-xl font-bold tabular-nums', color)}>{value}</span>
      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{sub}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { LogIn, Mail, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/authReturnTo";

export default function Login() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  // Post-login destination (e.g. the MCP OAuth consent page sends users here
  // with returnTo so the grant flow can resume). Same-origin paths only.
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo();

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.loginViaEmailPassword(email, password);
      window.location.href = returnTo;
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Invalid email or password");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGoogle = () => {
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", returnTo);
  };

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={LogIn}
      title="Welcome back"
      subtitle="Log in to your account"
      footer={
        <>
          Don't have an account?{" "}
          <Link
            to={"/register" + (returnTo !== "/" ? "?returnTo=" + encodeURIComponent(returnTo) : "")}
            className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline"
          >
            Create one
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        className="w-full h-12 text-sm font-medium mb-6"
        onClick={handleGoogle}
      >
        <GoogleIcon className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
        Continue with Google
      </Button>

      <div className="relative mb-6">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
          <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
        </div>
        <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
          <span className="bg-card px-3 text-muted-foreground">or</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
            <Link to="/forgot-password" className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline">
              Forgot password?
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Logging in...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Log in"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { MessageCircle, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import * as social from '@/lib/social';

export default function Messages() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [convs, setConvs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const list = await social.listConversations();
      setConvs(list || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const otherName = (c) => {
    const idx = (c.participant_ids || []).findIndex((id) => id !== user?.id);
    return c.participant_names?.[idx] || 'Conversation';
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Messages</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">Private 1-to-1 conversations.</p>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={() => navigate('/community')}><Plus size={16} /> New</Button>
      </div>
      {loading ? (
        <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-10 text-sm">Loading…</p>
      ) : convs.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon={MessageCircle} title="No conversations yet" description="Find an athlete in Community to start chatting." />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {convs.map((c) => (
            <Card key={c.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 active:scale-[0.99] transition-transform cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/messages/${c.id}`)}>
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full luxury-gradient flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold shrink-0">
                {(otherName(c) || '?')[0]?.toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{otherName(c)}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{c.last_message_preview || 'Say hi 👋'}</p>
              </div>
              {c.last_message_at && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{new Date(c.last_message_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>}
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, Stat, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ArrowLeft, Dumbbell, Flame, Activity, Apple, Heart, Trophy, TrendingUp, ListChecks } from 'lucide-react';
import { estimate1RM } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';

const monthStr = (d) => `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
const monthLabel = (d) => d.toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
const daysInMonth = (y, m) => new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();

export default function MonthlyReport() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState(new Date());
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const prefix = monthStr(cursor);
    try {
      const [workouts, cardio, nutrition, recovery, meas, habits, logs, sets] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.RecoveryRecord.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.Habit.list('-created_date', 100),
        base44.entities.HabitLog.list('-date', 400),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 2000),
      ]);
      const inMonth = (dateStr) => (dateStr || '').startsWith(prefix);

      const mWorkouts = (workouts || []).filter((w) => w.status === 'completed' && inMonth(w.date));
      const mCardio = (cardio || []).filter((c) => inMonth(c.date));
      const mNutrition = (nutrition || []).filter((n) => inMonth(n.date));
      const mRecovery = (recovery || []).filter((r) => inMonth(r.date));
      const mMeas = (meas || []).filter((m) => inMonth(m.date)).sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
      const mLogs = (logs || []).filter((l) => inMonth(l.date));

      const totalVolume = mWorkouts.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.total_volume_kg || 0), 0);
      const prCount = mWorkouts.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.pr_count || 0), 0);
      const cardioSeconds = mCardio.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.duration_seconds || 0), 0);
      const cardioCals = mCardio.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.calories || 0), 0);

      // nutrition avg per day
      const byDay = {};
      mNutrition.forEach((n) => { const d = (n.date || '').slice(0, 10); if (!byDay[d]) byDay[d] = { cals: 0, protein: 0 }; byDay[d].cals += n.calories || 0; byDay[d].protein += n.protein_g || 0; });
      const dayCount = Object.keys(byDay).length || 1;
      const avgCals = Object.values(byDay).reduce((a, d) => a + d.cals, 0) / dayCount;
      const avgProtein = Object.values(byDay).reduce((a, d) => a + d.protein, 0) / dayCount;

      const avgReadiness = mRecovery.length ? mRecovery.reduce((a, r) => a + (r.readiness_score || 0), 0) / mRecovery.length : null;
      const weightChange = mMeas.length > 1 ? (mMeas[mMeas.length - 1].weight_kg - mMeas[0].weight_kg) : null;

      // habit completion
      const habitCount = (habits || []).length;
      const dim = daysInMonth(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth());
      const habitRate = habitCount ? Math.min(100, Math.round((mLogs.length / (habitCount * dim)) * 100)) : null;

      // top exercises by volume this month (from sets)
      const setMap = {};
      (sets || []).forEach((s) => {
        if (!inMonth(s.created_date)) return;
        const vol = (s.weight_kg || 0) * (s.reps || 0);
        if (!setMap[s.exercise_name]) setMap[s.exercise_name] = { vol: 0, topE1rm: 0 };
        setMap[s.exercise_name].vol += vol;
        setMap[s.exercise_name].topE1rm = Math.max(setMap[s.exercise_name].topE1rm, estimate1RM(s.weight_kg, s.reps));
      });
      const topExercises = Object.entries(setMap).map(([name, v]) => ({ name, ...v })).sort((a, b) => b.vol - a.vol).slice(0, 5);

      setData({ mWorkouts: mWorkouts.length, totalVolume: Math.round(totalVolume), prCount, cardioCount: mCardio.length, cardioMinutes: Math.round(cardioSeconds / 60), cardioCals: Math.round(cardioCals), avgCals: Math.round(avgCals), avgProtein: Math.round(avgProtein), avgReadiness: avgReadiness ? Math.round(avgReadiness) : null, weightChange, habitRate, topExercises });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [cursor]);

  const shift = (n) => { const d = new Date(cursor); d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + n); setCursor(d); };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
        <h1 className="font-semibold text-lg">Monthly Report</h1>
        <div className="w-11" />
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => shift(-1)} className="min-h-[44px]"><ChevronLeft size={18} /></Button>
        <span className="font-semibold">{monthLabel(cursor)}</span>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => shift(1)} className="min-h-[44px]"><ChevronRight size={18} /></Button>
      </div>

      {loading ? <div className="flex justify-center py-16"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div> : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <Card><Stat label="Workouts" value={data.mWorkouts} accent="blue" /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="Total Volume" value={data.totalVolume} unit="kg" accent="red" /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="PRs Hit" value={data.prCount} /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="Cardio Sessions" value={data.cardioCount} /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="Cardio Time" value={data.cardioMinutes} unit="min" accent="blue" /></Card>
            <Card><Stat label="Cardio Calories" value={data.cardioCals} unit="kcal" accent="red" /></Card>
          </div>

          <Card>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Apple size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Nutrition Averages</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <Stat label="Avg Daily Cals" value={data.avgCals} unit="kcal" accent="red" />
              <Stat label="Avg Daily Protein" value={data.avgProtein} unit="g" accent="blue" />
            </div>
          </Card>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <Card>
              <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1 flex items-center gap-1"><Heart size={12} /> Avg Readiness</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{data.avgReadiness ?? '—'}</p>
            </Card>
            <Card>
              <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1 flex items-center gap-1"><TrendingUp size={12} /> Weight Δ</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{data.weightChange != null ? `${data.weightChange > 0 ? '+' : ''}${data.weightChange.toFixed(1)}` : '—'}<span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-1">kg</span></p>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {data.habitRate != null && (
            <Card>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2"><ListChecks size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Habit Consistency</p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="flex-1 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-muted/30 overflow-hidden"><div className="h-full bg-luxury-blue" style={{ width: `${data.habitRate}%` }} /></div>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums">{data.habitRate}%</span>
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}

          {data.topExercises.length > 0 && (
            <Card>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Dumbbell size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Top Exercises (by volume)</p>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {data.topExercises.map((e, i) => (
                  <div key={e.name} className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground w-4">{i + 1}</span>
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium flex-1 truncate">{e.name}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{Math.round(e.vol)}kg</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold tabular-nums text-gradient-blue w-12 text-right">{Math.round(e.topE1rm)}kg</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}

          {data.mWorkouts === 0 && data.cardioCount === 0 && (
            <EmptyState icon={Activity} title="No activity this month" description="Log workouts or cardio to see your monthly performance report." />
          )}

          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground text-center">All values are computed deterministically from your logged data. Estimates are labeled, never presented as measurements.</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Bell, BellRing, ChevronRight, Dumbbell, Apple, Activity, Scale, Heart, Target, Brain, Calendar, Droplet, Moon, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react';
import { computeReminders, fireBrowserNotifications, loadReminderData } from '@/lib/reminders';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const ICONS = { Dumbbell, Apple, Activity, Scale, Heart, Target, Brain, Calendar, Droplet, Moon, BarChart3 };

export default function Notifications() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [reminders, setReminders] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [perm, setPerm] = useState(typeof Notification !== 'undefined' ? Notification.permission : 'unsupported');

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await loadReminderData();
      const r = computeReminders(data);
      setReminders(r);
      fireBrowserNotifications(r);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const enableNotifications = async () => {
    if (typeof Notification === 'undefined') return;
    const p = await Notification.requestPermission();
    setPerm(p);
    if (p === 'granted') {
      new Notification('LRAZ 63', { body: 'Notifications enabled. We will remind you to train, fuel, and stay on track.' });
      fireBrowserNotifications(reminders);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">Reminders</p>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Notifications</h1>
        </div>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="min-h-[44px]"><ChevronRight size={18} /></Button>
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center">{perm === 'granted' ? <BellRing size={20} /> : <Bell size={20} />}</div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Browser notifications</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{perm === 'granted' ? 'Enabled — reminders appear on your device.' : perm === 'denied' ? 'Blocked in browser settings.' : perm === 'unsupported' ? 'Not supported on this device.' : 'Get reminded to train, fuel and log.'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          {perm !== 'granted' && perm !== 'unsupported' && <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[40px]" onClick={enableNotifications}>Enable</Button>}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">Checking your day…</div>
      ) : reminders.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon={BellRing} title="You're all caught up" description="No reminders right now. Everything you need to do today is done." />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {reminders.map((r) => {
            const Icon = ICONS[r.icon] || Bell;
            const accent = r.priority === 'high' ? 'text-luxury-red bg-luxury-red/10' : r.priority === 'medium' ? 'text-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/10' : 'text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30';
            return (
              <Card key={r.id} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className={cn('w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0', accent)}><Icon size={18} /></div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{r.title}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mt-0.5">{r.body}</p>
                  <Button size="sm" className="mt-2 min-h-[40px] bg-luxury-blue glow-blue" onClick={() => navigate(r.action)}>{r.cta}</Button>
                </div>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground text-center mt-6 leading-relaxed">Reminders are calculated on your device from your data — no AI, no credits. Notifications fire live throughout the day while the app is open (or installed on your home screen), once per reminder per day. Enable browser notifications above to receive them on your device.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Plus, X, Clock, Pencil, Trash2, AlertTriangle, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Droplets, Zap, ScanLine, Layers, Copy, Utensils, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react';
import BarcodeScanner from '@/components/nutrition/BarcodeScanner';
import CopyMealSheet from '@/components/nutrition/CopyMealSheet';
import MealBuilder from '@/components/nutrition/MealBuilder';
import SavedMealsSheet from '@/components/nutrition/SavedMealsSheet';
import MyFoodsSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MyFoodsSheet';
import MobileFuelSummary from '@/components/nutrition/MobileFuelSummary';
import AddFoodPage from '@/components/nutrition/AddFoodPage';
import QuickAdd from '@/components/nutrition/QuickAdd';
import NutritionDetails from '@/components/nutrition/NutritionDetails';
import MobileSheet from '@/components/nutrition/MobileSheet';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import PullToRefresh from '@/components/PullToRefresh';
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast';
import { getNutritionFeedback } from '@/lib/feedbackMessages';
import { FOODS, foodFactor, parseQty, isPer100g, defaultQty, foodItemToFood } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';

const MEALS = ['Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Snack', 'Pre-Workout', 'Post-Workout'];
const WATER_TARGET_ML = 3000;

export default function Nutrition() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState(null);
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
  const [weekLogs, setWeekLogs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(null);
  const [selectedMeal, setSelectedMeal] = useState('Breakfast');
  const [buildingMeal, setBuildingMeal] = useState(false);
  const [viewingSaved, setViewingSaved] = useState(false);
  const [viewingMyFoods, setViewingMyFoods] = useState(false);
  const [copyingFrom, setCopyingFrom] = useState(false);
  const [barcodeScanning, setBarcodeScanning] = useState(false);
  const [customFoods, setCustomFoods] = useState([]);
  const [favorites, setFavorites] = useState([]);
  const [expandedMeal, setExpandedMeal] = useState(null);
  const [savedMeals, setSavedMeals] = useState([]);
  const [showAddFood, setShowAddFood] = useState(false);
  const [showQuickAdd, setShowQuickAdd] = useState(false);
  const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(false);
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  useEffect(() => { loadAll(); }, []);

  const loadAll = async () => {
    try {
      const weekAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const [g, weekData, cf, favs, sm] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.filter({ date: { $gte: weekAgo } }, '-date', 300),
        base44.entities.FoodItem.filter({ is_custom: true }, '-created_date', 200),
        base44.entities.Favorite.filter({ type: 'food' }, '-created_date', 100),
        base44.entities.SavedMeal.filter({}, '-created_date', 100),
      ]);
      setGoal(g[0] || null);
      setWeekLogs(weekData || []);
      setLogs((weekData || []).filter((l) => l.date === today));
      setCustomFoods((cf || []).map(foodItemToFood));
      setFavorites(favs || []);
      setSavedMeals(sm || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const waterEntries = useMemo(() => logs.filter((l) => l.food_name === 'Water'), [logs]);
  const foodLogs = useMemo(() => logs.filter((l) => l.food_name !== 'Water'), [logs]);

  const totals = useMemo(() => ({
    calories: foodLogs.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.calories || 0), 0),
    protein: foodLogs.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.protein_g || 0), 0),
    carbs: foodLogs.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.carbs_g || 0), 0),
    fat: foodLogs.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.fat_g || 0), 0),
    fiber: foodLogs.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.fiber_g || 0), 0),
    sugar: foodLogs.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.sugar_g || 0), 0),
    sodium: foodLogs.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.sodium_mg || 0), 0),
    water: waterEntries.reduce((a, n) => a + (n.quantity || 0), 0),
  }), [foodLogs, waterEntries]);

  const weeklyAverages = useMemo(() => {
    const days = {};
    weekLogs.filter((l) => l.food_name !== 'Water').forEach((l) => {
      if (!days[l.date]) days[l.date] = { calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0 };
      days[l.date].calories += l.calories || 0;
      days[l.date].protein += l.protein_g || 0;
      days[l.date].carbs += l.carbs_g || 0;
      days[l.date].fat += l.fat_g || 0;
    });
    const dayCount = Object.keys(days).length;
    if (!dayCount) return null;
    const sum = Object.values(days).reduce((a, d) => ({
      calories: a.calories + d.calories, protein: a.protein + d.protein,
      carbs: a.carbs + d.carbs, fat: a.fat + d.fat,
    }), { calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0 });
    return {
      calories: Math.round(sum.calories / dayCount), protein: Math.round(sum.protein / dayCount),
      carbs: Math.round(sum.carbs / dayCount), fat: Math.round(sum.fat / dayCount), days: dayCount,
    };
  }, [weekLogs]);

  const addFood = async (food, qtyRaw) => {
    const qty = parseQty(qtyRaw) || defaultQty(food);
    const factor = foodFactor(food, qty);
    const storedQty = isPer100g(food) ? +(qty * 100).toFixed(1) : qty;
    const entry = {
      date: today, meal: selectedMeal, food_name: food.name,
      quantity: storedQty, unit: food.unit || 'serving',
      calories: Math.round((food.calories || 0) * factor),
      protein_g: +((food.protein_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      carbs_g: +((food.carbs_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      fat_g: +((food.fat_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      fiber_g: +((food.fiber_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      sugar_g: +((food.sugar_g || 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      sodium_mg: Math.round((food.sodium_mg || 0) * factor),
      source: food._custom ? 'User Entered' : 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const tempId = `tmp-${Date.now()}`;
    const newEntry = { ...entry, id: tempId };
    setLogs((l) => [...l, newEntry]);
    setWeekLogs((w) => [...w, newEntry]);
    try {
      const created = await base44.entities.NutritionLog.create(entry);
      const realId = created?.id || created?._id;
      if (realId && realId !== tempId) {
        setLogs((l) => l.map((x) => x.id === tempId ? { ...x, id: realId } : x));
        setWeekLogs((w) => w.map((x) => x.id === tempId ? { ...x, id: realId } : x));
      }
      const newCals = totals.calories + (entry.calories || 0);
      const newPro = totals.protein + (entry.protein_g || 0);
      const fb = getNutritionFeedback({ calories: newCals, calorieTarget: goal?.calorie_target, protein: newPro, proteinTarget: goal?.protein_target_g });
      if (fb) toast({ title: fb.title, description: fb.message });
    } catch (e) {
      setLogs((l) => l.filter((x) => x.id !== tempId));
      setWeekLogs((w) => w.filter((x) => x.id !== tempId));
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const addWater = async (ml) => {
    const entry = {
      date: today, meal: 'Snack', food_name: 'Water',
      quantity: ml, unit: 'ml', calories: 0, protein_g: 0, carbs_g: 0, fat_g: 0,
      fiber_g: 0, sugar_g: 0, sodium_mg: 0, source: 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    const tempId = `tmp-${Date.now()}`;
    const newEntry = { ...entry, id: tempId };
    setLogs((l) => [...l, newEntry]);
    setWeekLogs((w) => [...w, newEntry]);
    try {
      const created = await base44.entities.NutritionLog.create(entry);
      const realId = created?.id || created?._id;
      if (realId && realId !== tempId) {
        setLogs((l) => l.map((x) => x.id === tempId ? { ...x, id: realId } : x));
        setWeekLogs((w) => w.map((x) => x.id === tempId ? { ...x, id: realId } : x));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setLogs((l) => l.filter((x) => x.id !== tempId));
      setWeekLogs((w) => w.filter((x) => x.id !== tempId));
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const deleteLog = async (id) => {
    setLogs((l) => l.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
    setWeekLogs((w) => w.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    try { await base44.entities.NutritionLog.delete(id); } catch (e) { loadAll(); console.error(e); }
  };

  const saveEdit = async (updated) => {
    setLogs((l) => l.map((x) => x.id === updated.id ? { ...x, ...updated } : x));
    setWeekLogs((w) => w.map((x) => x.id === updated.id ? { ...x, ...updated } : x));
    setEditing(null);
    try { await base44.entities.NutritionLog.update(updated.id, updated); } catch (e) { loadAll(); console.error(e); }
  };

  const toggleFavorite = async (food) => {
    const existing = favorites.find((f) => f.ref_id === food.name);
    if (existing) {
      setFavorites((favs) => favs.filter((f) => f.id !== existing.id));
      try { await base44.entities.Favorite.delete(existing.id); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    } else {
      const rec = await base44.entities.Favorite.create({
        type: 'food', ref_id: food.name, name: food.name,
        subtitle: food.category || '', created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      setFavorites((favs) => [...favs, rec]);
    }
  };

  const mealsByType = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    MEALS.forEach((m) => (map[m] = []));
    foodLogs.forEach((l) => { if (map[l.meal]) map[l.meal].push(l); });
    return map;
  }, [foodLogs]);

  const recentFoods = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set();
    const result = [];
    [...weekLogs].reverse().filter((l) => l.food_name !== 'Water').forEach((l) => {
      if (!seen.has(l.food_name)) {
        seen.add(l.food_name);
        const food = [...customFoods, ...FOODS].find((f) => f.name === l.food_name);
        if (food) result.push(food);
      }
    });
    return result.slice(0, 20);
  }, [weekLogs, customFoods]);

  const logSavedMeal = async (meal) => {
    const items = meal.items || [];
    const entries = items.map((item) => ({
      date: today, meal: selectedMeal, food_name: item.food_name,
      quantity: item.quantity, unit: item.unit || 'serving',
      calories: item.calories || 0, protein_g: item.protein_g || 0,
      carbs_g: item.carbs_g || 0, fat_g: item.fat_g || 0,
      fiber_g: item.fiber_g || 0, sugar_g: item.sugar_g || 0,
      sodium_mg: item.sodium_mg || 0, source: 'Recipe', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }));
    const tempEntries = entries.map((e, i) => ({ ...e, id: `tmp-${Date.now()}-${i}` }));
    setLogs((l) => [...l, ...tempEntries]);
    setWeekLogs((w) => [...w, ...tempEntries]);
    try {
      await base44.entities.NutritionLog.bulkCreate(entries);
    } catch (e) {
      setLogs((l) => l.filter((x) => !tempEntries.find((t) => t.id === x.id)));
      setWeekLogs((w) => w.filter((x) => !tempEntries.find((t) => t.id === x.id)));
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (expandedMeal === null && !loading) {
      const firstWithFood = MEALS.find((m) => mealsByType[m].length > 0);
      setExpandedMeal(firstWithFood || 'Breakfast');
    }
  }, [loading, mealsByType, expandedMeal]);

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <PullToRefresh onRefresh={loadAll}>
          <div className="px-4 pt-6 pb-28">

            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{new Date().toLocaleDateString('default', { weekday: 'long', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}</p>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">Fuel</h1>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => navigate('/nutrition/history')} className="glass rounded-xl p-2.5 min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center">
                <Clock size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Summary — calorie ring + macro bars */}
            <MobileFuelSummary totals={totals} goal={goal} onShowDetails={() => setShowDetails(true)} />

            {/* Primary action grid — 4 big touch targets */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 mb-3">
              <button onClick={() => setShowAddFood(true)} className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl py-3 min-h-[72px] bg-luxury-blue text-white glow-blue active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <Plus size={20} /><span className="text-[10px] font-medium">Add Food</span>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setShowQuickAdd(true)} className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl py-3 min-h-[72px] glass active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <Zap size={20} className="text-luxury-gold" /><span className="text-[10px] font-medium">Quick Cal</span>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setBarcodeScanning(true)} className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl py-3 min-h-[72px] glass active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <ScanLine size={20} className="text-luxury-blue" /><span className="text-[10px] font-medium">Scan</span>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setViewingSaved(true)} className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl py-3 min-h-[72px] glass active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <Layers size={20} className="text-luxury-red" /><span className="text-[10px] font-medium">Meals</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Water tracker */}
            <WaterTracker entries={waterEntries} total={totals.water} target={WATER_TARGET_ML} onAdd={addWater} onDelete={deleteLog} />

            {/* Meal sections — list-based entries */}
            <div className="space-y-2 mt-3">
              {MEALS.map((meal) => (
                <MealSection key={meal} meal={meal} logs={mealsByType[meal]}
                  expanded={expandedMeal === meal}
                  onToggle={() => setExpandedMeal(expandedMeal === meal ? null : meal)}
                  onAdd={() => { setSelectedMeal(meal); setShowAddFood(true); }}
                  confirmDelete={confirmDelete} onConfirmDelete={setConfirmDelete} onDelete={deleteLog} onEdit={setEditing} />
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Secondary actions */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-4">
              <button onClick={() => setCopyingFrom(true)} className="flex items-center gap-2 glass rounded-xl px-3 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-sm font-medium active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <Copy size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" /><span>Copy Day</span>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setViewingMyFoods(true)} className="flex items-center gap-2 glass rounded-xl px-3 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-sm font-medium active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <Utensils size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" /><span>My Foods</span>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setBuildingMeal(true)} className="flex items-center gap-2 glass rounded-xl px-3 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-sm font-medium active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <Layers size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" /><span>Build Meal</span>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setShowDetails(true)} className="flex items-center gap-2 glass rounded-xl px-3 py-3 min-h-[48px] text-sm font-medium active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                <BarChart3 size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" /><span>Details</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </PullToRefresh>
      </div>

      {/* Shared sheets & modals */}
      {showAddFood && <AddFoodPage onClose={() => setShowAddFood(false)} selectedMeal={selectedMeal} setSelectedMeal={setSelectedMeal}
        customFoods={customFoods} favorites={favorites} toggleFavorite={toggleFavorite} addFood={addFood}
        recentFoods={recentFoods} savedMeals={savedMeals} onLogSavedMeal={logSavedMeal}
        onScan={() => { setShowAddFood(false); setBarcodeScanning(true); }}
        onQuickAdd={() => { setShowAddFood(false); setShowQuickAdd(true); }}
        onBuildMeal={() => { setShowAddFood(false); setBuildingMeal(true); }}
        onCopyDay={() => { setShowAddFood(false); setCopyingFrom(true); }}
        onCreateFood={() => { setShowAddFood(false); setViewingMyFoods(true); }} />}
      {showQuickAdd && <QuickAdd onClose={() => setShowQuickAdd(false)} selectedMeal={selectedMeal} setSelectedMeal={setSelectedMeal} addFood={addFood} />}
      {showDetails && <NutritionDetails onClose={() => setShowDetails(false)} totals={totals} goal={goal} weeklyAverages={weeklyAverages} waterTarget={WATER_TARGET_ML} />}
      {barcodeScanning && <BarcodeScanner selectedMeal={selectedMeal} onLogged={loadAll} onClose={() => setBarcodeScanning(false)} />}
      {editing && <EditMealSheet log={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} onSave={saveEdit} />}
      {buildingMeal && <MealBuilder onClose={() => setBuildingMeal(false)} selectedMeal={selectedMeal} setSelectedMeal={setSelectedMeal} onLogged={loadAll} customFoods={customFoods} />}
      {viewingSaved && <SavedMealsSheet onClose={() => setViewingSaved(false)} onLogged={loadAll} />}
      {viewingMyFoods && <MyFoodsSheet onClose={() => setViewingMyFoods(false)} onChanged={loadAll} />}
      {copyingFrom && <CopyMealSheet onClose={() => setCopyingFrom(false)} onCopied={loadAll} />}
    </>
  );
}

function WaterTracker({ entries, total, target, onAdd, onDelete }) {
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState('');
  const pct = Math.min(100, (total / target) * 100);
  const addCustom = () => { const ml = parseInt(custom, 10); if (ml > 0) { onAdd(ml); setCustom(''); } };
  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-xl p-3 mb-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
        <Droplets size={18} className="text-luxury-blue shrink-0" />
        <div className="flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{Math.round(total)}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground"> / {target} ml</span></span>
            {entries.length > 0 && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{entries.length} entries</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted/30 mt-1 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="h-full bg-luxury-blue transition-all" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-2">
        {[250, 500, 750].map((ml) => (
          <button key={ml} onClick={() => onAdd(ml)} className="glass rounded-lg py-2.5 text-xs font-medium min-h-[44px] hover:bg-luxury-blue/10 transition-all">+{ml}ml</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Input type="number" value={custom} onChange={(e) => setCustom(e.target.value)} placeholder="Custom ml" className="glass h-11 flex-1 text-center text-sm tabular-nums" inputMode="numeric" />
        <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue px-4 min-h-[44px]" onClick={addCustom} disabled={!custom}><Plus size={16} /> Add</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const MealSection = React.memo(function MealSection({ meal, logs, expanded, onToggle, onAdd, confirmDelete, onConfirmDelete, onDelete, onEdit }) {
  const totalCal = logs.reduce((a, l) => a + (l.calories || 0), 0);
  return (
    <div className="glass rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
      <button onClick={onToggle} className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 min-h-[52px]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {expanded ? <ChevronUp size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" /> : <ChevronDown size={16} className="text-muted-foreground" />}
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{meal}</span>
          {logs.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{logs.length} {logs.length === 1 ? 'food' : 'foods'}</span>}
        </div>
        <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(totalCal)} <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">kcal</span></span>
      </button>
      {expanded && (
        <div className="px-3 pb-3 space-y-1.5">
          {logs.length ? logs.map((log) => (
            <div key={log.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/20">
              {confirmDelete === log.id ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
                  <AlertTriangle size={14} className="text-luxury-red shrink-0" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex-1 truncate" dir="auto">Delete <span className="text-foreground font-medium">{log.food_name}</span>?</p>
                  <button onClick={() => onDelete(log.id)} className="text-xs font-medium text-luxury-red px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-luxury-red/10 min-h-[36px]">Delete</button>
                  <button onClick={() => onConfirmDelete(null)} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1 min-h-[36px]">Cancel</button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" dir="auto">{log.food_name}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">{log.quantity}{log.unit} · P{log.protein_g} C{log.carbs_g} F{log.fat_g}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-luxury-blue tabular-nums">{Math.round(log.calories)}</span>
                    <button onClick={() => onEdit(log)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue p-1.5 tap-min"><Pencil size={14} /></button>
                    <button onClick={() => onConfirmDelete(log.id)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1.5 tap-min"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )) : (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground py-2 text-center">Nothing logged yet</p>
          )}
          <button onClick={onAdd} className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1 py-2 text-xs text-luxury-blue min-h-[40px]">
            <Plus size={14} /> Add food
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

function EditMealSheet({ log, onClose, onSave }) {
  const origQty = log.quantity ?? 1;
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    food_name: log.food_name || '',
    meal: log.meal || 'Snack',
    quantity: log.quantity ?? 1,
    unit: log.unit || 'serving',
    calories: log.calories ?? 0,
    protein_g: log.protein_g ?? 0,
    carbs_g: log.carbs_g ?? 0,
    fat_g: log.fat_g ?? 0,
    fiber_g: log.fiber_g ?? 0,
    sugar_g: log.sugar_g ?? 0,
    sodium_mg: log.sodium_mg ?? 0,
  });
  const set = (k, v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const changeQty = (val) => {
    const q = parseQty(val);
    const factor = origQty ? q / origQty : 1;
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f, quantity: q,
      calories: Math.round((log.calories ?? 0) * factor),
      protein_g: +((log.protein_g ?? 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      carbs_g: +((log.carbs_g ?? 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      fat_g: +((log.fat_g ?? 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      fiber_g: +((log.fiber_g ?? 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      sugar_g: +((log.sugar_g ?? 0) * factor).toFixed(1),
      sodium_mg: Math.round((log.sodium_mg ?? 0) * factor),
    }));
  };
  return (
    <MobileSheet onClose={onClose}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Edit Food</h3>
        <button onClick={onClose} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground p-2 min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"><X size={18} /></button>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Input value={form.food_name} onChange={(e) => set('food_name', e.target.value)} placeholder="Food name" className="glass h-11" />
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
          {MEALS.map((m) => (
            <button key={m} onClick={() => set('meal', m)} className={cn('text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border whitespace-nowrap min-h-[36px] flex items-center', form.meal === m ? 'border-luxury-blue bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue' : 'border-border glass text-muted-foreground')}>{m}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Qty</Label><Input type="text" inputMode="decimal" value={form.quantity} onChange={(e) => changeQty(e.target.value)} className="glass h-11 tabular-nums" /></div>
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Unit</Label><Input value={form.unit} onChange={(e) => set('unit', e.target.value)} className="glass h-11" /></div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Changing quantity auto-scales calories and macros.</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Kcal</Label><Input type="number" value={form.calories} onChange={(e) => set('calories', Number(e.target.value))} className="glass h-11 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" /></div>
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">P g</Label><Input type="number" value={form.protein_g} onChange={(e) => set('protein_g', Number(e.target.value))} className="glass h-11 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" /></div>
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">C g</Label><Input type="number" value={form.carbs_g} onChange={(e) => set('carbs_g', Number(e.target.value))} className="glass h-11 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" /></div>
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">F g</Label><Input type="number" value={form.fat_g} onChange={(e) => set('fat_g', Number(e.target.value))} className="glass h-11 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" /></div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Fiber g</Label><Input type="number" value={form.fiber_g} onChange={(e) => set('fiber_g', Number(e.target.value))} className="glass h-11 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" /></div>
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Sugar g</Label><Input type="number" value={form.sugar_g} onChange={(e) => set('sugar_g', Number(e.target.value))} className="glass h-11 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" /></div>
          <div><Label className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Sodium mg</Label><Input type="number" value={form.sodium_mg} onChange={(e) => set('sodium_mg', Number(e.target.value))} className="glass h-11 text-center text-xs tabular-nums" /></div>
        </div>
        <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px] text-base font-semibold" onClick={() => onSave({ id: log.id, ...form })}>Save Changes</Button>
      </div>
    </MobileSheet>
  );
}
