import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, Pill } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Calendar, TrendingUp, Sparkles, ArrowLeft, Repeat, Flame, Bookmark, Check, Trash2, AlertTriangle, X, Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import NutritionCalendar from '@/components/nutrition/NutritionCalendar';
import EditNutritionLogSheet from '@/components/nutrition/EditNutritionLogSheet';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import PullToRefresh from '@/components/PullToRefresh';
import { ResponsiveContainer, AreaChart, Area, XAxis, Tooltip, CartesianGrid } from 'recharts';

const TODAY = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const MEAL_ORDER = ['Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Snack', 'Pre-Workout', 'Post-Workout'];

export default function NutritionHistory() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState(null);
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState('week');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(TODAY);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(null);
  const [confirmDeleteRecent, setConfirmDeleteRecent] = useState(null);
  const [editingLog, setEditingLog] = useState(null);

  const onLogSaved = () => { setEditingLog(null); loadAll(); };

  const deleteLog = async (id) => {
    setLogs((l) => l.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    try { await base44.entities.NutritionLog.delete(id); } catch (e) { loadAll(); console.error(e); }
  };

  const deleteRecentFood = async (f) => {
    setConfirmDeleteRecent(null);
    setLogs((l) => l.filter((x) => x.food_name !== f.food_name));
    try { await base44.entities.NutritionLog.deleteMany({ food_name: f.food_name }); } catch (e) { loadAll(); console.error(e); }
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadAll(); }, []);
  const loadAll = async () => {
    try {
      const [g, l, s] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Goal.filter({ status: 'active' }, '-created_date', 1),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 60),
      ]);
      setGoal(g[0] || null);
      setLogs(l || []);
      setSessions(s || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const byDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    for (const l of logs) {
      if (!l.date) continue;
      if (!map[l.date]) map[l.date] = { date: l.date, calories: 0, protein: 0, carbs: 0, fat: 0, fiber: 0, meals: [] };
      map[l.date].calories += l.calories || 0;
      map[l.date].protein += l.protein_g || 0;
      map[l.date].carbs += l.carbs_g || 0;
      map[l.date].fat += l.fat_g || 0;
      map[l.date].fiber += l.fiber_g || 0;
      map[l.date].meals.push(l);
    }
    return map;
  }, [logs]);

  const trainingDays = useMemo(() => new Set(sessions.filter((s) => s.status === 'completed').map((s) => (s.date || '').slice(0, 10))), [sessions]);

  const periodDays = useMemo(() => {
    const n = period === 'week' ? 7 : 30;
    const days = [];
    for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) days.push(new Date(Date.now() - i * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    return days;
  }, [period]);

  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    const entries = periodDays.map((d) => byDate[d]).filter(Boolean);
    if (!entries.length) return { daysLogged: 0 };
    const avg = (k) => Math.round(entries.reduce((a, e) => a + e[k], 0) / entries.length);
    const calTarget = goal?.calorie_target || 0;
    const proTarget = goal?.protein_target_g || 0;
    const calHit = calTarget ? entries.filter((e) => e.calories >= calTarget * 0.85 && e.calories <= calTarget * 1.15).length : 0;
    const proHit = proTarget ? entries.filter((e) => e.protein >= proTarget * 0.85).length : 0;
    return {
      daysLogged: entries.length, avgCalories: avg('calories'), avgProtein: avg('protein'),
      avgCarbs: avg('carbs'), avgFat: avg('fat'),
      calAdherence: calTarget ? Math.round((calHit / entries.length) * 100) : null,
      proteinAdherence: proTarget ? Math.round((proHit / entries.length) * 100) : null,
    };
  }, [periodDays, byDate, goal]);

  const chartData = useMemo(() => periodDays.map((d) => {
    const e = byDate[d];
    return { date: d.slice(5), calories: e ? Math.round(e.calories) : 0, protein: e ? Math.round(e.protein) : 0 };
  }), [periodDays, byDate]);

  const insights = useMemo(() => {
    const out = [];
    const last7 = periodDays.slice(-7).map((d) => byDate[d]).filter(Boolean);
    const prev7 = [];
    for (let i = 7; i < 14; i++) { const d = new Date(Date.now() - i * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); if (byDate[d]) prev7.push(byDate[d]); }
    if (last7.length && prev7.length) {
      const a = last7.reduce((s, e) => s + e.protein, 0) / last7.length;
      const b = prev7.reduce((s, e) => s + e.protein, 0) / prev7.length;
      const diff = Math.round(a - b);
      if (Math.abs(diff) >= 5) out.push({ icon: Flame, title: 'Protein trend', body: `Average protein ${diff > 0 ? 'increased' : 'decreased'} from ${Math.round(b)}g to ${Math.round(a)}g vs last week.` });
    }
    if (summary.proteinAdherence != null) {
      out.push({ icon: Sparkles, title: 'Protein adherence', body: `You hit your protein target on ${Math.round((summary.proteinAdherence / 100) * summary.daysLogged)} of ${summary.daysLogged} logged days (${summary.proteinAdherence}%).` });
    }
    const tCals = [], rCals = [];
    for (const d of periodDays) { const e = byDate[d]; if (!e) continue; (trainingDays.has(d) ? tCals : rCals).push(e.calories); }
    if (tCals.length >= 2 && rCals.length >= 2) {
      const tAvg = Math.round(tCals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / tCals.length);
      const rAvg = Math.round(rCals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / rCals.length);
      const diff = tAvg - rAvg;
      if (Math.abs(diff) >= 50) out.push({ icon: TrendingUp, title: 'Training vs rest days', body: `You eat ${diff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${diff} kcal on training days vs rest days (avg ${tAvg} vs ${rAvg}).` });
    }
    const ranked = periodDays.map((d) => byDate[d]).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => b.calories - a.calories);
    if (ranked.length >= 2) out.push({ icon: Calendar, title: 'Daily range', body: `Highest day ${Math.round(ranked[0].calories)} kcal vs lowest ${Math.round(ranked[ranked.length - 1].calories)} kcal.` });
    return out.slice(0, 4);
  }, [periodDays, byDate, summary, trainingDays]);

  const recentFoods = useMemo(() => {
    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const map = {};
    for (const l of logs) {
      if (!l.food_name || l.food_name === 'Water' || (l.date || '') < cutoff) continue;
      const cur = map[l.food_name] || { food_name: l.food_name, _count: 0, last: l };
      cur._count += 1;
      if ((l.logged_at || '') > (cur.last.logged_at || '')) cur.last = l;
      map[l.food_name] = cur;
    }
    return Object.values(map).sort((a, b) => b._count - a._count).slice(0, 30).map((x) => ({ ...x.last, _count: x._count }));
  }, [logs]);

  const addAgain = async (log) => {
    const entry = {
      date: TODAY, meal: log.meal || 'Snack', food_name: log.food_name, quantity: log.quantity, unit: log.unit,
      calories: log.calories, protein_g: log.protein_g, carbs_g: log.carbs_g, fat_g: log.fat_g, fiber_g: log.fiber_g,
      source: log.source || 'Database', logged_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    try { await base44.entities.NutritionLog.create(entry); loadAll(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const [savedIds, setSavedIds] = useState(new Set());
  const saveAsMeal = async (log) => {
    try {
      await base44.entities.SavedMeal.create({
        name: log.food_name,
        meal_type: log.meal || 'Snack',
        items: [{
          food_name: log.food_name, quantity: log.quantity, unit: log.unit,
          calories: log.calories, protein_g: log.protein_g, carbs_g: log.carbs_g,
          fat_g: log.fat_g, fiber_g: log.fiber_g, sugar_g: log.sugar_g, sodium_mg: log.sodium_mg,
        }],
        total_calories: Math.round(log.calories || 0),
        total_protein_g: +(log.protein_g || 0).toFixed(1),
      });
      setSavedIds((s) => new Set(s).add(log.id || log.food_name));
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const dayDetail = byDate[selectedDate];
  const dayMeals = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    MEAL_ORDER.forEach((m) => (map[m] = []));
    (dayDetail?.meals || []).filter((l) => l.food_name !== 'Water').forEach((l) => { if (map[l.meal]) map[l.meal].push(l); });
    return map;
  }, [dayDetail]);

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <PullToRefresh onRefresh={loadAll}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
          <button onClick={() => navigate('/nutrition')} className="p-2 rounded-lg glass min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"><ArrowLeft size={18} /></button>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">Nutrition</p>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">History</h1>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
          <Pill active={period === 'week'} onClick={() => setPeriod('week')}>Week</Pill>
          <Pill active={period === 'month'} onClick={() => setPeriod('month')}>Month</Pill>
        </div>

        <Card className="mb-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">{period === 'week' ? 'Last 7 days' : 'Last 30 days'} · {summary.daysLogged || 0} days logged</p>
          {summary.daysLogged ? (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
              <SummaryStat label="Avg Calories" value={summary.avgCalories} target={goal?.calorie_target} unit="kcal" />
              <SummaryStat label="Avg Protein" value={summary.avgProtein} target={goal?.protein_target_g} unit="g" />
              <SummaryStat label="Avg Carbs" value={summary.avgCarbs} target={goal?.carb_target_g} unit="g" />
              <SummaryStat label="Avg Fat" value={summary.avgFat} target={goal?.fat_target_g} unit="g" />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">No nutrition data for this period yet.</p>
          )}
          {summary.proteinAdherence != null && (
            <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
              <AdherenceChip label="Calorie adherence" value={summary.calAdherence} />
              <AdherenceChip label="Protein adherence" value={summary.proteinAdherence} />
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>

        {chartData.some((d) => d.calories > 0) && (
          <Card className="mb-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Calorie trend</p>
            <div className="h-32">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 4, right: 4, bottom: 0, left: -28 }}>
                  <defs>
                    <linearGradient id="calGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                      <stop offset="0%" stopColor="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" stopOpacity={0.5} />
                      <stop offset="100%" stopColor="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" stopOpacity={0} />
                    </linearGradient>
                  </defs>
                  <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="hsl(var(--border))" opacity={0.3} />
                  <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} interval="preserveStartEnd" tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
                  <Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: 'hsl(var(--card))', border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 12 }} labelStyle={{ color: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }} />
                  <Area type="monotone" dataKey="calories" stroke="hsl(var(--luxury-blue))" strokeWidth={2} fill="url(#calGrad)" />
                </AreaChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
          </Card>
        )}

        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Calendar size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Calendar</h2>
        <Card className="mb-4">
          <NutritionCalendar byDate={byDate} target={goal} selectedDate={selectedDate} onSelect={setSelectedDate} />
        </Card>

        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground mb-3">{new Date(selectedDate).toLocaleDateString('default', { weekday: 'long', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}</h2>
        <Card className="mb-4">
          {dayDetail ? (
            <>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center mb-3">
                <DayMini label="Cal" value={Math.round(dayDetail.calories)} unit="kcal" />
                <DayMini label="Protein" value={Math.round(dayDetail.protein)} unit="g" />
                <DayMini label="Carbs" value={Math.round(dayDetail.carbs)} unit="g" />
                <DayMini label="Fat" value={Math.round(dayDetail.fat)} unit="g" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {MEAL_ORDER.filter((m) => dayMeals[m].length).map((meal) => (
                  <div key={meal}>
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">{meal}</p>
                    {dayMeals[meal].map((l) => (
                      <div key={l.id} className="py-1.5 border-t border-border/30 first:border-t-0">
                        {confirmDelete === l.id ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <AlertTriangle size={14} className="text-luxury-red shrink-0" />
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex-1 truncate" dir="auto">Delete <span className="text-foreground font-medium">{l.food_name}</span>?</p>
                            <button onClick={() => deleteLog(l.id)} className="text-xs font-medium text-luxury-red px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-luxury-red/10 min-h-[32px]">Delete</button>
                            <button onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(null)} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1 min-h-[32px]">Cancel</button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" dir="auto">{l.food_name}</p>
                              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">{l.quantity}{l.unit} · P{l.protein_g} C{l.carbs_g} F{l.fat_g}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 ml-2">
                              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-luxury-blue tabular-nums">{Math.round(l.calories)}</span>
                              <button onClick={() => setEditingLog(l)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue p-1.5 tap-min" title="Edit"><Pencil size={13} /></button>
                              <button onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(l.id)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1.5 tap-min"><Trash2 size={13} /></button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">No food logged on this day.</p>
          )}
        </Card>

        {insights.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Sparkles size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Insights</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-4">
              {insights.map((ins, i) => {
                const Icon = ins.icon;
                return (
                  <Card key={i} className="flex items-start gap-3 py-3">
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-luxury-blue/15 text-luxury-blue flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Icon size={15} /></div>
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{ins.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mt-0.5">{ins.body}</p>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {recentFoods.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Repeat size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> All Foods You've Logged</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {recentFoods.map((f, i) => (
                <Card key={i} className="p-2.5">
                  {confirmDeleteRecent === f.food_name ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <AlertTriangle size={14} className="text-luxury-red shrink-0" />
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex-1 truncate" dir="auto">Delete all <span className="text-foreground font-medium">{f.food_name}</span> from history?</p>
                      <button onClick={() => deleteRecentFood(f)} className="text-xs font-medium text-luxury-red px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-luxury-red/10 min-h-[36px]">Delete</button>
                      <button onClick={() => setConfirmDeleteRecent(null)} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1 min-h-[36px]">Cancel</button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" dir="auto">{f.food_name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">{Math.round(f.calories)} kcal · P{Math.round(f.protein_g)} · {f._count}×</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0 ml-1">
                        <button onClick={() => saveAsMeal(f)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue p-1.5 tap-min" title={savedIds.has(f.id || f.food_name) ? 'Saved' : 'Save as meal'}>
                          {savedIds.has(f.id || f.food_name) ? <Check size={14} className="text-emerald-400" /> : <Bookmark size={14} />}
                        </button>
                        <button onClick={() => addAgain(f)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue p-1.5 tap-min" title="Log again"><Repeat size={14} /></button>
                        <button onClick={() => setConfirmDeleteRecent(f.food_name)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red p-1.5 tap-min" title="Delete"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {editingLog && <EditNutritionLogSheet log={editingLog} onClose={() => setEditingLog(null)} onSaved={onLogSaved} />}
    </PullToRefresh>
  );
}

function SummaryStat({ label, value, target, unit }) {
  const pct = target ? Math.min(100, (value / target) * 100) : 0;
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums">{value}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">{unit}</span></p>
      {target && <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">/ {Math.round(target)}{unit} · {Math.round(pct)}%</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function AdherenceChip({ label, value }) {
  const color = value >= 80 ? 'text-emerald-400' : value >= 60 ? 'text-luxury-gold' : 'text-luxury-red';
  return (
    <div className="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-muted/20 px-3 py-2">
      <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      <p className={cn('text-lg font-bold tabular-nums', color)}>{value}%</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function DayMini({ label, value, unit }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <span className="text-base font-bold tabular-nums">{value}</span>
      <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{unit}</span>
      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { appParams } from "@/lib/app-params";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ShieldCheck, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";

// App-side OAuth consent page for the app's MCP server. The platform redirects
// AI clients here (see base44/mcp/config.json `consent_path`) with an opaque
// `ctx` handle — the authorization request itself lives on the server. This page
// gates on the app-user session, fetches the display info for that handle, shows
// the categories of access being granted, and posts the approve/deny decision.
// Do not change the fetch calls, headers, or the `ctx` handle handling — styling
// and copy are safe to edit.
export default function OAuthConsent() {
  const ctx = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("ctx");
  const [info, setInfo] = useState(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [decided, setDecided] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [reconnect, setReconnect] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      let redirecting = false;
      try {
        if (!ctx) {
          setError("This authorization link is invalid or has expired.");
          return;
        }
        // Resolve the handle first: a dead handle must never render
        // approve/deny, and the response carries the app's configured login
        // route for the signed-out redirect below. Send the session (cookie +
        // bearer token) so the server can list the granted tools for a
        // signed-in user — the same auth the approve/deny call sends; without
        // it the display request is anonymous and shows no tools.
        const infoHeaders = {};
        if (appParams.token) infoHeaders.Authorization = "Bearer " + appParams.token;
        const res = await fetch(
          `/api/apps/${appParams.appId}/mcp/consent-info?handle=${encodeURIComponent(ctx)}`,
          { credentials: "include", headers: infoHeaders },
        );
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError("This authorization link is invalid or has expired.");
          return;
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        // Gate on the server's auth result, NOT base44.auth.isAuthenticated():
        // the SDK check runs the bearer path, so a cookie-only session (platform
        // login/SSO, or a private app with a stale localStorage token) would read
        // as signed-out and redirect — even though /consent-info just
        // authenticated this same request via its cookie fallback. data.authenticated
        // keeps the redirect decision in agreement with what the server returned.
        if (!data.authenticated) {
          // The short handle rides back in returnTo; login_path is
          // owner-configured and validated server-side as a same-origin path.
          // Send from_url too: a custom-auth app coerced to platform auth (e.g.
          // public_without_login under workspace SSO) serves the platform login,
          // which honors from_url rather than returnTo. Rebuild the query from
          // `ctx` alone — never forward window.location.search raw: the platform
          // resume returns from_url verbatim, so crafted extras on the consent
          // link (app_base_url, access_token, …) would ride through the login
          // round-trip and app-params.js would persist them into the freshly
          // authenticated session.
          const returnTo =
            window.location.pathname + "?ctx=" + encodeURIComponent(ctx);
          const encoded = encodeURIComponent(returnTo);
          redirecting = true; // keep the spinner while the browser navigates
          window.location.href =
            (data.login_path || "/login") + "?returnTo=" + encoded + "&from_url=" + encoded;
          return;
        }
        setInfo(data);
      } catch (e) {
        setError("Could not load this authorization request. Please try again.");
      } finally {
        if (!redirecting) setChecking(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [ctx]);

  const respond = async (action) => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
      // Cookie-backed sessions carry no token; sending "Bearer null" would
      // shadow the valid cookie, so add the header only when a token exists.
      if (appParams.token) headers.Authorization = "Bearer " + appParams.token;
      const res = await fetch(`/api/apps/${appParams.appId}/mcp/authorize-grant`, {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "include",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ ctx, action }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        // 401 = the session expired before the (single-use, still-unconsumed)
        // handle was spent; retrying the same controls re-sends the dead session
        // forever. Send the user back through login preserving `ctx` — the same
        // redirect the initial signed-out path uses — so they can return and
        // approve the still-valid handle.
        if (res.status === 401) {
          const returnTo = window.location.pathname + "?ctx=" + encodeURIComponent(ctx);
          const encoded = encodeURIComponent(returnTo);
          window.location.href =
            ((info && info.login_path) || "/login") + "?returnTo=" + encoded + "&from_url=" + encoded;
          return;
        }
        // These all come AFTER the single-use handle is atomically consumed
        // (409 tool set changed; 403 host/resource/app mismatch; 404 access
        // gone; 400 malformed/handle already used), so retrying can only 404.
        // Show a terminal reconnect state, not an impossible "try again".
        if ([400, 403, 404, 409].includes(res.status)) {
          let detail = "";
          try { detail = (await res.json()).detail; } catch (_) { /* keep default */ }
          setReconnect(detail || "This authorization can no longer be completed. Reconnect from your AI client to try again.");
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        throw new Error("Could not complete authorization. Please try again.");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      window.location.href = data.redirect_url;
      if (!/^https?:/i.test(data.redirect_url)) {
        // Custom-scheme redirect (native AI clients, e.g. cursor://): browsers
        // may block or not visibly navigate, so show a terminal state instead
        // of an eternal spinner.
        setDecided(action);
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (checking) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Authorize access">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6 text-muted-foreground">
          <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          Loading…
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  const client = (info && info.client_name) || "An AI client";
  const appName = (info && info.app_name) || "this app";

  if (decided) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={ShieldCheck}
        title={decided === "approve" ? "Access granted" : "Access denied"}
        subtitle={`You can return to ${client} and close this window.`}
      />
    );
  }

  // Terminal: the authorization request is no longer valid (tool set changed +
  // handle consumed). Retrying can't succeed, so show reconnect guidance with
  // no approve/deny controls.
  if (reconnect) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Reconnect required">
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {reconnect}
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  // No consent details means nothing trustworthy to approve: a failed
  // consent-info load (expired handle, rate limit, transient error) renders
  // the error alone, never the approve/deny controls.
  if (error && !info) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Authorize access">
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  const tools = Array.isArray(info.tools) ? info.tools : [];

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={ShieldCheck}
      title="Authorize access"
      subtitle={`${client} wants to access ${appName} on your behalf`}
    >
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-2">
        {tools.length ? `It will be able to use these tools in ${appName}:` : "No tools requested"}
      </p>
      {tools.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="space-y-2 text-sm mb-6">
          {tools.map((tool) => (
            <li key={tool.name} className="flex flex-col">
              <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
                {tool.title || tool.name}
              </span>
              {tool.description && (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{tool.description}</span>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="flex-1 h-12 font-medium"
          disabled={submitting}
          onClick={() => respond("deny")}
        >
          Deny
        </Button>
        <Button
          className="flex-1 h-12 font-medium"
          disabled={submitting}
          onClick={() => respond("approve")}
        >
          {submitting ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : null}
          Approve
        </Button>
      </div>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Pill } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, Check, Activity, Dumbbell, Apple, Moon, Target, TrendingUp, Heart, Brain, Calendar, Bell, ListChecks, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { calcBMR, calcTDEE, calcCalorieTarget, calcMacros } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';

const GOALS = ['Muscle Gain', 'Strength Gain', 'Fat Loss', 'Body Recomposition', 'Endurance', 'General Fitness'];
const EXPERIENCE = ['Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced'];
const SPLITS = ['Full Body', 'Upper Lower', 'Push Pull Legs', 'Push Pull', 'Bro Split'];
const ACTIVITY = [
  { v: 'sedentary', l: 'Sedentary', d: 'Little to no exercise' },
  { v: 'light', l: 'Light', d: 'Light exercise 1-3 days' },
  { v: 'moderate', l: 'Moderate', d: 'Exercise 3-5 days' },
  { v: 'active', l: 'Active', d: 'Hard exercise 6-7 days' },
  { v: 'very_active', l: 'Very Active', d: 'Physical job + training' },
];
const EQUIPMENT = ['Barbell', 'Dumbbells', 'Cables', 'Machines', 'Kettlebells', 'Bands', 'Bodyweight', 'Smith Machine'];

export default function Onboarding() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    age: '', sex: 'male', height_cm: '', weight_kg: '', goal_weight_kg: '',
    preferred_units: 'metric', activity_level: 'moderate', primary_goal: 'Body Recomposition',
    experience_level: 'Beginner', days_per_week: 4, preferred_split: 'Upper Lower',
    gym_or_home: 'gym', equipment: ['Barbell', 'Dumbbells'], session_duration_minutes: 60,
    dietary_preference: '', allergies: [], injury_history: '',
  });

  const totalSteps = 6;
  const set = (k, v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  const next = () => setStep((s) => Math.min(totalSteps - 1, s + 1));
  const back = () => setStep((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1));

  const toggleArray = (k, v) => setForm((f) => {
    const arr = f[k] || [];
    return { ...f, [k]: arr.includes(v) ? arr.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...arr, v] };
  });

  const finish = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const profileData = {
        ...form,
        age: Number(form.age), height_cm: Number(form.height_cm),
        weight_kg: Number(form.weight_kg), goal_weight_kg: Number(form.goal_weight_kg),
        days_per_week: Number(form.days_per_week),
        session_duration_minutes: Number(form.session_duration_minutes),
        onboarding_completed: true,
      };
      await base44.auth.updateMe(profileData);

      // Compute initial nutrition targets and create a Goal
      const bmr = calcBMR({ weightKg: profileData.weight_kg, heightCm: profileData.height_cm, age: profileData.age, sex: profileData.sex });
      const tdee = calcTDEE(bmr, profileData.activity_level);
      const calorieTarget = calcCalorieTarget(tdee, profileData.primary_goal, 'Moderate');
      const macros = calcMacros({ weightKg: profileData.weight_kg, calorieTarget, goal: profileData.primary_goal });
      if (calorieTarget && macros) {
        await base44.entities.Goal.create({
          primary_goal: profileData.primary_goal,
          phase: profileData.primary_goal === 'Fat Loss' ? 'Cutting' : profileData.primary_goal === 'Muscle Gain' ? 'Hypertrophy' : 'Recomposition',
          target_weight_kg: profileData.goal_weight_kg,
          rate_preference: 'Moderate',
          starting_weight_kg: profileData.weight_kg,
          calorie_target: calorieTarget,
          protein_target_g: macros.proteinG,
          carb_target_g: macros.carbG,
          fat_target_g: macros.fatG,
          fiber_target_g: macros.fiberG,
          water_target_ml: macros.waterMl,
          step_target: 8000,
          status: 'active',
        });
      }
      navigate('/');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const canProceed = () => {
    if (step === 0) return true;
    if (step === 1) return form.age && form.height_cm && form.weight_kg;
    if (step === 2) return form.primary_goal && form.experience_level;
    if (step === 3) return form.preferred_split && form.days_per_week;
    return true;
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen luxury-gradient flex flex-col">
      <div className="px-5 safe-pt pb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-6">
          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-luxury-blue/20 border border-luxury-blue/40 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-luxury-blue font-bold text-sm">63</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-widest uppercase">LRAZ 63</p>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Performance OS</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
          {Array.from({ length: totalSteps }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={cn('h-1 flex-1 rounded-full transition-all', i <= step ? 'bg-luxury-blue glow-blue' : 'bg-muted/40')} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 px-5 overflow-y-auto">
        {step === 0 && <FeaturesStep />}
        {step === 1 && <PersonalStep form={form} set={set} />}
        {step === 2 && <GoalStep form={form} set={set} />}
        {step === 3 && <TrainingStep form={form} set={set} toggleArray={toggleArray} />}
        {step === 4 && <NutritionStep form={form} set={set} toggleArray={toggleArray} />}
        {step === 5 && <ReviewStep form={form} />}
      </div>

      <div className="px-5 safe-pb pt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        {step > 0 && (
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={back} className="px-4" disabled={saving}>
            <ChevronLeft size={18} /> Back
          </Button>
        )}
        {step < totalSteps - 1 ? (
          <Button onClick={next} disabled={!canProceed()} className="flex-1 bg-luxury-blue hover:bg-luxury-blue/90 glow-blue">
            {step === 0 ? 'Get Started' : 'Continue'} <ChevronRight size={18} />
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button onClick={finish} disabled={saving} className="flex-1 bg-luxury-red hover:bg-luxury-red/90 glow-red">
            {saving ? 'Building your plan…' : <>Launch LRAZ 63 <Check size={18} /></>}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Shield, Download, Lock, Eye, Trash2, FileText, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';

export default function Privacy() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  const exportData = async () => {
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      const [
        measurements, workouts, sets, nutrition, cardio, goals, programs,
        scheduled, recovery, achievements, photos, foodItems, savedMeals,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 2000),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.Goal.list('-created_date', 100),
        base44.entities.TrainingProgram.list('-created_date', 100),
        base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.RecoveryRecord.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.Achievement.list('-created_date', 200),
        base44.entities.ProgressPhoto.list('-date', 500),
        base44.entities.FoodItem.list('-created_date', 500),
        base44.entities.SavedMeal.list('-created_date', 200),
      ]);
      const payload = {
        exported_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        app: 'LRAZ 63 Performance OS',
        body_measurements: measurements || [],
        workout_sessions: workouts || [],
        workout_sets: sets || [],
        nutrition_logs: nutrition || [],
        cardio_sessions: cardio || [],
        goals: goals || [],
        training_programs: programs || [],
        scheduled_workouts: scheduled || [],
        recovery_records: recovery || [],
        achievements: achievements || [],
        progress_photos: (photos || []).map((p) => ({ ...p, photo_url: '[private url omitted]' })),
        food_items: foodItems || [],
        saved_meals: savedMeals || [],
      };
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `lraz63-export-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
      a.click();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
      setDone(true); setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 2000);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setExporting(false); }
  };

  const csvCell = (v) => { const s = v == null ? '' : String(v); return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s; };
  const rowsToCsv = (rows, cols) => {
    if (!rows || !rows.length) return '';
    const keys = cols || Object.keys(rows[0]);
    const head = keys.map(csvCell).join(',');
    const body = rows.map((r) => keys.map((k) => csvCell(r[k])).join(',')).join('\n');
    return head + '\n' + body;
  };
  const exportCSV = async () => {
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      const [measurements, workouts, sets, nutrition, cardio] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 2000),
        base44.entities.NutritionLog.list('-date', 1000),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 1000),
      ]);
      const sections = [
        ['BODY_MEASUREMENTS', measurements || [], ['date', 'weight_kg', 'body_fat_percent', 'waist_cm', 'resting_hr']],
        ['WORKOUT_SESSIONS', workouts || [], ['date', 'name', 'focus', 'status', 'total_volume_kg', 'duration_minutes']],
        ['WORKOUT_SETS', sets || [], ['exercise_name', 'set_index', 'weight_kg', 'reps', 'rpe', 'estimated_1rm']],
        ['NUTRITION_LOGS', nutrition || [], ['date', 'meal', 'food_name', 'calories', 'protein_g', 'carbs_g', 'fat_g']],
        ['CARDIO_SESSIONS', cardio || [], ['date', 'activity_label', 'duration_seconds', 'distance_km', 'calories', 'heart_rate_avg']],
      ];
      const csv = sections.map(([title, rows, cols]) => `# ${title}\n${rowsToCsv(rows, cols)}`).join('\n\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = `lraz63-export-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`; a.click();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
      setDone(true); setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 2000);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setExporting(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
        <h1 className="font-semibold text-lg">Privacy & Data</h1>
        <div className="w-11" />
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-4 border-luxury-blue/30 bg-luxury-blue/5">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-2"><Lock size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Your Data Stays Yours</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">Every record you create — workouts, measurements, nutrition, photos, recovery — is stored privately and only visible to you. Nothing is shared with third parties or used for advertising.</p>
      </Card>

      <Card className="mb-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Eye size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Privacy Principles</p>
        <div className="space-y-2.5">
          <Principle icon={Lock} title="Private by default" desc="Body composition, measurements, and progress photos are sensitive and never exposed." />
          <Principle icon={Shield} title="No medical claims" desc="Body-fat, metabolic, and readiness values are estimates — not diagnoses." />
          <Principle icon={FileText} title="Full export" desc="Download every record you've entered at any time." />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card className="mb-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2"><Download size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Export Your Data</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Download a complete JSON backup of all your records (photo URLs are omitted for privacy).</p>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Button onClick={exportData} disabled={exporting} className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]">
            {exporting ? <><div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" /> Exporting…</> : <><Download size={18} /> {done ? 'Exported!' : 'Download Data (JSON)'}</>}
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={exportCSV} disabled={exporting} variant="outline" className="w-full glass min-h-[48px]">
            <Download size={18} /> Download Data (CSV)
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card className="mb-4 border-luxury-red/20">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-luxury-red"><Trash2 size={15} /> Delete Account</p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">Permanently erase your account and all associated data. This is irreversible.</p>
        <Button variant="outline" className="w-full border-luxury-red/40 text-luxury-red hover:bg-luxury-red/10 min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/profile')}>Go to Profile to Delete</Button>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function Principle({ icon: Icon, title, desc }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
      <Icon size={15} className="text-luxury-blue shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
      <div><p className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</p><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{desc}</p></div>
    </div>
  );
}

                  </Button>
                </AlertDialogTrigger>
                <AlertDialogContent className="max-w-md">
                  <AlertDialogHeader>
                    <AlertDialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-luxury-red"><AlertTriangle size={18} /> Delete Account Permanently?</AlertDialogTitle>
                    <AlertDialogDescription>
                      This will permanently erase all your data from LRAZ 63 — training programs, workout sessions, body measurements, nutrition logs, progress photos, recovery records, goals, and coaching history. This cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.
                    </AlertDialogDescription>
                  </AlertDialogHeader>
                  <ConfirmDelete user={user} onDone={() => logout()} />
                </AlertDialogContent>
              </AlertDialog>
            </Card>

            <Button variant="ghost" className="w-full text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => logout()}>
              <LogOut size={16} /> Sign Out
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ConfirmDelete({ user, onDone }) {
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const doDelete = async () => {
    setDeleting(true); setError('');
    try {
      const entities = ['WorkoutSet', 'WorkoutSession', 'TrainingProgram', 'BodyMeasurement', 'NutritionLog', 'RecoveryRecord', 'ProgressPhoto', 'Goal', 'CoachMessage', 'FoodItem'];
      for (const name of entities) {
        try { await base44.entities[name].deleteMany({}); } catch (e) { /* entity may not exist or be empty */ }
      }
      onDone();
    } catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Deletion failed'); }
    finally { setDeleting(false); }
  };

  return (
    <AlertDialogFooter className="flex-col gap-2">
      <Input
        value={confirm}
        onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Type DELETE"
        className="glass"
      />
      {error && <p className="text-xs text-luxury-red text-center">{error}</p>}
      <div className="flex gap-2 w-full">
        <AlertDialogCancel className="flex-1 min-h-[44px]" disabled={deleting}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
        <AlertDialogAction
          className="flex-1 min-h-[44px] bg-luxury-red text-white hover:bg-luxury-red/90"
          disabled={deleting || confirm !== 'DELETE'}
          onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); doDelete(); }}
        >
          {deleting ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete Forever'}
        </AlertDialogAction>
      </div>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  );
}

function Field({ label, editing, value, onChange }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
      <Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>
      {editing ? <Input value={value || ''} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className="glass" /> : <p className="text-sm font-medium">{value || '—'}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ icon: Icon, label, value }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Icon size={15} className="text-muted-foreground" /><span className="text-sm">{label}</span></div>
      <span className="text-sm font-medium">{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function SocialCard({ user }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(null);
  const [followers, setFollowers] = useState(0);
  const [following, setFollowing] = useState(0);

  const onAvatar = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !profile) return;
    try {
      const { file_url } = await base44.integrations.Core.UploadFile({ file });
      await base44.entities.SocialProfile.update(profile.id, { avatar_url: file_url });
      setProfile((p) => (p ? { ...p, avatar_url: file_url } : p));
      await base44.auth.updateMe({ avatar_url: file_url }).catch(() => {});
    } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
  };

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const p = await social.ensureMyProfile();
      setProfile(p);
      if (p) {
        const [fols, fing] = await Promise.all([social.listFollowers(p.user_id), social.listFollowing(p.user_id)]);
        setFollowers((fols || []).length);
        setFollowing((fing || []).length);
      }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  const togglePrivate = async (v) => {
    if (!profile) return;
    setProfile((p) => (p ? { ...p, is_private: v } : p));
    await base44.entities.SocialProfile.update(profile.id, { is_private: v }).catch(() => {});
  };

  if (!profile) return null;
  return (
    <Card className="mb-4">
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2"><Users size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Social</p>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full luxury-gradient flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-lg overflow-hidden shrink-0">
          {profile.avatar_url ? <img src={profile.avatar_url} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> : (profile.display_name || '?')[0]?.toUpperCase()}
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{profile.display_name}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate">@{profile.username || '—'}</p>
        </div>
        <label className="text-[11px] text-luxury-blue px-2 py-1 rounded-lg glass cursor-pointer min-h-[36px] flex items-center">
          Photo
          <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={onAvatar} />
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className="flex justify-around mb-3">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(`/social/${user?.id}/followers`)} className="text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-bold">{followers}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Followers</p>
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => navigate(`/social/${user?.id}/following`)} className="text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-bold">{following}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Following</p>
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/community')} className="text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-bold flex justify-center"><MessageCircle size={18} /></p>
          <p className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Community</p>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-border">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium">Private social profile</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Require approval for new followers.</p>
        </div>
        <Switch checked={!!profile.is_private} onCheckedChange={togglePrivate} />
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

function TemplateGenerator({ onDone }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState(null);
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState({ days_per_week: 4, session_duration_minutes: 60, split: 'Upper Lower', duration_weeks: 8 });
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) fitnessRecords('Goal', user.id, { status: 'active' }, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 1 }).then((g) => setGoal(g[0] || null));
  }, [user?.id]);

  const generate = () => {
    setError('');
    try { setPreview(generateProgram({ user, goal, preferences: prefs })); }
    catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Generation failed'); }
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true); setError('');
    try { await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.create({ ...preview, is_ai_generated: false }); recordsChanged('TrainingProgram'); onDone(); }
    catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Save failed'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/30">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <Layers size={18} className="text-luxury-blue" />
          <p className="font-semibold text-white">Template Program</p>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-white/70 mb-4">Builds a periodized program instantly from fixed, evidence-based templates scaled to your experience. No AI, no credits — fully editable after saving.</p>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <SelectField label="Split" value={prefs.split} options={SPLITS} onChange={(v) => setPrefs({ ...prefs, split: v })} />
          <SelectField label="Days per week" value={prefs.days_per_week} options={[2, 3, 4, 5, 6]} onChange={(v) => setPrefs({ ...prefs, days_per_week: Number(v) })} />
          <SelectField label="Session length (min)" value={prefs.session_duration_minutes} options={[30, 45, 60, 75, 90]} onChange={(v) => setPrefs({ ...prefs, session_duration_minutes: Number(v) })} />
          <SelectField label="Duration (weeks)" value={prefs.duration_weeks} options={[4, 6, 8, 12, 16]} onChange={(v) => setPrefs({ ...prefs, duration_weeks: Number(v) })} />
        </div>
      </Card>

      {!preview && <Button onClick={generate} className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]"><Layers size={16} /> Generate Program</Button>}
      {error && <p className="text-xs text-luxury-red text-center">{error}</p>}

      {preview && (
        <div className="space-y-3 animate-fade-up">
          <Card>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="font-semibold">{preview.name}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{preview.goal} · {preview.split} · {preview.days_per_week}d/wk · {preview.duration_weeks}w</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {preview.description && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">{preview.description}</p>}
          </Card>
          {preview.days?.map((d, i) => (
            <Card key={i} className="p-3">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1">{d.day_name} <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">· {d.focus}</span></p>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {d.exercises?.map((ex, j) => (
                  <div key={j} className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                    <span>{ex.exercise_name}</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{ex.sets}×{ex.reps_low}-{ex.reps_high}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}

            </Card>
          ))}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1 glass" onClick={() => setPreview(null)}>Regenerate</Button>
            <Button className="flex-1 bg-luxury-red glow-red" onClick={save} disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Save Program</>}</Button>

function ManualBuilder({ onDone }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '', description: '', goal: 'Hypertrophy', split: 'Upper Lower',
    days_per_week: 4, session_duration_minutes: 60, experience_level: 'Intermediate',
    duration_weeks: 8, phase: 'Hypertrophy', blocks: [], days: [{ day_name: 'Day 1', focus: '', exercises: [] }],
  });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const addDay = () => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, days: [...f.days, { day_name: `Day ${f.days.length + 1}`, focus: '', exercises: [] }] }));
  const updateDay = (i, day) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, days: f.days.map((d, j) => j === i ? day : d) }));
  const removeDay = (i) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, days: f.days.filter((_, j) => j !== i) }));

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true); setError('');
    try {
      const payload = { ...form, name: form.name.trim() || 'New Program', is_ai_generated: false };
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.create(payload);
      recordsChanged('TrainingProgram');
      onDone();
    }
    catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Save failed'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  const saveDraft = async () => {
    setSaving(true); setError('');
    try {
      const payload = { ...form, name: form.name.trim() || `Untitled Draft · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}`, is_ai_generated: false, draft: true, active: false };
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.create(payload);
      recordsChanged('TrainingProgram');
      onDone();
    }
    catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Save failed'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Program Name</Label>
            <Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Off-Season Strength Block" className="glass mt-1" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Description</Label>
            <Input value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} placeholder="Optional notes" className="glass mt-1" />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <SelectField label="Goal" value={form.goal} options={GOALS} onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, goal: v })} />
            <SelectField label="Split" value={form.split} options={SPLITS} onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, split: v })} />
            <SelectField label="Experience" value={form.experience_level} options={LEVELS} onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, experience_level: v })} />
            <SelectField label="Days/week" value={form.days_per_week} options={[2, 3, 4, 5, 6]} onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, days_per_week: Number(v) })} />
            <SelectField label="Session (min)" value={form.session_duration_minutes} options={[30, 45, 60, 75, 90]} onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, session_duration_minutes: Number(v) })} />
            <SelectField label="Weeks" value={form.duration_weeks} options={[4, 6, 8, 12, 16]} onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, duration_weeks: Number(v) })} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <MesocycleEditor blocks={form.blocks} onChange={(blocks) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, blocks }))} />

      {form.days.map((day, i) => (
        <DayEditor key={i} day={day} onChange={(d) => updateDay(i, d)} onRemove={form.days.length > 1 ? () => removeDay(i) : null} index={i} />
      ))}

      <Button variant="outline" className="w-full glass border-dashed min-h-[44px]" onClick={addDay}><Dumbbell size={15} /> Add Day</Button>

      {error && <p className="text-xs text-luxury-red text-center">{error}</p>}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={saveDraft} disabled={saving}><Save size={16} /> Save Draft</Button>
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving} className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]">{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Save</>}</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TextImporter({ onDone }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const parse = () => {
    setError('');
    if (!text.trim()) { setError('Paste your program text first'); return; }
    const program = parseProgramText(text);
    if (!program.days.some((d) => d.exercises.length)) { setError('No exercises found. Use lines like "Bench Press 4x6-8"'); return; }
    setPreview(program);
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true); setError('');
    try { await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.create({ ...preview, is_ai_generated: false, is_template: false }); recordsChanged('TrainingProgram'); onDone(); }
    catch (e) { setError(e.message || 'Save failed'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/30">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
          <FileUp size={18} className="text-luxury-blue" />
          <p className="font-semibold text-white">Import from Text</p>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-white/70 mb-3">Paste a program (from a coach, spreadsheet, or notes). Day headers on their own line (e.g. "Upper A:"), then exercises as "Name setsxreps" (e.g. "Bench Press 4x6-8"). Parsed locally — no AI.</p>
        <textarea value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder={'Upper A:\nBench Press 4x6-8\nBarbell Row 4x8-10\n\nLower A:\nBack Squat 5x5\nRomanian Deadlift 3x8-12'} rows={8} className="w-full rounded-xl glass border border-white/15 p-3 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-white/40" />
      </Card>

      {!preview && <Button onClick={parse} className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]"><FileUp size={16} /> Parse Program</Button>}
      {error && <p className="text-xs text-luxury-red text-center">{error}</p>}

      {preview && (
        <div className="space-y-3 animate-fade-up">
          <Card>
            <p className="font-semibold">{preview.name}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{preview.days?.length || 0} days parsed</p>
          </Card>
          {preview.days?.map((d, i) => (
            <Card key={i} className="p-3">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-1">{d.day_name}</p>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {d.exercises?.map((ex, j) => (
                  <div key={j} className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                    <span>{ex.exercise_name}</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{ex.sets}×{ex.reps_low}-{ex.reps_high}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1 glass" onClick={() => setPreview(null)}>Redo</Button>
            <Button className="flex-1 bg-luxury-red glow-red" onClick={save} disabled={saving}><Check size={16} /> Save</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SelectField({ label, value, options, onChange }) {
  return <ActionSelect label={label} value={value} options={options} onChange={onChange} />;
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { ArrowLeft, Dumbbell, Play, Trash2, Pencil, Copy, Archive, ArchiveRestore, Check, X, Plus, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Bookmark, Activity } from 'lucide-react';
import ExerciseVideo from '@/components/exercises/ExerciseVideo';
import DayEditor from '@/components/programs/DayEditor';
import ProgramProgress from '@/components/programs/ProgramProgress';
import { recordsChanged } from '@/lib/recordEditing';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';

export default function ProgramDetail() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [program, setProgram] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.entities.TrainingProgram.get(id)
      .then(setProgram).catch(() => setProgram(null)).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  const startEdit = () => { setDraft(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(program))); setEditing(true); };
  const cancelEdit = () => { setEditing(false); setDraft(null); };

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.update(id, { name: draft.name, description: draft.description, days: draft.days });
      recordsChanged('TrainingProgram');
      setProgram({ ...program, name: draft.name, description: draft.description, days: draft.days });
      setEditing(false);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  // Day management
  const updateDay = (i, day) => setDraft({ ...draft, days: draft.days.map((d, j) => j === i ? day : d) });
  const addDay = () => setDraft({ ...draft, days: [...(draft.days || []), { day_name: `Day ${(draft.days?.length || 0) + 1}`, focus: '', exercises: [] }] });
  const removeDay = (i) => setDraft({ ...draft, days: draft.days.filter((_, j) => j !== i) });
  const moveDay = (i, dir) => {
    const arr = [...draft.days]; const j = i + dir;
    if (j < 0 || j >= arr.length) return;
    [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
    setDraft({ ...draft, days: arr });
  };
  const duplicateDay = (i) => {
    const arr = [...draft.days];
    const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(arr[i])); copy.day_name = `${arr[i].day_name} Copy`;
    arr.splice(i + 1, 0, copy);
    setDraft({ ...draft, days: arr });
  };

  // Program actions
  const duplicate = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const { id: _omit, created_date: _c, updated_date: _u, created_by_id: _cb, ...rest } = program;
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.create({ ...rest, name: `${program.name} Copy`, active: false, archived: false, draft: false, start_date: undefined });
      recordsChanged('TrainingProgram');
      navigate('/train');
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const saveAsTemplate = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const { id: _omit, created_date: _c, updated_date: _u, created_by_id: _cb, ...rest } = program;
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.create({ ...rest, name: `Template: ${program.name}`, is_template: true, active: false, archived: false, draft: false, start_date: undefined });
      recordsChanged('TrainingProgram');
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const toggleArchive = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const archived = !program.archived;
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.update(id, { archived, active: archived ? false : program.active });
      recordsChanged('TrainingProgram');
      setProgram({ ...program, archived, active: archived ? false : program.active });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const activate = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      let result;
      do {
        result = await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.updateMany({ created_by_id: user.id, id: { $ne: id }, active: true }, { $set: { active: false } });
      } while (result.has_more);
      await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.update(id, { active: true, archived: false, draft: false });
      recordsChanged('TrainingProgram');
      setProgram({ ...program, active: true, archived: false, draft: false });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const remove = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.delete(id); recordsChanged('TrainingProgram'); navigate('/train'); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  if (!program) return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4">
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => navigate('/train')} className="min-h-[44px] mb-4"><ArrowLeft size={18} /> Train</Button>
      <EmptyState icon={Dumbbell} title="Program not found" description="This program may have been deleted." action={<Button className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue mt-4 min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/train')}>Back to Train</Button>} />
    </div>
  );

  const p = editing ? draft : program;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 pb-36">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-5">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => navigate('/train')} className="min-h-[44px]"><ArrowLeft size={18} /> Train</Button>
        {!editing && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={startEdit} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><Pencil size={16} /></Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={duplicate} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><Copy size={16} /></Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={saveAsTemplate} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2" title="Save as template"><Bookmark size={16} /></Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={toggleArchive} disabled={busy} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2">{program.archived ? <ArchiveRestore size={16} /> : <Archive size={16} />}</Button>
            <AlertDialog>
              <AlertDialogTrigger asChild><Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="text-luxury-red min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><Trash2 size={16} /></Button></AlertDialogTrigger>
              <AlertDialogContent className="max-w-md">
                <AlertDialogHeader>
                  <AlertDialogTitle>Delete program?</AlertDialogTitle>
                  <AlertDialogDescription>This removes the program. Completed workouts keep their original values and are not affected.</AlertDialogDescription>
                </AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogFooter>
                  <AlertDialogCancel className="min-h-[44px]">Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                  <AlertDialogAction className="bg-luxury-red text-white hover:bg-luxury-red/90 min-h-[44px]" disabled={busy} onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); remove(); }}>Delete</AlertDialogAction>
                </AlertDialogFooter>
              </AlertDialogContent>
            </AlertDialog>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Header card */}
      <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/30 mb-4">
        {editing ? (
          <>
            <Input value={draft.name} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, name: e.target.value })} className="glass h-10 text-base font-bold mb-2" />
            <Input value={draft.description || ''} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, description: e.target.value })} placeholder="Description" className="glass h-10 text-xs mb-2" />
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-white/60 tracking-wider uppercase">Program</p>
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">{program.name}</h1>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-1">
                {program.active && <span className="text-[9px] font-bold bg-luxury-blue text-white rounded-full px-2 py-0.5">ACTIVE</span>}
                {program.archived && <span className="text-[9px] font-bold bg-muted text-muted-foreground rounded-full px-2 py-0.5">ARCHIVED</span>}
              </div>
            </div>
            {program.description && <p className="text-xs text-white/70 mt-2 leading-relaxed">{program.description}</p>}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3">
              {[program.goal, program.split, `${program.days_per_week}d/wk`, `${program.duration_weeks}w`, program.experience_level, program.phase].filter(Boolean).map((t) => (
                <span key={t} className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white">{t}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </Card>

      {!editing && !program.archived && (
        <Button className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px] mb-4" onClick={() => navigate(program.days?.length ? `/workout/new?programId=${program.id}&dayIndex=0` : '/workout/new')}>
          <Play size={16} /> Start Workout
        </Button>
      )}

      {!editing && !program.active && !program.archived && (
        <Button variant="outline" className="w-full glass min-h-[44px] mb-4" onClick={activate} disabled={busy}><Check size={16} /> Set as Active Program</Button>
      )}

      {!editing && <ProgramProgress program={program} />}

      {/* Days */}
      {editing ? (
        <>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {(draft.days || []).map((d, i) => (
              <div key={i}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mb-1.5 px-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground flex-1">Day {i + 1}</span>
                  <button onClick={() => moveDay(i, -1)} disabled={i === 0} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30 min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><ChevronUp size={14} /></button>
                  <button onClick={() => moveDay(i, 1)} disabled={i === (draft.days.length - 1)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-30 min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><ChevronDown size={14} /></button>
                  <button onClick={() => duplicateDay(i)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue min-h-[40px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Copy size={13} /></button>
                </div>
                <DayEditor day={d} onChange={(day) => updateDay(i, day)} onRemove={draft.days.length > 1 ? () => removeDay(i) : null} index={i} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline" className="w-full glass border-dashed min-h-[44px] mt-3 mb-4" onClick={addDay}><Plus size={15} /> Add Day</Button>
          <div className="flex gap-2 sticky bottom-[calc(5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] md:bottom-4 bg-background py-2">
            <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1 glass min-h-[44px]" onClick={cancelEdit}><X size={16} /> Cancel</Button>
            <Button className="flex-1 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={save} disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Check size={16} /> Save</>}</Button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {(program.days || []).map((d, i) => (
            <Card key={i}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{d.day_name}</p>
                  {d.focus && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{d.focus}</p>}
                </div>
                <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[36px]" onClick={() => navigate(`/workout/new?programId=${program.id}&dayIndex=${i}`)}><Play size={13} /> Start</Button>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-0">
                {(d.exercises || []).map((ex, j) => (
                  <div key={j} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs py-2 border-t border-border/40 first:border-t-0">
                    <ExerciseVideo name={ex.exercise_name} compact />
                    <span className="font-medium flex-1">{ex.exercise_name}{ex.optional && <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground ml-1">(opt)</span>}</span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">{ex.sets}×{ex.reps_low}-{ex.reps_high}{ex.rir_target != null ? ` @${ex.rir_target}RIR` : ''}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {!d.exercises?.length && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground py-2">No exercises defined</p>}
                {d.cardio?.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="pt-2 mt-1 border-t border-border/40">
                    <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1 flex items-center gap-1"><Activity size={11} className="text-luxury-red" /> Cardio</p>
                    {d.cardio.map((c, j) => (
                      <div key={j} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-1">
                        <span className="font-medium flex-1">{c.activity_label}</span>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">{c.target_duration_minutes ? `${c.target_duration_minutes}min` : ''}{c.target_distance_km ? ` · ${c.target_distance_km}km` : ''}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
          {!program.days?.length && <EmptyState icon={Dumbbell} title="No training days" description="Tap the edit icon to add days and exercises." />}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Progress.jsx
