import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Card, Ring, Stat, ConfidenceBadge, EmptyState, Pill } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { LineChart, Line, ResponsiveContainer, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, CartesianGrid, Area, AreaChart } from 'recharts';
import { TrendingUp, Plus, X, Ruler, Award, Activity, Scale, Flame, Route, Clock, Trophy, Flag, Camera } from 'lucide-react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import ProgressPhotos from '@/components/progress/ProgressPhotos';
import MeasurementHistory from '@/components/progress/MeasurementHistory';
import PRTimeline from '@/components/progress/PRTimeline';
import { rollingAverage, trendDirection, weeklyRateOfChange, dataConfidence, calcBMI, navyBodyFat, fatMassLeanMass, calcFFMI, waistToHeight } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { ActionSelect } from '@/components/ui/action-select';
import { syncProfileFromMeasurement } from '@/lib/profileSync';
import { weeklyAggregates, detectCardioPRs, performanceComparison, formatDuration, formatDistance, formatPace } from '@/lib/cardioAnalytics';
import PullToRefresh from '@/components/PullToRefresh';

export default function Progress() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('body');
  const [measurements, setMeasurements] = useState([]);
  const [workouts, setWorkouts] = useState([]);
  const [achievements, setAchievements] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [logging, setLogging] = useState(false);
  const [cardio, setCardio] = useState([]);
  const [sets, setSets] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => { loadAll(); }, []);
  const loadAll = async () => {
    try {
      const [m, w, a, c, st] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 60),
        base44.entities.Achievement.list('-created_date', 50),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 500),
      ]);
      setMeasurements(m || []);
      setWorkouts(w || []);
      setAchievements(a || []);
      setCardio(c || []);
      setSets(st || []);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const sorted = useMemo(() => [...measurements].reverse(), [measurements]);
  const weights = sorted.map((m) => m.weight_kg).filter(Boolean);
  const latest = measurements[0];
  const trend = trendDirection(weights);
  const rate = weeklyRateOfChange(weights);
  const confidence = dataConfidence(weights.length);

  const chartData = useMemo(() => sorted.map((m, i) => ({
    date: new Date(m.date).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }),
    weight: m.weight_kg, bf: m.body_fat_percent, waist: m.waist_cm,
    avg7: rollingAverage(weights.slice(0, i + 1), 7),
  })), [sorted, weights]);

  if (loading) return <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <PullToRefresh onRefresh={loadAll}>
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-6 pb-36">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tracking-wider uppercase">Analytics</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">Progress</h1>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Link to="/goal-journey" className="min-h-[44px] px-3 rounded-md text-sm font-medium border border-input bg-transparent glass flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:bg-accent"><Flag size={15} className="text-luxury-blue" /> Journey</Link>
          <Button size="sm" className="bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => setLogging(true)}><Plus size={16} /> Log</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 mb-5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar -mx-1 px-1 pb-1">
        <Pill active={tab === 'body'} onClick={() => setTab('body')}>Body</Pill>
        <Pill active={tab === 'performance'} onClick={() => setTab('performance')}>Performance</Pill>
        <Pill active={tab === 'awards'} onClick={() => setTab('awards')}>Awards</Pill>
        <Pill active={tab === 'cardio'} onClick={() => setTab('cardio')}>Cardio</Pill>
        <Pill active={tab === 'photos'} onClick={() => setTab('photos')}><Camera size={12} className="mr-1" />Photos</Pill>
      </div>

      {tab === 'body' && (
        <BodyTab chartData={chartData} latest={latest} weights={weights} trend={trend} rate={rate} confidence={confidence} user={user} measurements={measurements} onRefresh={loadAll} />
      )}
      {tab === 'performance' && <PerformanceTab workouts={workouts} sets={sets} />}
      {tab === 'awards' && <AwardsTab achievements={achievements} />}
      {tab === 'cardio' && <CardioTab cardio={cardio} />}
      {tab === 'photos' && <ProgressPhotos />}

      {logging && <LogMeasurementSheet onClose={() => setLogging(false)} onSaved={(entry) => setMeasurements((m) => [entry, ...m])} user={user} />}
    </div>
    </PullToRefresh>
  );
}

function BodyTab({ chartData, latest, weights, trend, rate, confidence, user, measurements, onRefresh }) {
  const bmi = latest && user ? calcBMI(latest.weight_kg, user.height_cm) : null;
  const fm = latest ? fatMassLeanMass(latest.weight_kg, latest.body_fat_percent) : null;
  const ffmi = latest && user ? calcFFMI(latest.weight_kg, latest.body_fat_percent, user.height_cm) : null;
  const wth = latest && user ? waistToHeight(latest.waist_cm, user.height_cm) : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card className="luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/30">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">Weight Trend</p>
          <ConfidenceBadge level={confidence} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-end gap-4 mb-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-white tabular-nums">{latest?.weight_kg || '—'}<span className="text-base text-white/60 ml-1">kg</span></p>
            <p className="text-xs text-white/60">{trend === 'decreasing' ? '↓ decreasing' : trend === 'increasing' ? '↑ increasing' : '— stable'}</p>
          </div>
          {rate != null && <Stat label="Weekly Δ" value={`${rate > 0 ? '+' : ''}${rate}`} unit="kg" accent="red" />}
        </div>
        <div className="h-32 -mx-2">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <AreaChart data={chartData}>
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="wgrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="0%" stopColor="hsl(36 44% 59%)" stopOpacity={0.5} />
                  <stop offset="100%" stopColor="hsl(36 44% 59%)" stopOpacity={0} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              <CartesianGrid stroke="hsl(0 0% 20%)" strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
              <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} domain={['dataMin - 2', 'dataMax + 2']} />
              <Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: 'hsl(0 0% 11%)', border: '1px solid hsl(0 0% 20%)', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 12 }} />
              <Area type="monotone" dataKey="weight" stroke="hsl(36 44% 59%)" strokeWidth={2} fill="url(#wgrad)" dot={false} />
            </AreaChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card><Stat label="Body Fat" value={latest?.body_fat_percent ?? '—'} unit="%" accent="red" sub={latest?.body_fat_method || 'no data'} /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Fat Mass" value={fm?.fatMass ?? '—'} unit="kg" accent="blue" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Lean Mass" value={fm?.leanMass ?? '—'} unit="kg" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="BMI" value={bmi ?? '—'} /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="FFMI" value={ffmi ?? '—'} sub="estimate" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="W:H Ratio" value={wth ?? '—'} sub="waist/height" /></Card>
      </div>

      {latest?.body_fat_is_estimate && (
        <Card className="border-luxury-gold/30 bg-luxury-gold/5">
          <p className="text-xs text-luxury-gold leading-relaxed">
            <strong>Estimate notice:</strong> Body-fat values from circumference formulas or visual estimation are approximations, not clinical measurements. For accuracy, use DEXA, Bod Pod, or hydrostatic weighing.
          </p>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Composition Trend</p>
        <div className="h-32 -mx-2">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <LineChart data={chartData}>
              <CartesianGrid stroke="hsl(0 0% 20%)" strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
              <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
              <Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: 'hsl(0 0% 11%)', border: '1px solid hsl(0 0% 20%)', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 12 }} />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="bf" stroke="hsl(141 53% 53%)" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Body Fat %" />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="waist" stroke="hsl(36 44% 59%)" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Waist cm" />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <MeasurementHistory measurements={measurements} onRefresh={onRefresh} />
    </div>
  );
}

function PerformanceTab({ workouts, sets }) {
  const completed = workouts.filter((w) => w.status === 'completed');
  const totalVolume = completed.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.total_volume_kg || 0), 0);
  const totalPRs = completed.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.pr_count || 0), 0);
  const topE1RM = Math.max(0, ...completed.map((w) => w.estimated_1rm_top_set || 0));

  const chartData = completed.slice(0, 12).reverse().map((w) => ({
    date: new Date(w.date).toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }),
    volume: w.total_volume_kg || 0,
  }));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card><Stat label="Sessions" value={completed.length} accent="blue" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Total Volume" value={Math.round(totalVolume)} unit="kg" accent="red" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="PRs" value={totalPRs} /></Card>
      </div>
      <Card>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Training Volume</p>
        {chartData.length ? (
          <div className="h-40 -mx-2">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <AreaChart data={chartData}>
                <defs><linearGradient id="vgrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="hsl(141 53% 53%)" stopOpacity={0.5} /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="hsl(141 53% 53%)" stopOpacity={0} /></linearGradient></defs>
                <CartesianGrid stroke="hsl(0 0% 20%)" strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} />
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
                <Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: 'hsl(0 0% 11%)', border: '1px solid hsl(0 0% 20%)', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 12 }} />
                <Area type="monotone" dataKey="volume" stroke="hsl(141 53% 53%)" strokeWidth={2} fill="url(#vgrad)" />
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        ) : <EmptyState icon={Activity} title="No sessions yet" description="Log a workout to see performance trends." />}
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Top Estimated 1RM</p><p className="text-2xl font-bold text-luxury-red tabular-nums">{Math.round(topE1RM)}<span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-1">kg</span></p></div>
          <Scale size={32} className="text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>
      </Card>

      <PRTimeline sessions={workouts} sets={sets} />
    </div>
  );
}

function AwardsTab({ achievements }) {
  if (!achievements.length) return <EmptyState icon={Award} title="No achievements yet" description="Train, log, and stay consistent to unlock badges." />;
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
      {achievements.map((a) => (
        <Card key={a.id} className={cn('flex flex-col items-center text-center', a.unlocked && 'border-luxury-red/40')}>
          <div className={cn('w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-2', a.unlocked ? 'bg-luxury-red/15 text-luxury-red glow-red' : 'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground')}>
            <Award size={26} />
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{a.title}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{a.description}</p>
          <div className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted/30 mt-2 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="h-full bg-luxury-red transition-all" style={{ width: `${a.progress_percent || 0}%` }} />
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">{a.unlocked ? `+${a.xp_reward} XP · Unlocked` : `${Math.round(a.progress_percent || 0)}%`}</p>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function CardioTab({ cardio }) {
  const weeks = useMemo(() => weeklyAggregates(cardio, 12), [cardio]);
  const prs = useMemo(() => detectCardioPRs(cardio), [cardio]);
  const runComp = useMemo(() => performanceComparison(cardio, 'running'), [cardio]);
  const chartData = weeks.map((w) => ({ label: w.label, minutes: Math.round(w.seconds / 60), distance: +w.distance.toFixed(2), calories: Math.round(w.calories), sessions: w.sessions }));

  if (!cardio.length) return <EmptyState icon={Activity} title="No cardio yet" description="Start a cardio session to see time, distance, calories and PR trends here." />;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card><Stat label="Sessions" value={cardio.length} accent="blue" /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Total Time" value={formatDuration(cardio.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.duration_seconds || 0), 0))} /></Card>
        <Card><Stat label="Calories" value={Math.round(cardio.reduce((a, s) => a + (s.calories || 0), 0))} unit="kcal" accent="red" /></Card>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Cardio Time (weekly minutes)</p>

      </Card>

        <div className="h-40 -mx-2">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <LineChart data={chartData}>
              <CartesianGrid stroke="hsl(0 0% 20%)" strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
              <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
              <Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: 'hsl(0 0% 11%)', border: '1px solid hsl(0 0% 20%)', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 12 }} />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="distance" stroke="hsl(141 53% 53%)" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Distance km" />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-3">Cardio Calories (per week)</p>
        <div className="h-40 -mx-2">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <AreaChart data={chartData}>
              <defs><linearGradient id="ccal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="hsl(141 53% 53%)" stopOpacity={0.5} /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="hsl(141 53% 53%)" stopOpacity={0} /></linearGradient></defs>
              <CartesianGrid stroke="hsl(0 0% 20%)" strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
              <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: 'hsl(0 0% 63%)' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
              <Tooltip contentStyle={{ background: 'hsl(0 0% 11%)', border: '1px solid hsl(0 0% 20%)', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 12 }} />
              <Area type="monotone" dataKey="calories" stroke="hsl(141 53% 53%)" strokeWidth={2} fill="url(#ccal)" name="Calories" />
            </AreaChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">Calorie values are estimated (MET × weight × time) unless recorded from a machine or wearable. Estimates are not measurements.</p>
      </Card>

      {runComp && (

          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mb-2">Running Performance</p>

            <div><p className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Current pace</p><p className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums text-luxury-blue">{formatPace(runComp.currentPace)}/km</p><p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{formatDistance(runComp.currentDistance)} km</p></div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs mt-2 text-muted-foreground">{runComp.faster ? `${formatPace(Math.abs(runComp.improvement))}/km faster than your first session` : `${formatPace(Math.abs(runComp.improvement))}/km slower than your first session`}. Comparison uses average pace per session.</p>
        </Card>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3"><Trophy size={16} className="text-luxury-gold" /><p className="text-sm font-semibold">Cardio Personal Records</p></div>

            {prs.map((p) => (
              <div key={p.id} className="flex items-center justify-between">

                <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-gradient-blue">{p.display}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function LogMeasurementSheet({ onClose, onSaved, user }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ weight_kg: '', body_fat_percent: '', body_fat_method: 'Calipers', waist_cm: '', hip_cm: '', neck_cm: '', notes: '' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const set = (k, v) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const data = { date: new Date().toISOString(), ...form };
      ['weight_kg', 'body_fat_percent', 'waist_cm', 'hip_cm', 'neck_cm'].forEach((k) => (data[k] = data[k] ? Number(data[k]) : undefined));
      // Auto-estimate body fat from Navy method if waist/neck available and no BF entered
      if (!data.body_fat_percent && data.waist_cm && data.neck_cm && user?.height_cm) {
        const est = navyBodyFat({ sex: user.sex, heightCm: user.height_cm, neckCm: data.neck_cm, waistCm: data.waist_cm, hipCm: data.hip_cm });
        if (est) { data.body_fat_percent = est; data.body_fat_method = 'Circumference Estimate'; data.body_fat_is_estimate = true; data.body_fat_confidence = 'Moderate'; }
      } else if (data.body_fat_percent) {
        data.body_fat_is_estimate = !['DEXA', 'Bod Pod', 'Hydrostatic'].includes(data.body_fat_method);
        data.body_fat_confidence = data.body_fat_is_estimate ? 'Moderate' : 'High';
      }
      // Optimistic: append immediately, persist behind the scenes
      onSaved({ ...data, id: `tmp-${Date.now()}` });
      onClose();
      await base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.create(data);
      await syncProfileFromMeasurement(data, user);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto animate-fade-up">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Ruler size={18} className="text-luxury-blue" /><h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Log Measurement</h3></div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px]"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <Field label="Weight (kg)"><Input type="number" value={form.weight_kg} onChange={(e) => set('weight_kg', e.target.value)} placeholder="82.0" /></Field>
          <Field label="Body Fat (%)"><Input type="number" value={form.body_fat_percent} onChange={(e) => set('body_fat_percent', e.target.value)} placeholder="optional" /></Field>
          <Field label="Waist (cm)"><Input type="number" value={form.waist_cm} onChange={(e) => set('waist_cm', e.target.value)} placeholder="optional" /></Field>
          <Field label="Neck (cm)"><Input type="number" value={form.neck_cm} onChange={(e) => set('neck_cm', e.target.value)} placeholder="optional" /></Field>
          <Field label="Hip (cm)"><Input type="number" value={form.hip_cm} onChange={(e) => set('hip_cm', e.target.value)} placeholder="optional" /></Field>
          <Field label="BF Method">
            <ActionSelect
              value={form.body_fat_method}
              options={['DEXA', 'Bod Pod', 'Hydrostatic', 'Calipers', 'BIA', 'Circumference Estimate', 'Visual Estimate', 'User Entered']}
              onChange={(v) => set('body_fat_method', v)}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <Field label="Notes"><Input value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="morning, fasted…" /></Field>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-3">Leave body fat blank to auto-estimate from circumferences (Navy method). Estimates are clearly labeled and never replace a measured value.</p>
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving || !form.weight_kg} className="w-full mt-4 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]">{saving ? 'Saving…' : 'Save Measurement'}</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({ label, children }) {
  return (<div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</Label>{children}</div>);
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { UserPlus, Mail, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot } from "@/components/ui/input-otp";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { toast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";
import { safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/authReturnTo";

export default function Register() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showOtp, setShowOtp] = useState(false);
  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.register({ email, password });
      setShowOtp(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Registration failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await base44.auth.verifyOtp({ email, otpCode });
      if (result?.access_token) {
        base44.auth.setToken(result.access_token);
      }
      window.location.href = safeReturnTo();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Invalid verification code");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResend = async () => {
    setError("");
    try {
      await base44.auth.resendOtp(email);
      toast({
        title: "Code sent",
        description: "Check your email for the new code.",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to resend code");
    }
  };

  const handleGoogle = () => {
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", safeReturnTo());
  };

  if (showOtp) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={Mail}
        title="Verify your email"
        subtitle={`We sent a code to ${email}`}
      >
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
          <InputOTP
            maxLength={6}
            value={otpCode}
            onChange={setOtpCode}
            autoFocus
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
          >
            <InputOTPGroup>
              <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
            </InputOTPGroup>
          </InputOTP>
        </div>
        <Button
          className="w-full h-12 font-medium"
          onClick={handleVerify}
          disabled={loading || otpCode.length < 6}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Verifying...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Verify"
          )}
        </Button>
        <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-4">
          Didn't receive the code?{" "}
          <button onClick={handleResend} className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline">
            Resend
          </button>
        </p>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={UserPlus}
      title="Create your account"
      subtitle="Sign up to get started"
      footer={
        <>
          Already have an account?{" "}
          <Link
            to={"/login" + (safeReturnTo() !== "/" ? "?returnTo=" + encodeURIComponent(safeReturnTo()) : "")}
            className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline"
          >
            Log in
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        className="w-full h-12 text-sm font-medium mb-6"
        onClick={handleGoogle}
      >
        <GoogleIcon className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
        Continue with Google
      </Button>

      <div className="relative mb-6">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
          <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
        </div>
        <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
          <span className="bg-card px-3 text-muted-foreground">or</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="confirm">Confirm Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Creating account...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Create account"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Lock, Loader2, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";

export default function ResetPassword() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const resetToken = searchParams.get("token");

  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.resetPassword({ resetToken, newPassword });
      window.location.href = "/login";
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to reset password");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!resetToken) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={AlertTriangle}
        title="Invalid reset link"
        subtitle="This password reset link is missing or invalid"
        footer={
          <Link to="/forgot-password" className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline">
            Request a new link
          </Link>
        }
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-foreground text-center">
          The link you used appears to be incomplete. Please request a new password reset email.
        </p>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={Lock}
      title="New password"
      subtitle="Enter your new password below"
    >
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="password">New Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={newPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="confirm">Confirm Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Resetting...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Reset password"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { EXERCISES } from '@/lib/exerciseDatabase';
import { FOODS } from '@/lib/foodDatabase';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Search as SearchIcon, Dumbbell, Apple, Calendar, ArrowLeft, X, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function Search() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('exercises');
  const [programs, setPrograms] = useState([]);
  const [favs, setFavs] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.entities.TrainingProgram.list('-created_date', 100).then((p) => setPrograms(p || [])).catch(() => {});
    base44.entities.Favorite.list('-created_date', 500).then((f) => {
      const m = {}; (f || []).forEach((x) => { m[`${x.type}:${x.ref_id}`] = x; }); setFavs(m);
    }).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const toggleFav = async (type, ref_id, name, subtitle) => {
    const key = `${type}:${ref_id}`;
    if (favs[key]) {
      try { await base44.entities.Favorite.delete(favs[key].id); setFavs((p) => { const n = { ...p }; delete n[key]; return n; }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    } else {
      try { const created = await base44.entities.Favorite.create({ type, ref_id, name, subtitle, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }); setFavs((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: created })); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    }
  };

  const query = q.toLowerCase().trim();

  const exResults = useMemo(() => {
    if (!query) return [];
    return EXERCISES.filter((e) => `${e.name} ${e.primary_muscle} ${e.muscle_group} ${(e.equipment || []).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)).slice(0, 30);
  }, [query]);

  const foodResults = useMemo(() => {
    if (!query) return [];
    return FOODS.filter((f) => `${f.name} ${f.category}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)).slice(0, 30);
  }, [query]);

  const progResults = useMemo(() => {
    if (!query) return [];
    return programs.filter((p) => (p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(query)).slice(0, 20);
  }, [query, programs]);

  const tabs = [
    { key: 'exercises', label: 'Exercises', icon: Dumbbell, count: exResults.length },
    { key: 'foods', label: 'Foods', icon: Apple, count: foodResults.length },
    { key: 'programs', label: 'Programs', icon: Calendar, count: progResults.length },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
        <h1 className="font-semibold text-lg">Search</h1>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mb-3">
        <SearchIcon size={18} className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <input
          autoFocus
          value={q}
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search exercises, foods, programs…"
          className="w-full glass rounded-xl pl-10 pr-10 py-3 text-sm outline-none min-h-[48px] focus:border-luxury-blue/50"
        />
        {q && <button onClick={() => setQ('')} className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"><X size={16} /></button>}
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button key={t.key} onClick={() => setTab(t.key)} className={cn(
            'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-all min-h-[40px]',
            tab === t.key ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground'
          )}>
            <t.icon size={14} /> {t.label} {t.count > 0 && <span className="opacity-70">{t.count}</span>}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {!query && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-10">Start typing to search across the exercise library, food database, and your programs.</p>}

      {query && tab === 'exercises' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {exResults.length === 0 && <Empty />}
          {exResults.map((e) => (
            <Card key={e.slug} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button onClick={() => navigate(`/exercise-history?name=${encodeURIComponent(e.name)}`)} className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-luxury-blue/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Dumbbell size={18} className="text-luxury-blue" /></div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{e.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{e.muscle_group} · {(e.equipment || []).join(', ')}</p>
                </div>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => toggleFav('exercise', e.slug, e.name, `${e.muscle_group}`)} className={cn('min-h-[44px] min-w-[40px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0', favs[`exercise:${e.slug}`] ? 'text-luxury-gold' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                <Star size={18} fill={favs[`exercise:${e.slug}`] ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} />
              </button>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {query && tab === 'foods' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {foodResults.length === 0 && <Empty />}
          {foodResults.map((f, i) => (
            <Card key={i} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button onClick={() => navigate('/nutrition')} className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-0 text-left">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-luxury-red/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Apple size={18} className="text-luxury-red" /></div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{f.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{f.category} · {f.calories} kcal · {f.protein_g}g protein</p>
                </div>
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => toggleFav('food', f.name, f.name, f.category)} className={cn('min-h-[44px] min-w-[40px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0', favs[`food:${f.name}`] ? 'text-luxury-gold' : 'text-muted-foreground')}>
                <Star size={18} fill={favs[`food:${f.name}`] ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} />
              </button>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {query && tab === 'programs' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {progResults.length === 0 && <Empty />}
          {progResults.map((p) => (
            <button key={p.id} onClick={() => navigate(`/program/${p.id}`)} className="w-full text-left">
              <Card className="flex items-center gap-3 active:scale-[0.99] transition-transform">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-luxury-blue/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"><Calendar size={18} className="text-luxury-blue" /></div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">{p.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{p.goal} · {p.split} · {p.days_per_week}d/wk</p>
                </div>
              </Card>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/ShareProfile.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import html2canvas from 'html2canvas';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Share2, Download, ArrowLeft, Trophy, Dumbbell, Flame, Activity, Target, Award, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { estimate1RM } from '@/lib/fitnessScience';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function ShareProfile() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const cardRef = useRef(null);
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [sharing, setSharing] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [goals, meas, workouts, ach, cardio, sets] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.Goal.list('-created_date', 1),
        base44.entities.BodyMeasurement.list('-date', 1),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSession.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.Achievement.list('-created_date', 50),
        base44.entities.CardioSession.list('-date', 200),
        base44.entities.WorkoutSet.list('-created_date', 500),
      ]);
      const completed = (workouts || []).filter((w) => w.status === 'completed');
      const totalVolume = completed.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.total_volume_kg || 0), 0);
      const prCount = completed.reduce((a, w) => a + (w.pr_count || 0), 0);

      // top lifts by e1RM
      const liftMap = {};
      (sets || []).forEach((s) => {
        if (!s.weight_kg || !s.reps || !s.exercise_name) return;
        const e = estimate1RM(s.weight_kg, s.reps);
        if (!liftMap[s.exercise_name] || e > liftMap[s.exercise_name].e1rm) liftMap[s.exercise_name] = { e1rm: e, weight: s.weight_kg, reps: s.reps };
      });
      const topLifts = Object.entries(liftMap).map(([name, v]) => ({ name, ...v })).sort((a, b) => b.e1rm - a.e1rm).slice(0, 3);

      const unlocked = (ach || []).filter((a) => a.unlocked).slice(0, 4);

      setData({
        goal: goals?.[0],
        latest: meas?.[0],
        sessions: completed.length,
        totalVolume: Math.round(totalVolume),
        prCount,
        cardioSessions: (cardio || []).length,
        topLifts,
        achievements: unlocked,
      });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const initials = (user?.full_name || user?.email || 'A').split(' ').map((s) => s[0]).slice(0, 2).join('').toUpperCase();

  const shareImage = async () => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    setSharing(true);
    try {
      const canvas = await html2canvas(cardRef.current, { backgroundColor: '#0a0a12', scale: 2, useCORS: true });
      canvas.toBlob(async (blob) => {
        if (!blob) return;
        const file = new File([blob], 'lraz-profile.png', { type: 'image/png' });
        if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) {
          try { await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'LRAZ 63 Profile', text: 'My performance profile' }); } catch (e) {}
        } else {
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = url; a.download = 'lraz-profile.png'; a.click();
          setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
        }
      });
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setSharing(false); }
  };

  const copyLink = () => {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(window.location.href);
    setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
  };

  if (!data) return <div className="flex justify-center py-20"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  const isPrivate = !!user?.profile_private;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
        <h1 className="font-semibold text-lg">Share Profile</h1>
        <div className="w-11" />
      </div>

      {/* Shareable card */}
      <div ref={cardRef} className="rounded-3xl overflow-hidden luxury-gradient border border-luxury-blue/30 p-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-luxury-blue/20 border border-luxury-blue/40 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl font-bold text-white">{initials}</div>
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-white truncate">{user?.full_name || 'Athlete'}</p>
            {!isPrivate && <p className="text-xs text-white/70">{data.goal?.primary_goal || 'Performance'} · {user?.experience_level || 'Athlete'}</p>}
            {isPrivate && <p className="text-xs text-white/50 flex items-center gap-1"><Lock size={10} /> Private Profile</p>}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-widest text-luxury-gold bg-luxury-gold/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-full">LRAZ 63</span>
        </div>

        {!isPrivate && (
          <>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-4">
              <StatTile icon={Activity} label="Sessions" value={data.sessions} />
              <StatTile icon={Dumbbell} label="Volume kg" value={data.totalVolume} />
              <StatTile icon={Trophy} label="PRs" value={data.prCount} />
              <StatTile icon={Flame} label="Cardio" value={data.cardioSessions} />
              <StatTile icon={Target} label="Weight" value={data.latest?.weight_kg ? `${data.latest.weight_kg}kg` : '—'} />
              <StatTile icon={Target} label="Body Fat" value={data.latest?.body_fat_percent != null ? `${data.latest.body_fat_percent}%` : '—'} />
            </div>

            {data.topLifts.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-4">
                <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-white/60 mb-2">Top Lifts (est. 1RM)</p>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {data.topLifts.map((l) => (
                    <div key={l.name} className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white/5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
                      <span className="text-sm text-white font-medium truncate">{l.name}</span>
                      <span className="text-sm font-bold text-luxury-gold tabular-nums">{Math.round(l.e1rm)}kg</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {data.achievements.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mb-4">
                {data.achievements.map((a) => (
                  <span key={a.id} className="text-[10px] font-medium bg-luxury-red/15 text-luxury-red px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1"><Award size={10} /> {a.title}</span>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}

        <p className="text-[9px] text-white/40 text-center">LRAZ 63 · Performance OS · {new Date().toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}</p>
      </div>

      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground text-center mt-3 mb-4">Share your profile card as an image to post anywhere, or copy a link to this page.</p>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Button onClick={shareImage} disabled={sharing} className="w-full bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[48px]">
          {sharing ? <><div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" /> Generating…</> : <><Share2 size={18} /> Share as Image</>}
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={copyLink} variant="outline" className="w-full min-h-[48px]">
          <Download size={16} /> {copied ? 'Link Copied!' : 'Copy Link'}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatTile({ icon: Icon, label, value }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white/5 rounded-xl p-2.5 border border-white/10">
      <Icon size={13} className="text-luxury-blue mb-1" />
      <p className="text-lg font-bold text-white tabular-nums leading-none">{value}</p>
      <p className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-white/50 mt-1">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState, Suspense, lazy } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { BookOpen, Layers, History, Plus, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
const TodayView = lazy(() => import('@/components/train/TodayView'));

export default function Train() {
  const [programs, setPrograms] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => { loadPrograms(); }, []);

  const loadPrograms = async () => {
    try {
      const progs = await base44.entities.TrainingProgram.filter({}, { sort: '-created_date', limit: 50 });
      setPrograms(progs.items);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const hasProgram = programs.some((p) => !p.archived && !p.draft);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-6 pb-36">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-6">Train</h1>

      {/* Hero — Today's Workout */}
      <Suspense fallback={<div className="py-16 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading today's training…</div>}>
        <TodayView programs={programs} />
      </Suspense>

      {/* Navigation Tiles */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mt-5">
        <NavTile icon={BookOpen} label="Exercises" onClick={() => navigate('/exercises')} />
        <NavTile icon={Layers} label="Programs" onClick={() => navigate('/program/new?mode=templates')} />

      </div>

      {/* Secondary Actions */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-3">
        <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[52px] font-medium" onClick={() => navigate('/workout/new')}><Plus size={18} /> Quick Log</Button>
        <Button variant="outline" className="glass min-h-[52px] font-medium" onClick={() => navigate('/calendar')}><Calendar size={18} /> Calendar</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center"><Icon size={20} /></div>
      <span className="text-xs font-medium">{label}</span>

  );

FILE: src/pages/UserProfile.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import { ArrowLeft, Lock, MessageCircle, Check, Clock, Dumbbell, Trophy, Activity, Flame, Target } from 'lucide-react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import * as social from '@/lib/social';
import { refreshMyTrainingStats } from '@/lib/activityFeed';

export default function UserProfile() {
  const { userId } = useParams();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(null);
  const [follow, setFollow] = useState(null);
  const [followers, setFollowers] = useState(0);
  const [following, setFollowing] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState(false);

  const load = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const myProfile = await social.ensureMyProfile();
      setMe(myProfile);
      const p = await social.getProfile(userId);
      setProfile(p);
      if (p) {
        const [f, fols, fing] = await Promise.all([
          myProfile ? social.getFollow(myProfile.user_id, p.user_id) : Promise.resolve(null),
          social.listFollowers(p.user_id),
          social.listFollowing(p.user_id),
        ]);
        setFollow(f);
        setFollowers((fols || []).length);
        setFollowing((fing || []).length);
      }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [userId]);

  const isMe = userId === user?.id;
  const canViewPrivate = !profile?.is_private || isMe || follow?.status === 'accepted';
  const showStats = profile?.share_training_stats && canViewPrivate;

  const doFollow = async () => { if (!profile || !me) return; const f = await social.followUser(profile, me); setFollow(f); };
  const doUnfollow = async () => { if (!profile || !me) return; await social.unfollowUser(profile, me); setFollow(null); };
  const doCancel = async () => { if (!profile || !me) return; await social.cancelRequest(profile, me); setFollow(null); };
  const message = async () => {
    if (!profile || !me) return;
    const conv = await social.createOrGetConversation(profile.user_id, me.display_name, profile.display_name);
    navigate(`/messages/${conv.id}`);
  };

  const toggleShareStats = async () => {
    if (!profile || !isMe) return;
    setToggling(true);
    const next = !profile.share_training_stats;
    setProfile({ ...profile, share_training_stats: next });
    try {
      await base44.entities.SocialProfile.update(profile.id, { share_training_stats: next });
      if (next) await refreshMyTrainingStats();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setToggling(false); }
  };

  const toggleShareFeed = async () => {
    if (!profile || !isMe) return;
    setToggling(true);
    const next = !profile.share_to_feed;
    setProfile({ ...profile, share_to_feed: next });
    try { await base44.entities.SocialProfile.update(profile.id, { share_to_feed: next }); }
    catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    finally { setToggling(false); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center"><div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;
  if (!profile) return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px]"><ArrowLeft size={18} /> Back</Button>
      <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground mt-10">Profile not found.</p>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] flex items-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground mb-3"><ArrowLeft size={18} /> Back</button>
      <Card className="text-center mb-4">
        <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full luxury-gradient mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-2xl mb-3 overflow-hidden">
          {profile.avatar_url ? <img src={profile.avatar_url} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> : (profile.display_name || '?')[0]?.toUpperCase()}
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">{profile.display_name}</h1>
        {profile.username && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">@{profile.username}</p>}
        {profile.is_private && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mt-1"><Lock size={11} /> Private profile</p>}
        {canViewPrivate && profile.bio && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2">{profile.bio}</p>}
        {!canViewPrivate && profile.is_private && !isMe && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">Follow to see this athlete's bio.</p>}
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-6 mt-4">
          <button onClick={() => navigate(`/social/${profile.user_id}/followers`)} className="text-center">
            <p className="text-lg font-bold">{followers}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Followers</p>
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => navigate(`/social/${profile.user_id}/following`)} className="text-center">
            <p className="text-lg font-bold">{following}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase text-muted-foreground">Following</p>
          </button>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {showStats && (
        <Card className="mb-4">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-3">Training Stats</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <StatItem icon={Dumbbell} label="Workouts" value={profile.public_workout_count || 0} color="text-luxury-blue" />
            <StatItem icon={Trophy} label="PRs" value={profile.public_pr_count || 0} color="text-luxury-gold" />
            <StatItem icon={Activity} label="Cardio" value={profile.public_cardio_count || 0} color="text-luxury-red" />
            <StatItem icon={Flame} label="Volume kg" value={Math.round(profile.public_total_volume || 0)} />
            <StatItem icon={Target} label="Streak" value={profile.public_streak || 0} unit="days" color="text-luxury-blue" />
          </div>
          {profile.public_goal && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-3 text-center">Goal: {profile.public_goal}</p>}
        </Card>
      )}

      {isMe && (
        <Card className="mb-4">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-3">Privacy & Sharing</p>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">Share training stats</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Show workout count, PRs, volume on your profile</p>
              </div>
              <Switch checked={!!profile.share_training_stats} onCheckedChange={toggleShareStats} disabled={toggling} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">Post to community feed</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Auto-share workouts, PRs, and milestones</p>
              </div>
              <Switch checked={!!profile.share_to_feed} onCheckedChange={toggleShareFeed} disabled={toggling} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-3">Body measurements, progress photos, and nutrition data are never shared — only aggregate training stats you choose.</p>
        </Card>
      )}

      {!isMe ? (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {!follow ? (
            <Button className="flex-1 bg-luxury-blue min-h-[44px]" onClick={doFollow}>{profile.is_private ? 'Request to Follow' : 'Follow'}</Button>
          ) : follow.status === 'pending' ? (
            <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1 min-h-[44px]" onClick={doCancel}><Clock size={16} /> Requested</Button>
          ) : (
            <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1 min-h-[44px]" onClick={doUnfollow}><Check size={16} /> Following</Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1 min-h-[44px]" onClick={message}><MessageCircle size={16} /> Message</Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Button variant="outline" className="w-full min-h-[44px]" onClick={() => navigate('/profile')}>Edit my profile</Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatItem({ icon: Icon, label, value, unit, color }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
      <Icon size={16} className={color || 'text-muted-foreground'} />
      <p className="text-base font-bold tabular-nums mt-1">{value}{unit && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-0.5">{unit}</span>}</p>
      <p className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { Card, EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/fitness';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { ArrowLeft, Plus, X, Check, Calendar, Dumbbell, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const dayNames = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];
const dateStr = (d) => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

export default function WeeklyPlan() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [week, setWeek] = useState([]);
  const [scheduled, setScheduled] = useState([]);
  const [program, setProgram] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [addingFor, setAddingFor] = useState(null); // date string

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [progs, sched] = await Promise.all([
        base44.entities.TrainingProgram.list('-created_date', 50),
        base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.list('-date', 100),
      ]);
      setScheduled(sched || []);
      setProgram((progs || []).find((p) => p.active && !p.archived) || null);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const start = new Date(); start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => { const d = new Date(start); d.setDate(start.getDate() + i); return d; });
    setWeek(days);
  }, []);

  const byDate = useMemo(() => {
    const m = {};
    (scheduled || []).forEach((s) => { (m[s.date] = m[s.date] || []).push(s); });
    return m;
  }, [scheduled]);

  const toggleDone = async (s) => {
    try {
      const updated = await base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.update(s.id, { completed: !s.completed });
      setScheduled((p) => p.map((x) => (x.id === s.id ? updated : x)));
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  const remove = async (s) => {
    try { await base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.delete(s.id); setScheduled((p) => p.filter((x) => x.id !== s.id)); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex justify-center py-20"><div className="w-7 h-7 border-4 border-luxury-blue/30 border-t-luxury-blue rounded-full animate-spin" /></div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen safe-pt px-4 pb-36 max-w-md mx-auto">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"><ArrowLeft size={22} /></button>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">This Week</h1>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Plan your next 7 days</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {program && <Card className="mb-3 border-luxury-blue/20 bg-luxury-blue/5"><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Active Program</p><p className="text-sm font-semibold">{program.name}</p></Card>}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        {week.map((d) => {
          const ds = dateStr(d);
          const items = byDate[ds] || [];
          const isToday = ds === dateStr(new Date());
          return (
            <div key={ds}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5 px-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className={cn('text-xs font-bold uppercase w-9 text-center py-1 rounded-lg', isToday ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>{dayNames[d.getDay()]}</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium">{d.toLocaleDateString('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}{isToday && <span className="text-[10px] text-luxury-blue ml-1">Today</span>}</span>
                </div>
                <button onClick={() => setAddingFor(ds)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-blue min-h-[36px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center"><Plus size={18} /></button>
              </div>
              {items.length === 0 ? (
                <button onClick={() => setAddingFor(ds)} className="w-full glass rounded-xl py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground min-h-[44px]">+ Schedule a workout</button>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {items.map((s) => (
                    <Card key={s.id} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 py-2.5">
                      <button onClick={() => toggleDone(s)} className={cn('w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 min-h-[36px]', s.completed ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass border border-border text-muted-foreground')}><Check size={16} strokeWidth={s.completed ? 3 : 2} /></button>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className={cn('text-sm font-semibold truncate', s.completed && 'line-through text-muted-foreground')}>{s.title}</p>
                        {s.focus && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{s.focus}</p>}
                      </div>
                      <button onClick={() => remove(s)} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-luxury-red min-h-[36px] min-w-[32px] flex items-center justify-center"><X size={14} /></button>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {addingFor && <AddSheet date={addingFor} program={program} onClose={() => setAddingFor(null)} onSaved={() => { setAddingFor(null); load(); }} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function AddSheet({ date, program, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState('');
  const [dayIdx, setDayIdx] = useState(-1);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const pickProgramDay = (idx) => {
    setDayIdx(idx);
    const day = program?.days?.[idx];
    if (day) { setTitle(day.day_name || `${program.name} — Day ${idx + 1}`); setFocus(day.focus || ''); }
  };

  const save = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = { date, title: title || 'Workout', focus, completed: false, source: dayIdx >= 0 ? 'program' : 'manual' };
      if (dayIdx >= 0 && program) { payload.program_id = program.id; payload.day_index = dayIdx; payload.program_day_name = program.days[dayIdx]?.day_name; }
      await base44.entities.ScheduledWorkout.create(payload);
      onSaved();
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); } finally { setSaving(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md glass-strong rounded-t-3xl p-5 animate-fade-up safe-pb max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-lg">Schedule for {new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}</h3>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] p-2"><X size={18} /></Button>
        </div>

        {program?.days?.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mb-4">
            <Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2 block">From {program.name}</Label>
            <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1">
              {program.days.map((d, i) => (
                <button key={i} onClick={() => pickProgramDay(i)} className={cn('px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap min-h-[40px]', dayIdx === i ? 'bg-luxury-blue text-white' : 'glass text-muted-foreground')}>{d.day_name || `Day ${i + 1}`}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Title</Label><Input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Push Day" /></div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><Label className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">Focus (optional)</Label><Input value={focus} onChange={(e) => setFocus(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Chest, Shoulders, Triceps" /></div>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving || !title} className="w-full mt-4 bg-luxury-blue glow-blue min-h-[44px]">{saving ? 'Saving…' : <><Calendar size={16} /> Schedule</>}</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
